1.he: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי־הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר ׀ לֹ֥א הָלַךְ֮ בַּעֲצַ֪ת רְשָׁ֫עִ֥ים וּבְדֶ֣רֶךְ חַ֭טָּאִים לֹ֥א עָמָ֑ד וּבְמוֹשַׁ֥ב לֵ֝צִ֗ים לֹ֣א יָשָֽׁב׃

lines.text: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;
O the happiness of that one, who Hath not walked in the counsel of the wicked. And in the way of sinners hath not stood, And in the seat of scorners hath not sat;

1.he: כִּ֤י אִ֥ם בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָ֗ה חֶ֫פְצ֥וֹ וּֽבְתוֹרָת֥וֹ יֶהְגֶּ֗ה יוֹמָ֥ם וָלָֽיְלָה׃

lines.text: but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.
But — in the law of Jehovah [is] his delight, And in His law he doth meditate by day and by night:

1.he: וְֽהָיָ֗ה כְּעֵץ֮ שָׁת֪וּל עַֽל־פַּלְגֵ֫י מָ֥יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר פִּרְי֨וֹ ׀ יִתֵּ֬ן בְּעִתּ֗וֹ וְעָלֵ֥הוּ לֹֽא־יִבּ֑וֹל וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יַצְלִֽיחַ׃

lines.text: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.
And he hath been as a tree, Planted by rivulets of water, That giveth its fruit in its season, And its leaf doth not wither, And all that he doth he causeth to prosper.

1.he: לֹא־כֵ֥ן הָרְשָׁעִ֑ים כִּ֥י אִם־כַּ֝מֹּ֗ץ אֲֽשֶׁר־תִּדְּפֶ֥נּוּ רֽוּחַ׃

lines.text: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.
Not so the wicked: But — as chaff that wind driveth away!

1.he: עַל־כֵּ֤ן ׀ לֹא־יָקֻ֣מוּ רְ֭שָׁעִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ֝חַטָּאִ֗ים בַּעֲדַ֥ת צַדִּיקִֽים׃

lines.text: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
Therefore the wicked rise not in judgment, Nor sinners in the company of the righteous,

1.he: כִּֽי־יוֹדֵ֣עַ יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֣רֶךְ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃

lines.text: For Yahweh knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.
For Jehovah is knowing the way of the righteous, And the way of the wicked is lost!
Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
Why have nations tumultuously assembled? And do peoples meditate vanity?

2.he: יִ֥תְיַצְּב֨וּ ׀ מַלְכֵי־אֶ֗רֶץ וְרוֹזְנִ֥ים נֽוֹסְדוּ־יָ֑חַד עַל־יְ֝הוָה וְעַל־מְשִׁיחֽוֹ׃

lines.text: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahweh, and against his Anointed, saying,
Station themselves do kings of the earth, And princes have been united together, Against Jehovah, and against His Messiah:
“Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”
'Let us draw off Their cords, And cast from us Their thick bands.'
He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.
He who is sitting in the heavens doth laugh, The Lord doth mock at them.

2.he: אָ֤ז יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֵ֣ימוֹ בְאַפּ֑וֹ וּֽבַחֲרוֹנ֥וֹ יְבַהֲלֵֽמוֹ׃

lines.text: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:
Then doth He speak unto them in His anger, And in His wrath He doth trouble them:
“Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”
'And I — I have anointed My King, Upon Zion — My holy hill.'

2.he: אֲסַפְּרָ֗ה אֶֽ֫ל חֹ֥ק יְֽהוָ֗ה אָמַ֘ר אֵלַ֥י בְּנִ֥י אַ֑תָּה אֲ֝נִ֗י הַיּ֥וֹם יְלִדְתִּֽיךָ׃

lines.text: I will tell of the decree: Yahweh said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.
I declare concerning a statute: Jehovah said unto me, 'My Son Thou [art], I to-day have brought thee forth.

2.he: שְׁאַ֤ל מִמֶּ֗נִּי וְאֶתְּנָ֣ה ג֭וֹיִם נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ וַ֝אֲחֻזָּתְךָ֗ אַפְסֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.
Ask of Me and I give nations — thy inheritance, And thy possession — the ends of earth.

2.he: תְּ֭רֹעֵם בְּשֵׁ֣בֶט בַּרְזֶ֑ל כִּכְלִ֖י יוֹצֵ֣ר תְּנַפְּצֵֽם׃

lines.text: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”
Thou dost rule them with a sceptre of iron, As a vessel of a potter Thou dost crush them.'

2.he: וְ֭עַתָּה מְלָכִ֣ים הַשְׂכִּ֑ילוּ הִ֝וָּסְר֗וּ שֹׁ֣פְטֵי אָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.
And now, O kings, act wisely, Be instructed, O judges of earth,
Serve Yahweh with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
Serve ye Jehovah with fear, And rejoice with trembling.

2.he: נַשְּׁקוּ־בַ֡ר פֶּן־יֶאֱנַ֤ף ׀ וְתֹ֬אבְדוּ דֶ֗רֶךְ כִּֽי־יִבְעַ֣ר כִּמְעַ֣ט אַפּ֑וֹ אַ֝שְׁרֵ֗י כָּל־ח֥וֹסֵי בֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.
Kiss the Chosen One, lest He be angry, And ye lose the way, When His anger burneth but a little, O the happiness of all trusting in Him!

3.he: מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִ֑ד בְּ֝בָרְח֗וֹ מִפְּנֵ֤י ׀ אַבְשָׁל֬וֹם בְּנֽוֹ׃

lines.text: A Psalm of David, in his fleeing from the face of Absalom his son. Jehovah, how have my distresses multiplied! Many are rising up against me.

3.he: יְ֭הוָה מָֽה־רַבּ֣וּ צָרָ֑י רַ֝בִּ֗ים קָמִ֥ים עָלָֽי׃

lines.text: Yahweh, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.
A Psalm of David, in his fleeing from the face of Absalom his son. Jehovah, how have my distresses multiplied! Many are rising up against me.

3.he: רַבִּים֮ אֹמְרִ֪ים לְנַ֫פְשִׁ֥י אֵ֤ין יְֽשׁוּעָ֓תָה לּ֬וֹ בֵֽאלֹהִ֬ים סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.”
Many are saying of my soul, 'There is no salvation for him in God.' Selah.

3.he: וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה מָגֵ֣ן בַּעֲדִ֑י כְּ֝בוֹדִ֗י וּמֵרִ֥ים רֹאשִֽׁי׃

lines.text: But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
And Thou, O Jehovah, [art] a shield for me, My honour, and lifter up of my head.

3.he: ק֭וֹלִי אֶל־יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָ֑א וַיַּֽעֲנֵ֨נִי מֵהַ֖ר קָדְשׁ֣וֹ סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: I cry to Yahweh with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill.
My voice [is] unto Jehovah: I call: And He answereth me from his holy hill, Selah.

3.he: אֲנִ֥י שָׁכַ֗בְתִּי וָֽאִ֫ישָׁ֥נָה הֱקִיצ֑וֹתִי כִּ֖י יְהוָ֣ה יִסְמְכֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened; for Yahweh sustains me.
I — I have lain down, and I sleep, I have waked, for Jehovah sustaineth me.

3.he: לֹֽא־אִ֭ירָא מֵרִבְב֥וֹת עָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר סָ֝בִ֗יב שָׁ֣תוּ עָלָֽי׃

lines.text: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.
I am not afraid of myriads of people, That round about they have set against me.

3.he: ק֘וּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה ׀ הוֹשִׁ֘יעֵ֤נִי אֱלֹהַ֗י כִּֽי־הִכִּ֣יתָ אֶת־כָּל־אֹיְבַ֣י לֶ֑חִי שִׁנֵּ֖י רְשָׁעִ֣ים שִׁבַּֽרְתָּ׃

lines.text: Arise, Yahweh! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.
Rise, O Jehovah! save me, my God. Because Thou hast smitten All mine enemies [on] the cheek. The teeth of the wicked Thou hast broken.
Salvation belongs to Yahweh. May your blessing be on your people.
Of Jehovah [is] this salvation; On Thy people [is] Thy blessing! Selah.
To the Overseer with Stringed Instruments. — A Psalm of David. In my calling answer Thou me, O God of my righteousness. In adversity Thou gavest enlargement to me; Favour me, and hear my prayer.

4.he: בְּקָרְאִ֡י עֲנֵ֤נִי ׀ אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י צִדְקִ֗י בַּ֭צָּר הִרְחַ֣בְתָּ לִּ֑י חָ֝נֵּ֗נִי וּשְׁמַ֥ע תְּפִלָּתִֽי׃

lines.text: Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.
To the Overseer with Stringed Instruments. — A Psalm of David. In my calling answer Thou me, O God of my righteousness. In adversity Thou gavest enlargement to me; Favour me, and hear my prayer.

4.he: בְּנֵ֥י אִ֡ישׁ עַד־מֶ֬ה כְבוֹדִ֣י לִ֭כְלִמָּה תֶּאֱהָב֣וּן רִ֑יק תְּבַקְשׁ֖וּ כָזָ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood?
Sons of men! till when [is] my glory for shame? Ye love a vain thing, ye seek a lie. Selah.

4.he: וּדְע֗וּ כִּֽי־הִפְלָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה חָסִ֣יד ל֑וֹ יְהוָ֥ה יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע בְּקָרְאִ֥י אֵלָֽיו׃

lines.text: But know that Yahweh has set apart for himself him who is godly: Yahweh will hear when I call to him.
And know ye that Jehovah Hath separated a saintly one to Himself. Jehovah heareth in my calling to Him.

4.he: רִגְז֗וּ וְֽאַל־תֶּ֫חֱטָ֥אוּ אִמְר֣וּ בִ֭לְבַבְכֶם עַֽל־מִשְׁכַּבְכֶ֗ם וְדֹ֣מּוּ סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still.
'Tremble ye, and do not sin;' Say ye [thus] in your heart on your bed, And be ye silent. Selah.
Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in Yahweh.
Sacrifice ye sacrifices of righteousness, And trust ye unto Jehovah.

4.he: רַבִּ֥ים אֹמְרִים֮ מִֽי־יַרְאֵ֪נ֫וּ ט֥וֹב נְֽסָה־עָ֭לֵינוּ א֨וֹר פָּנֶ֬יךָ יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.
Many are saying, 'Who doth show us good?' Lift on us the light of Thy face, O Jehovah,

4.he: נָתַ֣תָּה שִׂמְחָ֣ה בְלִבִּ֑י מֵעֵ֬ת דְּגָנָ֖ם וְתִֽירוֹשָׁ֣ם רָֽבּוּ׃

lines.text: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.
Thou hast given joy in my heart, From the time their corn and their wine Have been multiplied.

4.he: בְּשָׁל֣וֹם יַחְדָּו֮ אֶשְׁכְּבָ֪ה וְאִ֫ישָׁ֥ן כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה לְבָדָ֑ד לָ֝בֶ֗טַח תּוֹשִׁיבֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you, Yahweh alone, make me live in safety.
In peace together I lie down and sleep, For Thou, O Jehovah, alone, In confidence dost cause me to dwell!
To the Overseer, 'Concerning the Inheritances.' — A Psalm of David. My sayings hear, O Jehovah, Consider my meditation.
Give ear to my words, Yahweh. Consider my meditation.
To the Overseer, 'Concerning the Inheritances.' — A Psalm of David. My sayings hear, O Jehovah, Consider my meditation.

5.he: הַקְשִׁ֤יבָה ׀ לְק֬וֹל שַׁוְעִ֗י מַלְכִּ֥י וֵאלֹהָ֑י כִּֽי־אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ אֶתְפַּלָּֽל׃

lines.text: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God; for I pray to you.
Be attentive to the voice of my cry, My king and my God, For unto Thee I pray habitually.

5.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה בֹּ֭קֶר תִּשְׁמַ֣ע קוֹלִ֑י בֹּ֥קֶר אֶֽעֱרָךְ־לְ֝ךָ֗ וַאֲצַפֶּֽה׃

lines.text: Yahweh, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.
Jehovah, [at] morning Thou hearest my voice, [At] morning I set in array for Thee, And I look out.

5.he: כִּ֤י ׀ לֹ֤א אֵֽל־חָפֵ֘ץ רֶ֥שַׁע ׀ אָ֑תָּה לֹ֖א יְגֻרְךָ֣ רָֽע׃

lines.text: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.
For not a God desiring wickedness [art] Thou, Evil inhabiteth Thee not.

5.he: לֹֽא־יִתְיַצְּב֣וּ הֽ֭וֹלְלִים לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינֶ֑יךָ שָׂ֝נֵ֗אתָ כָּל־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

lines.text: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.
The boastful station not themselves before Thine eyes: Thou hast hated all working iniquity.

5.he: תְּאַבֵּד֮ דֹּבְרֵ֪י כָ֫זָ֥ב אִישׁ־דָּמִ֥ים וּמִרְמָ֗ה יְתָ֘עֵ֥ב ׀ יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: You will destroy those who speak lies. Yahweh abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
Thou destroyest those speaking lies, A man of blood and deceit Jehovah doth abominate.

5.he: וַאֲנִ֗י בְּרֹ֣ב חַ֭סְדְּךָ אָב֣וֹא בֵיתֶ֑ךָ אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥ה אֶל־הֵֽיכַל־קָ֝דְשְׁךָ֗ בְּיִרְאָתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.
And I, in the abundance of Thy kindness, I enter Thy house, I bow myself toward Thy holy temple in Thy fear.

5.he: יְהוָ֤ה ׀ נְחֵ֬נִי בְצִדְקָתֶ֗ךָ לְמַ֥עַן שׁוֹרְרָ֑י הושר לְפָנַ֣י דַּרְכֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: Lead me, Yahweh, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.
O Jehovah, lead me in Thy righteousness, Because of those observing me, Make straight before me Thy way,

5.he: כִּ֤י אֵ֪ין בְּפִ֡יהוּ נְכוֹנָה֮ קִרְבָּ֪ם הַ֫וּ֥וֹת קֶֽבֶר־פָּת֥וּחַ גְּרוֹנָ֑ם לְ֝שׁוֹנָ֗ם יַחֲלִֽיקוּן׃

lines.text: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.
For there is no stability in their mouth. Their heart [is] mischiefs, An open grave [is] their throat, Their tongue they make smooth.

5.he: הַֽאֲשִׁימֵ֨ם ׀ אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים יִפְּלוּ֮ מִֽמֹּעֲצ֪וֹתֵ֫יהֶ֥ם בְּרֹ֣ב פִּ֭שְׁעֵיהֶם הַדִּיחֵ֑מוֹ כִּי־מָ֥רוּ בָֽךְ׃

lines.text: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.
Declare them guilty, O God, Let them fall from their own counsels, In the abundance of their transgressions Drive them away, Because they have rebelled against Thee.

5.he: וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ כָל־ח֪וֹסֵי בָ֡ךְ לְעוֹלָ֣ם יְ֭רַנֵּנוּ וְתָסֵ֣ךְ עָלֵ֑ימוֹ וְֽיַעְלְצ֥וּ בְ֝ךָ֗ אֹהֲבֵ֥י שְׁמֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.
And rejoice do all trusting in Thee, To the age they sing, and Thou coverest them over, And those loving Thy name exult in Thee.

5.he: כִּֽי־אַתָּה֮ תְּבָרֵ֪ךְ צַ֫דִּ֥יק יְהוָ֑ה כַּ֝צִּנָּ֗ה רָצ֥וֹן תַּעְטְרֶֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: For you will bless the righteous. Yahweh, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.
For Thou blessest the righteous, O Jehovah, As a buckler with favour dost compass him!
To the Overseer with stringed instruments, on the octave. — A Psalm of David. O Jehovah, in Thine anger reprove me not, Nor in Thy fury chastise me.
Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.
To the Overseer with stringed instruments, on the octave. — A Psalm of David. O Jehovah, in Thine anger reprove me not, Nor in Thy fury chastise me.

6.he: חָנֵּ֥נִי יְהוָה֮ כִּ֤י אֻמְלַ֫ל אָ֥נִי רְפָאֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י נִבְהֲל֣וּ עֲצָמָֽי׃

lines.text: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am faint. Yahweh, heal me, for my bones are troubled.
Favour me, O Jehovah, for I [am] weak, Heal me, O Jehovah, For troubled have been my bones,

6.he: וְ֭נַפְשִׁי נִבְהֲלָ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד ואת יְ֝הוָ֗ה עַד־מָתָֽי׃

lines.text: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, Yahweh—how long?
And my soul hath been troubled greatly, And Thou, O Jehovah, till when?

6.he: שׁוּבָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה חַלְּצָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י ה֝וֹשִׁיעֵ֗נִי לְמַ֣עַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: Return, Yahweh. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.
Turn back, O Jehovah, draw out my soul, Save me for Thy kindness' sake.

6.he: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין בַּמָּ֣וֶת זִכְרֶ֑ךָ בִּ֝שְׁא֗וֹל מִ֣י יֽוֹדֶה־לָּֽךְ׃

lines.text: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?
For there is not in death Thy memorial, In Sheol, who doth give thanks to Thee?

6.he: יָגַ֤עְתִּי ׀ בְּֽאַנְחָתִ֗י אַשְׂחֶ֣ה בְכָל־לַ֭יְלָה מִטָּתִ֑י בְּ֝דִמְעָתִ֗י עַרְשִׂ֥י אַמְסֶֽה׃

lines.text: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
I have been weary with my sighing, I meditate through all the night [on] my bed, With my tear my couch I waste.
My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.
Old from provocation is mine eye, It is old because of all mine adversaries,

6.he: ס֣וּרוּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי כָּל־פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן כִּֽי־שָׁמַ֥ע יְ֝הוָ֗ה ק֣וֹל בִּכְיִֽי׃

lines.text: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for Yahweh has heard the voice of my weeping.
Turn from me all ye workers of iniquity, For Jehovah heard the voice of my weeping,

6.he: שָׁמַ֣ע יְ֭הוָה תְּחִנָּתִ֑י יְ֝הוָ֗ה תְּֽפִלָּתִ֥י יִקָּֽח׃

lines.text: Yahweh has heard my supplication. Yahweh accepts my prayer.
Jehovah hath heard my supplication, Jehovah my prayer receiveth.

6.he: יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ ׀ וְיִבָּהֲל֣וּ מְ֭אֹד כָּל־אֹיְבָ֑י יָ֝שֻׁ֗בוּ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ רָֽגַע׃

lines.text: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.
Ashamed and troubled greatly are all mine enemies, They turn back — ashamed [in] a moment!

7.he: שִׁגָּי֗וֹן לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲשֶׁר־שָׁ֥ר לַיהוָ֑ה עַל־דִּבְרֵי־כ֝֗וּשׁ בֶּן־יְמִינִֽי׃

lines.text: 'The Erring One,' by David, that he sung to Jehovah concerning the words of Cush a Benjamite. O Jehovah, my God, in Thee I have trusted, Save me from all my pursuers, and deliver me.

7.he: יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי בְּךָ֣ חָסִ֑יתִי הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥נִי מִכָּל־רֹ֝דְפַ֗י וְהַצִּילֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: Yahweh, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,
'The Erring One,' by David, that he sung to Jehovah concerning the words of Cush a Benjamite. O Jehovah, my God, in Thee I have trusted, Save me from all my pursuers, and deliver me.

7.he: פֶּן־יִטְרֹ֣ף כְּאַרְיֵ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י פֹּ֝רֵ֗ק וְאֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל׃

lines.text: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.
Lest he tear as a lion my soul, Rending, and there is no deliverer.

7.he: יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי אִם־עָשִׂ֣יתִי זֹ֑את אִֽם־יֶשׁ־עָ֥וֶל בְּכַפָּֽי׃

lines.text: Yahweh, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,
O Jehovah, my God, if I have done this, If there is iniquity in my hands,

7.he: אִם־גָּ֭מַלְתִּי שֽׁוֹלְמִ֥י רָ֑ע וָאֲחַלְּצָ֖ה צוֹרְרִ֣י רֵיקָֽם׃

lines.text: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have delivered him who without cause was my adversary),
If I have done my well-wisher evil, And draw mine adversary without cause,

7.he: יִֽרַדֹּ֥ף אוֹיֵ֨ב ׀ נַפְשִׁ֡י וְיַשֵּׂ֗ג וְיִרְמֹ֣ס לָאָ֣רֶץ חַיָּ֑י וּכְבוֹדִ֓י ׀ לֶעָפָ֖ר יַשְׁכֵּ֣ן סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust.
An enemy pursueth my soul, and overtaketh, And treadeth down to the earth my life, And my honour placeth in the dust. Selah.

7.he: ק֘וּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה ׀ בְּאַפֶּ֗ךָ הִ֭נָּשֵׂא בְּעַבְר֣וֹת צוֹרְרָ֑י וְע֥וּרָה אֵ֝לַ֗י מִשְׁפָּ֥ט צִוִּֽיתָ׃

lines.text: Arise, Yahweh, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.
Rise, O Jehovah, in Thine anger, Be lifted up at the wrath of mine adversaries, And awake Thou for me: Judgment Thou hast commanded:

7.he: וַעֲדַ֣ת לְ֭אֻמִּים תְּסוֹבְבֶ֑ךָּ וְ֝עָלֶ֗יהָ לַמָּר֥וֹם שֽׁוּבָה׃

lines.text: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.
And a company of peoples compass Thee, And over it on high turn Thou back,

7.he: יְהוָה֮ יָדִ֪ין עַ֫מִּ֥ים שָׁפְטֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֑ה כְּצִדְקִ֖י וּכְתֻמִּ֣י עָלָֽי׃

lines.text: Yahweh administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, Yahweh, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.
Jehovah doth judge the peoples; Judge me, O Jehovah, According to my righteousness, And according to mine integrity on me,

7.he: יִגְמָר־נָ֬א רַ֨ע ׀ רְשָׁעִים֮ וּתְכוֹנֵ֪ן צַ֫דִּ֥יק וּבֹחֵ֣ן לִ֭בּ֗וֹת וּכְלָי֗וֹת אֱלֹהִ֥ים צַדִּֽיק׃

lines.text: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.
Let, I pray Thee be ended the evil of the wicked, And establish Thou the righteous, And a trier of hearts and reins is the righteous God.
My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.
My shield [is] on God, Saviour of the upright in heart!

7.he: אֱ֭לֹהִים שׁוֹפֵ֣ט צַדִּ֑יק וְ֝אֵ֗ל זֹעֵ֥ם בְּכָל־יֽוֹם׃

lines.text: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.
God [is] a righteous judge, And He is not angry at all times.

7.he: אִם־לֹ֣א יָ֭שׁוּב חַרְבּ֣וֹ יִלְט֑וֹשׁ קַשְׁתּ֥וֹ דָ֝רַ֗ךְ וַֽיְכוֹנְנֶֽהָ׃

lines.text: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.
If [one] turn not, His sword he sharpeneth, His bow he hath trodden — He prepareth it,

7.he: וְ֭לוֹ הֵכִ֣ין כְּלֵי־מָ֑וֶת חִ֝צָּ֗יו לְֽדֹלְקִ֥ים יִפְעָֽל׃

lines.text: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.
Yea, for him He hath prepared Instruments of death, His arrows for burning pursuers He maketh.

7.he: הִנֵּ֥ה יְחַבֶּל־אָ֑וֶן וְהָרָ֥ה עָ֝מָ֗ל וְיָ֣לַד שָֽׁקֶר׃

lines.text: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.
Lo, he travaileth [with] iniquity, And he hath conceived perverseness, And hath brought forth falsehood.

7.he: בּ֣וֹר כָּ֭רָֽה וַֽיַּחְפְּרֵ֑הוּ וַ֝יִּפֹּ֗ל בְּשַׁ֣חַת יִפְעָֽל׃

lines.text: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.
A pit he hath prepared, and he diggeth it, And he falleth into a ditch he maketh.

7.he: יָשׁ֣וּב עֲמָל֣וֹ בְרֹאשׁ֑וֹ וְעַ֥ל קָ֝דְקֳד֗וֹ חֲמָס֥וֹ יֵרֵֽד׃

lines.text: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.
Return doth his perverseness on his head, And on his crown his violence cometh down.

7.he: אוֹדֶ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה כְּצִדְק֑וֹ וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה שֵֽׁם־יְהוָ֥ה עֶלְיֽוֹן׃

lines.text: I will give thanks to Yahweh according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of Yahweh Most High.
I thank Jehovah, According to His righteousness, And praise the name of Jehovah Most High!
To the Overseer, 'On the Gittith.' A Psalm of David. Jehovah, our Lord, How honourable Thy name in all the earth! Who settest thine honour on the heavens.

8.he: יְהוָ֤ה אֲדֹנֵ֗ינוּ מָֽה־אַדִּ֣יר שִׁ֭מְךָ בְּכָל־הָאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּנָ֥ה ה֝וֹדְךָ֗ עַל־הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

lines.text: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!
To the Overseer, 'On the Gittith.' A Psalm of David. Jehovah, our Lord, How honourable Thy name in all the earth! Who settest thine honour on the heavens.

8.he: מִפִּ֤י עֽוֹלְלִ֨ים ׀ וְֽיֹנְקִים֮ יִסַּ֪דְתָּ֫ עֹ֥ז לְמַ֥עַן צוֹרְרֶ֑יךָ לְהַשְׁבִּ֥ית א֝וֹיֵ֗ב וּמִתְנַקֵּֽם׃

lines.text: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.
From the mouths of infants and sucklings Thou hast founded strength, Because of Thine adversaries, To still an enemy and a self-avenger.

8.he: כִּֽי־אֶרְאֶ֣ה שָׁ֭מֶיךָ מַעֲשֵׂ֣י אֶצְבְּעֹתֶ֑יךָ יָרֵ֥חַ וְ֝כוֹכָבִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר כּוֹנָֽנְתָּה׃

lines.text: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained;
For I see Thy heavens, a work of Thy fingers, Moon and stars that Thou didst establish.
what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?
What [is] man that Thou rememberest him? The son of man that Thou inspectest him?

8.he: וַתְּחַסְּרֵ֣הוּ מְּ֭עַט מֵאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְכָב֖וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר תְּעַטְּרֵֽהוּ׃

lines.text: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.
And causest him to lack a little of Godhead, And with honour and majesty compassest him.

8.he: תַּ֭מְשִׁילֵהוּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣י יָדֶ֑יךָ כֹּ֝ל שַׁ֣תָּה תַֽחַת־רַגְלָֽיו׃

lines.text: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:
Thou dost cause him to rule Over the works of Thy hands, All Thou hast placed under his feet.

8.he: צֹנֶ֣ה וַאֲלָפִ֣ים כֻּלָּ֑ם וְ֝גַ֗ם בַּהֲמ֥וֹת שָׂדָֽי׃

lines.text: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,
Sheep and oxen, all of them, And also beasts of the field,

8.he: צִפּ֣וֹר שָׁ֭מַיִם וּדְגֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם עֹ֝בֵ֗ר אָרְח֥וֹת יַמִּֽים׃

lines.text: the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.
Bird of the heavens, and fish of the sea, Passing through the paths of the seas!
Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!
Jehovah, our Lord, How honourable Thy name in all the earth!

9.he: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ עַלְמ֥וּת לַבֵּ֗ן מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃

lines.text: To the Overseer, 'On the Death of Labben.' — A Psalm of David. I confess, O Jehovah, with all my heart, I recount all Thy wonders,

9.he: אוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל־לִבִּ֑י אֲ֝סַפְּרָ֗ה כָּל־נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.
To the Overseer, 'On the Death of Labben.' — A Psalm of David. I confess, O Jehovah, with all my heart, I recount all Thy wonders,

9.he: אֶשְׂמְחָ֣ה וְאֶעֶלְצָ֣ה בָ֑ךְ אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה שִׁמְךָ֣ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃

lines.text: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.
I rejoice and exult in Thee, I praise Thy Name, O Most High.

9.he: בְּשׁוּב־אוֹיְבַ֥י אָח֑וֹר יִכָּשְׁל֥וּ וְ֝יֹאבְד֗וּ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.
In mine enemies turning backward, they stumble and perish from Thy face.

9.he: כִּֽי־עָ֭שִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣י וְדִינִ֑י יָשַׁ֥בְתָּ לְ֝כִסֵּ֗א שׁוֹפֵ֥ט צֶֽדֶק׃

lines.text: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.
For Thou hast done my judgment and my right. Thou hast sat on a throne, A judge of righteousness.

9.he: גָּעַ֣רְתָּ ג֭וֹיִם אִבַּ֣דְתָּ רָשָׁ֑ע שְׁמָ֥ם מָ֝חִ֗יתָ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃

lines.text: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.
Thou hast rebuked nations, Thou hast destroyed the wicked, Their name Thou hast blotted out to the age and for ever.

9.he: הָֽאוֹיֵ֨ב ׀ תַּ֥מּוּ חֳרָב֗וֹת לָ֫נֶ֥צַח וְעָרִ֥ים נָתַ֑שְׁתָּ אָבַ֖ד זִכְרָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה׃

lines.text: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.
O thou Enemy, Finished have been destructions for ever, As to cities thou hast plucked up, Perished hath their memorial with them.

9.he: וַֽ֭יהוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם יֵשֵׁ֑ב כּוֹנֵ֖ן לַמִּשְׁפָּ֣ט כִּסְאֽוֹ׃

lines.text: But Yahweh reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.
And Jehovah to the age abideth, He is preparing for judgment His throne.

9.he: וְה֗וּא יִשְׁפֹּֽט־תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק יָדִ֥ין לְ֝אֻמִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃

lines.text: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.
And He judgeth the world in righteousness, He judgeth the peoples in uprightness.

9.he: וִ֘יהִ֤י יְהוָ֣ה מִשְׂגָּ֣ב לַדָּ֑ךְ מִ֝שְׂגָּ֗ב לְעִתּ֥וֹת בַּצָּרָֽה׃

lines.text: Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.
And Jehovah is a tower for the bruised, A tower for times of adversity.

9.he: וְיִבְטְח֣וּ בְ֭ךָ יוֹדְעֵ֣י שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י לֹֽא־עָזַ֖בְתָּ דֹרְשֶׁ֣יךָ יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.
They trust in Thee who do know Thy name, For Thou hast not forsaken Those seeking Thee, O Jehovah.

9.he: זַמְּר֗וּ לַ֭יהוָה יֹשֵׁ֣ב צִיּ֑וֹן הַגִּ֥ידוּ בָ֝עַמִּ֗ים עֲלִֽילוֹתָֽיו׃

lines.text: Sing praises to Yahweh, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.
Sing ye praise to Jehovah, inhabiting Zion, Declare ye among the peoples His acts,

9.he: כִּֽי־דֹרֵ֣שׁ דָּ֭מִים אוֹתָ֣ם זָכָ֑ר לֹֽא־שָׁ֝כַ֗ח צַעֲקַ֥ת עניים׃

lines.text: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.
For He who is seeking for blood Them hath remembered, He hath not forgotten the cry of the afflicted.

9.he: חָֽנְנֵ֬נִי יְהוָ֗ה רְאֵ֣ה עָ֭נְיִי מִשֹּׂנְאָ֑י מְ֝רוֹמְמִ֗י מִשַּׁ֥עֲרֵי מָֽוֶת׃

lines.text: Have mercy on me, Yahweh. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,
Favour me, O Jehovah, See mine affliction by those hating me, Thou who liftest me up from the gates of death,

9.he: לְמַ֥עַן אֲסַפְּרָ֗ה כָּֽל־תְּהִלָּ֫תֶ֥יךָ בְּשַֽׁעֲרֵ֥י בַת־צִיּ֑וֹן אָ֝גִ֗ילָה בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
So that I recount all Thy praise, In the gates of the daughter of Zion. I rejoice on Thy salvation.

9.he: טָבְע֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם בְּשַׁ֣חַת עָשׂ֑וּ בְּרֶֽשֶׁת־ז֥וּ טָ֝מָ֗נוּ נִלְכְּדָ֥ה רַגְלָֽם׃

lines.text: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.
Sunk have nations in a pit they made, In a net that they hid hath their foot been captured.

9.he: נ֤וֹדַ֨ע ׀ יְהוָה֮ מִשְׁפָּ֪ט עָ֫שָׂ֥ה בְּפֹ֣עַל כַּ֭פָּיו נוֹקֵ֣שׁ רָשָׁ֑ע הִגָּי֥וֹן סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: Yahweh has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands.
Jehovah hath been known, Judgment He hath done, By a work of his hands Hath the wicked been snared. Meditation. Selah.

9.he: יָשׁ֣וּבוּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים לִשְׁא֑וֹלָה כָּל־גּ֝וֹיִ֗ם שְׁכֵחֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃

lines.text: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.
The wicked do turn back to Sheol, All nations forgetting God.

9.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א לָ֭נֶצַח יִשָּׁכַ֣ח אֶבְי֑וֹן תִּקְוַ֥ת ענוים תֹּאבַ֥ד לָעַֽד׃

lines.text: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.
For not for ever is the needy forgotten, The hope of the humble lost to the age.

9.he: קוּמָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אַל־יָעֹ֣ז אֱנ֑וֹשׁ יִשָּׁפְט֥וּ ג֝וֹיִ֗ם עַל־פָּנֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Arise, Yahweh! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.
Rise, O Jehovah, let not man be strong, Let nations be judged before Thy face.

9.he: שִׁ֘יתָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה ׀ מוֹרָ֗ה לָ֫הֶ֥ם יֵדְע֥וּ גוֹיִ֑ם אֱנ֖וֹשׁ הֵ֣מָּה סֶּֽלָה׃

lines.text: Put them in fear, Yahweh. Let the nations know that they are only men.
Appoint, O Jehovah, a director to them, Let nations know they [are] men! Selah.

10.he: לָמָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תַּעֲמֹ֣ד בְּרָח֑וֹק תַּ֝עְלִ֗ים לְעִתּ֥וֹת בַּצָּרָֽה׃

lines.text: Why do you stand far off, Yahweh? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
Why, Jehovah, dost Thou stand at a distance? Thou dost hide in times of adversity,

10.he: בְּגַאֲוַ֣ת רָ֭שָׁע יִדְלַ֣ק עָנִ֑י יִתָּפְשׂ֓וּ ׀ בִּמְזִמּ֖וֹת ז֣וּ חָשָֽׁבוּ׃

lines.text: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.
Through the pride of the wicked, Is the poor inflamed, They are caught in devices that they devised.

10.he: כִּֽי־הִלֵּ֣ל רָ֭שָׁע עַל־תַּאֲוַ֣ת נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּבֹצֵ֥עַ בֵּ֝רֵ֗ךְ נִ֘אֵ֥ץ ׀ יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns Yahweh.
Because the wicked hath boasted Of the desire of his soul, And a dishonest gainer he hath blessed, He hath despised Jehovah.

10.he: רָשָׁ֗ע כְּגֹ֣בַהּ אַ֭פּוֹ בַּל־יִדְרֹ֑שׁ אֵ֥ין אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים כָּל־מְזִמּוֹתָֽיו׃

lines.text: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.
The wicked according to the height of his face, inquireth not. 'God is not!' [are] all his devices.

10.he: יָ֘חִ֤ילוּ דרכו ׀ בְּכָל־עֵ֗ת מָר֣וֹם מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶיךָ מִנֶּגְדּ֑וֹ כָּל־צ֝וֹרְרָ֗יו יָפִ֥יחַ בָּהֶֽם׃

lines.text: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is arrogant, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.
Pain do his ways at all times, On high [are] Thy judgments before him, All his adversaries — he puffeth at them.

10.he: אָמַ֣ר בְּ֭לִבּוֹ בַּל־אֶמּ֑וֹט לְדֹ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־בְרָֽע׃

lines.text: He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”
He hath said in his heart, 'I am not moved,' To generation and generation not in evil.

10.he: אָלָ֤ה פִּ֣יהוּ מָ֭לֵא וּמִרְמ֣וֹת וָתֹ֑ךְ תַּ֥חַת לְ֝שׁוֹנ֗וֹ עָמָ֥ל וָאָֽוֶן׃

lines.text: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.
Of oaths his mouth is full, And deceits, and fraud: Under his tongue [is] perverseness and iniquity,

10.he: יֵשֵׁ֤ב ׀ בְּמַאְרַ֬ב חֲצֵרִ֗ים בַּֽ֭מִּסְתָּרִים יַהֲרֹ֣ג נָקִ֑י עֵ֝ינָ֗יו לְֽחֵלְכָ֥ה יִצְפֹּֽנוּ׃

lines.text: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.
He doth sit in an ambush of the villages, In secret places he doth slay the innocent. His eyes for the afflicted watch secretly,

10.he: יֶאֱרֹ֬ב בַּמִּסְתָּ֨ר ׀ כְּאַרְיֵ֬ה בְסֻכֹּ֗ה יֶ֭אֱרֹב לַחֲט֣וֹף עָנִ֑י יַחְטֹ֥ף עָ֝נִ֗י בְּמָשְׁכ֥וֹ בְרִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he draws him in his net.
He lieth in wait in a secret place, as a lion in a covert. He lieth in wait to catch the poor, He catcheth the poor, drawing him into his net.
The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.
He is bruised — he boweth down, Fallen by his mighty ones hath the afflicted.

10.he: אָמַ֣ר בְּ֭לִבּוֹ שָׁ֣כַֽח אֵ֑ל הִסְתִּ֥יר פָּ֝נָ֗יו בַּל־רָאָ֥ה לָנֶֽצַח׃

lines.text: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”
He said in his heart, 'God hath forgotten, He hath hid His face, He hath never seen.'

10.he: קוּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֭ל נְשָׂ֣א יָדֶ֑ךָ אַל־תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח עניים׃

lines.text: Arise, Yahweh! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.
Arise, O Jehovah! O God, lift up Thy hand! Forget not the humble.

10.he: עַל־מֶ֤ה ׀ נִאֵ֖ץ רָשָׁ֥ע ׀ אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָמַ֥ר בְּ֝לִבּ֗וֹ לֹ֣א תִדְרֹֽשׁ׃

lines.text: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account?”
Wherefore hath the wicked despised God? He hath said in his heart, 'It is not required.'

10.he: רָאִ֡תָה כִּֽי־אַתָּ֤ה ׀ עָ֘מָ֤ל וָכַ֨עַס ׀ תַּבִּיט֮ לָתֵ֪ת בְּיָ֫דֶ֥ךָ עָ֭לֶיךָ יַעֲזֹ֣ב חֵלֶ֑כָה יָ֝ת֗וֹם אַתָּ֤ה ׀ הָיִ֬יתָ עוֹזֵֽר׃

lines.text: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.
Thou hast seen, For Thou perverseness and anger beholdest; By giving into Thy hand, On Thee doth the afflicted leave [it], Of the fatherless Thou hast been an helper.

10.he: שְׁ֭בֹר זְר֣וֹעַ רָשָׁ֑ע וָ֝רָ֗ע תִּֽדְרוֹשׁ־רִשְׁע֥וֹ בַל־תִּמְצָֽא׃

lines.text: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.
Break the arm of the wicked and the evil, Seek out his wickedness, find none;

10.he: יְהוָ֣ה מֶ֭לֶךְ עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד אָבְד֥וּ ג֝וֹיִ֗ם מֵֽאַרְצֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Yahweh is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.
Jehovah [is] king to the age, and for ever, The nations have perished out of His land!

10.he: תַּאֲוַ֬ת עֲנָוִ֣ים שָׁמַ֣עְתָּ יְהוָ֑ה תָּכִ֥ין לִ֝בָּ֗ם תַּקְשִׁ֥יב אָזְנֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
The desire of the humble Thou hast heard, O Jehovah. Thou preparest their heart; Thou causest Thine ear to attend,

10.he: לִשְׁפֹּ֥ט יָת֗וֹם וָ֫דָ֥ךְ בַּל־יוֹסִ֥יף ע֑וֹד לַעֲרֹ֥ץ אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ מִן־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.
To judge the fatherless and bruised: He addeth no more to oppress — man of the earth!

11.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָ֫וִ֥ד בַּֽיהוָ֨ה ׀ חָסִ֗יתִי אֵ֭יךְ תֹּאמְר֣וּ לְנַפְשִׁ֑י נודו הַרְכֶ֥ם צִפּֽוֹר׃

lines.text: In Yahweh, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?
To the Overseer. — By David. In Jehovah I trusted, how say ye to my soul, 'They moved [to] Thy mountain for the bird?

11.he: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה הָרְשָׁעִ֡ים יִדְרְכ֬וּן קֶ֗שֶׁת כּוֹנְנ֣וּ חִצָּ֣ם עַל־יֶ֑תֶר לִיר֥וֹת בְּמוֹ־אֹ֝֗פֶל לְיִשְׁרֵי־לֵֽב׃

lines.text: For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.
For lo, the wicked tread a bow, They have prepared their arrow on the string, To shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.
If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?
When the foundations are destroyed, The righteous — what hath he done?

11.he: יְהוָ֤ה ׀ בְּֽהֵ֘יכַ֤ל קָדְשׁ֗וֹ יְהוָה֮ בַּשָּׁמַ֪יִם כִּ֫סְא֥וֹ עֵינָ֥יו יֶחֱז֑וּ עַפְעַפָּ֥יו יִ֝בְחֲנ֗וּ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃

lines.text: Yahweh is in his holy temple. Yahweh is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.
'Jehovah [is] in his holy temple: Jehovah — in the heavens [is] His throne. His eyes see — His eyelids try the sons of men.

11.he: יְהוָה֮ צַדִּ֪יק יִ֫בְחָ֥ן וְ֭רָשָׁע וְאֹהֵ֣ב חָמָ֑ס שָֽׂנְאָ֥ה נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

lines.text: Yahweh examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.
Jehovah the righteous doth try. And the wicked and the lover of violence, Hath His soul hated,

11.he: יַמְטֵ֥ר עַל־רְשָׁעִ֗ים פַּ֫חִ֥ים אֵ֣שׁ וְ֭גָפְרִית וְר֥וּחַ זִלְעָפ֗וֹת מְנָ֣ת כּוֹסָֽם׃

lines.text: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.
He poureth on the wicked snares, fire, and brimstone, And a horrible wind [is] the portion of their cup.

11.he: כִּֽי־צַדִּ֣יק יְ֭הוָה צְדָק֣וֹת אָהֵ֑ב יָ֝שָׁ֗ר יֶחֱז֥וּ פָנֵֽימוֹ׃

lines.text: For Yahweh is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.
For righteous [is] Jehovah, Righteousness He hath loved, The upright doth His countenance see!'
To the Overseer, on the octave. — A Psalm of David. Save, Jehovah, for the saintly hath failed, For the stedfast have ceased From the sons of men:

12.he: הוֹשִׁ֣יעָה יְ֭הוָה כִּי־גָמַ֣ר חָסִ֑יד כִּי־פַ֥סּוּ אֱ֝מוּנִ֗ים מִבְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

lines.text: Help, Yahweh; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
To the Overseer, on the octave. — A Psalm of David. Save, Jehovah, for the saintly hath failed, For the stedfast have ceased From the sons of men:

12.he: שָׁ֤וְא ׀ יְֽדַבְּרוּ֮ אִ֤ישׁ אֶת־רֵ֫עֵ֥הוּ שְׂפַ֥ת חֲלָק֑וֹת בְּלֵ֖ב וָלֵ֣ב יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃

lines.text: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
Vanity they speak each with his neighbour, Lip of flattery! With heart and heart they speak.

12.he: יַכְרֵ֣ת יְ֭הוָה כָּל־שִׂפְתֵ֣י חֲלָק֑וֹת לָ֝שׁ֗וֹן מְדַבֶּ֥רֶת גְּדֹלֽוֹת׃

lines.text: May Yahweh cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,
Jehovah doth cut off all lips of flattery, A tongue speaking great things,

12.he: אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָֽמְר֨וּ ׀ לִלְשֹׁנֵ֣נוּ נַ֭גְבִּיר שְׂפָתֵ֣ינוּ אִתָּ֑נוּ מִ֖י אָד֣וֹן לָֽנוּ׃

lines.text: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”
Who said, 'By our tongue we do mightily: Our lips [are] our own; who [is] lord over us?'

12.he: מִשֹּׁ֥ד עֲנִיִּים֮ מֵאַנְקַ֪ת אֶבְי֫וֹנִ֥ים עַתָּ֣ה אָ֭קוּם יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אָשִׁ֥ית בְּ֝יֵ֗שַׁע יָפִ֥יחַֽ לֽוֹ׃

lines.text: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says Yahweh; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”
Because of the spoiling of the poor, Because of the groaning of the needy, Now do I arise, saith Jehovah, I set in safety [him who] doth breathe for it.

12.he: אִֽמֲר֣וֹת יְהוָה֮ אֲמָר֪וֹת טְהֹ֫ר֥וֹת כֶּ֣סֶף צָ֭רוּף בַּעֲלִ֣יל לָאָ֑רֶץ מְ֝זֻקָּ֗ק שִׁבְעָתָֽיִם׃

lines.text: Yahweh’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
Sayings of Jehovah [are] pure sayings; Silver tried in a furnace of earth refined sevenfold.

12.he: אַתָּֽה־יְהוָ֥ה תִּשְׁמְרֵ֑ם תִּצְּרֶ֓נּוּ ׀ מִן־הַדּ֖וֹר ז֣וּ לְעוֹלָֽם׃

lines.text: You will keep them, Yahweh. You will preserve them from this generation forever.
Thou, O Jehovah, dost preserve them, Thou keepest us from this generation to the age.

12.he: סָבִ֗יב רְשָׁעִ֥ים יִתְהַלָּכ֑וּן כְּרֻ֥ם זֻ֝לּ֗וּת לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

lines.text: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.
Around the wicked walk continually, According as vileness is exalted by sons of men!
To the Overseer. — A Psalm of David. Till when, O Jehovah, Dost Thou forget me? — for ever? Till when dost Thou hide Thy face from me?

13.he: עַד־אָ֣נָה יְ֭הוָה תִּשְׁכָּחֵ֣נִי נֶ֑צַח עַד־אָ֓נָה ׀ תַּסְתִּ֖יר אֶת־פָּנֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

lines.text: How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
To the Overseer. — A Psalm of David. Till when, O Jehovah, Dost Thou forget me? — for ever? Till when dost Thou hide Thy face from me?

13.he: עַד־אָ֨נָה אָשִׁ֪ית עֵצ֡וֹת בְּנַפְשִׁ֗י יָג֣וֹן בִּלְבָבִ֣י יוֹמָ֑ם עַד־אָ֓נָה ׀ יָר֖וּם אֹיְבִ֣י עָלָֽי׃

lines.text: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?
Till when do I set counsels in my soul? Sorrow in my heart daily? Till when is mine enemy exalted over me?

13.he: הַבִּ֣יטָֽה עֲ֭נֵנִי יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י הָאִ֥ירָה עֵ֝ינַ֗י פֶּן־אִישַׁ֥ן הַמָּֽוֶת׃

lines.text: Behold, and answer me, Yahweh, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;
Look attentively; Answer me, O Jehovah, my God, Enlighten mine eyes, lest I sleep in death,

13.he: פֶּן־יֹאמַ֣ר אֹיְבִ֣י יְכָלְתִּ֑יו צָרַ֥י יָ֝גִ֗ילוּ כִּ֣י אֶמּֽוֹט׃

lines.text: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.
Lest mine enemy say, 'I overcame him,' Mine adversaries joy when I am moved.

13.he: וַאֲנִ֤י ׀ בְּחַסְדְּךָ֣ בָטַחְתִּי֮ יָ֤גֵ֥ל לִבִּ֗י בִּֽישׁוּעָ֫תֶ֥ךָ אָשִׁ֥ירָה לַיהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י גָמַ֣ל עָלָֽי׃

lines.text: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.
I will sing to Yahweh, because he has been good to me.
And I, in Thy kindness I have trusted, Rejoice doth my heart in Thy salvation.
I do sing to Jehovah, For He hath conferred benefits upon me!

14.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אָ֘מַ֤ר נָבָ֣ל בְּ֭לִבּוֹ אֵ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֑ים הִֽשְׁחִ֗יתוּ הִֽתְעִ֥יבוּ עֲלִילָ֗ה אֵ֣ין עֹֽשֵׂה־טֽוֹב׃

lines.text: The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.
To the Overseer. — By David. A fool hath said in his heart, 'God is not;' They have done corruptly, They have done abominable actions, There is not a doer of good.

14.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה מִשָּׁמַיִם֮ הִשְׁקִ֪יף עַֽל־בְּנֵי־אָ֫דָ֥ם לִ֭רְאוֹת הֲיֵ֣שׁ מַשְׂכִּ֑יל דֹּ֝רֵשׁ אֶת־אֱלֹהִֽים׃

lines.text: Yahweh looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.
Jehovah from the heavens Hath looked on the sons of men, To see if there is a wise one — seeking God.

14.he: הַכֹּ֥ל סָר֮ יַחְדָּ֪ו נֶ֫אֱלָ֥חוּ אֵ֤ין עֹֽשֵׂה־ט֑וֹב אֵ֝֗ין גַּם־אֶחָֽד׃

lines.text: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
The whole have turned aside, Together they have been filthy: There is not a doer of good, not even one.

14.he: הֲלֹ֥א יָדְעוּ֮ כָּל־פֹּ֪עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן אֹכְלֵ֣י עַ֭מִּי אָ֣כְלוּ לֶ֑חֶם יְ֝הוָ֗ה לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ׃

lines.text: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on Yahweh?
Have all working iniquity not known? Those consuming my people have eaten bread, Jehovah they have not called.

14.he: שָׁ֤ם ׀ פָּ֣חֲדוּ פָ֑חַד כִּֽי־אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בְּד֣וֹר צַדִּֽיק׃

lines.text: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.
There they have feared a fear, For God [is] in the generation of the righteous.
You frustrate the plan of the poor, because Yahweh is his refuge.
The counsel of the poor ye cause to stink, Because Jehovah [is] his refuge.

14.he: מִ֥י יִתֵּ֣ן מִצִיּוֹן֮ יְשׁוּעַ֪ת יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל בְּשׁ֣וּב יְ֭הוָה שְׁב֣וּת עַמּ֑וֹ יָגֵ֥ל יַ֝עֲקֹ֗ב יִשְׂמַ֥ח יִשְׂרָֽאֵל׃

lines.text: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When Yahweh restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
'Who doth give from Zion the salvation of Israel? When Jehovah doth turn back [To] a captivity of His people, Jacob doth rejoice — Israel is glad!

15.he: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥ד י֭הֹוָה מִי־יָג֣וּר בְּאָהֳלֶ֑ךָ מִֽי־יִ֝שְׁכֹּ֗ן בְּהַ֣ר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃

lines.text: Yahweh, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?
A Psalm of David. Jehovah, who doth sojourn in Thy tent? Who doth dwell in Thy holy hill?

15.he: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ תָּ֭מִים וּפֹעֵ֥ל צֶ֑דֶק וְדֹבֵ֥ר אֱ֝מֶ֗ת בִּלְבָֽבוֹ׃

lines.text: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;
He who is walking uprightly, And working righteousness, And speaking truth in his heart.

15.he: לֹֽא־רָגַ֨ל ׀ עַל־לְשֹׁנ֗וֹ לֹא־עָשָׂ֣ה לְרֵעֵ֣הוּ רָעָ֑ה וְ֝חֶרְפָּ֗ה לֹא־נָשָׂ֥א עַל־קְרֹֽבוֹ׃

lines.text: he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;
He hath not slandered by his tongue, He hath not done to his friend evil; And reproach he hath not lifted up Against his neighbour.

15.he: נִבְזֶ֤ה ׀ בְּֽעֵ֘ינָ֤יו נִמְאָ֗ס וְאֶת־יִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֣ה יְכַבֵּ֑ד נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לְ֝הָרַ֗ע וְלֹ֣א יָמִֽר׃

lines.text: in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear Yahweh; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;
Despised in his eyes [is] a rejected one, And those fearing Jehovah he doth honour. He hath sworn to suffer evil, and changeth not;

15.he: כַּסְפּ֤וֹ ׀ לֹא־נָתַ֣ן בְּנֶשֶׁךְ֮ וְשֹׁ֥חַד עַל־נָקִ֗י לֹ֥א לָ֫קָ֥ח עֹֽשֵׂה־אֵ֑לֶּה לֹ֖א יִמּ֣וֹט לְעוֹלָֽם׃

lines.text: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.
His silver he hath not given in usury, And a bribe against the innocent Hath not taken; Whoso is doing these is not moved to the age!

16.he: מִכְתָּ֥ם לְדָוִ֑ד שָֽׁמְרֵ֥נִי אֵ֝֗ל כִּֽי־חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽךְ׃

lines.text: Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.
A Secret Treasure of David. Preserve me, O God, for I did trust in Thee.

16.he: אָמַ֣רְתְּ לַֽ֭יהוָה אֲדֹנָ֣י אָ֑תָּה ט֝וֹבָתִ֗י בַּל־עָלֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: My soul, you have said to Yahweh, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”
Thou hast said to Jehovah, 'My Lord Thou [art];' My good [is] not for thine own sake;
As for the saints who are in the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.
For the holy ones who [are] in the land, And the honourable, all my delight [is] in them.

16.he: יִרְבּ֥וּ עַצְּבוֹתָם֮ אַחֵ֪ר מָ֫הָ֥רוּ בַּל־אַסִּ֣יךְ נִסְכֵּיהֶ֣ם מִדָּ֑ם וּֽבַל־אֶשָּׂ֥א אֶת־שְׁ֝מוֹתָ֗ם עַל־שְׂפָתָֽי׃

lines.text: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.
Multiplied are their griefs, [Who] have hastened backward; I pour not out their libations of blood, Nor do I take up their names on my lips.

16.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה מְנָת־חֶלְקִ֥י וְכוֹסִ֑י אַ֝תָּ֗ה תּוֹמִ֥יךְ גּוֹרָלִֽי׃

lines.text: Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.
Jehovah [is] the portion of my share, and of my cup, Thou — Thou dost uphold my lot.

16.he: חֲבָלִ֣ים נָֽפְלוּ־לִ֭י בַּנְּעִמִ֑ים אַף־נַ֝חֲלָ֗ת שָֽׁפְרָ֥ה עָלָֽי׃

lines.text: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.
Lines have fallen to me in pleasant places, Yea, a beauteous inheritance [is] for me.

16.he: אֲבָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת־יְ֭הוָה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְעָצָ֑נִי אַף־לֵ֝יל֗וֹת יִסְּר֥וּנִי כִלְיוֹתָֽי׃

lines.text: I will bless Yahweh, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.
I bless Jehovah who hath counselled me; Also [in] the nights my reins instruct me.

16.he: שִׁוִּ֬יתִי יְהוָ֣ה לְנֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִ֑יד כִּ֥י מִֽ֝ימִינִ֗י בַּל־אֶמּֽוֹט׃

lines.text: I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
I did place Jehovah before me continually, Because — at my right hand I am not moved.

16.he: לָכֵ֤ן ׀ שָׂמַ֣ח לִ֭בִּי וַיָּ֣גֶל כְּבוֹדִ֑י אַף־בְּ֝שָׂרִ֗י יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָבֶֽטַח׃

lines.text: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.
Therefore hath my heart been glad, And my honour doth rejoice, Also my flesh dwelleth confidently:

16.he: כִּ֤י ׀ לֹא־תַעֲזֹ֣ב נַפְשִׁ֣י לִשְׁא֑וֹל לֹֽא־תִתֵּ֥ן חֲ֝סִידְךָ֗ לִרְא֥וֹת שָֽׁחַת׃

lines.text: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.
For Thou dost not leave my soul to Sheol, Nor givest thy saintly one to see corruption.

16.he: תּֽוֹדִיעֵנִי֮ אֹ֤רַח חַ֫יִּ֥ים שֹׂ֣בַע שְׂ֭מָחוֹת אֶת־פָּנֶ֑יךָ נְעִמ֖וֹת בִּימִינְךָ֣ נֶֽצַח׃

lines.text: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
Thou causest me to know the path of life; Fulness of joys [is] with Thy presence, Pleasant things by Thy right hand for ever!

17.he: תְּפִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד שִׁמְעָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה ׀ צֶ֗דֶק הַקְשִׁ֥יבָה רִנָּתִ֗י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה תְפִלָּתִ֑י בְּ֝לֹ֗א שִׂפְתֵ֥י מִרְמָֽה׃

lines.text: Hear, Yahweh, my righteous plea; Give ear to my prayer, that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.
A Prayer of David. Hear, O Jehovah, righteousness, attend my cry, Give ear [to] my prayer, without lips of deceit.

17.he: מִ֭לְּפָנֶיךָ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣י יֵצֵ֑א עֵ֝ינֶ֗יךָ תֶּחֱזֶ֥ינָה מֵישָׁרִֽים׃

lines.text: Let my sentence come out of your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.
From before thee my judgment doth go out; Thine eyes do see uprightly.

17.he: בָּ֘חַ֤נְתָּ לִבִּ֨י ׀ פָּ֘קַ֤דְתָּ לַּ֗יְלָה צְרַפְתַּ֥נִי בַל־תִּמְצָ֑א זַ֝מֹּתִ֗י בַּל־יַעֲבָר־פִּֽי׃

lines.text: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.
Thou hast proved my heart, Thou hast inspected by night, Thou hast tried me, Thou findest nothing; My thoughts pass not over my mouth.

17.he: לִפְעֻלּ֣וֹת אָ֭דָם בִּדְבַ֣ר שְׂפָתֶ֑יךָ אֲנִ֥י שָׁ֝מַ֗רְתִּי אָרְח֥וֹת פָּרִֽיץ׃

lines.text: As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.
As to doings of man, Through a word of Thy lips I have observed The paths of a destroyer;
My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.
To uphold my goings in Thy paths, My steps have not slidden.

17.he: אֲנִֽי־קְרָאתִ֣יךָ כִֽי־תַעֲנֵ֣נִי אֵ֑ל הַֽט־אָזְנְךָ֥ לִ֝֗י שְׁמַ֣ע אִמְרָתִֽי׃

lines.text: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.
I — I called Thee, for Thou dost answer me, O God, incline Thine ear to me, hear my speech.

17.he: הַפְלֵ֣ה חֲ֭סָדֶיךָ מוֹשִׁ֣יעַ חוֹסִ֑ים מִ֝מִּתְקוֹמְמִ֗ים בִּֽימִינֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.
Separate wonderfully Thy kindness, O Saviour of the confiding, By Thy right hand, from withstanders.

17.he: שָׁ֭מְרֵנִי כְּאִישׁ֣וֹן בַּת־עָ֑יִן בְּצֵ֥ל כְּ֝נָפֶ֗יךָ תַּסְתִּירֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,
Keep me as the apple, the daughter of the eye; In shadow of Thy wings thou dost hide me.

17.he: מִפְּנֵ֣י רְ֭שָׁעִים ז֣וּ שַׁדּ֑וּנִי אֹיְבַ֥י בְּ֝נֶ֗פֶשׁ יַקִּ֥יפוּ עָלָֽי׃

lines.text: from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.
From the face of the wicked who spoiled me. Mine enemies in soul go round against me.
They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.
Their fat they have closed up, Their mouths have spoken with pride:

17.he: אַ֭שֻּׁרֵינוּ עַתָּ֣ה סבבוני עֵינֵיהֶ֥ם יָ֝שִׁ֗יתוּ לִנְט֥וֹת בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.
'Our steps now have compassed [him];' Their eyes they set to turn aside in the land.

17.he: דִּמְיֹנ֗וֹ כְּ֭אַרְיֵה יִכְס֣וֹף לִטְר֑וֹף וְ֝כִכְפִ֗יר יֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּמִסְתָּרִֽים׃

lines.text: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
His likeness as a lion desirous to tear, As a young lion dwelling in secret places.

17.he: קוּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה קַדְּמָ֣ה פָ֭נָיו הַכְרִיעֵ֑הוּ פַּלְּטָ֥ה נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י מֵרָשָׁ֥ע חַרְבֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: Arise, Yahweh, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword;
Arise, O Jehovah, go before his face, Cause him to bend. Deliver my soul from the wicked, Thy sword,

17.he: מִֽמְתִֽים יָדְךָ֨ ׀ יְהוָ֡ה מִֽמְתִ֬ים מֵחֶ֗לֶד חֶלְקָ֥ם בַּֽחַיִּים֮ וצפינך תְּמַלֵּ֪א בִ֫טְנָ֥ם יִשְׂבּ֥עוּ בָנִ֑ים וְהִנִּ֥יחוּ יִ֝תְרָ֗ם לְעוֹלְלֵֽיהֶם׃

lines.text: from men by your hand, Yahweh, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your cherished ones. Your sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.

From men, Thy hand, O Jehovah, From men of the world, their portion [is] in life, And [with] Thy hidden things Thou fillest their belly, They are satisfied [with] sons; And have left their abundance to their sucklings.

17.he: אֲנִ֗י בְּ֭צֶדֶק אֶחֱזֶ֣ה פָנֶ֑יךָ אֶשְׂבְּעָ֥ה בְ֝הָקִ֗יץ תְּמוּנָתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.
I — in righteousness, I see Thy face; I am satisfied, in awaking, [with] Thy form!

18.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֤חַ ׀ לְעֶ֥בֶד יְהוָ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבֶּ֨ר ׀ לַיהוָ֗ה אֶת־דִּ֭בְרֵי הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את בְּי֤וֹם הִֽצִּיל־יְהוָ֘ה אוֹת֥וֹ מִכַּ֥ף כָּל־אֹ֝יְבָ֗יו וּמִיַּ֥ד שָׁאֽוּל׃

lines.text: To the Overseer. — By a servant of Jehovah, by David, who hath spoken to Jehovah the words of this song in the day Jehovah delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul, and he saith: — I love Thee, O Jehovah, my strength.

18.he: וַיֹּאמַ֡ר אֶרְחָמְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה חִזְקִֽי׃

lines.text: I love you, Yahweh, my strength.

To the Overseer. — By a servant of Jehovah, by David, who hath spoken to Jehovah the words of this song in the day Jehovah delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul, and he saith: — I love Thee, O Jehovah, my strength.

18.he: יְהוָ֤ה ׀ סַֽלְעִ֥י וּמְצוּדָתִ֗י וּמְפַ֫לְטִ֥י אֵלִ֣י צ֭וּרִי אֶֽחֱסֶה־בּ֑וֹ מָֽגִנִּ֥י וְקֶֽרֶן־יִ֝שְׁעִ֗י מִשְׂגַּבִּֽי׃

lines.text: Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
Jehovah [is] my rock, and my bulwark, And my deliverer, My God [is] my rock, I trust in Him: My shield, and a horn of my salvation, My high tower.

18.he: מְ֭הֻלָּל אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּמִן־אֹ֝יְבַ֗י אִוָּשֵֽׁעַ׃

lines.text: I call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.
The 'Praised One' I call Jehovah, And from my enemies I am saved.

18.he: אֲפָפ֥וּנִי חֶבְלֵי־מָ֑וֶת וְֽנַחֲלֵ֖י בְלִיַּ֣עַל יְבַֽעֲתֽוּנִי׃

lines.text: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
Compassed me have cords of death, And streams of the worthless make me afraid.

18.he: חֶבְלֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל סְבָב֑וּנִי קִ֝דְּמ֗וּנִי מ֣וֹקְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת׃

lines.text: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.
Cords of Sheol have surrounded me, Before me have been snares of death.

18.he: בַּצַּר־לִ֤י ׀ אֶֽקְרָ֣א יְהוָה֮ וְאֶל־אֱלֹהַ֪י אֲשַׁ֫וֵּ֥עַ יִשְׁמַ֣ע מֵהֵיכָל֣וֹ קוֹלִ֑י וְ֝שַׁוְעָתִ֗י לְפָנָ֤יו ׀ תָּב֬וֹא בְאָזְנָֽיו׃

lines.text: In my distress I called on Yahweh, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.
In mine adversity I call Jehovah, And unto my God I cry. He heareth from His temple my voice, And My cry before Him cometh into His ears.

18.he: וַתִּגְעַ֬שׁ וַתִּרְעַ֨שׁ ׀ הָאָ֗רֶץ וּמוֹסְדֵ֣י הָרִ֣ים יִרְגָּ֑זוּ וַ֝יִּתְגָּֽעֲשׁ֗וּ כִּי־חָ֥רָה לֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
And shake and tremble doth the earth, And foundations of hills are troubled, And they shake — because He hath wrath.

18.he: עָ֘לָ֤ה עָשָׁ֨ן ׀ בְּאַפּ֗וֹ וְאֵשׁ־מִפִּ֥יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל גֶּ֝חָלִ֗ים בָּעֲר֥וּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.
Gone up hath smoke by His nostrils, And fire from His mouth consumeth, Coals have been kindled by it.

18.he: וַיֵּ֣ט שָׁ֭מַיִם וַיֵּרַ֑ד וַ֝עֲרָפֶ֗ל תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָֽיו׃

lines.text: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.
And He inclineth the heavens, and cometh down, And thick darkness [is] under His feet.

18.he: וַיִּרְכַּ֣ב עַל־כְּ֭רוּב וַיָּעֹ֑ף וַ֝יֵּ֗דֶא עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רֽוּחַ׃

lines.text: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.
And He rideth on a cherub, and doth fly, And He flieth on wings of wind.

18.he: יָ֤שֶׁת חֹ֨שֶׁךְ ׀ סִתְר֗וֹ סְבִֽיבוֹתָ֥יו סֻכָּת֑וֹ חֶשְׁכַת־מַ֝֗יִם עָבֵ֥י שְׁחָקִֽים׃

lines.text: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
He maketh darkness His secret place, Round about Him His tabernacle, Darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

18.he: מִנֹּ֗גַהּ נֶ֫גְדּ֥וֹ עָבָ֥יו עָבְר֑וּ בָּ֝רָ֗ד וְגַֽחֲלֵי־אֵֽשׁ׃

lines.text: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.
From the brightness over-against Him His thick clouds have passed on, Hail and coals of fire.

18.he: וַיַּרְעֵ֬ם בַּשָּׁמַ֨יִם ׀ יְֽהוָ֗ה וְ֭עֶלְיוֹן יִתֵּ֣ן קֹל֑וֹ בָּ֝רָ֗ד וְגַֽחֲלֵי־אֵֽשׁ׃

lines.text: Yahweh also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.
And thunder in the heavens doth Jehovah, And the Most High giveth forth His voice, Hail and coals of fire.

18.he: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח חִ֭צָּיו וַיְפִיצֵ֑ם וּבְרָקִ֥ים רָ֝ב וַיְהֻמֵּֽם׃

lines.text: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them; Yes, great lightning bolts, and routed them.
And He sendeth His arrows and scattereth them, And much lightning, and crusheth them.

18.he: וַיֵּ֤רָא֨וּ ׀ אֲפִ֥יקֵי מַ֗יִם וַֽיִּגָּלוּ֮ מוֹסְד֪וֹת תֵּ֫בֵ֥ל מִגַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה מִ֝נִּשְׁמַ֗ת ר֣וּחַ אַפֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, Yahweh, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.
And seen are the streams of waters, And revealed are foundations of the earth. From Thy rebuke, O Jehovah, From the breath of the spirit of Thine anger.

18.he: יִשְׁלַ֣ח מִ֭מָּרוֹם יִקָּחֵ֑נִי יַֽ֝מְשֵׁ֗נִי מִמַּ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃

lines.text: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.
He sendeth from above — He taketh me, He draweth me out of many waters.

18.he: יַצִּילֵ֗נִי מֵאֹיְבִ֥י עָ֑ז וּ֝מִשֹּׂנְאַ֗י כִּֽי־אָמְצ֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

lines.text: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.
He delivereth me from my strong enemy, And from those hating me, For they have been stronger than I.

18.he: יְקַדְּמ֥וּנִי בְיוֹם־אֵידִ֑י וַֽיְהִי־יְהוָ֖ה לְמִשְׁעָ֣ן לִֽי׃

lines.text: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support.
They go before me in a day of my calamity And Jehovah is for a support to me.

18.he: וַיּוֹצִיאֵ֥נִי לַמֶּרְחָ֑ב יְ֝חַלְּצֵ֗נִי כִ֘י חָ֥פֵֽץ בִּֽי׃

lines.text: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
And He bringeth me forth to a large place, He draweth me out, because He delighted in me.

18.he: יִגְמְלֵ֣נִי יְהוָ֣ה כְּצִדְקִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָ֝דַ֗י יָשִׁ֥יב לִֽי׃

lines.text: Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.
Jehovah doth recompense me According to my righteousness, According to the cleanness of my hands, He doth return to me.

18.he: כִּֽי־שָׁ֭מַרְתִּי דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־רָ֝שַׁ֗עְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָֽי׃

lines.text: For I have kept the ways of Yahweh, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
For I have kept the ways of Jehovah, And have not done wickedly against my God.

18.he: כִּ֣י כָל־מִשְׁפָּטָ֣יו לְנֶגְדִּ֑י וְ֝חֻקֹּתָ֗יו לֹא־אָסִ֥יר מֶֽנִּי׃

lines.text: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.
For all His judgments [are] before me, And His statutes I turn not from me.

18.he: וָאֱהִ֣י תָמִ֣ים עִמּ֑וֹ וָ֝אֶשְׁתַּמֵּ֗ר מֵעֲוֺנִֽי׃

lines.text: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.
And I am perfect with him, And I keep myself from mine iniquity.

18.he: וַיָּֽשֶׁב־יְהוָ֣ה לִ֣י כְצִדְקִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָ֝דַ֗י לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽיו׃

lines.text: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
And Jehovah doth return to me, According to my righteousness, According to the cleanness of my hands, Over-against his eyes.

18.he: עִם־חָסִ֥יד תִּתְחַסָּ֑ד עִם־גְּבַ֥ר תָּ֝מִ֗ים תִּתַּמָּֽם׃

lines.text: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.
With the kind Thou showest Thyself kind, With a perfect man showest Thyself perfect.

18.he: עִם־נָבָ֥ר תִּתְבָּרָ֑ר וְעִם־עִ֝קֵּ֗שׁ תִּתְפַּתָּֽל׃

lines.text: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
With the pure Thou showest Thyself pure, And with the perverse showest Thyself a wrestler,

18.he: כִּֽי־אַ֭תָּה עַם־עָנִ֣י תוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְעֵינַ֖יִם רָמ֣וֹת תַּשְׁפִּֽיל׃

lines.text: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.
For Thou a poor people savest, And the eyes of the high causest to fall.

18.he: כִּֽי־אַ֭תָּה תָּאִ֣יר נֵרִ֑י יְהוָ֥ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י יַגִּ֥יהַּ חָשְׁכִּֽי׃

lines.text: For you will light my lamp, Yahweh. My God will light up my darkness.
For Thou — Thou lightest my lamp, Jehovah my God enlighteneth my darkness.

18.he: כִּֽי־בְ֭ךָ אָרֻ֣ץ גְּד֑וּד וּ֝בֵֽאלֹהַ֗י אֲדַלֶּג־שֽׁוּר׃

lines.text: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.
For by Thee I run — a troop! And by my God I leap a wall.

18.he: הָאֵל֮ תָּמִ֪ים דַּ֫רְכּ֥וֹ אִמְרַֽת־יְהוָ֥ה צְרוּפָ֑ה מָגֵ֥ן ה֝֗וּא לְכֹ֤ל ׀ הַחֹסִ֬ים בּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
God! perfect [is] His way, The saying of Jehovah is tried, A shield [is] He to all those trusting in Him.

18.he: כִּ֤י מִ֣י אֱ֭לוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וּמִ֥י צ֝֗וּר זוּלָתִ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

lines.text: For who is God, except Yahweh? Who is a rock, besides our God,
For who [is] God besides Jehovah? And who [is] a rock save our God?

18.he: הָ֭אֵל הַמְאַזְּרֵ֣נִי חָ֑יִל וַיִּתֵּ֖ן תָּמִ֣ים דַּרְכִּֽי׃

lines.text: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?
God! who is girding me [with] strength, And He maketh perfect my way.

18.he: מְשַׁוֶּ֣ה רַ֭גְלַי כָּאַיָּל֑וֹת וְעַ֥ל בָּ֝מֹתַ֗י יַעֲמִידֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.
Making my feet like hinds, And on my high places causeth me to stand.

18.he: מְלַמֵּ֣ד יָ֭דַי לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְֽנִחֲתָ֥ה קֶֽשֶׁת־נְ֝חוּשָׁ֗ה זְרוֹעֹתָֽי׃

lines.text: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.
Teaching my hands for battle, And a bow of brass was brought down by my arms.

18.he: וַתִּתֶּן־לִי֮ מָגֵ֪ן יִ֫שְׁעֶ֥ךָ וִֽימִינְךָ֥ תִסְעָדֵ֑נִי וְֽעַנְוַתְךָ֥ תַרְבֵּֽנִי׃

lines.text: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.
And Thou givest to me the shield of Thy salvation, And Thy right hand doth support me, And Thy lowliness maketh me great.

18.he: תַּרְחִ֣יב צַעֲדִ֣י תַחְתָּ֑י וְלֹ֥א מָ֝עֲד֗וּ קַרְסֻלָּֽי׃

lines.text: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.
Thou enlargest my step under me, And mine ankles have not slidden.

18.he: אֶרְדּ֣וֹף א֭וֹיְבַי וְאַשִּׂיגֵ֑ם וְלֹֽא־אָ֝שׁוּב עַד־כַּלּוֹתָֽם׃

lines.text: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.
I pursue mine enemies, and overtake them, And turn back not till they are consumed.

18.he: אֶ֭מְחָצֵם וְלֹא־יֻ֣כְלוּ ק֑וּם יִ֝פְּל֗וּ תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָֽי׃

lines.text: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.
I smite them, and they are not able to rise, They fall under my feet,

18.he: וַתְּאַזְּרֵ֣נִי חַ֭יִל לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה תַּכְרִ֖יעַ קָמַ֣י תַּחְתָּֽי׃

lines.text: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.
And Thou girdest me [with] strength for battle, Causest my withstanders to bow under me.

18.he: וְֽאֹיְבַ֗י נָתַ֣תָּה לִּ֣י עֹ֑רֶף וּ֝מְשַׂנְאַ֗י אַצְמִיתֵֽם׃

lines.text: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.
As to mine enemies — Thou hast given to me the neck, As to those hating me — I cut them off.

18.he: יְשַׁוְּע֥וּ וְאֵין־מוֹשִׁ֑יעַ עַל־יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְלֹ֣א עָנָֽם׃

lines.text: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to Yahweh, but he didn’t answer them.
They cry, and there is no saviour, On Jehovah, and He doth not answer them.

18.he: וְֽאֶשְׁחָקֵ֗ם כְּעָפָ֥ר עַל־פְּנֵי־ר֑וּחַ כְּטִ֖יט חוּצ֣וֹת אֲרִיקֵֽם׃

lines.text: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.
And I beat them as dust before wind, As mire of the streets I empty them out.

18.he: תְּפַלְּטֵנִי֮ מֵרִ֪יבֵ֫י עָ֥ם תְּ֭שִׂימֵנִי לְרֹ֣אשׁ גּוֹיִ֑ם עַ֖ם לֹא־יָדַ֣עְתִּי יַֽעַבְדֽוּנִי׃

lines.text: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.
Thou dost deliver me From the strivings of the people, Thou placest me for a head of nations, A people I have not known do serve me.

18.he: לְשֵׁ֣מַֽע אֹ֭זֶן יִשָּׁ֣מְעוּ לִ֑י בְּנֵֽי־נֵ֝כָ֗ר יְכַחֲשׁוּ־לִֽי׃

lines.text: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.
At the hearing of the ear they hearken to me, Sons of a stranger feign obedience to me,

18.he: בְּנֵי־נֵכָ֥ר יִבֹּ֑לוּ וְ֝יַחְרְג֗וּ מִֽמִּסְגְּרֽוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.
Sons of a stranger fade away, And are slain out of their close places.

18.he: חַי־יְ֭הוָה וּבָר֣וּךְ צוּרִ֑י וְ֝יָר֗וּם אֱלוֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי׃

lines.text: Yahweh lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,
Jehovah liveth — and blessed [is] my rock, And exalted is the God of my salvation.

18.he: הָאֵ֗ל הַנּוֹתֵ֣ן נְקָמ֣וֹת לִ֑י וַיַּדְבֵּ֖ר עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽי׃

lines.text: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.
God — who is giving vengeance to me, And He subdueth peoples under me,

18.he: מְפַלְּטִ֗י מֵאֹ֫יְבָ֥י אַ֣ף מִן־קָ֭מַי תְּרוֹמְמֵ֑נִי מֵאִ֥ישׁ חָ֝מָ֗ס תַּצִּילֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.
My deliverer from mine enemies, Above my withstanders Thou raisest me, From a man of violence dost deliver me.

18.he: עַל־כֵּ֤ן ׀ אוֹדְךָ֖ בַגּוֹיִ֥ם ׀ יְהוָ֑ה וּלְשִׁמְךָ֥ אֲזַמֵּֽרָה׃

lines.text: Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.
Therefore I confess Thee among nations, O Jehovah, And to Thy name I sing praise,

18.he: מגדל יְשׁוּע֪וֹת מַ֫לְכּ֥וֹ וְעֹ֤שֶׂה חֶ֨סֶד ׀ לִמְשִׁיח֗וֹ לְדָוִ֥ד וּלְזַרְע֗וֹ עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

lines.text: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.
Magnifying the salvation of His king, And doing kindness to His anointed, To David, and to his seed — unto the age!
To the Overseer. — A Psalm of David. The heavens [are] recounting the honour of God, And the work of His hands The expanse [is] declaring.

19.he: הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם מְֽסַפְּרִ֥ים כְּבֽוֹד־אֵ֑ל וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָ֝דָ֗יו מַגִּ֥יד הָרָקִֽיעַ׃

lines.text: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
To the Overseer. — A Psalm of David. The heavens [are] recounting the honour of God, And the work of His hands The expanse [is] declaring.

19.he: י֣וֹם לְ֭יוֹם יַבִּ֣יעַֽ אֹ֑מֶר וְלַ֥יְלָה לְּ֝לַ֗יְלָה יְחַוֶּה־דָּֽעַת׃

lines.text: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.
Day to day uttereth speech, And night to night sheweth knowledge.

19.he: אֵֽין־אֹ֭מֶר וְאֵ֣ין דְּבָרִ֑ים בְּ֝לִ֗י נִשְׁמָ֥ע קוֹלָֽם׃

lines.text: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
There is no speech, and there are no words. Their voice hath not been heard.

19.he: בְּכָל־הָאָ֨רֶץ ׀ יָ֘צָ֤א קַוָּ֗ם וּבִקְצֵ֣ה תֵ֭בֵל מִלֵּיהֶ֑ם לַ֝שֶּׁ֗מֶשׁ שָֽׂם־אֹ֥הֶל בָּהֶֽם׃

lines.text: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,
Into all the earth hath their line gone forth, And to the end of the world their sayings, For the sun He placed a tent in them,

19.he: וְה֗וּא כְּ֭חָתָן יֹצֵ֣א מֵחֻפָּת֑וֹ יָשִׂ֥ישׂ כְּ֝גִבּ֗וֹר לָר֥וּץ אֹֽרַח׃

lines.text: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.
And he, as a bridegroom, goeth out from his covering, He rejoiceth as a mighty one To run the path.

19.he: מִקְצֵ֤ה הַשָּׁמַ֨יִם ׀ מֽוֹצָא֗וֹ וּתְקוּפָת֥וֹ עַל־קְצוֹתָ֑ם וְאֵ֥ין נִ֝סְתָּ֗ר מֵֽחַמָּתוֹ׃

lines.text: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.
From the end of the heavens [is] his going out, And his revolution [is] unto their ends, And nothing is hid from his heat.

19.he: תּ֘וֹרַ֤ת יְהוָ֣ה תְּ֭מִימָה מְשִׁ֣יבַת נָ֑פֶשׁ עֵד֥וּת יְהוָ֥ה נֶ֝אֱמָנָ֗ה מַחְכִּ֥ימַת פֶּֽתִי׃

lines.text: Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
The law of Jehovah [is] perfect, refreshing the soul, The testimonies of Jehovah [are] stedfast, Making wise the simple,

19.he: פִּקּ֘וּדֵ֤י יְהוָ֣ה יְ֭שָׁרִים מְשַׂמְּחֵי־לֵ֑ב מִצְוַ֥ת יְהוָ֥ה בָּ֝רָ֗ה מְאִירַ֥ת עֵינָֽיִם׃

lines.text: Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
The precepts of Jehovah [are] upright, Rejoicing the heart, The command of Jehovah [is] pure, enlightening the eyes,

19.he: יִרְאַ֤ת יְהוָ֨ה ׀ טְהוֹרָה֮ עוֹמֶ֪דֶת לָ֫עַ֥ד מִֽשְׁפְּטֵי־יְהוָ֥ה אֱמֶ֑ת צָֽדְק֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו׃

lines.text: The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever. Yahweh’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.
The fear of Jehovah [is] clean, standing to the age, The judgments of Jehovah [are] true, They have been righteous — together.

19.he: הַֽנֶּחֱמָדִ֗ים מִ֭זָּהָב וּמִפַּ֣ז רָ֑ב וּמְתוּקִ֥ים מִ֝דְּבַ֗שׁ וְנֹ֣פֶת צוּפִֽים׃

lines.text: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.
They are more desirable than gold, Yea, than much fine gold; and sweeter than honey, Even liquid honey of the comb.

19.he: גַּֽם־עַ֭בְדְּךָ נִזְהָ֣ר בָּהֶ֑ם בְּ֝שָׁמְרָ֗ם עֵ֣קֶב רָֽב׃

lines.text: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.
Also — Thy servant is warned by them, 'In keeping them [is] a great reward.'
Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
Errors! who doth understand? From hidden ones declare me innocent,

19.he: גַּ֤ם מִזֵּדִ֨ים ׀ חֲשֹׂ֬ךְ עַבְדֶּ֗ךָ אַֽל־יִמְשְׁלוּ־בִ֣י אָ֣ז אֵיתָ֑ם וְ֝נִקֵּ֗יתִי מִפֶּ֥שַֽׁע רָֽב׃

lines.text: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.
Also — from presumptuous ones keep back Thy servant, Let them not rule over me, Then am I perfect, And declared innocent of much transgression,

19.he: יִֽהְי֥וּ לְרָצ֨וֹן ׀ אִמְרֵי־פִ֡י וְהֶגְי֣וֹן לִבִּ֣י לְפָנֶ֑יךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה צוּרִ֥י וְגֹאֲלִֽי׃

lines.text: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.
Let the sayings of my mouth, And the meditation of my heart, Be for a pleasing thing before Thee, O Jehovah, my rock, and my redeemer!
To the Overseer. — A Psalm of David. Jehovah doth answer thee, In a day of adversity, The name of the God of Jacob doth set thee on high,

20.he: יַֽעַנְךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה יְ֝שַׂגֶּבְךָ֗ שֵׁ֤ם ׀ אֱלֹהֵ֬י יַעֲקֹֽב׃

lines.text: May Yahweh answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,
To the Overseer. — A Psalm of David. Jehovah doth answer thee, In a day of adversity, The name of the God of Jacob doth set thee on high,
send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,
He doth send thy help from the sanctuary, And from Zion doth support thee,
remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice.
He doth remember all thy presents, And thy burnt-offering doth reduce to ashes. Selah.
May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.
He doth give to thee according to thy heart, And all thy counsel doth fulfil.

20.he: נְרַנְּנָ֤ה ׀ בִּ֘ישׁ֤וּעָתֶ֗ךָ וּבְשֵֽׁם־אֱלֹהֵ֥ינוּ נִדְגֹּ֑ל יְמַלֵּ֥א יְ֝הוָ֗ה כָּל־מִשְׁאֲלוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May Yahweh grant all your requests.
We sing of thy salvation, And in the name of our God set up a banner. Jehovah doth fulfil all thy requests.

20.he: עַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּ֤י הוֹשִׁ֥יעַ ׀ יְהוָ֗ה מְשִׁ֫יח֥וֹ יַ֭עֲנֵהוּ מִשְּׁמֵ֣י קָדְשׁ֑וֹ בִּ֝גְבֻר֗וֹת יֵ֣שַׁע יְמִינֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Now I know that Yahweh saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.
Now I have known That Jehovah hath saved His anointed, He answereth him from His holy heavens, With the saving might of His right hand.

20.he: אֵ֣לֶּה בָ֭רֶכֶב וְאֵ֣לֶּה בַסּוּסִ֑ים וַאֲנַ֓חְנוּ ׀ בְּשֵׁם־יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ נַזְכִּֽיר׃

lines.text: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of Yahweh our God.
Some of chariots, and some of horses, And we of the name of Jehovah our God Make mention.

20.he: הֵ֭מָּה כָּרְע֣וּ וְנָפָ֑לוּ וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ קַּ֝֗מְנוּ וַנִּתְעוֹדָֽד׃

lines.text: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.
They — they have bowed and have fallen, And we have risen and station ourselves upright.
Save, Yahweh! Let the King answer us when we call!
O Jehovah, save the king, He doth answer us in the day we call!
To the Overseer. — A Psalm of David. Jehovah, in Thy strength is the king joyful, In Thy salvation how greatly he rejoiceth.

21.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה בְּעָזְּךָ֥ יִשְׂמַח־מֶ֑לֶךְ וּ֝בִישׁ֥וּעָתְךָ֗ מַה־יגיל מְאֹֽד׃

lines.text: The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
To the Overseer. — A Psalm of David. Jehovah, in Thy strength is the king joyful, In Thy salvation how greatly he rejoiceth.

21.he: תַּאֲוַ֣ת לִ֭בּוֹ נָתַ֣תָּה לּ֑וֹ וַאֲרֶ֥שֶׁת שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו בַּל־מָנַ֥עְתָּ סֶּֽלָה׃

lines.text: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips.
The desire of his heart Thou gavest to him, And the request of his lips Thou hast not withheld. Selah.

21.he: כִּֽי־תְ֭קַדְּמֶנּוּ בִּרְכ֣וֹת ט֑וֹב תָּשִׁ֥ית לְ֝רֹאשׁ֗וֹ עֲטֶ֣רֶת פָּֽז׃

lines.text: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.
For Thou puttest before him blessings of goodness, Thou settest on his head a crown of fine gold.

21.he: חַיִּ֤ים ׀ שָׁאַ֣ל מִ֭מְּךָ נָתַ֣תָּה לּ֑וֹ אֹ֥רֶךְ יָ֝מִ֗ים עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃

lines.text: He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.
Life he hath asked from Thee, Thou hast given to him — length of days, Age-during — and for ever.

21.he: גָּד֣וֹל כְּ֭בוֹדוֹ בִּישׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ ה֥וֹד וְ֝הָדָר תְּשַׁוֶּ֥ה עָלָֽיו׃

lines.text: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.
Great [is] his honour in Thy salvation, Honour and majesty Thou placest on him.

21.he: כִּֽי־תְשִׁיתֵ֣הוּ בְרָכ֣וֹת לָעַ֑ד תְּחַדֵּ֥הוּ בְ֝שִׂמְחָ֗ה אֶת־פָּנֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.
For Thou makest him blessings for ever, Thou dost cause him to rejoice with joy, By Thy countenance.

21.he: כִּֽי־הַ֭מֶּלֶךְ בֹּטֵ֣חַ בַּיהוָ֑ה וּבְחֶ֥סֶד עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן בַּל־יִמּֽוֹט׃

lines.text: For the king trusts in Yahweh. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.
For the king is trusting in Jehovah, And in the kindness of the Most High He is not moved.

21.he: תִּמְצָ֣א יָ֭דְךָ לְכָל־אֹיְבֶ֑יךָ יְ֝מִֽינְךָ תִּמְצָ֥א שֹׂנְאֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.
Thy hand cometh to all Thine enemies, Thy right hand doth find Thy haters.

21.he: תְּשִׁיתֵ֤מוֹ ׀ כְּתַנּ֥וּר אֵשׁ֮ לְעֵ֪ת פָּ֫נֶ֥יךָ יְ֭הוָה בְּאַפּ֣וֹ יְבַלְּעֵ֑ם וְֽתֹאכְלֵ֥ם אֵֽשׁ׃

lines.text: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. Yahweh will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.
Thou makest them as a furnace of fire, At the time of Thy presence. Jehovah in His anger doth swallow them, And fire doth devour them.

21.he: פִּ֭רְיָמוֹ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תְּאַבֵּ֑ד וְ֝זַרְעָ֗ם מִבְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

lines.text: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.
Their fruit from earth Thou destroyest, And their seed from the sons of men.

21.he: כִּי־נָט֣וּ עָלֶ֣יךָ רָעָ֑ה חָֽשְׁב֥וּ מְ֝זִמָּ֗ה בַּל־יוּכָֽלוּ׃

lines.text: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.
For they stretched out against Thee evil, They devised a wicked device, they prevail not,

21.he: כִּ֭י תְּשִׁיתֵ֣מוֹ שֶׁ֑כֶם בְּ֝מֵֽיתָרֶ֗יךָ תְּכוֹנֵ֥ן עַל־פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.
For Thou makest them a butt, When Thy strings Thou preparest against their faces.

21.he: ר֣וּמָה יְהוָ֣ה בְּעֻזֶּ֑ךָ נָשִׁ֥ירָה וּֽ֝נְזַמְּרָה גְּבוּרָתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.
Be Thou exalted, O Jehovah in, Thy strength, We sing and we praise Thy might!

22.he: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ עַל־אַיֶּ֥לֶת הַשַּׁ֗חַר מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃

lines.text: To the Overseer, on 'The Hind of the Morning.' — A Psalm of David. My God, my God, why hast Thou forsaken me? Far from my salvation, The words of my roaring?

22.he: אֵלִ֣י אֵ֭לִי לָמָ֣ה עֲזַבְתָּ֑נִי רָח֥וֹק מִֽ֝ישׁוּעָתִ֗י דִּבְרֵ֥י שַׁאֲגָתִֽי׃

lines.text: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
To the Overseer, on 'The Hind of the Morning.' — A Psalm of David. My God, my God, why hast Thou forsaken me? Far from my salvation, The words of my roaring?

22.he: אֱֽלֹהַ֗י אֶקְרָ֣א י֭וֹמָם וְלֹ֣א תַעֲנֶ֑ה וְ֝לַ֗יְלָה וְֽלֹא־דֽוּמִיָּ֥ה לִֽי׃

lines.text: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
My God, I call by day, and Thou answerest not, And by night, and there is no silence to me.

22.he: וְאַתָּ֥ה קָד֑וֹשׁ י֝וֹשֵׁ֗ב תְּהִלּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

lines.text: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.
And Thou [art] holy, Sitting — the Praise of Israel.

22.he: בְּ֭ךָ בָּטְח֣וּ אֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ בָּ֝טְח֗וּ וַֽתְּפַלְּטֵֽמוֹ׃

lines.text: Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you delivered them.
In Thee did our fathers trust — they trusted, And Thou dost deliver them.

22.he: אֵלֶ֣יךָ זָעֲק֣וּ וְנִמְלָ֑טוּ בְּךָ֖ בָטְח֣וּ וְלֹא־בֽוֹשׁוּ׃

lines.text: They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.
Unto Thee they cried, and were delivered, In Thee they trusted, and were not ashamed.

22.he: וְאָנֹכִ֣י תוֹלַ֣עַת וְלֹא־אִ֑ישׁ חֶרְפַּ֥ת אָ֝דָ֗ם וּבְז֥וּי עָֽם׃

lines.text: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.
And I [am] a worm, and no man, A reproach of man, and despised of the people.

22.he: כָּל־רֹ֭אַי יַלְעִ֣גוּ לִ֑י יַפְטִ֥ירוּ בְ֝שָׂפָ֗ה יָנִ֥יעוּ רֹֽאשׁ׃

lines.text: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,
All beholding me do mock at me, They make free with the lip — shake the head,
