22.he: גֹּ֣ל אֶל־יְהוָ֣ה יְפַלְּטֵ֑הוּ יַ֝צִּילֵ֗הוּ כִּ֘י חָ֥פֵֽץ בּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: “He trusts in Yahweh. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”
'Roll unto Jehovah, He doth deliver him, He doth deliver him, for he delighted in him.'

22.he: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה גֹחִ֣י מִבָּ֑טֶן מַ֝בְטִיחִ֗י עַל־שְׁדֵ֥י אִמִּֽי׃

lines.text: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.
For thou [art] He bringing me forth from the womb, Causing me to trust, On the breasts of my mother.

22.he: עָ֭לֶיךָ הָשְׁלַ֣כְתִּי מֵרָ֑חֶם מִבֶּ֥טֶן אִ֝מִּ֗י אֵ֣לִי אָֽתָּה׃

lines.text: I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.
On Thee I have been cast from the womb, From the belly of my mother Thou [art] my God.

22.he: אַל־תִּרְחַ֣ק מִ֭מֶּנִּי כִּי־צָרָ֣ה קְרוֹבָ֑ה כִּי־אֵ֥ין עוֹזֵֽר׃

lines.text: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.
Be not far from me, For adversity is near, for there is no helper.

22.he: סְ֭בָבוּנִי פָּרִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים אַבִּירֵ֖י בָשָׁ֣ן כִּתְּרֽוּנִי׃

lines.text: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.
Many bulls have surrounded me, Mighty ones of Bashan have compassed me,

22.he: פָּצ֣וּ עָלַ֣י פִּיהֶ֑ם אַ֝רְיֵ֗ה טֹרֵ֥ף וְשֹׁאֵֽג׃

lines.text: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.
They have opened against me their mouth, A lion tearing and roaring.

22.he: כַּמַּ֥יִם נִשְׁפַּכְתִּי֮ וְהִתְפָּֽרְד֗וּ כָּֽל־עַצְמ֫וֹתָ֥י הָיָ֣ה לִ֭בִּי כַּדּוֹנָ֑ג נָ֝מֵ֗ס בְּת֣וֹךְ מֵעָֽי׃

lines.text: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.
As waters I have been poured out, And separated themselves have all my bones, My heart hath been like wax, It is melted in the midst of my bowels.

22.he: יָ֘בֵ֤שׁ כַּחֶ֨רֶשׂ ׀ כֹּחִ֗י וּ֭לְשׁוֹנִי מֻדְבָּ֣ק מַלְקוֹחָ֑י וְֽלַעֲפַר־מָ֥וֶת תִּשְׁפְּתֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.
Dried up as an earthen vessel is my power, And my tongue is cleaving to my jaws.

22.he: כִּ֥י סְבָב֗וּנִי כְּלָ֫בִ֥ים עֲדַ֣ת מְ֭רֵעִים הִקִּיפ֑וּנִי כָּ֝אֲרִ֗י יָדַ֥י וְרַגְלָֽי׃

lines.text: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.
And to the dust of death thou appointest me, For surrounded me have dogs, A company of evil doers have compassed me, Piercing my hands and my feet.

22.he: אֲסַפֵּ֥ר כָּל־עַצְמוֹתָ֑י הֵ֥מָּה יַ֝בִּ֗יטוּ יִרְאוּ־בִֽי׃

lines.text: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.
I count all my bones — they look expectingly, They look upon me,

22.he: יְחַלְּק֣וּ בְגָדַ֣י לָהֶ֑ם וְעַל־לְ֝בוּשִׁ֗י יַפִּ֥ילוּ גוֹרָֽל׃

lines.text: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.
They apportion my garments to themselves, And for my clothing they cause a lot to fall.

22.he: וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אַל־תִּרְחָ֑ק אֱ֝יָלוּתִ֗י לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חֽוּשָׁה׃

lines.text: But don’t be far off, Yahweh. You are my help. Hurry to help me!
And Thou, O Jehovah, be not far off, O my strength, to help me haste.

22.he: הַצִּ֣ילָה מֵחֶ֣רֶב נַפְשִׁ֑י מִיַּד־כֶּ֝֗לֶב יְחִידָתִֽי׃

lines.text: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.
Deliver from the sword my soul, From the paw of a dog mine only one.

22.he: ה֭וֹשִׁיעֵנִי מִפִּ֣י אַרְיֵ֑ה וּמִקַּרְנֵ֖י רֵמִ֣ים עֲנִיתָֽנִי׃

lines.text: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.
Save me from the mouth of a lion: — And — from the horns of the high places Thou hast answered me!

22.he: אֲסַפְּרָ֣ה שִׁמְךָ֣ לְאֶחָ֑י בְּת֖וֹךְ קָהָ֣ל אֲהַלְלֶֽךָּ׃

lines.text: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.
I declare Thy name to my brethren, In the midst of the assembly I praise Thee.

22.he: יִרְאֵ֤י יְהוָ֨ה ׀ הַֽלְל֗וּהוּ כָּל־זֶ֣רַע יַעֲקֹ֣ב כַּבְּד֑וּהוּ וְג֥וּרוּ מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ כָּל־זֶ֥רַע יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

lines.text: You who fear Yahweh, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!
Ye who fear Jehovah, praise ye Him, All the seed of Jacob, honour ye Him, And be afraid of Him, all ye seed of Israel.

22.he: כִּ֤י לֹֽא־בָזָ֨ה וְלֹ֪א שִׁקַּ֡ץ עֱנ֬וּת עָנִ֗י וְלֹא־הִסְתִּ֣יר פָּנָ֣יו מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וּֽבְשַׁוְּע֖וֹ אֵלָ֣יו שָׁמֵֽעַ׃

lines.text: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, Neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.
For He hath not despised, nor abominated, The affliction of the afflicted, Nor hath He hidden His face from him, And in his crying unto Him He heareth.

22.he: מֵ֥אִתְּךָ֗ תְּֽהִלָּ֫תִ֥י בְּקָהָ֥ל רָ֑ב נְדָרַ֥י אֲ֝שַׁלֵּ֗ם נֶ֣גֶד יְרֵאָֽיו׃

lines.text: My praise of you comes in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.
Of Thee my praise [is] in the great assembly. My vows I complete before His fearers.

22.he: יֹאכְל֬וּ עֲנָוִ֨ים ׀ וְיִשְׂבָּ֗עוּ יְהַֽלְל֣וּ יְ֭הוָה דֹּ֣רְשָׁ֑יו יְחִ֖י לְבַבְכֶ֣ם לָעַֽד׃

lines.text: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise Yahweh who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.
The humble do eat and are satisfied, Praise Jehovah do those seeking Him, Your heart doth live for ever.

22.he: יִזְכְּר֤וּ ׀ וְיָשֻׁ֣בוּ אֶל־יְ֭הוָה כָּל־אַפְסֵי־אָ֑רֶץ וְיִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לְ֝פָנֶ֗יךָ כָּֽל־מִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת גּוֹיִֽם׃

lines.text: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to Yahweh. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.
Remember and return unto Jehovah, Do all ends of the earth, And before Thee bow themselves, Do all families of the nations,

22.he: כִּ֣י לַ֭יהוָה הַמְּלוּכָ֑ה וּ֝מֹשֵׁ֗ל בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃

lines.text: For the kingdom is Yahweh’s. He is the ruler over the nations.
For to Jehovah [is] the kingdom, And He is ruling among nations.

22.he: אָכְל֬וּ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוּ֨וּ ׀ כָּֽל־דִּשְׁנֵי־אֶ֗רֶץ לְפָנָ֣יו יִ֭כְרְעוּ כָּל־יוֹרְדֵ֣י עָפָ֑ר וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ לֹ֣א חִיָּֽה׃

lines.text: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can’t keep his soul alive.
And the fat ones of earth have eaten, And they bow themselves, Before Him bow do all going down to dust, And he [who] hath not revived his soul.

22.he: זֶ֥רַע יַֽעַבְדֶ֑נּוּ יְסֻפַּ֖ר לַֽאדֹנָ֣י לַדּֽוֹר׃

lines.text: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.
A seed doth serve Him, It is declared of the Lord to the generation.

22.he: יָ֭בֹאוּ וְיַגִּ֣ידוּ צִדְקָת֑וֹ לְעַ֥ם נ֝וֹלָ֗ד כִּ֣י עָשָֽׂה׃

lines.text: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.
They come and declare His righteousness, To a people that is borne, that He hath made!

23.he: מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִ֑ד יְהוָ֥ה רֹ֝עִ֗י לֹ֣א אֶחְסָֽר׃

lines.text: Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.
A Psalm of David. Jehovah [is] my shepherd, I do not lack,

23.he: בִּנְא֣וֹת דֶּ֭שֶׁא יַרְבִּיצֵ֑נִי עַל־מֵ֖י מְנֻח֣וֹת יְנַהֲלֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.
In pastures of tender grass He causeth me to lie down, By quiet waters He doth lead me.

23.he: נַפְשִׁ֥י יְשׁוֹבֵ֑ב יַֽנְחֵ֥נִי בְמַעְגְּלֵי־צֶ֝֗דֶק לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֽוֹ׃

lines.text: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
My soul He refresheth, He leadeth me in paths of righteousness, For His name's sake,

23.he: גַּ֤ם כִּֽי־אֵלֵ֨ךְ בְּגֵ֪יא צַלְמָ֡וֶת לֹא־אִ֘ירָ֤א רָ֗ע כִּי־אַתָּ֥ה עִמָּדִ֑י שִׁבְטְךָ֥ וּ֝מִשְׁעַנְתֶּ֗ךָ הֵ֣מָּה יְנַֽחֲמֻֽנִי׃

lines.text: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
Also — when I walk in a valley of death-shade, I fear no evil, for Thou [art] with me, Thy rod and Thy staff — they comfort me.

23.he: תַּעֲרֹ֬ךְ לְפָנַ֨י ׀ שֻׁלְחָ֗ן נֶ֥גֶד צֹרְרָ֑י דִּשַּׁ֖נְתָּ בַשֶּׁ֥מֶן רֹ֝אשִׁ֗י כּוֹסִ֥י רְוָיָֽה׃

lines.text: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.
Thou arrangest before me a table, Over-against my adversaries, Thou hast anointed with oil my head, My cup is full!

23.he: אַ֤ךְ ׀ ט֤וֹב וָחֶ֣סֶד יִ֭רְדְּפוּנִי כָּל־יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֑י וְשַׁבְתִּ֥י בְּבֵית־יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְאֹ֣רֶךְ יָמִֽים׃

lines.text: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in Yahweh’s house forever.
Only — goodness and kindness pursue me, All the days of my life, And my dwelling [is] in the house of Jehovah, For a length of days!

24.he: לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר לַֽ֭יהוָה הָאָ֣רֶץ וּמְלוֹאָ֑הּ תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל וְיֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃

lines.text: The earth is Yahweh’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.
A Psalm of David. To Jehovah [is] the earth and its fulness, The world and the inhabitants in it.
For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.
For He on the seas hath founded it, And on the floods He doth establish it.
Who may ascend to Yahweh’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?
Who goeth up into the hill of Jehovah? And who riseth up in His holy place?

24.he: נְקִ֥י כַפַּ֗יִם וּֽבַר־לֵ֫בָ֥ב אֲשֶׁ֤ר ׀ לֹא־נָשָׂ֣א לַשָּׁ֣וְא נַפְשִׁ֑י וְלֹ֖א נִשְׁבַּ֣ע לְמִרְמָֽה׃

lines.text: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.
The clean of hands, and pure of heart, Who hath not lifted up to vanity his soul, Nor hath sworn to deceit.

24.he: יִשָּׂ֣א בְ֭רָכָה מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה מֵאֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעֽוֹ׃

lines.text: He shall receive a blessing from Yahweh, righteousness from the God of his salvation.
He beareth away a blessing from Jehovah, Righteousness from the God of his salvation.

24.he: זֶ֭ה דּ֣וֹר דרשו מְבַקְשֵׁ֨י פָנֶ֖יךָ יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob.
This [is] a generation of those seeking Him. Seeking Thy face, O Jacob! Selah.

24.he: שְׂא֤וּ שְׁעָרִ֨ים ׀ רָֽאשֵׁיכֶ֗ם וְֽ֭הִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵ֣י עוֹלָ֑ם וְ֝יָב֗וֹא מֶ֣לֶךְ הַכָּבֽוֹד׃

lines.text: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
Lift up, O gates, your heads, And be lifted up, O doors age-during, And come in doth the king of glory!

24.he: מִ֥י זֶה֮ מֶ֤לֶךְ הַכָּ֫ב֥וֹד יְ֭הוָה עִזּ֣וּז וְגִבּ֑וֹר יְ֝הוָ֗ה גִּבּ֥וֹר מִלְחָמָֽה׃

lines.text: Who is the King of glory? Yahweh strong and mighty, Yahweh mighty in battle.
Who [is] this — 'the king of glory?' Jehovah — strong and mighty, Jehovah, the mighty in battle.

24.he: שְׂא֤וּ שְׁעָרִ֨ים ׀ רָֽאשֵׁיכֶ֗ם וּ֭שְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵ֣י עוֹלָ֑ם וְ֝יָבֹא מֶ֣לֶךְ הַכָּבֽוֹד׃

lines.text: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
Lift up, O gates, your heads, And be lifted up, O doors age-during, And come in doth the king of glory!

24.he: מִ֤י ה֣וּא זֶה֮ מֶ֤לֶךְ הַכָּ֫ב֥וֹד יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֑וֹת ה֤וּא מֶ֖לֶךְ הַכָּב֣וֹד סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: Who is this King of glory? Yahweh of Armies is the King of glory!
Who [is] He — this 'king of glory?' Jehovah of hosts — He [is] the king of glory! Selah.

25.he: לְדָוִ֡ד אֵלֶ֥יךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה נַפְשִׁ֥י אֶשָּֽׂא׃

lines.text: To you, Yahweh, I lift up my soul.
By David. Unto Thee, O Jehovah, my soul I lift up.

25.he: אֱֽלֹהַ֗י בְּךָ֣ בָ֭טַחְתִּי אַל־אֵב֑וֹשָׁה אַל־יַֽעַלְצ֖וּ אֹיְבַ֣י לִֽי׃

lines.text: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.
My God, in Thee I have trusted, Let me not be ashamed, Let not mine enemies exult over me.

25.he: גַּ֣ם כָּל־קֹ֭וֶיךָ לֹ֣א יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ יֵ֝בֹ֗שׁוּ הַבּוֹגְדִ֥ים רֵיקָֽם׃

lines.text: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.
Also let none waiting on Thee be ashamed, Let the treacherous dealers without cause be ashamed.

25.he: דְּרָכֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הוָה הוֹדִיעֵ֑נִי אֹ֖רְחוֹתֶ֣יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.
Thy ways, O Jehovah, cause me to know, Thy paths teach Thou me.

25.he: הַדְרִ֘יכֵ֤נִי בַאֲמִתֶּ֨ךָ ׀ וְֽלַמְּדֵ֗נִי כִּֽי־אַ֭תָּה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֑י אוֹתְךָ֥ קִ֝וִּ֗יתִי כָּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃

lines.text: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, For you are the God of my salvation, I wait for you all day long.
Cause me to tread in Thy truth, and teach me, For Thou [art] the God of my salvation, Near Thee I have waited all the day.

25.he: זְכֹר־רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הוָה וַחֲסָדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י מֵעוֹלָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה׃

lines.text: Yahweh, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.
Remember Thy mercies, O Jehovah, And Thy kindnesses, for from the age [are] they.

25.he: חַטֹּ֤אות נְעוּרַ֨י ׀ וּפְשָׁעַ֗י אַל־תִּ֫זְכֹּ֥ר כְּחַסְדְּךָ֥ זְכָר־לִי־אַ֑תָּה לְמַ֖עַן טוּבְךָ֣ יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, Yahweh.
Sins of my youth, and my transgressions, Do not Thou remember. According to Thy kindness be mindful of me, For Thy goodness' sake, O Jehovah.

25.he: טוֹב־וְיָשָׁ֥ר יְהוָ֑ה עַל־כֵּ֤ן יוֹרֶ֖ה חַטָּאִ֣ים בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃

lines.text: Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
Good and upright [is] Jehovah, Therefore He directeth sinners in the way.

25.he: יַדְרֵ֣ךְ עֲ֭נָוִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וִֽילַמֵּ֖ד עֲנָוִ֣ים דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
He causeth the humble to tread in judgment, And teacheth the humble His way.

25.he: כָּל־אָרְח֣וֹת יְ֭הוָה חֶ֣סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֑ת לְנֹצְרֵ֥י בְ֝רִית֗וֹ וְעֵדֹתָֽיו׃

lines.text: All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
All the paths of Jehovah [are] kindness and truth, To those keeping His covenant, And His testimonies.

25.he: לְמַֽעַן־שִׁמְךָ֥ יְהוָ֑ה וְֽסָלַחְתָּ֥ לַ֝עֲוֺנִ֗י כִּ֣י רַב־הֽוּא׃

lines.text: For your name’s sake, Yahweh, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
For Thy name's sake, O Jehovah, Thou hast pardoned mine iniquity, for it [is] great.

25.he: מִי־זֶ֣ה הָ֭אִישׁ יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה י֝וֹרֶ֗נּוּ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יִבְחָֽר׃

lines.text: What man is he who fears Yahweh? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.
Who [is] this — the man fearing Jehovah? He directeth him in the way He doth choose.

25.he: נַ֭פְשׁוֹ בְּט֣וֹב תָּלִ֑ין וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ יִ֣ירַשׁ אָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.
His soul in good doth remain, And his seed doth possess the land.

25.he: ס֣וֹד יְ֭הוָה לִירֵאָ֑יו וּ֝בְרִית֗וֹ לְהוֹדִיעָֽם׃

lines.text: The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.
The secret of Jehovah [is] for those fearing Him, And His covenant — to cause them to know.

25.he: עֵינַ֣י תָּ֭מִיד אֶל־יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י הֽוּא־יוֹצִ֖יא מֵרֶ֣שֶׁת רַגְלָֽי׃

lines.text: My eyes are ever on Yahweh, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.
Mine eyes [are] continually unto Jehovah, For He bringeth out from a net my feet.

25.he: פְּנֵה־אֵלַ֥י וְחָנֵּ֑נִי כִּֽי־יָחִ֖יד וְעָנִ֣י אָֽנִי׃

lines.text: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.
Turn Thou unto me, and favour me, For lonely and afflicted [am] I.

25.he: צָר֣וֹת לְבָבִ֣י הִרְחִ֑יבוּ מִ֝מְּצֽוּקוֹתַ֗י הוֹצִיאֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.
The distresses of my heart have enlarged themselves, From my distresses bring me out.

25.he: רְאֵ֣ה עָ֭נְיִי וַעֲמָלִ֑י וְ֝שָׂ֗א לְכָל־חַטֹּאותָֽי׃

lines.text: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.
See mine affliction and my misery, And bear with all my sins.

25.he: רְאֵֽה־אוֹיְבַ֥י כִּי־רָ֑בּוּ וְשִׂנְאַ֖ת חָמָ֣ס שְׂנֵאֽוּנִי׃

lines.text: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.
See my enemies, for they have been many, And with violent hatred they have hated me.

25.he: שָׁמְרָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי וְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי אַל־אֵ֝ב֗וֹשׁ כִּֽי־חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽךְ׃

lines.text: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.
Keep my soul, and deliver me, Let me not be ashamed, for I trusted in Thee.

25.he: תֹּם־וָיֹ֥שֶׁר יִצְּר֑וּנִי כִּ֝֗י קִוִּיתִֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
Integrity and uprightness do keep me, For I have waited [on] Thee.

25.he: פְּדֵ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִ֝כֹּ֗ל צָֽרוֹתָיו׃

lines.text: Redeem Israel, God, out of all his troubles.
Redeem Israel, O God, from all his distresses!

26.he: לְדָוִ֨ד ׀ שָׁפְטֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֗ה כִּֽי־אֲ֭נִי בְּתֻמִּ֣י הָלַ֑כְתִּי וּבַיהוָ֥ה בָּ֝טַ֗חְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶמְעָֽד׃

lines.text: Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.
By David. Judge me, O Jehovah, for I in mine integrity have walked, And in Jehovah I have trusted, I slide not.

26.he: בְּחָנֵ֣נִי יְהוָ֣ה וְנַסֵּ֑נִי צרופה כִלְיוֹתַ֣י וְלִבִּֽי׃

lines.text: Examine me, Yahweh, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.
Try me, O Jehovah, and prove me, Purified [are] my reins and my heart.
For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.
For Thy kindness [is] before mine eyes, And I have walked habitually in Thy truth.

26.he: לֹא־יָ֭שַׁבְתִּי עִם־מְתֵי־שָׁ֑וא וְעִ֥ם נַ֝עֲלָמִ֗ים לֹ֣א אָבֽוֹא׃

lines.text: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.
I have not sat with vain men, And with dissemblers I enter not.

26.he: שָׂ֭נֵאתִי קְהַ֣ל מְרֵעִ֑ים וְעִם־רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים לֹ֣א אֵשֵֽׁב׃

lines.text: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.
I have hated the assembly of evil doers, And with the wicked I sit not.

26.he: אֶרְחַ֣ץ בְּנִקָּי֣וֹן כַּפָּ֑י וַאֲסֹבְבָ֖ה אֶת־מִזְבַּחֲךָ֣ יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, Yahweh,
I wash in innocency my hands, And I compass Thine altar, O Jehovah.
that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds.
To sound with a voice of confession, And to recount all Thy wonders.

26.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה אָ֭הַבְתִּי מְע֣וֹן בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מְק֗וֹם מִשְׁכַּ֥ן כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Yahweh, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.
Jehovah, I have loved the habitation of Thy house, And the place of the tabernacle of Thine honour.

26.he: אַל־תֶּאֱסֹ֣ף עִם־חַטָּאִ֣ים נַפְשִׁ֑י וְעִם־אַנְשֵׁ֖י דָמִ֣ים חַיָּֽי׃

lines.text: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men;
Do not gather with sinners my soul, And with men of blood my life,
in whose hands is wickedness, their right hand is full of bribes.
In whose hand [is] a wicked device, And their right hand [is] full of bribes.
But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.
And I, in mine integrity I walk, Redeem me, and favour me.

26.he: רַ֭גְלִי עָֽמְדָ֣ה בְמִישׁ֑וֹר בְּ֝מַקְהֵלִ֗ים אֲבָרֵ֥ךְ יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless Yahweh.
My foot hath stood in uprightness, In assemblies I bless Jehovah!

27.he: לְדָוִ֨ד ׀ יְהוָ֤ה ׀ אוֹרִ֣י וְ֭יִשְׁעִי מִמִּ֣י אִירָ֑א יְהוָ֥ה מָֽעוֹז־חַ֝יַּ֗י מִמִּ֥י אֶפְחָֽד׃

lines.text: Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
By David. Jehovah [is] my light and my salvation, Whom do I fear? Jehovah [is] the strength of my life, Of whom am I afraid?

27.he: בִּקְרֹ֤ב עָלַ֨י ׀ מְרֵעִים֮ לֶאֱכֹ֪ל אֶת־בְּשָׂ֫רִ֥י צָרַ֣י וְאֹיְבַ֣י לִ֑י הֵ֖מָּה כָשְׁל֣וּ וְנָפָֽלוּ׃

lines.text: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
When evil doers come near to me to eat my flesh, My adversaries and mine enemies to me, They have stumbled and fallen.

27.he: אִם־תַּחֲנֶ֬ה עָלַ֨י ׀ מַחֲנֶה֮ לֹֽא־יִירָ֪א לִ֫בִּ֥י אִם־תָּק֣וּם עָ֭לַי מִלְחָמָ֑ה בְּ֝זֹ֗את אֲנִ֣י בוֹטֵֽחַ׃

lines.text: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.
Though a host doth encamp against me, My heart doth not fear, Though war riseth up against me, In this I [am] confident.

27.he: אַחַ֤ת ׀ שָׁאַ֣לְתִּי מֵֽאֵת־יְהוָה֮ אוֹתָ֪הּ אֲבַ֫קֵּ֥שׁ שִׁבְתִּ֣י בְּבֵית־יְ֭הוָה כָּל־יְמֵ֣י חַיַּ֑י לַחֲז֥וֹת בְּנֹֽעַם־יְ֝הוָ֗ה וּלְבַקֵּ֥ר בְּהֵיכָלֽוֹ׃

lines.text: One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life, to see Yahweh’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.
One [thing] I asked of Jehovah — it I seek. My dwelling in the house of Jehovah, All the days of my life, To look on the pleasantness of Jehovah, And to inquire in His temple.

27.he: כִּ֤י יִצְפְּנֵ֨נִי ׀ בְּסֻכֹּה֮ בְּי֪וֹם רָ֫עָ֥ה יַ֭סְתִּרֵנִי בְּסֵ֣תֶר אָהֳל֑וֹ בְּ֝צ֗וּר יְרוֹמְמֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.
For He hideth me in a tabernacle in the day of evil, He hideth me in a secret place of His tent, On a rock he raiseth me up.

27.he: וְעַתָּ֨ה יָר֪וּם רֹאשִׁ֡י עַ֤ל אֹֽיְבַ֬י סְֽבִיבוֹתַ֗י וְאֶזְבְּחָ֣ה בְ֭אָהֳלוֹ זִבְחֵ֣י תְרוּעָ֑ה אָשִׁ֥ירָה וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה לַיהוָֽה׃

lines.text: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to Yahweh.
And now, lifted up is my head, Above my enemies — my surrounders, And I sacrifice in His tent sacrifices of shouting, I sing, yea, I sing praise to Jehovah.
Hear, Yahweh, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.
Hear, O Jehovah, my voice — I call, And favour me, and answer me.

27.he: לְךָ֤ ׀ אָמַ֣ר לִ֭בִּי בַּקְּשׁ֣וּ פָנָ֑י אֶת־פָּנֶ֖יךָ יְהוָ֣ה אֲבַקֵּֽשׁ׃

lines.text: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, Yahweh.”
To Thee said my heart 'They sought my face, Thy face, O Jehovah, I seek.'

27.he: אַל־תַּסְתֵּ֬ר פָּנֶ֨יךָ ׀ מִמֶּנִּי֮ אַֽל־תַּט־בְּאַ֗ף עַ֫בְדֶּ֥ךָ עֶזְרָתִ֥י הָיִ֑יתָ אַֽל־תִּטְּשֵׁ֥נִי וְאַל־תַּֽ֝עַזְבֵ֗נִי אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי׃

lines.text: Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.
Hide not Thy face from me, Turn not aside in anger Thy servant, My help Thou hast been. Leave me not, nor forsake me, O God of my salvation.
When my father and my mother forsake me, then Yahweh will take me up.
When my father and my mother Have forsaken me, then doth Jehovah gather me.

27.he: ה֤וֹרֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֗ה דַּ֫רְכֶּ֥ךָ וּ֭נְחֵנִי בְּאֹ֣רַח מִישׁ֑וֹר לְ֝מַ֗עַן שׁוֹרְרָֽי׃

lines.text: Teach me your way, Yahweh. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.
Shew me, O Jehovah, Thy way, And lead me in a path of uprightness, For the sake of my beholders.

27.he: אַֽל־תִּ֭תְּנֵנִי בְּנֶ֣פֶשׁ צָרָ֑י כִּ֥י קָֽמוּ־בִ֥י עֵֽדֵי־שֶׁ֝֗קֶר וִיפֵ֥חַ חָמָֽס׃

lines.text: Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.
Give me not to the will of my adversaries, For risen against me have false witnesses, And they breathe out violence to me.

27.he: לׅׄוּלֵׅ֗ׄאׅׄ הֶ֭אֱמַנְתִּי לִרְא֥וֹת בְּֽטוּב־יְהוָ֗ה בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּֽים׃

lines.text: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living.
I had not believed to look on the goodness of Jehovah In the land of the living!

27.he: קַוֵּ֗ה אֶל־יְה֫וָ֥ה חֲ֭זַק וְיַאֲמֵ֣ץ לִבֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝קַוֵּ֗ה אֶל־יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
Look unto Jehovah — be strong, And He doth strengthen thy heart, Yea, look unto Jehovah!

28.he: לְדָוִ֡ד אֵ֘לֶ֤יךָ יְהוָ֨ה ׀ אֶקְרָ֗א צוּרִי֮ אַֽל־תֶּחֱרַ֪שׁ מִּ֫מֶּ֥נִּי פֶּן־תֶּֽחֱשֶׁ֥ה מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְ֝נִמְשַׁ֗לְתִּי עִם־י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃

lines.text: To you, Yahweh, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.
By David. Unto Thee, O Jehovah, I call, My rock, be not silent to me! Lest Thou be silent to me, And I have been compared With those going down to the pit.

28.he: שְׁמַ֤ע ק֣וֹל תַּ֭חֲנוּנַי בְּשַׁוְּעִ֣י אֵלֶ֑יךָ בְּנָשְׂאִ֥י יָ֝דַ֗י אֶל־דְּבִ֥יר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃

lines.text: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.
Hear the voice of my supplications, In my crying unto Thee, In my lifting up my hands toward thy holy oracle.

28.he: אַל־תִּמְשְׁכֵ֣נִי עִם־רְשָׁעִים֮ וְעִם־פֹּ֪עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן דֹּבְרֵ֣י שָׁ֭לוֹם עִם־רֵֽעֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝רָעָ֗ה בִּלְבָבָֽם׃

lines.text: Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.
Draw me not with the wicked, And with workers of iniquity, Speaking peace with their neighbours, And evil in their heart.

28.he: תֶּן־לָהֶ֣ם כְּפָעֳלָם֮ וּכְרֹ֪עַ מַֽעַלְלֵ֫יהֶ֥ם כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְ֭דֵיהֶם תֵּ֣ן לָהֶ֑ם הָשֵׁ֖ב גְּמוּלָ֣ם לָהֶֽם׃

lines.text: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.
Give to them according to their acting, And according to the evil of their doings. According to the work of their hands give to them. Return their deed to them.

28.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֤א יָבִ֡ינוּ אֶל־פְּעֻלֹּ֣ת יְ֭הוָה וְאֶל־מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדָ֑יו יֶ֝הֶרְסֵ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יִבְנֵֽם׃

lines.text: Because they don’t respect the works of Yahweh, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.
For they attend not to the doing of Jehovah, And unto the work of His hands. He throweth them down, And doth not build them up.
Blessed be Yahweh, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.
Blessed [is] Jehovah, For He hath heard the voice of my supplications.

28.he: יְהוָ֤ה ׀ עֻזִּ֥י וּמָגִנִּי֮ בּ֤וֹ בָטַ֥ח לִבִּ֗י וְֽנֶ֫עֱזָ֥רְתִּי וַיַּעֲלֹ֥ז לִבִּ֑י וּֽמִשִּׁירִ֥י אֲהוֹדֶֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
Jehovah [is] my strength, and my shield, In Him my heart trusted, and I have been helped. And my heart exulteth, And with my song I thank Him.

28.he: יְהוָ֥ה עֹֽז־לָ֑מוֹ וּמָ֘ע֤וֹז יְשׁוּע֖וֹת מְשִׁיח֣וֹ הֽוּא׃

lines.text: Yahweh is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.
Jehovah [is] strength to him, Yea, the strength of the salvation of His anointed [is] He.

28.he: הוֹשִׁ֤יעָה ׀ אֶת־עַמֶּ֗ךָ וּבָרֵ֥ךְ אֶת־נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ וּֽרְעֵ֥ם וְ֝נַשְּׂאֵ֗ם עַד־הָעוֹלָֽם׃

lines.text: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.
Save Thy people, and bless Thine inheritance, And feed them, and carry them to the age!

29.he: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥ד הָב֣וּ לַֽ֭יהוָה בְּנֵ֣י אֵלִ֑ים הָב֥וּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז׃

lines.text: Ascribe to Yahweh, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.
A Psalm of David. Ascribe to Jehovah, ye sons of the mighty, Ascribe to Jehovah honour and strength.

29.he: הָב֣וּ לַֽ֭יהוָה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ הִשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה בְּהַדְרַת־קֹֽדֶשׁ׃

lines.text: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Worship Yahweh in holy array.
Ascribe to Jehovah the honour of His name, Bow yourselves to Jehovah, In the beauty of holiness.

29.he: ק֥וֹל יְהוָ֗ה עַל־הַ֫מָּ֥יִם אֵֽל־הַכָּב֥וֹד הִרְעִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה עַל־מַ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃

lines.text: Yahweh’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even Yahweh on many waters.
The voice of Jehovah [is] on the waters, The God of glory hath thundered, Jehovah [is] on many waters.
Yahweh’s voice is powerful. Yahweh’s voice is full of majesty.
The voice of Jehovah [is] with power, The voice of Jehovah [is] with majesty,

29.he: ק֣וֹל יְ֭הוָה שֹׁבֵ֣ר אֲרָזִ֑ים וַיְשַׁבֵּ֥ר יְ֝הוָ֗ה אֶת־אַרְזֵ֥י הַלְּבָנֽוֹן׃

lines.text: Yahweh’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, Yahweh breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
The voice of Jehovah [is] shivering cedars, Yea, Jehovah shivers the cedars of Lebanon.

29.he: וַיַּרְקִידֵ֥ם כְּמוֹ־עֵ֑גֶל לְבָנ֥וֹן וְ֝שִׂרְיֹ֗ן כְּמ֣וֹ בֶן־רְאֵמִֽים׃

lines.text: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.
And He causeth them to skip as a calf, Lebanon and Sirion as a son of Reems,
Yahweh’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.
The voice of Jehovah is hewing fiery flames,

29.he: ק֣וֹל יְ֭הוָה יָחִ֣יל מִדְבָּ֑ר יָחִ֥יל יְ֝הוָ֗ה מִדְבַּ֥ר קָדֵֽשׁ׃

lines.text: Yahweh’s voice shakes the wilderness. Yahweh shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
The voice of Jehovah paineth a wilderness, Jehovah paineth the wilderness of Kadesh.

29.he: ק֤וֹל יְהוָ֨ה ׀ יְחוֹלֵ֣ל אַיָּלוֹת֮ וַֽיֶּחֱשֹׂ֪ף יְעָ֫ר֥וֹת וּבְהֵיכָל֑וֹ כֻּ֝לּ֗וֹ אֹמֵ֥ר כָּבֽוֹד׃

lines.text: Yahweh’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”
The voice of Jehovah paineth the oaks, And maketh bare the forests, And in His temple every one saith, 'Glory.'

29.he: יְ֭הוָה לַמַּבּ֣וּל יָשָׁ֑ב וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב יְ֝הוָ֗ה מֶ֣לֶךְ לְעוֹלָֽם׃

lines.text: Yahweh sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, Yahweh sits as King forever.
Jehovah on the deluge hath sat, And Jehovah sitteth king — to the age,

29.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה עֹ֭ז לְעַמּ֣וֹ יִתֵּ֑ן יְהוָ֓ה ׀ יְבָרֵ֖ךְ אֶת־עַמּ֣וֹ בַשָּׁלֽוֹם׃

lines.text: Yahweh will give strength to his people. Yahweh will bless his people with peace.
Jehovah strength to his people giveth, Jehovah blesseth His people with peace!
A Psalm. — A song of the dedication of the house of David. I exalt Thee, O Jehovah, For Thou hast drawn me up, and hast not let mine enemies rejoice over me.

30.he: אֲרוֹמִמְךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה כִּ֣י דִלִּיתָ֑נִי וְלֹא־שִׂמַּ֖חְתָּ אֹיְבַ֣י לִֽי׃

lines.text: I will extol you, Yahweh, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
A Psalm. — A song of the dedication of the house of David. I exalt Thee, O Jehovah, For Thou hast drawn me up, and hast not let mine enemies rejoice over me.
Yahweh my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.
Jehovah my God, I have cried to Thee, And Thou dost heal me.

30.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה הֶֽעֱלִ֣יתָ מִּן־שְׁא֣וֹל נַפְשִׁ֑י חִ֝יִּיתַ֗נִי מיורדי־בֽוֹר׃

lines.text: Yahweh, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
Jehovah, Thou hast brought up from Sheol my soul, Thou hast kept me alive, From going down [to] the pit.

30.he: זַמְּר֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חֲסִידָ֑יו וְ֝הוֹד֗וּ לְזֵ֣כֶר קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃

lines.text: Sing praise to Yahweh, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.
Sing praise to Jehovah, ye His saints, And give thanks at the remembrance of His holiness,

30.he: כִּ֤י רֶ֨גַע ׀ בְּאַפּוֹ֮ חַיִּ֪ים בִּרְצ֫וֹנ֥וֹ בָּ֭עֶרֶב יָלִ֥ין בֶּ֗כִי וְלַבֹּ֥קֶר רִנָּֽה׃

lines.text: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
For — a moment [is] in His anger, Life [is] in His good-will, At even remaineth weeping, and at morn singing.
As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”
And I — I have said in mine ease, 'I am not moved — to the age.

30.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה בִּרְצוֹנְךָ֮ הֶעֱמַ֪דְתָּה לְֽהַרְרִ֫י עֹ֥ז הִסְתַּ֥רְתָּ פָנֶ֗יךָ הָיִ֥יתִי נִבְהָֽל׃

lines.text: You, Yahweh, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.
O Jehovah, in Thy good pleasure, Thou hast caused strength to remain for my mountain,' Thou hast hidden Thy face — I have been troubled.
I cried to you, Yahweh. I made supplication to the Lord:
Unto Thee, O Jehovah, I call, And unto Jehovah I make supplication.

30.he: מַה־בֶּ֥צַע בְּדָמִי֮ בְּרִדְתִּ֪י אֶ֫ל־שָׁ֥חַת הֲיוֹדְךָ֥ עָפָ֑ר הֲיַגִּ֥יד אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?
'What gain [is] in my blood? In my going down unto corruption? Doth dust thank Thee? doth it declare Thy truth?
Hear, Yahweh, and have mercy on me. Yahweh, be my helper.”
Hear, O Jehovah, and favour me, O Jehovah, be a helper to me.'

30.he: הָפַ֣כְתָּ מִסְפְּדִי֮ לְמָח֪וֹל לִ֥י פִּתַּ֥חְתָּ שַׂקִּ֑י וַֽתְּאַזְּרֵ֥נִי שִׂמְחָֽה׃

lines.text: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,
Thou hast turned my mourning to dancing for me, Thou hast loosed my sackcloth, And girdest me [with] joy.

30.he: לְמַ֤עַן ׀ יְזַמֶּרְךָ֣ כָ֭בוֹד וְלֹ֣א יִדֹּ֑ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י לְעוֹלָ֥ם אוֹדֶֽךָּ׃

lines.text: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
So that honour doth praise Thee, and is not silent, O Jehovah, my God, to the age I thank Thee!

31.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃

lines.text: To the Overseer. — A Psalm of David. In Thee, O Jehovah, I have trusted, Let me not be ashamed to the age, In Thy righteousness deliver me.

31.he: בְּךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה חָ֭סִיתִי אַל־אֵב֣וֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָ֑ם בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֥ פַלְּטֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.
To the Overseer. — A Psalm of David. In Thee, O Jehovah, I have trusted, Let me not be ashamed to the age, In Thy righteousness deliver me.

31.he: הַטֵּ֤ה אֵלַ֨י ׀ אָזְנְךָ֮ מְהֵרָ֪ה הַצִּ֫ילֵ֥נִי הֱיֵ֤ה לִ֨י ׀ לְֽצוּר־מָ֭עוֹז לְבֵ֥ית מְצוּד֗וֹת לְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.
Incline unto me Thine ear hastily, deliver me, Be to me for a strong rock, For a house of bulwarks to save me.

31.he: כִּֽי־סַלְעִ֣י וּמְצוּדָתִ֣י אָ֑תָּה וּלְמַ֥עַן שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ תַּֽנְחֵ֥נִי וּֽתְנַהֲלֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.
For my rock and my bulwark [art] Thou, For Thy name's sake lead me and tend me.

31.he: תּוֹצִיאֵ֗נִי מֵרֶ֣שֶׁת ז֭וּ טָ֣מְנוּ לִ֑י כִּֽי־אַ֝תָּה מָֽעוּזִּי׃

lines.text: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.
Bring me out from the net that they hid for me, For Thou [art] my strength.

31.he: בְּיָדְךָ֮ אַפְקִ֪יד ר֫וּחִ֥י פָּדִ֖יתָה אוֹתִ֥י יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֣ל אֱמֶֽת׃

lines.text: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, Yahweh, God of truth.
Into Thy hand I commit my spirit, Thou hast redeemed me, Jehovah God of truth.

31.he: שָׂנֵ֗אתִי הַשֹּׁמְרִ֥ים הַבְלֵי־שָׁ֑וא וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶל־יְהוָ֥ה בָּטָֽחְתִּי׃

lines.text: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in Yahweh.
I have hated the observers of lying vanities, And I toward Jehovah have been confident.

31.he: אָגִ֥ילָה וְאֶשְׂמְחָ֗ה בְּחַ֫סְדֶּ֥ךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָ֭אִיתָ אֶת־עָנְיִ֑י יָ֝דַ֗עְתָּ בְּצָר֥וֹת נַפְשִֽׁי׃

lines.text: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.
I rejoice, and am glad in Thy kindness, In that Thou hast seen mine affliction, Thou hast known in adversities my soul.

31.he: וְלֹ֣א הִ֭סְגַּרְתַּנִי בְּיַד־אוֹיֵ֑ב הֶֽעֱמַ֖דְתָּ בַמֶּרְחָ֣ב רַגְלָֽי׃

lines.text: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.
And Thou hast not shut me up, Into the hand of an enemy, Thou hast caused my feet to stand in a broad place.

31.he: חָנֵּ֥נִי יְהוָה֮ כִּ֤י צַ֫ר־לִ֥י עָשְׁשָׁ֖ה בְכַ֥עַס עֵינִ֗י נַפְשִׁ֥י וּבִטְנִֽי׃

lines.text: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.
Favour me, O Jehovah, for distress [is] to me, Mine eye, my soul, and my body Have become old by provocation.

31.he: כִּ֤י כָל֪וּ בְיָג֡וֹן חַיַּי֮ וּשְׁנוֹתַ֪י בַּאֲנָ֫חָ֥ה כָּשַׁ֣ל בַּעֲוֺנִ֣י כֹחִ֑י וַעֲצָמַ֥י עָשֵֽׁשׁוּ׃

lines.text: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.
For my life hath been consumed in sorrow And my years in sighing. Feeble because of mine iniquity hath been my strength, And my bones have become old.

31.he: מִכָּל־צֹרְרַ֨י הָיִ֪יתִי חֶרְפָּ֡ה וְלִ֥שֲׁכֵנַ֨י ׀ מְאֹד֮ וּפַ֪חַד לִֽמְיֻדָּ֫עָ֥י רֹאַ֥י בַּח֑וּץ נָדְד֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

lines.text: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.
Among all mine adversaries I have been a reproach, And to my neighbours exceedingly, And a fear to mine acquaintances, Those seeing me without — fled from me.

31.he: נִ֭שְׁכַּחְתִּי כְּמֵ֣ת מִלֵּ֑ב הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כִּכְלִ֥י אֹבֵֽד׃

lines.text: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.
I have been forgotten as dead out of mind, I have been as a perishing vessel.

31.he: כִּ֤י שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי ׀ דִּבַּ֥ת רַבִּים֮ מָג֪וֹר מִסָּ֫בִ֥יב בְּהִוָּסְדָ֣ם יַ֣חַד עָלַ֑י לָקַ֖חַת נַפְשִׁ֣י זָמָֽמוּ׃

lines.text: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.
For I have heard an evil account of many, Fear [is] round about. In their being united against me, To take my life they have devised,

31.he: וַאֲנִ֤י ׀ עָלֶ֣יךָ בָטַ֣חְתִּי יְהוָ֑ה אָ֝מַ֗רְתִּי אֱלֹהַ֥י אָֽתָּה׃

lines.text: But I trust in you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my God.”
And I on Thee — I have trusted, O Jehovah, I have said, 'Thou [art] my God.'

31.he: בְּיָדְךָ֥ עִתֹּתָ֑י הַצִּ֘ילֵ֤נִי מִיַּד־א֝וֹיְבַ֗י וּמֵרֹדְפָֽי׃

lines.text: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.
In Thy hand [are] my times, Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, And from my pursuers.

31.he: הָאִ֣ירָה פָ֭נֶיךָ עַל־עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ ה֖וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי בְחַסְדֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.
Cause Thy face to shine on Thy servant, Save me in Thy kindness.

31.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל־אֵ֭בוֹשָׁה כִּ֣י קְרָאתִ֑יךָ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יִדְּמ֥וּ לִשְׁאֽוֹל׃

lines.text: Let me not be disappointed, Yahweh, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.
O Jehovah, let me not be ashamed, For I have called Thee, let the wicked be ashamed, Let them become silent to Sheol.

31.he: תֵּ֥אָלַ֗מְנָה שִׂפְתֵ֫י שָׁ֥קֶר הַדֹּבְר֖וֹת עַל־צַדִּ֥יק עָתָ֗ק בְּגַאֲוָ֥ה וָבֽוּז׃

lines.text: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.
Let lips of falsehood become dumb, That are speaking against the righteous, Ancient sayings, in pride and contempt.

31.he: מָ֤ה רַֽב־טוּבְךָ֮ אֲשֶׁר־צָפַ֪נְתָּ לִּֽירֵ֫אֶ֥יךָ פָּ֭עַלְתָּ לַחֹסִ֣ים בָּ֑ךְ נֶ֝֗גֶד בְּנֵ֣י אָדָם׃

lines.text: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!
How abundant is Thy goodness, That Thou hast laid up for those fearing Thee,

31.he: תַּסְתִּירֵ֤ם ׀ בְּסֵ֥תֶר פָּנֶיךָ֮ מֵֽרֻכְסֵ֫י אִ֥ישׁ תִּצְפְּנֵ֥ם בְּסֻכָּ֗ה מֵרִ֥יב לְשֹׁנֽוֹת׃

lines.text: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.

Thou hast wrought for those trusting in Thee, Before sons of men. Thou hidest them in the secret place of Thy presence, From artifices of man, Thou concealest them in a tabernacle, From the strife of tongues.

31.he: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י הִפְלִ֘יא חַסְדּ֥וֹ לִ֝֗י בְּעִ֣יר מָצֽוֹר׃

lines.text: Praise be to Yahweh, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.
Blessed [is] Jehovah, For He hath made marvellous His kindness To me in a city of bulwarks.

31.he: וַאֲנִ֤י ׀ אָ֘מַ֤רְתִּי בְחָפְזִ֗י נִגְרַזְתִּי֮ מִנֶּ֪גֶד עֵ֫ינֶ֥יךָ אָכֵ֗ן שָׁ֭מַעְתָּ ק֥וֹל תַּחֲנוּנַ֗י בְּשַׁוְּעִ֥י אֵלֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.
And I — I have said in my haste, 'I have been cut off from before Thine eyes,' But Thou hast heard the voice of my supplications, In my crying unto Thee.

31.he: אֶ֥הֱב֥וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֗ה כָּֽל־חֲסִ֫ידָ֥יו אֱ֭מוּנִים נֹצֵ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וּמְשַׁלֵּ֥ם עַל־יֶ֝֗תֶר עֹשֵׂ֥ה גַאֲוָֽה׃

lines.text: Oh love Yahweh, all you his saints! Yahweh preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.
Love Jehovah, all ye His saints, Jehovah is keeping the faithful, And recompensing abundantly a proud doer.

31.he: חִ֭זְקוּ וְיַאֲמֵ֣ץ לְבַבְכֶ֑ם כָּל־הַ֝מְיַחֲלִ֗ים לַיהוָֽה׃

lines.text: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in Yahweh.
Be strong, and He strengtheneth your heart, All ye who are waiting for Jehovah!

32.he: לְדָוִ֗ד מַ֫שְׂכִּ֥יל אַשְׁרֵ֥י נְֽשׂוּי־פֶּ֗שַׁע כְּס֣וּי חֲטָאָֽה׃

lines.text: Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
By David. — An Instruction. O the happiness of him whose transgression [is] forgiven, Whose sin is covered.

32.he: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי אָדָ֗ם לֹ֤א יַחְשֹׁ֬ב יְהוָ֣ה ל֣וֹ עָוֺ֑ן וְאֵ֖ין בְּרוּח֣וֹ רְמִיָּה׃

lines.text: Blessed is the man to whom Yahweh doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
O the happiness of a man, To whom Jehovah imputeth not iniquity, And in whose spirit there is no deceit.
When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
When I have kept silence, become old have my bones, Through my roaring all the day.

32.he: כִּ֤י ׀ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַיְלָה֮ תִּכְבַּ֥ד עָלַ֗י יָ֫דֶ֥ךָ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ לְשַׁדִּ֑י בְּחַרְבֹ֖נֵי קַ֣יִץ סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer.
When by day and by night Thy hand is heavy upon me, My moisture hath been changed Into the droughts of summer. Selah.

32.he: חַטָּאתִ֨י אוֹדִ֪יעֲךָ֡ וַעֲוֺ֘נִ֤י לֹֽא־כִסִּ֗יתִי אָמַ֗רְתִּי אוֹדֶ֤ה עֲלֵ֣י פְ֭שָׁעַי לַיהוָ֑ה וְאַתָּ֨ה נָ֘שָׂ֤אתָ עֲוֺ֖ן חַטָּאתִ֣י סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin.
My sin I cause Thee to know, And mine iniquity I have not covered. I have said, 'I confess concerning My transgressions to Jehovah,' And Thou — Thou hast taken away, The iniquity of my sin. Selah.

32.he: עַל־זֹ֡את יִתְפַּלֵּ֬ל כָּל־חָסִ֨יד ׀ אֵלֶיךָ֮ לְעֵ֪ת מְ֫צֹ֥א רַ֗ק לְ֭שֵׁטֶף מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים אֵ֝לָ֗יו לֹ֣א יַגִּֽיעוּ׃

lines.text: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.
For this doth every saintly one pray to Thee, As the time to find. Surely at an overflowing of many waters, Unto him they come not.

32.he: אַתָּ֤ה ׀ סֵ֥תֶר לִי֮ מִצַּ֪ר תִּ֫צְּרֵ֥נִי רָנֵּ֥י פַלֵּ֑ט תְּס֖וֹבְבֵ֣נִי סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance.
Thou [art] a hiding-place for me, From distress Thou dost keep me, [With] songs of deliverance dost compass me. Selah.

32.he: אַשְׂכִּֽילְךָ֨ ׀ וְֽאוֹרְךָ֗ בְּדֶֽרֶךְ־ז֥וּ תֵלֵ֑ךְ אִֽיעֲצָ֖ה עָלֶ֣יךָ עֵינִֽי׃

lines.text: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
I cause thee to act wisely, And direct thee in the way that thou goest, I cause mine eye to take counsel concerning thee.

32.he: אַל־תִּֽהְי֤וּ ׀ כְּס֥וּס כְּפֶרֶד֮ אֵ֤ין הָ֫בִ֥ין בְּמֶֽתֶג־וָרֶ֣סֶן עֶדְי֣וֹ לִבְל֑וֹם בַּ֝֗ל קְרֹ֣ב אֵלֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.
Be ye not as a horse — as a mule, Without understanding, With bridle and bit, its ornaments, to curb, Not to come near unto thee.

32.he: רַבִּ֥ים מַכְאוֹבִ֗ים לָרָ֫שָׁ֥ע וְהַבּוֹטֵ֥חַ בַּיהוָ֑ה חֶ֝֗סֶד יְסוֹבְבֶֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.
Many [are] the pains of the wicked; As to him who is trusting in Jehovah, Kindness doth compass him.

32.he: שִׂמְח֬וּ בַֽיהוָ֣ה וְ֭גִילוּ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְ֝הַרְנִ֗ינוּ כָּל־יִשְׁרֵי־לֵֽב׃

lines.text: Be glad in Yahweh, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
Be glad in Jehovah, and rejoice, ye righteous, And sing, all ye upright of heart!

33.he: רַנְּנ֣וּ צַ֭דִּיקִים בַּֽיהוָ֑ה לַ֝יְשָׁרִ֗ים נָאוָ֥ה תְהִלָּֽה׃

lines.text: Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
Sing, ye righteous, in Jehovah, For upright ones praise [is] comely.

33.he: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה בְּכִנּ֑וֹר בְּנֵ֥בֶל עָ֝שׂ֗וֹר זַמְּרוּ־לֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Give thanks to Yahweh with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.
Give ye thanks to Jehovah with a harp, With psaltery of ten strings sing praise to Him,

33.he: שִֽׁירוּ־ל֭וֹ שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ הֵיטִ֥יבוּ נַ֝גֵּ֗ן בִּתְרוּעָֽה׃

lines.text: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!
Sing ye to Him a new song, Play skilfully with shouting.

33.he: כִּֽי־יָשָׁ֥ר דְּבַר־יְהוָ֑ה וְכָל־מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗הוּ בֶּאֱמוּנָֽה׃

lines.text: For Yahweh’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.
For upright [is] the word of Jehovah, And all His work [is] in faithfulness.

33.he: אֹ֭הֵב צְדָקָ֣ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט חֶ֥סֶד יְ֝הוָ֗ה מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of Yahweh.
Loving righteousness and judgment, Of the kindness of Jehovah is the earth full.

33.he: בִּדְבַ֣ר יְ֭הוָה שָׁמַ֣יִם נַעֲשׂ֑וּ וּבְר֥וּחַ פִּ֝֗יו כָּל־צְבָאָֽם׃

lines.text: By Yahweh’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.
By the word of Jehovah The heavens have been made, And by the breath of His mouth all their host.

33.he: כֹּנֵ֣ס כַּ֭נֵּד מֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם נֹתֵ֖ן בְּאֹצָר֣וֹת תְּהוֹמֽוֹת׃

lines.text: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.
Gathering as a heap the waters of the sea, Putting in treasuries the depths.

33.he: יִֽירְא֣וּ מֵ֭יְהוָה כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ מִמֶּ֥נּוּ יָ֝ג֗וּרוּ כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֥י תֵבֵֽל׃

lines.text: Let all the earth fear Yahweh. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
Afraid of Jehovah are all the earth, Of Him are all the inhabitants of the world afraid.

33.he: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא אָמַ֣ר וַיֶּ֑הִי הֽוּא־צִ֝וָּ֗ה וַֽיַּעֲמֹֽד׃

lines.text: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.
For He hath said, and it is, He hath commanded, and it standeth.

33.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה הֵפִ֥יר עֲצַת־גּוֹיִ֑ם הֵ֝נִ֗יא מַחְשְׁב֥וֹת עַמִּֽים׃

lines.text: Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
Jehovah made void the counsel of nations, He disallowed the thoughts of the peoples.

33.he: עֲצַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם תַּעֲמֹ֑ד מַחְשְׁב֥וֹת לִ֝בּ֗וֹ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃

lines.text: The counsel of Yahweh stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
The counsel of Jehovah to the age standeth, The thoughts of His heart to all generations.

33.he: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הַ֭גּוֹי אֲשֶׁר־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו הָעָ֓ם ׀ בָּחַ֖ר לְנַחֲלָ֣ה לֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Blessed is the nation whose God is Yahweh, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.
O the happiness of the nation whose God [is] Jehovah, Of the people He did choose, For an inheritance to Him.

33.he: מִ֭שָּׁמַיִם הִבִּ֣יט יְהוָ֑ה רָ֝אָ֗ה אֶֽת־כָּל־בְּנֵ֥י הָאָדָֽם׃

lines.text: Yahweh looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.
From the heavens hath Jehovah looked, He hath seen all the sons of men.

33.he: מִֽמְּכוֹן־שִׁבְתּ֥וֹ הִשְׁגִּ֑יחַ אֶ֖ל כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,
From the fixed place of His dwelling, He looked unto all inhabitants of the earth;

33.he: הַיֹּצֵ֣ר יַ֣חַד לִבָּ֑ם הַ֝מֵּבִ֗ין אֶל־כָּל־מַעֲשֵׂיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.
Who is forming their hearts together, Who is attending unto all their works.

33.he: אֵֽין־הַ֭מֶּלֶךְ נוֹשָׁ֣ע בְּרָב־חָ֑יִל גִּ֝בּ֗וֹר לֹֽא־יִנָּצֵ֥ל בְּרָב־כֹּֽחַ׃

lines.text: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
The king is not saved by the multitude of a force. A mighty man is not delivered, By abundance of power.

33.he: שֶׁ֣קֶר הַ֭סּוּס לִתְשׁוּעָ֑ה וּבְרֹ֥ב חֵ֝יל֗וֹ לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּֽט׃

lines.text: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.
A false thing [is] the horse for safety, And by the abundance of his strength He doth not deliver.

33.he: הִנֵּ֤ה עֵ֣ין יְ֭הוָה אֶל־יְרֵאָ֑יו לַֽמְיַחֲלִ֥ים לְחַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Behold, Yahweh’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,
Lo, the eye of Jehovah [is] to those fearing Him, To those waiting for His kindness,

33.he: לְהַצִּ֣יל מִמָּ֣וֶת נַפְשָׁ֑ם וּ֝לְחַיּוֹתָ֗ם בָּרָעָֽב׃

lines.text: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.
To deliver from death their soul, And to keep them alive in famine.

33.he: נַ֭פְשֵׁנוּ חִכְּתָ֣ה לַֽיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרֵ֖נוּ וּמָגִנֵּ֣נוּ הֽוּא׃

lines.text: Our soul has waited for Yahweh. He is our help and our shield.
Our soul hath waited for Jehovah, Our help and our shield [is] He,

33.he: כִּי־ב֭וֹ יִשְׂמַ֣ח לִבֵּ֑נוּ כִּ֤י בְשֵׁ֖ם קָדְשׁ֣וֹ בָטָֽחְנוּ׃

lines.text: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
For in Him doth our heart rejoice, For in His holy name we have trusted.

33.he: יְהִֽי־חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה עָלֵ֑ינוּ כַּ֝אֲשֶׁ֗ר יִחַ֥לְנוּ לָֽךְ׃

lines.text: Let your loving kindness be on us, Yahweh, since we have hoped in you.
Let Thy kindness, O Jehovah, be upon us, As we have waited for Thee!

34.he: לְדָוִ֗ד בְּשַׁנּוֹת֣וֹ אֶת־טַ֭עְמוֹ לִפְנֵ֣י אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ וַֽ֝יְגָרֲשֵׁ֗הוּ וַיֵּלַֽךְ׃

lines.text: By David, in his changing his behaviour before Abimelech, and he driveth him away, and he goeth. I do bless Jehovah at all times, Continually His praise [is] in my mouth.

34.he: אֲבָרֲכָ֣ה אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה בְּכָל־עֵ֑ת תָּ֝מִ֗יד תְּֽהִלָּת֥וֹ בְּפִֽי׃

lines.text: I will bless Yahweh at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.
By David, in his changing his behaviour before Abimelech, and he driveth him away, and he goeth. I do bless Jehovah at all times, Continually His praise [is] in my mouth.

34.he: בַּ֭יהוָה תִּתְהַלֵּ֣ל נַפְשִׁ֑י יִשְׁמְע֖וּ עֲנָוִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָֽחוּ׃

lines.text: My soul shall boast in Yahweh. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.
In Jehovah doth my soul boast herself, Hear do the humble and rejoice.

34.he: גַּדְּל֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה אִתִּ֑י וּנְרוֹמְמָ֖ה שְׁמ֣וֹ יַחְדָּֽו׃

lines.text: Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let’s exalt his name together.
Ascribe ye greatness to Jehovah with me, And we exalt His name together.

34.he: דָּרַ֣שְׁתִּי אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה וְעָנָ֑נִי וּמִכָּל־מְ֝גוּרוֹתַ֗י הִצִּילָֽנִי׃

lines.text: I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
I sought Jehovah, and He answered me, And from all my fears did deliver me.

34.he: הִבִּ֣יטוּ אֵלָ֣יו וְנָהָ֑רוּ וּ֝פְנֵיהֶ֗ם אַל־יֶחְפָּֽרוּ׃

lines.text: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.
They looked expectingly unto Him, And they became bright, And their faces are not ashamed.

34.he: זֶ֤ה עָנִ֣י קָ֭רָא וַיהוָ֣ה שָׁמֵ֑עַ וּמִכָּל־צָ֝רוֹתָ֗יו הוֹשִׁיעֽוֹ׃

lines.text: This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
This poor [one] called, and Jehovah heard, And from all his distresses saved him.

34.he: חֹנֶ֤ה מַלְאַךְ־יְהוָ֓ה סָ֘בִ֤יב לִֽירֵאָ֗יו וַֽיְחַלְּצֵֽם׃

lines.text: Yahweh’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.
A messenger of Jehovah is encamping, Round about those who fear Him, And He armeth them.

34.he: טַעֲמ֣וּ וּ֭רְאוּ כִּי־ט֣וֹב יְהוָ֑ה אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י הַ֝גֶּ֗בֶר יֶחֱסֶה־בּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
Taste ye and see that Jehovah [is] good, O the happiness of the man who trusteth in Him.

34.he: יְר֣אוּ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה קְדֹשָׁ֑יו כִּי־אֵ֥ין מַ֝חְס֗וֹר לִירֵאָֽיו׃

lines.text: Oh fear Yahweh, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.
Fear Jehovah, ye His holy ones, For there is no lack to those fearing Him.

34.he: כְּ֭פִירִים רָשׁ֣וּ וְרָעֵ֑בוּ וְדֹרְשֵׁ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה לֹא־יַחְסְר֥וּ כָל־טֽוֹב׃

lines.text: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.
Young lions have lacked and been hungry, And those seeking Jehovah lack not any good,

34.he: לְֽכוּ־בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִ֑י יִֽרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה אֲלַמֶּדְכֶֽם׃

lines.text: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.
Come ye, children, hearken to me, The fear of Jehovah I do teach you.

34.he: מִֽי־הָ֭אִישׁ הֶחָפֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים אֹהֵ֥ב יָ֝מִ֗ים לִרְא֥וֹת טֽוֹב׃

lines.text: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?
Who [is] the man that is desiring life? Loving days to see good?

34.he: נְצֹ֣ר לְשׁוֹנְךָ֣ מֵרָ֑ע וּ֝שְׂפָתֶ֗יךָ מִדַּבֵּ֥ר מִרְמָֽה׃

lines.text: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.
Keep thy tongue from evil, And thy lips from speaking deceit.

34.he: ס֣וּר מֵ֭רָע וַעֲשֵׂה־ט֑וֹב בַּקֵּ֖שׁ שָׁל֣וֹם וְרָדְפֵֽהוּ׃

lines.text: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.
Turn aside from evil and do good, Seek peace and pursue it.

34.he: עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה אֶל־צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְ֝אָזְנָ֗יו אֶל־שַׁוְעָתָֽם׃

lines.text: Yahweh’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.
The eyes of Jehovah [are] unto the righteous, And His ears unto their cry.

34.he: פְּנֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה בְּעֹ֣שֵׂי רָ֑ע לְהַכְרִ֖ית מֵאֶ֣רֶץ זִכְרָֽם׃

lines.text: Yahweh’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.
(The face of Jehovah [is] on doers of evil, To cut off from earth their memorial.)

34.he: צָעֲק֣וּ וַיהוָ֣ה שָׁמֵ֑עַ וּמִכָּל־צָ֝רוֹתָ֗ם הִצִּילָֽם׃

lines.text: The righteous cry, and Yahweh hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
They cried, and Jehovah heard, And from all their distresses delivered them.

34.he: קָר֣וֹב יְ֭הוָה לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי־לֵ֑ב וְֽאֶת־דַּכְּאֵי־ר֥וּחַ יוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃

lines.text: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
Near [is] Jehovah to the broken of heart, And the bruised of spirit He saveth.

34.he: רַ֭בּוֹת רָע֣וֹת צַדִּ֑יק וּ֝מִכֻּלָּ֗ם יַצִּילֶ֥נּוּ יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.
Many [are] the evils of the righteous, Out of them all doth Jehovah deliver him.

34.he: שֹׁמֵ֥ר כָּל־עַצְמוֹתָ֑יו אַחַ֥ת מֵ֝הֵ֗נָּה לֹ֣א נִשְׁבָּֽרָה׃

lines.text: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.
He is keeping all his bones, One of them hath not been broken.

34.he: תְּמוֹתֵ֣ת רָשָׁ֣ע רָעָ֑ה וְשֹׂנְאֵ֖י צַדִּ֣יק יֶאְשָֽׁמוּ׃

lines.text: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
Evil doth put to death the wicked, And those hating the righteous are desolate.

34.he: פּוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה נֶ֣פֶשׁ עֲבָדָ֑יו וְלֹ֥א יֶ֝אְשְׁמ֗וּ כָּֽל־הַחֹסִ֥ים בּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Yahweh redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.
Jehovah redeemeth the soul of His servants, And none trusting in Him are desolate!

35.he: לְדָוִ֨ד ׀ רִיבָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אֶת־יְרִיבַ֑י לְ֝חַ֗ם אֶת־לֹֽחֲמָֽי׃

lines.text: Contend, Yahweh, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.
By David. Strive, Jehovah, with my strivers, fight with my fighters,

35.he: הַחֲזֵ֣ק מָגֵ֣ן וְצִנָּ֑ה וְ֝ק֗וּמָה בְּעֶזְרָתִֽי׃

lines.text: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.
Take hold of shield and buckler, and rise for my help,

35.he: וְהָ֘רֵ֤ק חֲנִ֣ית וּ֭סְגֹר לִקְרַ֣את רֹדְפָ֑י אֱמֹ֥ר לְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י יְֽשֻׁעָתֵ֥ךְ אָֽנִי׃

lines.text: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”
And draw out spear and lance, To meet my pursuers. Say to my soul, 'Thy salvation I [am].'

35.he: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ וְיִכָּלְמוּ֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֪י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָח֣וֹר וְיַחְפְּר֑וּ חֹ֝שְׁבֵ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃

lines.text: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.
They are ashamed and blush, those seeking my soul, Turned backward and confounded, Those devising my evil.

35.he: יִֽהְי֗וּ כְּמֹ֥ץ לִפְנֵי־ר֑וּחַ וּמַלְאַ֖ךְ יְהוָ֣ה דּוֹחֶֽה׃

lines.text: Let them be as chaff before the wind, Yahweh’s angel driving them on.
They are as chaff before wind, And a messenger of Jehovah driving away.

35.he: יְֽהִי־דַרְכָּ֗ם חֹ֥שֶׁךְ וַחֲלַקְלַקּ֑וֹת וּמַלְאַ֥ךְ יְ֝הוָ֗ה רֹדְפָֽם׃

lines.text: Let their way be dark and slippery, Yahweh’s angel pursuing them.
Their way is darkness and slipperiness, And a messenger of Jehovah their pursuer.

35.he: כִּֽי־חִנָּ֣ם טָֽמְנוּ־לִ֭י שַׁ֣חַת רִשְׁתָּ֑ם חִ֝נָּ֗ם חָפְר֥וּ לְנַפְשִֽׁי׃

lines.text: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.
For without cause they hid for me their netpit, Without cause they digged for my soul.

35.he: תְּבוֹאֵ֣הוּ שׁוֹאָה֮ לֹֽא־יֵ֫דָ֥ע וְרִשְׁתּ֣וֹ אֲשֶׁר־טָמַ֣ן תִּלְכְּד֑וֹ בְּ֝שׁוֹאָ֗ה יִפָּל־בָּֽהּ׃

lines.text: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.
Meet him doth desolation — he knoweth not, And his net that he hid catcheth him, For desolation he falleth into it.

35.he: וְ֭נַפְשִׁי תָּגִ֣יל בַּיהוָ֑ה תָּ֝שִׂישׂ בִּישׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: My soul shall be joyful in Yahweh. It shall rejoice in his salvation.
And my soul is joyful in Jehovah, It rejoiceth in His salvation.

35.he: כָּ֥ל עַצְמוֹתַ֨י ׀ תֹּאמַרְנָה֮ יְהוָ֗ה מִ֥י כָ֫מ֥וֹךָ מַצִּ֣יל עָ֭נִי מֵחָזָ֣ק מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְעָנִ֥י וְ֝אֶבְי֗וֹן מִגֹּזְלֽוֹ׃

lines.text: All my bones shall say, “Yahweh, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”
All my bones say, 'Jehovah, who is like Thee, Delivering the poor from the stronger than he, And the poor and needy from his plunderer.'

35.he: יְ֭קוּמוּן עֵדֵ֣י חָמָ֑ס אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי יִשְׁאָלֽוּנִי׃

lines.text: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.
Violent witnesses rise up, That which I have not known they ask me.

35.he: יְשַׁלְּמ֣וּנִי רָ֭עָה תַּ֥חַת טוֹבָ֗ה שְׁכ֣וֹל לְנַפְשִֽׁי׃

lines.text: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.
They pay me evil for good, bereaving my soul,

35.he: וַאֲנִ֤י ׀ בַּחֲלוֹתָ֡ם לְב֬וּשִׁי שָׂ֗ק עִנֵּ֣יתִי בַצּ֣וֹם נַפְשִׁ֑י וּ֝תְפִלָּתִ֗י עַל־חֵיקִ֥י תָשֽׁוּב׃

lines.text: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.
And I — in their sickness my clothing [is] sackcloth, I have humbled with fastings my soul, And my prayer unto my bosom returneth.

35.he: כְּרֵֽעַ־כְּאָ֣ח לִ֭י הִתְהַלָּ֑כְתִּי כַּאֲבֶל־אֵ֝֗ם קֹדֵ֥ר שַׁחֽוֹתִי׃

lines.text: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.
As [if] a friend, as [if] my brother, I walked habitually, As a mourner for a mother, Mourning I have bowed down.

35.he: וּבְצַלְעִי֮ שָׂמְח֪וּ וְֽנֶאֱ֫סָ֥פוּ נֶאֶסְפ֬וּ עָלַ֣י נֵ֭כִים וְלֹ֣א יָדַ֑עְתִּי קָֽרְע֥וּ וְלֹא־דָֽמּוּ׃

lines.text: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.
And — in my halting they have rejoiced, And have been gathered together, Gathered against me were the smiters, And I have not known, They have rent, and they have not ceased;

35.he: בְּ֭חַנְפֵי לַעֲגֵ֣י מָע֑וֹג חָרֹ֖ק עָלַ֣י שִׁנֵּֽימוֹ׃

lines.text: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.
With profane ones, mockers in feasts, Gnashing against me their teeth.

35.he: אֲדֹנָי֮ כַּמָּ֪ה תִ֫רְאֶ֥ה הָשִׁ֣יבָה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִשֹּׁאֵיהֶ֑ם מִ֝כְּפִירִ֗ים יְחִידָתִֽי׃

lines.text: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.
Lord, how long dost thou behold? Keep back my soul from their desolations, From young lions my only one.

35.he: א֭וֹדְךָ בְּקָהָ֣ל רָ֑ב בְּעַ֖ם עָצ֣וּם אֲהַֽלְלֶֽךָּ׃

lines.text: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.
I thank Thee in a great assembly, Among a mighty people I praise Thee.

35.he: אַֽל־יִשְׂמְחוּ־לִ֣י אֹיְבַ֣י שֶׁ֑קֶר שֹׂנְאַ֥י חִ֝נָּ֗ם יִקְרְצוּ־עָֽיִן׃

lines.text: Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.
Mine enemies rejoice not over me [with] falsehood, Those hating me without cause wink the eye.

35.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֥א שָׁל֗וֹם יְדַ֫בֵּ֥רוּ וְעַ֥ל רִגְעֵי־אֶ֑רֶץ דִּבְרֵ֥י מִ֝רְמוֹת יַחֲשֹׁבֽוּן׃

lines.text: For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.
For they speak not peace, And against the quiet of the land, Deceitful words they devise,

35.he: וַיַּרְחִ֥יבוּ עָלַ֗י פִּ֫יהֶ֥ם אָ֭מְרוּ הֶאָ֣ח ׀ הֶאָ֑ח רָאֲתָ֥ה עֵינֵֽינוּ׃

lines.text: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”
And they enlarge against me their mouth, They said, 'Aha, aha, our eye hath seen.'

35.he: רָאִ֣יתָה יְ֭הוָה אַֽל־תֶּחֱרַ֑שׁ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י אֲל־תִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

lines.text: You have seen it, Yahweh. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.
Thou hast seen, O Jehovah, Be not silent, O Lord — be not far from me,

35.he: הָעִ֣ירָה וְ֭הָקִיצָה לְמִשְׁפָּטִ֑י אֱלֹהַ֖י וַֽאדֹנָ֣י לְרִיבִֽי׃

lines.text: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!
Stir up, and wake to my judgment, My God, and my Lord, to my plea.

35.he: שָׁפְטֵ֣נִי כְ֭צִדְקְךָ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֗י וְאַל־יִשְׂמְחוּ־לִֽי׃

lines.text: Vindicate me, Yahweh my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.
Judge me according to Thy righteousness, O Jehovah my God, And they do not rejoice over me.

35.he: אַל־יֹאמְר֣וּ בְ֭לִבָּם הֶאָ֣ח נַפְשֵׁ֑נוּ אַל־יֹ֝אמְר֗וּ בִּֽלַּעֲנֽוּהוּ׃

lines.text: Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”
They do not say in their heart, 'Aha, our desire.' They do not say, 'We swallowed him up.'

35.he: יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּר֨וּ ׀ יַחְדָּו֮ שְׂמֵחֵ֪י רָעָ֫תִ֥י יִֽלְבְּשׁוּ־בֹ֥שֶׁת וּכְלִמָּ֑ה הַֽמַּגְדִּילִ֥ים עָלָֽי׃

lines.text: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.
They are ashamed and confounded together, Who are rejoicing at my evil. They put on shame and confusion, Who are magnifying themselves against me.

35.he: יָרֹ֣נּוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ֮ חֲפֵצֵ֪י צִ֫דְקִ֥י וְיֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה הֶ֝חָפֵ֗ץ שְׁל֣וֹם עַבְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Yes, let them say continually, “May Yahweh be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”
They sing and rejoice, who are desiring my righteousness, And they say continually, 'Jehovah is magnified, Who is desiring the peace of His servant.'

35.he: וּ֭לְשׁוֹנִי תֶּהְגֶּ֣ה צִדְקֶ֑ךָ כָּל־הַ֝יּוֹם תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.
And my tongue uttereth Thy righteousness, All the day Thy praise!
To the Overseer. — By a servant of Jehovah, by David. The transgression of the wicked Is affirming within my heart, 'Fear of God is not before his eyes,

36.he: נְאֻֽם־פֶּ֣שַׁע לָ֭רָשָׁע בְּקֶ֣רֶב לִבִּ֑י אֵֽין־פַּ֥חַד אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽיו׃

lines.text: A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: “There is no fear of God before his eyes.”
To the Overseer. — By a servant of Jehovah, by David. The transgression of the wicked Is affirming within my heart, 'Fear of God is not before his eyes,

36.he: כִּֽי־הֶחֱלִ֣יק אֵלָ֣יו בְּעֵינָ֑יו לִמְצֹ֖א עֲוֺנ֣וֹ לִשְׂנֹֽא׃

lines.text: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.
For he made [it] smooth to himself in his eyes, To find his iniquity to be hated.

36.he: דִּבְרֵי־פִ֭יו אָ֣וֶן וּמִרְמָ֑ה חָדַ֖ל לְהַשְׂכִּ֣יל לְהֵיטִֽיב׃

lines.text: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.
The words of his mouth [are] iniquity and deceit, He ceased to act prudently — to do good.

36.he: אָ֤וֶן ׀ יַחְשֹׁ֗ב עַֽל־מִשְׁכָּ֫ב֥וֹ יִ֭תְיַצֵּב עַל־דֶּ֣רֶךְ לֹא־ט֑וֹב רָ֝֗ע לֹ֣א יִמְאָֽס׃

lines.text: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.
Iniquity he deviseth on his bed, He stationeth himself on a way not good, Evil he doth not refuse.'
Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
O Jehovah, in the heavens [is] Thy kindness, Thy faithfulness [is] unto the clouds.

36.he: צִדְקָֽתְךָ֨ ׀ כְּֽהַרְרֵי־אֵ֗ל מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶךָ תְּה֣וֹם רַבָּ֑ה אָ֤דָֽם־וּבְהֵמָ֖ה תוֹשִׁ֣יעַ יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. Yahweh, you preserve man and animal.
Thy righteousness [is] as mountains of God, Thy judgments [are] a great deep. Man and beast Thou savest, O Jehovah.

36.he: מַה־יָּקָ֥ר חַסְדְּךָ֗ אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים וּבְנֵ֥י אָדָ֑ם בְּצֵ֥ל כְּ֝נָפֶ֗יךָ יֶחֱסָיֽוּן׃

lines.text: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
How precious [is] Thy kindness, O God, And the sons of men In the shadow of Thy wings do trust.

36.he: יִ֭רְוִיֻן מִדֶּ֣שֶׁן בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וְנַ֖חַל עֲדָנֶ֣יךָ תַשְׁקֵֽם׃

lines.text: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.
They are filled from the fatness of Thy house, And the stream of Thy delights Thou dost cause them to drink.
For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.
For with Thee [is] a fountain of life, In Thy light we see light.
Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.
Draw out Thy kindness to those knowing Thee, And Thy righteousness to the upright of heart.
Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.
Let not a foot of pride meet me, And a hand of the wicked let not move me.

36.he: שָׁ֣ם נָ֭פְלוּ פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן דֹּ֝ח֗וּ וְלֹא־יָ֥כְלוּ קֽוּם׃

lines.text: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.
There have workers of iniquity fallen, They have been overthrown, And have not been able to arise!

37.he: לְדָוִ֨ד ׀ אַל־תִּתְחַ֥ר בַּמְּרֵעִ֑ים אַל־תְּ֝קַנֵּ֗א בְּעֹשֵׂ֥י עַוְלָֽה׃

lines.text: Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.
By David. Do not fret because of evil doers, Be not envious against doers of iniquity,

37.he: כִּ֣י כֶ֭חָצִיר מְהֵרָ֣ה יִמָּ֑לוּ וּכְיֶ֥רֶק דֶּ֝֗שֶׁא יִבּוֹלֽוּן׃

lines.text: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.
For as grass speedily they are cut off, And as the greenness of the tender grass do fade.

37.he: בְּטַ֣ח בַּֽ֭יהוָה וַעֲשֵׂה־ט֑וֹב שְׁכָן־אֶ֝֗רֶץ וּרְעֵ֥ה אֱמוּנָֽה׃

lines.text: Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
Trust in Jehovah, and do good, Dwell [in] the land, and enjoy faithfulness,

37.he: וְהִתְעַנַּ֥ג עַל־יְהוָ֑ה וְיִֽתֶּן־לְ֝ךָ֗ מִשְׁאֲלֹ֥ת לִבֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
And delight thyself on Jehovah, And He giveth to thee the petitions of thy heart.

37.he: גּ֣וֹל עַל־יְהוָ֣ה דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ וּבְטַ֥ח עָ֝לָ֗יו וְה֣וּא יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃

lines.text: Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:
Roll on Jehovah thy way, And trust upon Him, and He worketh,

37.he: וְהוֹצִ֣יא כָא֣וֹר צִדְקֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטֶ֗ךָ כַּֽצָּהֳרָֽיִם׃

lines.text: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.
And hath brought out as light thy righteousness, And thy judgment as noon-day.

37.he: דּ֤וֹם ׀ לַיהוָה֮ וְהִתְח֪וֹלֵ֫ל ל֥וֹ אַל־תִּ֭תְחַר בְּמַצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכּ֑וֹ בְּ֝אִ֗ישׁ עֹשֶׂ֥ה מְזִמּֽוֹת׃

lines.text: Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.
Be silent for Jehovah, and stay thyself for Him, Do not fret because of him Who is making prosperous his way, Because of a man doing wicked devices.

37.he: הֶ֣רֶף מֵ֭אַף וַעֲזֹ֣ב חֵמָ֑ה אַל־תִּ֝תְחַ֗ר אַךְ־לְהָרֵֽעַ׃

lines.text: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.
Desist from anger, and forsake fury, Fret not thyself only to do evil.

37.he: כִּֽי־מְ֭רֵעִים יִכָּרֵת֑וּן וְקֹוֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה הֵ֣מָּה יִֽירְשׁוּ־אָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for Yahweh shall inherit the land.
For evil doers are cut off, As to those waiting on Jehovah, they possess the land.

37.he: וְע֣וֹד מְ֭עַט וְאֵ֣ין רָשָׁ֑ע וְהִתְבּוֹנַ֖נְתָּ עַל־מְקוֹמ֣וֹ וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.
And yet a little, and the wicked is not, And thou hast considered his place, and it is not.

37.he: וַעֲנָוִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ־אָ֑רֶץ וְ֝הִתְעַנְּג֗וּ עַל־רֹ֥ב שָׁלֽוֹם׃

lines.text: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
And the humble do possess the land, And they have delighted themselves In the abundance of peace.

37.he: זֹמֵ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע לַצַּדִּ֑יק וְחֹרֵ֖ק עָלָ֣יו שִׁנָּֽיו׃

lines.text: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.
The wicked is devising against the righteous, And gnashing against him his teeth.

37.he: אֲדֹנָ֥י יִשְׂחַק־ל֑וֹ כִּֽי־רָ֝אָ֗ה כִּֽי־יָבֹ֥א יוֹמֽוֹ׃

lines.text: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.
The Lord doth laugh at him, For He hath seen that his day cometh.

37.he: חֶ֤רֶב ׀ פָּֽתְח֣וּ רְשָׁעִים֮ וְדָרְכ֪וּ קַ֫שְׁתָּ֥ם לְ֭הַפִּיל עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְי֑וֹן לִ֝טְב֗וֹחַ יִשְׁרֵי־דָֽרֶךְ׃

lines.text: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.
A sword have the wicked opened, And they have trodden their bow, To cause to fall the poor and needy, To slaughter the upright of the way.

37.he: חַ֭רְבָּם תָּב֣וֹא בְלִבָּ֑ם וְ֝קַשְּׁתוֹתָ֗ם תִּשָּׁבַֽרְנָה׃

lines.text: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.
Their sword doth enter into their own heart, And their bows are shivered.

37.he: טוֹב־מְ֭עַט לַצַּדִּ֑יק מֵ֝הֲמ֗וֹן רְשָׁעִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃

lines.text: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.
Better [is] the little of the righteous, Than the store of many wicked.

37.he: כִּ֤י זְרוֹע֣וֹת רְ֭שָׁעִים תִּשָּׁבַ֑רְנָה וְסוֹמֵ֖ךְ צַדִּיקִ֣ים יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Yahweh upholds the righteous.
For the arms of the wicked are shivered, And Jehovah is sustaining the righteous.

37.he: יוֹדֵ֣עַ יְ֭הוָה יְמֵ֣י תְמִימִ֑ם וְ֝נַחֲלָתָ֗ם לְעוֹלָ֥ם תִּהְיֶֽה׃

lines.text: Yahweh knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.
Jehovah knoweth the days of the perfect, And their inheritance is — to the age.

37.he: לֹֽא־יֵ֭בֹשׁוּ בְּעֵ֣ת רָעָ֑ה וּבִימֵ֖י רְעָב֣וֹן יִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃

lines.text: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
They are not ashamed in a time of evil, And in days of famine they are satisfied.

37.he: כִּ֤י רְשָׁעִ֨ים ׀ יֹאבֵ֗דוּ וְאֹיְבֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה כִּיקַ֣ר כָּרִ֑ים כָּל֖וּ בֶעָשָׁ֣ן כָּֽלוּ׃

lines.text: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of Yahweh shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.
But the wicked perish, and the enemies of Jehovah, As the preciousness of lambs, Have been consumed, In smoke they have been consumed.

37.he: לֹוֶ֣ה רָ֭שָׁע וְלֹ֣א יְשַׁלֵּ֑ם וְ֝צַדִּ֗יק חוֹנֵ֥ן וְנוֹתֵֽן׃

lines.text: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.
The wicked is borrowing and repayeth not, And the righteous is gracious and giving.

37.he: כִּ֣י מְ֭בֹרָכָיו יִ֣ירְשׁוּ אָ֑רֶץ וּ֝מְקֻלָּלָ֗יו יִכָּרֵֽתוּ׃

lines.text: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.
For His blessed ones do possess the land, And His reviled ones are cut off.

37.he: מֵ֭יְהוָה מִֽצְעֲדֵי־גֶ֥בֶר כּוֹנָ֗נוּ וְדַרְכּ֥וֹ יֶחְפָּֽץ׃

lines.text: A man’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.
From Jehovah [are] the steps of a man, They have been prepared, And his way he desireth.

37.he: כִּֽי־יִפֹּ֥ל לֹֽא־יוּטָ֑ל כִּֽי־יְ֝הוָ֗ה סוֹמֵ֥ךְ יָדֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
When he falleth, he is not cast down, For Jehovah is sustaining his hand.

37.he: נַ֤עַר ׀ הָיִ֗יתִי גַּם־זָ֫קַ֥נְתִּי וְֽלֹא־רָ֭אִיתִי צַדִּ֣יק נֶעֱזָ֑ב וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ־לָֽחֶם׃

lines.text: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.
Young I have been, I have also become old, And I have not seen the righteous forsaken, And his seed seeking bread.

37.he: כָּל־הַ֭יּוֹם חוֹנֵ֣ן וּמַלְוֶ֑ה וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ לִבְרָכָֽה׃

lines.text: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.
All the day he is gracious and lending, And his seed [is] for a blessing.

37.he: ס֣וּר מֵ֭רָע וַעֲשֵׂה־ט֗וֹב וּשְׁכֹ֥ן לְעוֹלָֽם׃

lines.text: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.
Turn aside from evil, and do good, and dwell to the age.

37.he: כִּ֤י יְהוָ֨ה ׀ אֹ֘הֵ֤ב מִשְׁפָּ֗ט וְלֹא־יַעֲזֹ֣ב אֶת־חֲ֭סִידָיו לְעוֹלָ֣ם נִשְׁמָ֑רוּ וְזֶ֖רַע רְשָׁעִ֣ים נִכְרָֽת׃

lines.text: For Yahweh loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.
For Jehovah is loving judgment, And He doth not forsake His saintly ones, To the age they have been kept, And the seed of the wicked is cut off.

37.he: צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ־אָ֑רֶץ וְיִשְׁכְּנ֖וּ לָעַ֣ד עָלֶֽיהָ׃

lines.text: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.
The righteous possess the land, And they dwell for ever on it.

37.he: פִּֽי־צַ֭דִּיק יֶהְגֶּ֣ה חָכְמָ֑ה וּ֝לְשׁוֹנ֗וֹ תְּדַבֵּ֥ר מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

lines.text: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
The mouth of the righteous uttereth wisdom, And his tongue speaketh judgment.

37.he: תּוֹרַ֣ת אֱלֹהָ֣יו בְּלִבּ֑וֹ לֹ֖א תִמְעַ֣ד אֲשֻׁרָיו׃

lines.text: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
The law of his God [is] his heart, His steps do not slide.

37.he: צוֹפֶ֣ה רָ֭שָׁע לַצַּדִּ֑יק וּ֝מְבַקֵּ֗שׁ לַהֲמִיתוֹ׃

lines.text: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.
The wicked is watching for the righteous, And is seeking to put him to death.

37.he: יְ֭הוָה לֹא־יַעַזְבֶ֣נּוּ בְיָד֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א יַ֝רְשִׁיעֶ֗נּוּ בְּהִשָּׁפְטֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Yahweh will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
Jehovah doth not leave him in his hand, Nor condemn him in his being judged.

37.he: קַוֵּ֤ה אֶל־יְהוָ֨ה ׀ וּשְׁמֹ֬ר דַּרְכּ֗וֹ וִֽ֭ירוֹמִמְךָ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אָ֑רֶץ בְּהִכָּרֵ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּרְאֶֽה׃

lines.text: Wait for Yahweh, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.
Look unto Jehovah, and keep His way, And He doth exalt thee to possess the land, In the wicked being cut off — thou seest!

37.he: רָ֭אִיתִי רָשָׁ֣ע עָרִ֑יץ וּ֝מִתְעָרֶ֗ה כְּאֶזְרָ֥ח רַעֲנָֽן׃

lines.text: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
I have seen the wicked terrible, And spreading as a green native plant,

37.he: וַ֭יַּֽעֲבֹר וְהִנֵּ֣ה אֵינֶ֑נּוּ וָֽ֝אֲבַקְשֵׁ֗הוּ וְלֹ֣א נִמְצָֽא׃

lines.text: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
And he passeth away, and lo, he is not, And I seek him, and he is not found!

37.he: שְׁמָר־תָּ֭ם וּרְאֵ֣ה יָשָׁ֑ר כִּֽי־אַחֲרִ֖ית לְאִ֣ישׁ שָׁלֽוֹם׃

lines.text: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
Observe the perfect, and see the upright, For the latter end of each [is] peace.

37.he: וּֽ֭פֹשְׁעִים נִשְׁמְד֣וּ יַחְדָּ֑ו אַחֲרִ֖ית רְשָׁעִ֣ים נִכְרָֽתָה׃

lines.text: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.
And transgressors were destroyed together, The latter end of the wicked was cut off.

37.he: וּתְשׁוּעַ֣ת צַ֭דִּיקִים מֵיְהוָ֑ה מָֽ֝עוּזָּ֗ם בְּעֵ֣ת צָרָֽה׃

lines.text: But the salvation of the righteous is from Yahweh. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
And the salvation of the righteous [is] from Jehovah, Their strong place in a time of adversity.

37.he: וַ֥יַּעְזְרֵ֥ם יְהוָ֗ה וַֽיְפַלְּ֫טֵ֥ם יְפַלְּטֵ֣ם מֵ֭רְשָׁעִים וְיוֹשִׁיעֵ֑ם כִּי־חָ֥סוּ בֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Yahweh helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.
And Jehovah doth help them and deliver them, He delivereth them from the wicked, And saveth them, Because they trusted in Him!

38.he: מִזְמ֖וֹר לְדָוִ֣ד לְהַזְכִּֽיר׃

lines.text: A Psalm of David, 'To cause to remember.' Jehovah, in Thy wrath reprove me not, Nor in Thy fury chastise me.

38.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל־בְּקֶצְפְּךָ֥ תוֹכִיחֵ֑נִי וּֽבַחֲמָתְךָ֥ תְיַסְּרֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
A Psalm of David, 'To cause to remember.' Jehovah, in Thy wrath reprove me not, Nor in Thy fury chastise me.

38.he: כִּֽי־חִ֭צֶּיךָ נִ֣חֲתוּ בִ֑י וַתִּנְחַ֖ת עָלַ֣י יָדֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.
For Thine arrows have come down on me, And Thou lettest down upon me Thy hand.

38.he: אֵין־מְתֹ֣ם בִּ֭בְשָׂרִי מִפְּנֵ֣י זַעְמֶ֑ךָ אֵין־שָׁל֥וֹם בַּ֝עֲצָמַ֗י מִפְּנֵ֥י חַטָּאתִֽי׃

lines.text: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.
Soundness is not in my flesh, Because of Thine indignation, Peace is not in my bones because of my sin.

38.he: כִּ֣י עֲ֭וֺנֹתַי עָבְר֣וּ רֹאשִׁ֑י כְּמַשָּׂ֥א כָ֝בֵ֗ד יִכְבְּד֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

lines.text: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
For mine iniquities have passed over my head, As a heavy burden — too heavy for me.

38.he: הִבְאִ֣ישׁוּ נָ֭מַקּוּ חַבּוּרֹתָ֑י מִ֝פְּנֵ֗י אִוַּלְתִּֽי׃

lines.text: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness.
Stunk — become corrupt have my wounds, Because of my folly.

38.he: נַעֲוֵ֣יתִי שַׁחֹ֣תִי עַד־מְאֹ֑ד כָּל־הַ֝יּ֗וֹם קֹדֵ֥ר הִלָּֽכְתִּי׃

lines.text: I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.
I have been bent down, I have been bowed down — unto excess, All the day I have gone mourning.
