56.he: בֵּאלֹהִים֮ אֲהַלֵּ֪ל דְּבָ֫ר֥וֹ בֵּאלֹהִ֣ים בָּ֭טַחְתִּי לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בָשָׂ֣ר לִֽי׃

lines.text: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
In God I praise His word, in God I have trusted, I fear not what flesh doth to me.

56.he: כָּל־הַ֭יּוֹם דְּבָרַ֣י יְעַצֵּ֑בוּ עָלַ֖י כָּל־מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֣ם לָרָֽע׃

lines.text: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.
All the day they wrest my words, Concerning me all their thoughts [are] for evil,

56.he: יָג֤וּרוּ ׀ יצפינו הֵ֭מָּה עֲקֵבַ֣י יִשְׁמֹ֑רוּ כַּ֝אֲשֶׁ֗ר קִוּ֥וּ נַפְשִֽׁי׃

lines.text: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.
They assemble, they hide, they watch my heels, When they have expected my soul.

56.he: עַל־אָ֥וֶן פַּלֶּט־לָ֑מוֹ בְּ֝אַ֗ף עַמִּ֤ים ׀ הוֹרֵ֬ד אֱלֹהִֽים׃

lines.text: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.
By iniquity they escape, In anger the peoples put down, O God.

56.he: נֹדִי֮ סָפַ֪רְתָּ֫ה אָ֥תָּה שִׂ֣ימָה דִמְעָתִ֣י בְנֹאדֶ֑ךָ הֲ֝לֹ֗א בְּסִפְרָתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?
My wandering Thou hast counted, Thou — place Thou my tear in Thy bottle, Are they not in Thy book?

56.he: אָ֥֨ז יָ֘שׁ֤וּבוּ אוֹיְבַ֣י אָ֭חוֹר בְּי֣וֹם אֶקְרָ֑א זֶה־יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֥ים לִֽי׃

lines.text: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.
Then turn back do mine enemies in the day I call. This I have known, that God [is] for me.

56.he: בֵּֽ֭אלֹהִים אֲהַלֵּ֣ל דָּבָ֑ר בַּ֝יהוָ֗ה אֲהַלֵּ֥ל דָּבָֽר׃

lines.text: In God, I will praise his word. In Yahweh, I will praise his word.
In God I praise the word, In Jehovah I praise the word.

56.he: בֵּֽאלֹהִ֣ים בָּ֭טַחְתִּי לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה אָדָ֣ם לִֽי׃

lines.text: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
In God I trusted, I fear not what man doth to me,

56.he: עָלַ֣י אֱלֹהִ֣ים נְדָרֶ֑יךָ אֲשַׁלֵּ֖ם תּוֹדֹ֣ת לָֽךְ׃

lines.text: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.
On me, O God, [are] Thy vows, I repay thank-offerings to Thee.

56.he: כִּ֤י הִצַּ֪לְתָּ נַפְשִׁ֡י מִמָּוֶת֮ הֲלֹ֥א רַגְלַ֗י מִ֫דֶּ֥חִי לְ֭הִֽתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּ֝א֗וֹר הַֽחַיִּֽים׃

lines.text: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.
For Thou hast delivered my soul from death, Dost Thou not my feet from falling? To walk habitually before God in the light of the living!

57.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ אַל־תַּ֭שְׁחֵת לְדָוִ֣ד מִכְתָּ֑ם בְּבָרְח֥וֹ מִפְּנֵי־שָׁ֝א֗וּל בַּמְּעָרָֽה׃

lines.text: To the Overseer. — 'Destroy not.' — A secret treasure of David, in his fleeing from the face of Saul into a cave. Favour me, O God, favour me, For in Thee is my soul trusting, And in the shadow of Thy wings I trust, Until the calamities pass over.

57.he: חָנֵּ֤נִי אֱלֹהִ֨ים ׀ חָנֵּ֗נִי כִּ֥י בְךָ֮ חָסָ֪יָה נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י וּבְצֵֽל־כְּנָפֶ֥יךָ אֶחְסֶ֑ה עַ֝֗ד יַעֲבֹ֥ר הַוּֽוֹת׃

lines.text: Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.

To the Overseer. — 'Destroy not.' — A secret treasure of David, in his fleeing from the face of Saul into a cave. Favour me, O God, favour me, For in Thee is my soul trusting, And in the shadow of Thy wings I trust, Until the calamities pass over.

57.he: אֶ֭קְרָא לֵֽאלֹהִ֣ים עֶלְי֑וֹן לָ֝אֵ֗ל גֹּמֵ֥ר עָלָֽי׃

lines.text: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.
I call to God Most High, To God [who] is perfecting for me.

57.he: יִשְׁלַ֤ח מִשָּׁמַ֨יִם ׀ וְֽיוֹשִׁיעֵ֗נִי חֵרֵ֣ף שֹׁאֲפִ֣י סֶ֑לָה יִשְׁלַ֥ח אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים חַסְדּ֥וֹ וַאֲמִתּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.
He sendeth from the heaven, and saveth me, He reproached — who is panting after me. Selah. God sendeth forth His kindness and His truth.

57.he: נַפְשִׁ֤י ׀ בְּת֥וֹךְ לְבָאִם֮ אֶשְׁכְּבָ֪ה לֹ֫הֲטִ֥ים בְּֽנֵי־אָדָ֗ם שִׁ֭נֵּיהֶם חֲנִ֣ית וְחִצִּ֑ים וּ֝לְשׁוֹנָ֗ם חֶ֣רֶב חַדָּֽה׃

lines.text: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
My soul [is] in the midst of lions, I lie down [among] flames — sons of men, Their teeth [are] a spear and arrows, And their tongue a sharp sword.

57.he: ר֣וּמָה עַל־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם אֱלֹהִ֑ים עַ֖ל כָּל־הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!
Be Thou exalted above the heavens, O God, Above all the earth Thine honour.

57.he: רֶ֤שֶׁת ׀ הֵכִ֣ינוּ לִפְעָמַי֮ כָּפַ֪ף נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י כָּר֣וּ לְפָנַ֣י שִׁיחָ֑ה נָפְל֖וּ בְתוֹכָ֣הּ סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it themselves.
A net they have prepared for my steps, Bowed down hath my soul, They have digged before me a pit, They have fallen into its midst. Selah.

57.he: נָ֘כ֤וֹן לִבִּ֣י אֱ֭לֹהִים נָכ֣וֹן לִבִּ֑י אָ֝שִׁ֗ירָה וַאֲזַמֵּֽרָה׃

lines.text: My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.
Prepared is my heart, O God, Prepared is my heart, I sing and praise.

57.he: ע֤וּרָה כְבוֹדִ֗י ע֭וּרָ֥ה הַנֵּ֥בֶל וְכִנּ֗וֹר אָעִ֥ירָה שָּֽׁחַר׃

lines.text: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.
Awake, mine honour, awake, psaltery and harp, I awake the morning dawn.
I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.
I thank Thee among the peoples, O Lord, I praise Thee among the nations.
For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.
For great unto the heavens [is] Thy kindness, And unto the clouds Thy truth.

57.he: ר֣וּמָה עַל־שָׁמַ֣יִם אֱלֹהִ֑ים עַ֖ל כָּל־הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.
Be thou exalted above the heavens, O God. Above all the earth Thine honour!
To the Overseer. — 'Destroy not.' — A secret treasure, by David. Is it true, O dumb one, righteously ye speak? Uprightly ye judge, O sons of men?

58.he: הַֽאֻמְנָ֗ם אֵ֣לֶם צֶ֭דֶק תְּדַבֵּר֑וּן מֵישָׁרִ֥ים תִּ֝שְׁפְּט֗וּ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃

lines.text: Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?
To the Overseer. — 'Destroy not.' — A secret treasure, by David. Is it true, O dumb one, righteously ye speak? Uprightly ye judge, O sons of men?

58.he: אַף־בְּלֵב֮ עוֹלֹ֪ת תִּפְעָ֫ל֥וּן בָּאָ֡רֶץ חֲמַ֥ס יְ֝דֵיכֶ֗ם תְּפַלֵּֽסֽוּן׃

lines.text: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth.
Even in heart ye work iniquities, In the land the violence of your hands ye ponder.

58.he: זֹ֣רוּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים מֵרָ֑חֶם תָּע֥וּ מִ֝בֶּ֗טֶן דֹּבְרֵ֥י כָזָֽב׃

lines.text: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.
The wicked have been estranged from the womb, They have erred from the belly, speaking lies.

58.he: חֲמַת־לָ֗מוֹ כִּדְמ֥וּת חֲמַת־נָחָ֑שׁ כְּמוֹ־פֶ֥תֶן חֵ֝רֵ֗שׁ יַאְטֵ֥ם אָזְנֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,
Their poison [is] as poison of a serpent, As a deaf asp shutting its ear,

58.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־יִ֭שְׁמַע לְק֣וֹל מְלַחֲשִׁ֑ים חוֹבֵ֖ר חֲבָרִ֣ים מְחֻכָּֽם׃

lines.text: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.
Which hearkeneth not to the voice of whisperers, A charmer of charms most skilful.

58.he: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים הֲרָס־שִׁנֵּ֥ימוֹ בְּפִ֑ימוֹ מַלְתְּע֥וֹת כְּ֝פִירִ֗ים נְתֹ֣ץ ׀ יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, Yahweh.
O God, break their teeth in their mouth, The jaw-teeth of young lions break down, O Jehovah.

58.he: יִמָּאֲס֣וּ כְמוֹ־מַ֭יִם יִתְהַלְּכוּ־לָ֑מוֹ יִדְרֹ֥ךְ חצו כְּמ֣וֹ יִתְמֹלָֽלוּ׃

lines.text: Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.
They are melted as waters, They go up and down for themselves, His arrow proceedeth as they cut themselves off.

58.he: כְּמ֣וֹ שַׁ֭בְּלוּל תֶּ֣מֶס יַהֲלֹ֑ךְ נֵ֥פֶל אֵ֝֗שֶׁת בַּל־חָ֥זוּ שָֽׁמֶשׁ׃

lines.text: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.
As a snail that melteth he goeth on, [As] an untimely birth of a woman, They have not seen the sun.

58.he: בְּטֶ֤רֶם יָבִ֣ינוּ סִּֽירֹתֵיכֶ֣ם אָטָ֑ד כְּמוֹ־חַ֥י כְּמוֹ־חָ֝ר֗וֹן יִשְׂעָרֶֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.
Before your pots discern the bramble, As well the raw as the heated He whirleth away.

58.he: יִשְׂמַ֣ח צַ֭דִּיק כִּי־חָזָ֣ה נָקָ֑ם פְּעָמָ֥יו יִ֝רְחַ֗ץ בְּדַ֣ם הָרָשָֽׁע׃

lines.text: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,
The righteous rejoiceth that he hath seen vengeance, His steps he washeth in the blood of the wicked.

58.he: וְיֹאמַ֣ר אָ֭דָם אַךְ־פְּרִ֣י לַצַּדִּ֑יק אַ֥ךְ יֵשׁ־אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים שֹׁפְטִ֥ים בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”
And man saith: 'Surely fruit [is] for the righteous: Surely there is a God judging in the earth!'

59.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ אַל־תַּשְׁחֵת֮ לְדָוִ֪ד מִ֫כְתָּ֥ם בִּשְׁלֹ֥חַ שָׁא֑וּל וַֽיִּשְׁמְר֥וּ אֶת־הַ֝בַּ֗יִת לַהֲמִיתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: To the Overseer. — 'Destroy not,' by David. — A secret treasure, in Saul's sending, and they watch the house to put him to death. Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God, From my withstanders set me on high.
Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.

To the Overseer. — 'Destroy not,' by David. — A secret treasure, in Saul's sending, and they watch the house to put him to death. Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God, From my withstanders set me on high.

59.he: הַ֭צִּילֵנִי מִפֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן וּֽמֵאַנְשֵׁ֥י דָ֝מִ֗ים הוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.
Deliver me from workers of iniquity, And from men of blood save me.

59.he: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה אָֽרְב֡וּ לְנַפְשִׁ֗י יָג֣וּרוּ עָלַ֣י עַזִ֑ים לֹא־פִשְׁעִ֖י וְלֹא־חַטָּאתִ֣י יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, Yahweh.
For, lo, they laid wait for my soul, Assembled against me are strong ones, Not my transgression nor my sin, O Jehovah.

59.he: בְּֽלִי־עָ֭וֺן יְרוּצ֣וּן וְיִכּוֹנָ֑נוּ ע֖וּרָה לִקְרָאתִ֣י וּרְאֵה׃

lines.text: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!
Without punishment they run and prepare themselves, Stir up to meet me, and see.

59.he: וְאַתָּ֤ה יְהוָֽה־אֱלֹהִ֥ים ׀ צְבָא֡וֹת אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הָקִ֗יצָה לִפְקֹ֥ד כָּֽל־הַגּוֹיִ֑ם אַל־תָּחֹ֨ן כָּל־בֹּ֖גְדֵי אָ֣וֶן סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: You, Yahweh God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors.
And Thou, Jehovah, God of Hosts, God of Israel, Awake to inspect all the nations. Favour not any treacherous dealers of iniquity. Selah.

59.he: יָשׁ֣וּבוּ לָ֭עֶרֶב יֶהֱמ֥וּ כַכָּ֗לֶב וִיס֥וֹבְבוּ עִֽיר׃

lines.text: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.
They turn back at evening, They make a noise like a dog, And go round about the city.

59.he: הִנֵּ֤ה ׀ יַבִּ֘יע֤וּן בְּפִיהֶ֗ם חֲ֭רָבוֹת בְּשִׂפְתוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם כִּי־מִ֥י שֹׁמֵֽעַ׃

lines.text: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”
Lo, they belch out with their mouths, Swords [are] in their lips, for 'Who heareth?'
But you, Yahweh, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.
And Thou, O Jehovah dost laugh at them, Thou dost mock at all the nations.
Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.
O my Strength, unto Thee I take heed, For God [is] my tower — the God of my kindness.

59.he: אֱלֹהֵ֣י חסדו יְקַדְּמֵ֑נִי אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים יַרְאֵ֥נִי בְשֹׁרְרָֽי׃

lines.text: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.
God doth go before me, He causeth me to look on mine enemies.

59.he: אַל־תַּהַרְגֵ֤ם ׀ פֶּֽן־יִשְׁכְּח֬וּ עַמִּ֗י הֲנִיעֵ֣מוֹ בְ֭חֵילְךָ וְהוֹרִידֵ֑מוֹ מָ֖גִנֵּ֣נוּ אֲדֹנָֽי׃

lines.text: Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.
Slay them not, lest my people forget, Shake them by Thy strength, And bring them down, O Lord our shield.

59.he: חַטַּאת־פִּ֗ימוֹ דְּֽבַר־שְׂפָ֫תֵ֥ימוֹ וְיִלָּכְד֥וּ בִגְאוֹנָ֑ם וּמֵאָלָ֖ה וּמִכַּ֣חַשׁ יְסַפֵּֽרוּ׃

lines.text: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.
The sin of their mouth [is] a word of their lips, And they are captured in their pride, And from the curse and lying they recount.

59.he: כַּלֵּ֥ה בְחֵמָה֮ כַּלֵּ֪ה וְֽאֵ֫ינֵ֥מוֹ וְֽיֵדְע֗וּ כִּֽי־אֱ֭לֹהִים מֹשֵׁ֣ל בְּיַעֲקֹ֑ב לְאַפְסֵ֖י הָאָ֣רֶץ סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth.
Consume in fury, consume and they are not, And they know that God is ruling in Jacob, To the ends of the earth. Selah.

59.he: וְיָשׁ֣וּבוּ לָ֭עֶרֶב יֶהֱמ֥וּ כַכָּ֗לֶב וִיס֥וֹבְבוּ עִֽיר׃

lines.text: At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.
And they turn back at evening, They make a noise like a dog, And they go round about the city.

59.he: הֵ֭מָּה ינועון לֶאֱכֹ֑ל אִם־לֹ֥א יִ֝שְׂבְּע֗וּ וַיָּלִֽינוּ׃

lines.text: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren’t satisfied.
They — they wander for food, If they are not satisfied — then they murmur.

59.he: וַאֲנִ֤י ׀ אָשִׁ֣יר עֻזֶּךָ֮ וַאֲרַנֵּ֥ן לַבֹּ֗קֶר חַ֫סְדֶּ֥ךָ כִּֽי־הָיִ֣יתָ מִשְׂגָּ֣ב לִ֑י וּ֝מָנ֗וֹס בְּי֣וֹם צַר־לִֽי׃

lines.text: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.
And I — I sing [of] Thy strength, And I sing at morn [of] Thy kindness, For thou hast been a tower to me, And a refuge for me in a day of adversity.

59.he: עֻ֭זִּי אֵלֶ֣יךָ אֲזַמֵּ֑רָה כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֥ים מִ֝שְׂגַּבִּ֗י אֱלֹהֵ֥י חַסְדִּֽי׃

lines.text: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
O my Strength, unto Thee I sing praise, For God [is] my tower, the God of my kindness!

60.he: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ עַל־שׁוּשַׁ֣ן עֵד֑וּת מִכְתָּ֖ם לְדָוִ֣ד לְלַמֵּֽד׃

lines.text: To the Overseer. — 'Concerning the Lily of Testimony,' a secret treasure of David, to teach, in his striving with Aram-Naharaim, and with Aram-Zobah, and Joab turneth back and smiteth Edom in the valley of Salt — twelve thousand. O God, Thou hadst cast us off, Thou hadst broken us — hadst been angry! — Thou dost turn back to us.

60.he: בְּהַצּוֹת֨וֹ ׀ אֶ֥ת אֲרַ֣ם נַהֲרַיִם֮ וְאֶת־אֲרַ֪ם צ֫וֹבָ֥ה וַיָּ֤שָׁב יוֹאָ֗ב וַיַּ֣ךְ אֶת־אֱד֣וֹם בְּגֵיא־מֶ֑לַח שְׁנֵ֖ים עָשָׂ֣ר אָֽלֶף׃

lines.text: To the Overseer. — 'Concerning the Lily of Testimony,' a secret treasure of David, to teach, in his striving with Aram-Naharaim, and with Aram-Zobah, and Joab turneth back and smiteth Edom in the valley of Salt — twelve thousand. O God, Thou hadst cast us off, Thou hadst broken us — hadst been angry! — Thou dost turn back to us.

60.he: אֱ֭לֹהִים זְנַחְתָּ֣נוּ פְרַצְתָּ֑נוּ אָ֝נַ֗פְתָּ תְּשׁ֣וֹבֵֽב לָֽנוּ׃

lines.text: God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.

To the Overseer. — 'Concerning the Lily of Testimony,' a secret treasure of David, to teach, in his striving with Aram-Naharaim, and with Aram-Zobah, and Joab turneth back and smiteth Edom in the valley of Salt — twelve thousand. O God, Thou hadst cast us off, Thou hadst broken us — hadst been angry! — Thou dost turn back to us.

60.he: הִרְעַ֣שְׁתָּה אֶ֣רֶץ פְּצַמְתָּ֑הּ רְפָ֖ה שְׁבָרֶ֣יהָ כִי־מָֽטָה׃

lines.text: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.
Thou hast caused the land to tremble, Thou hast broken it, Heal its breaches, for it hath moved.

60.he: הִרְאִ֣יתָה עַמְּךָ֣ קָשָׁ֑ה הִ֝שְׁקִיתָ֗נוּ יַ֣יִן תַּרְעֵלָֽה׃

lines.text: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.
Thou hast shewn Thy people a hard thing, Thou hast caused us to drink wine of trembling.

60.he: נָ֘תַ֤תָּה לִּירֵאֶ֣יךָ נֵּ֭ס לְהִתְנוֹסֵ֑ס מִ֝פְּנֵ֗י קֹ֣שֶׁט סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth.
Thou hast given to those fearing thee an ensign. To be lifted up as an ensign Because of truth. Selah.

60.he: לְ֭מַעַן יֵחָלְצ֣וּן יְדִידֶ֑יךָ הוֹשִׁ֖יעָה יְמִֽינְךָ֣ ועננו׃

lines.text: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
That Thy beloved ones may be drawn out, Save [with] Thy right hand, and answer us.

60.he: אֱלֹהִ֤ים ׀ דִּבֶּ֥ר בְּקָדְשׁ֗וֹ אֶ֫עְלֹ֥זָה אֲחַלְּקָ֥ה שְׁכֶ֑ם וְעֵ֖מֶק סֻכּ֣וֹת אֲמַדֵּֽד׃

lines.text: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
God hath spoken in His holiness: I exult — I apportion Shechem, And the valley of Succoth I measure,

60.he: לִ֤י גִלְעָ֨ד ׀ וְלִ֬י מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה וְ֭אֶפְרַיִם מָע֣וֹז רֹאשִׁ֑י יְ֝הוּדָ֗ה מְחֹֽקְקִי׃

lines.text: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.
Mine [is] Gilead, and mine [is] Manasseh, And Ephraim [is] the strength of my head, Judah [is] my lawgiver,

60.he: מוֹאָ֤ב ׀ סִ֬יר רַחְצִ֗י עַל־אֱ֭דוֹם אַשְׁלִ֣יךְ נַעֲלִ֑י עָ֝לַ֗י פְּלֶ֣שֶׁת הִתְרֹעָֽעִֽי׃

lines.text: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my sandal on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia.”
Moab [is] my pot for washing, over Edom I cast my shoe, Shout, concerning me, O Philistia.

60.he: מִ֣י יֹ֭בִלֵנִי עִ֣יר מָצ֑וֹר מִ֖י נָחַ֣נִי עַד־אֱדֽוֹם׃

lines.text: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?
Who doth bring me [to] a city of bulwarks? Who hath led me unto Edom?

60.he: הֲלֹֽא־אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים זְנַחְתָּ֑נוּ וְֽלֹא־תֵצֵ֥א אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בְּצִבְאוֹתֵֽינוּ׃

lines.text: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.
Is it not Thou, O God? hast Thou cast us off? And dost Thou not go forth, O God, with our hosts!

60.he: הָֽבָה־לָּ֣נוּ עֶזְרָ֣ת מִצָּ֑ר וְ֝שָׁ֗וְא תְּשׁוּעַ֥ת אָדָם׃

lines.text: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.
Give to us help from adversity, And vain [is] the deliverance of man.
Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.
In God we do mightily, And He treadeth down our adversaries!
To the Overseer, on stringed instruments. — By David. Hear, O God, my loud cry, attend to my prayer.
Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.
To the Overseer, on stringed instruments. — By David. Hear, O God, my loud cry, attend to my prayer.

61.he: מִקְצֵ֤ה הָאָ֨רֶץ ׀ אֵלֶ֣יךָ אֶ֭קְרָא בַּעֲטֹ֣ף לִבִּ֑י בְּצוּר־יָר֖וּם מִמֶּ֣נִּי תַנְחֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
From the end of the land unto Thee I call, In the feebleness of my heart, Into a rock higher than I Thou dost lead me.

61.he: כִּֽי־הָיִ֣יתָ מַחְסֶ֣ה לִ֑י מִגְדַּל־עֹ֝֗ז מִפְּנֵ֥י אוֹיֵֽב׃

lines.text: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.
For Thou hast been a refuge for me, A tower of strength because of the enemy.

61.he: אָג֣וּרָה בְ֭אָהָלְךָ עוֹלָמִ֑ים אֶֽחֱסֶ֨ה בְסֵ֖תֶר כְּנָפֶ֣יךָ סֶּֽלָה׃

lines.text: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings.
I sojourn in Thy tent to the ages, I trust in the secret place of Thy wings. Selah.

61.he: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים שָׁמַ֣עְתָּ לִנְדָרָ֑י נָתַ֥תָּ יְ֝רֻשַּׁ֗ת יִרְאֵ֥י שְׁמֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.
For Thou, O God, hast hearkened to my vows, Thou hast appointed the inheritance Of those fearing Thy name.

61.he: יָמִ֣ים עַל־יְמֵי־מֶ֣לֶךְ תּוֹסִ֑יף שְׁ֝נוֹתָ֗יו כְּמוֹ־דֹ֥ר וָדֹֽר׃

lines.text: You will prolong the king’s life. His years will be for generations.
Days to the days of the king Thou addest, His years as generation and generation.

61.he: יֵשֵׁ֣ב ע֭וֹלָם לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים חֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝אֱמֶ֗ת מַ֣ן יִנְצְרֻֽהוּ׃

lines.text: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.
He dwelleth to the age before God, Kindness and truth appoint — they keep him.

61.he: כֵּ֤ן אֲזַמְּרָ֣ה שִׁמְךָ֣ לָעַ֑ד לְֽשַׁלְּמִ֥י נְ֝דָרַ֗י י֣וֹם ׀ יֽוֹם׃

lines.text: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.
So do I praise Thy name for ever, When I pay my vows day by day!
To the Overseer, for Jeduthun. — A Psalm of David. Only — toward God [is] my soul silent, From Him [is] my salvation.

62.he: אַ֣ךְ אֶל־אֱ֭לֹהִים דּֽוּמִיָּ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ יְשׁוּעָתִֽי׃

lines.text: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
To the Overseer, for Jeduthun. — A Psalm of David. Only — toward God [is] my soul silent, From Him [is] my salvation.

62.he: אַךְ־ה֣וּא צ֭וּרִי וִֽישׁוּעָתִ֑י מִ֝שְׂגַּבִּ֗י לֹא־אֶמּ֥וֹט רַבָּֽה׃

lines.text: He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.
Only — He [is] my rock, and my salvation, My tower, I am not much moved.

62.he: עַד־אָ֤נָה ׀ תְּה֥וֹתְת֣וּ עַל אִישׁ֮ תְּרָצְּח֪וּ כֻ֫לְּכֶ֥ם כְּקִ֥יר נָט֑וּי גָּ֝דֵ֗ר הַדְּחוּֽיָה׃

lines.text: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?
Till when do ye devise mischief against a man? Ye are destroyed all of you, As a wall inclined, a hedge that is cast down.

62.he: אַ֤ךְ מִשְּׂאֵת֨וֹ ׀ יָ֥עֲצ֣וּ לְהַדִּיחַ֮ יִרְצ֪וּ כָ֫זָ֥ב בְּפִ֥יו יְבָרֵ֑כוּ וּ֝בְקִרְבָּ֗ם יְקַלְלוּ־סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly.
Only — from his excellency They have consulted to drive away, They enjoy a lie, with their mouth they bless, And with their heart revile. Selah.

62.he: אַ֣ךְ לֵ֭אלֹהִים דּ֣וֹמִּי נַפְשִׁ֑י כִּי־מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ תִּקְוָתִֽי׃

lines.text: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.
Only — for God, be silent, O my soul, For from Him [is] my hope.

62.he: אַךְ־ה֣וּא צ֭וּרִי וִֽישׁוּעָתִ֑י מִ֝שְׂגַּבִּ֗י לֹ֣א אֶמּֽוֹט׃

lines.text: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.
Only — He [is] my rock and my salvation, My tower, I am not moved.

62.he: עַל־אֱ֭לֹהִים יִשְׁעִ֣י וּכְבוֹדִ֑י צוּר־עֻזִּ֥י מַ֝חְסִ֗י בֵּֽאלֹהִֽים׃

lines.text: My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
On God [is] my salvation, and my honour, The rock of my strength, my refuge [is] in God.

62.he: בִּטְח֘וּ ב֤וֹ בְכָל־עֵ֨ת ׀ עָ֗ם שִׁפְכֽוּ־לְפָנָ֥יו לְבַבְכֶ֑ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים מַחֲסֶה־לָּ֣נוּ סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us.
Trust in Him at all times, O people, Pour forth before Him your heart, God [is] a refuge for us. Selah.

62.he: אַ֤ךְ ׀ הֶ֥בֶל בְּנֵֽי־אָדָם֮ כָּזָ֪ב בְּנֵ֫י אִ֥ישׁ בְּמֹאזְנַ֥יִם לַעֲל֑וֹת הֵ֝֗מָּה מֵהֶ֥בֶל יָֽחַד׃

lines.text: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.
Only — vanity [are] the low, a lie the high. In balances to go up they than vanity [are] lighter.

62.he: אַל־תִּבְטְח֣וּ בְעֹשֶׁק֮ וּבְגָזֵ֪ל אַל־תֶּ֫הְבָּ֥לוּ חַ֤יִל ׀ כִּֽי־יָנ֑וּב אַל־תָּשִׁ֥יתוּ לֵֽב׃

lines.text: Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.
Trust not in oppression, And in robbery become not vain, Wealth — when it increaseth — set not the heart.

62.he: אַחַ֤ת ׀ דִּבֶּ֬ר אֱלֹהִ֗ים שְׁתַּֽיִם־ז֥וּ שָׁמָ֑עְתִּי כִּ֥י עֹ֝֗ז לֵאלֹהִֽים׃

lines.text: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.
Once hath God spoken, twice I heard this, That 'strength [is] with God.'

62.he: וּלְךָֽ־אֲדֹנָ֥י חָ֑סֶד כִּֽי־אַתָּ֨ה תְשַׁלֵּ֖ם לְאִ֣ישׁ כְּֽמַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ׃

lines.text: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.
And with Thee, O Lord, [is] kindness, For Thou dost recompense to each, According to his work!

A Psalm of David, in his being in the wilderness of Judah. O God, Thou [art] my God, earnestly do I seek Thee, Thirsted for Thee hath my soul, Longed for Thee hath my flesh, In a land dry and weary, without waters.

63.he: אֱלֹהִ֤ים ׀ אֵלִ֥י אַתָּ֗ה אֲֽשַׁחֲ֫רֶ֥ךָּ צָמְאָ֬ה לְךָ֨ ׀ נַפְשִׁ֗י כָּמַ֣הּ לְךָ֣ בְשָׂרִ֑י בְּאֶֽרֶץ־צִיָּ֖ה וְעָיֵ֣ף בְּלִי־מָֽיִם׃

lines.text: God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.

A Psalm of David, in his being in the wilderness of Judah. O God, Thou [art] my God, earnestly do I seek Thee, Thirsted for Thee hath my soul, Longed for Thee hath my flesh, In a land dry and weary, without waters.

63.he: כֵּ֭ן בַּקֹּ֣דֶשׁ חֲזִיתִ֑יךָ לִרְא֥וֹת עֻ֝זְּךָ֗ וּכְבוֹדֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.
So in the sanctuary I have seen Thee, To behold Thy strength and Thine honour.
Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
Because better [is] Thy kindness than life, My lips do praise Thee.

63.he: כֵּ֣ן אֲבָרֶכְךָ֣ בְחַיָּ֑י בְּ֝שִׁמְךָ אֶשָּׂ֥א כַפָּֽי׃

lines.text: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.
So I bless Thee in my life, in Thy name I lift up my hands.

63.he: כְּמ֤וֹ חֵ֣לֶב וָ֭דֶשֶׁן תִּשְׂבַּ֣ע נַפְשִׁ֑י וְשִׂפְתֵ֥י רְ֝נָנ֗וֹת יְהַלֶּל־פִּֽי׃

lines.text: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,
As [with] milk and fatness is my soul satisfied, And [with] singing lips doth my mouth praise.
when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.
If I have remembered Thee on my couch, In the watches — I meditate on Thee.

63.he: כִּֽי־הָיִ֣יתָ עֶזְרָ֣תָה לִּ֑י וּבְצֵ֖ל כְּנָפֶ֣יךָ אֲרַנֵּֽן׃

lines.text: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.
For Thou hast been a help to me, And in the shadow of Thy wings I sing.

63.he: דָּבְקָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֣י אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ בִּ֝֗י תָּמְכָ֥ה יְמִינֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.
Cleaved hath my soul after Thee, On me hath Thy right hand taken hold.

63.he: וְהֵ֗מָּה לְ֭שׁוֹאָה יְבַקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י יָ֝בֹ֗אוּ בְּֽתַחְתִּיּ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: But those who seek my soul to destroy it shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
And they who for desolation seek my soul, Go in to the lower parts of the earth.
They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.
They cause him to run on the edge of the sword, A portion for foxes they are.

63.he: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ֮ יִשְׂמַ֪ח בֵּאלֹ֫הִ֥ים יִ֭תְהַלֵּל כָּל־הַנִּשְׁבָּ֣ע בּ֑וֹ כִּ֥י יִ֝סָּכֵ֗ר פִּ֣י דֽוֹבְרֵי־שָֽׁקֶר׃

lines.text: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.
And the king doth rejoice in God, Boast himself doth every one swearing by Him, But stopped is the mouth of those speaking lies!
To the Overseer. — A Psalm of David. Hear, O God, my voice, in my meditation, From the fear of an enemy Thou keepest my life,

64.he: שְׁמַע־אֱלֹהִ֣ים קוֹלִ֣י בְשִׂיחִ֑י מִפַּ֥חַד א֝וֹיֵ֗ב תִּצֹּ֥ר חַיָּֽי׃

lines.text: Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
To the Overseer. — A Psalm of David. Hear, O God, my voice, in my meditation, From the fear of an enemy Thou keepest my life,

64.he: תַּ֭סְתִּירֵנִי מִסּ֣וֹד מְרֵעִ֑ים מֵ֝רִגְשַׁ֗ת פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

lines.text: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;
Hidest me from the secret counsel of evil doers, From the tumult of workers of iniquity.

64.he: אֲשֶׁ֤ר שָׁנְנ֣וּ כַחֶ֣רֶב לְשׁוֹנָ֑ם דָּרְכ֥וּ חִ֝צָּ֗ם דָּבָ֥ר מָֽר׃

lines.text: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,
Who sharpened as a sword their tongue, They directed their arrow — a bitter word.

64.he: לִיר֣וֹת בַּמִּסְתָּרִ֣ים תָּ֑ם פִּתְאֹ֥ם יֹ֝רֻ֗הוּ וְלֹ֣א יִירָֽאוּ׃

lines.text: to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.
To shoot in secret places the perfect, Suddenly they shoot him, and fear not.

64.he: יְחַזְּקוּ־לָ֨מוֹ ׀ דָּ֘בָ֤ר רָ֗ע יְֽ֭סַפְּרוּ לִטְמ֣וֹן מוֹקְשִׁ֑ים אָ֝מְר֗וּ מִ֣י יִרְאֶה־לָּֽמוֹ׃

lines.text: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, “Who will see them?”
They strengthen for themselves an evil thing, They recount of the hiding of snares, They have said, 'Who doth look at it?'

64.he: יַֽחְפְּֽשׂוּ־עוֹלֹ֗ת תַּ֭מְנוּ חֵ֣פֶשׂ מְחֻפָּ֑שׂ וְקֶ֥רֶב אִ֝֗ישׁ וְלֵ֣ב עָמֹֽק׃

lines.text: They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.
They search out perverse things, 'We perfected a searching search,' And the inward part of man, and the heart [are] deep.

64.he: וַיֹּרֵ֗ם אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים חֵ֥ץ פִּתְא֑וֹם הָ֝י֗וּ מַכּוֹתָֽם׃

lines.text: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.
And God doth shoot them [with] an arrow, Sudden have been their wounds,

64.he: וַיַּכְשִׁיל֣וּהוּ עָלֵ֣ימוֹ לְשׁוֹנָ֑ם יִ֝תְנֹדֲד֗וּ כָּל־רֹ֥אֵה בָֽם׃

lines.text: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.
And they cause him to stumble, Against them [is] their own tongue, Every looker on them fleeth away.

64.he: וַיִּֽירְא֗וּ כָּל־אָ֫דָ֥ם וַ֭יַּגִּידוּ פֹּ֥עַל אֱלֹהִ֗ים וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֥הוּ הִשְׂכִּֽילוּ׃

lines.text: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.
And all men fear, and declare the work of God, And His deed they have considered wisely.

64.he: יִשְׂמַ֬ח צַדִּ֣יק בַּ֭יהוָה וְחָ֣סָה ב֑וֹ וְ֝יִתְהַֽלְל֗וּ כָּל־יִשְׁרֵי־לֵֽב׃

lines.text: The righteous shall be glad in Yahweh, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!
The righteous doth rejoice in Jehovah, And hath trusted in Him, And boast themselves do all the upright of heart!
To the Overseer. — A Psalm of David. A Song. To Thee, silence — praise, O God, [is] in Zion, And to Thee is a vow completed.

65.he: לְךָ֤ דֻֽמִיָּ֬ה תְהִלָּ֓ה אֱלֹ֘הִ֥ים בְּצִיּ֑וֹן וּ֝לְךָ֗ יְשֻׁלַּם־נֶֽדֶר׃

lines.text: Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.
To the Overseer. — A Psalm of David. A Song. To Thee, silence — praise, O God, [is] in Zion, And to Thee is a vow completed.
You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.
Hearer of prayer, to Thee all flesh cometh.

65.he: דִּבְרֵ֣י עֲ֭וֺנֹת גָּ֣בְרוּ מֶ֑נִּי פְּ֝שָׁעֵ֗ינוּ אַתָּ֥ה תְכַפְּרֵֽם׃

lines.text: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.
Matters of iniquities were mightier than I, Our transgressions — Thou dost cover them.

65.he: אַשְׁרֵ֤י ׀ תִּֽבְחַ֣ר וּתְקָרֵב֮ יִשְׁכֹּ֪ן חֲצֵ֫רֶ֥יךָ נִ֭שְׂבְּעָה בְּט֣וּב בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ קְ֝דֹ֗שׁ הֵיכָלֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.
O the happiness of [him whom] Thou choosest, And drawest near, he inhabiteth Thy courts, We are satisfied with the goodness of Thy house, Thy holy temple.

65.he: נ֤וֹרָא֨וֹת ׀ בְּצֶ֣דֶק תַּ֭עֲנֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֑נוּ מִבְטָ֥ח כָּל־קַצְוֵי־אֶ֝֗רֶץ וְיָ֣ם רְחֹקִֽים׃

lines.text: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea.
By fearful things in righteousness Thou answerest us, O God of our salvation, The confidence of all far off ends of earth and sea.
By your power, you form the mountains, having armed yourself with strength.
Establishing mountains by His power, He hath been girded with might,

65.he: מַשְׁבִּ֤יחַ ׀ שְׁא֣וֹן יַ֭מִּים שְׁא֥וֹן גַּלֵּיהֶ֗ם וַהֲמ֥וֹן לְאֻמִּֽים׃

lines.text: You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.
Restraining the noise of seas, the noise of their billows, And the multitude of the peoples.

65.he: וַיִּ֤ירְא֨וּ ׀ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י קְ֭צָוֺת מֵאוֹתֹתֶ֑יךָ מ֤וֹצָֽאֵי־בֹ֖קֶר וָעֶ֣רֶב תַּרְנִֽין׃

lines.text: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.
And the inhabitants of the uttermost parts From Thy signs are afraid, The outgoings of morning and evening Thou causest to sing.

65.he: פָּקַ֥דְתָּ הָאָ֨רֶץ ׀ וַתְּשֹׁ֪קְקֶ֡הָ רַבַּ֬ת תַּעְשְׁרֶ֗נָּה פֶּ֣לֶג אֱ֭לֹהִים מָ֣לֵא מָ֑יִם תָּכִ֥ין דְּ֝גָנָ֗ם כִּי־כֵ֥ן תְּכִינֶֽהָ׃

lines.text: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.
Thou hast inspected the earth, and waterest it, Thou makest it very rich, the rivulet of God [is] full of water, Thou preparest their corn, When thus Thou dost prepare it,

65.he: תְּלָמֶ֣יהָ רַ֭וֵּה נַחֵ֣ת גְּדוּדֶ֑יהָ בִּרְבִיבִ֥ים תְּ֝מֹגְגֶ֗נָּה צִמְחָ֥הּ תְּבָרֵֽךְ׃

lines.text: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.
Its ridges have been filled, Deepened hath been its furrow, With showers Thou dost soften it, Its springing up Thou blessest.

65.he: עִ֭טַּרְתָּ שְׁנַ֣ת טוֹבָתֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מַעְגָּלֶ֗יךָ יִרְעֲפ֥וּן דָּֽשֶׁן׃

lines.text: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.
Thou hast crowned the year of Thy goodness, And Thy paths drop fatness.

65.he: יִ֭רְעֲפוּ נְא֣וֹת מִדְבָּ֑ר וְ֝גִ֗יל גְּבָע֥וֹת תַּחְגֹּֽרְנָה׃

lines.text: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.
Drop do the pastures of a wilderness, And joy of the heights Thou girdest on.

65.he: לָבְשׁ֬וּ כָרִ֨ים ׀ הַצֹּ֗אן וַעֲמָקִ֥ים יַֽעַטְפוּ־בָ֑ר יִ֝תְרוֹעֲע֗וּ אַף־יָשִֽׁירוּ׃

lines.text: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.
Clothed have lambs the flock, And valleys are covered with corn, They shout — yea, they sing!

66.he: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ שִׁ֣יר מִזְמ֑וֹר הָרִ֥יעוּ לֵ֝אלֹהִים כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!
To the Overseer. — A Song, a Psalm. Shout ye to God, all the earth.

66.he: זַמְּר֥וּ כְבֽוֹד־שְׁמ֑וֹ שִׂ֥ימוּ כָ֝ב֗וֹד תְּהִלָּֽתוֹ׃

lines.text: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!
Praise ye the honour of His name, Make ye honourable His praise.

66.he: אִמְר֣וּ לֵ֭אלֹהִים מַה־נּוֹרָ֣א מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ בְּרֹ֥ב עֻ֝זְּךָ֗ יְֽכַחֲשׁ֖וּ לְךָ֣ אֹיְבֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.
Say to God, 'How fearful [are] Thy works, By the abundance of Thy strength, Thine enemies feign obedience to Thee.

66.he: כָּל־הָאָ֤רֶץ ׀ יִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לְ֭ךָ וִֽיזַמְּרוּ־לָ֑ךְ יְזַמְּר֖וּ שִׁמְךָ֣ סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.”
All the earth do bow to Thee, They sing praise to Thee, they praise Thy name.' Selah.

66.he: לְכ֣וּ וּ֭רְאוּ מִפְעֲל֣וֹת אֱלֹהִ֑ים נוֹרָ֥א עֲ֝לִילָ֗ה עַל־בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

lines.text: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.
Come ye, and see the works of God, Fearful acts toward the sons of men.

66.he: הָ֤פַךְ יָ֨ם ׀ לְֽיַבָּשָׁ֗ה בַּ֭נָּהָר יַֽעַבְר֣וּ בְרָ֑גֶל שָׁ֝֗ם נִשְׂמְחָה־בּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.
He hath turned a sea to dry land, Through a river they pass over on foot, There do we rejoice in Him.

66.he: מֹ֘שֵׁ֤ל בִּגְבוּרָת֨וֹ ׀ עוֹלָ֗ם עֵ֭ינָיו בַּגּוֹיִ֣ם תִּצְפֶּ֑ינָה הַסוֹרְרִ֓ים ׀ אַל־ירימו לָ֣מוֹ סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him.
Ruling by His might to the age, His eyes among the nations do watch, The refractory exalt not themselves. Selah.

66.he: בָּרְכ֖וּ עַמִּ֥ים ׀ אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְ֝הַשְׁמִ֗יעוּ ק֣וֹל תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,
Bless, ye peoples, our God, And sound the voice of His praise,

66.he: הַשָּׂ֣ם נַ֭פְשֵׁנוּ בַּֽחַיִּ֑ים וְלֹֽא־נָתַ֖ן לַמּ֣וֹט רַגְלֵֽנוּ׃

lines.text: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.
Who hath placed our soul in life, And suffered not our feet to be moved.

66.he: כִּֽי־בְחַנְתָּ֥נוּ אֱלֹהִ֑ים צְ֝רַפְתָּ֗נוּ כִּצְרָף־כָּֽסֶף׃

lines.text: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.
For Thou hast tried us, O God, Thou hast refined us as the refining of silver.

66.he: הֲבֵאתָ֥נוּ בַמְּצוּדָ֑ה שַׂ֖מְתָּ מוּעָקָ֣ה בְמָתְנֵֽינוּ׃

lines.text: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.
Thou hast brought us into a net, Thou hast placed pressure on our loins.

66.he: הִרְכַּ֥בְתָּ אֱנ֗וֹשׁ לְרֹ֫אשֵׁ֥נוּ בָּֽאנוּ־בָאֵ֥שׁ וּבַמַּ֑יִם וַ֝תּוֹצִיאֵ֗נוּ לָֽרְוָיָֽה׃

lines.text: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.
Thou hast caused man to ride at our head. We have entered into fire and into water, And Thou bringest us out to a watered place.

66.he: אָב֣וֹא בֵיתְךָ֣ בְעוֹל֑וֹת אֲשַׁלֵּ֖ם לְךָ֣ נְדָרָֽי׃

lines.text: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,
I enter Thy house with burnt-offerings, I complete to Thee my vows,

66.he: אֲשֶׁר־פָּצ֥וּ שְׂפָתָ֑י וְדִבֶּר־פִּ֝֗י בַּצַּר־לִֽי׃

lines.text: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.
For opened were my lips, And my mouth spake in my distress:

66.he: עֹ֘ל֤וֹת מֵחִ֣ים אַעֲלֶה־לָּ֭ךְ עִם־קְטֹ֣רֶת אֵילִ֑ים אֶ֥עֱשֶֽׂה בָקָ֖ר עִם־עַתּוּדִ֣ים סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats.
'Burnt-offerings of fatlings I offer to Thee, With perfume of rams, I prepare a bullock with he-goats.' Selah.

66.he: לְכֽוּ־שִׁמְע֣וּ וַ֭אֲסַפְּרָה כָּל־יִרְאֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר עָשָׂ֣ה לְנַפְשִֽׁי׃

lines.text: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.
Come, hear, all ye who fear God, And I recount what he did for my soul.

66.he: אֵלָ֥יו פִּֽי־קָרָ֑אתִי וְ֝רוֹמַ֗ם תַּ֣חַת לְשׁוֹנִֽי׃

lines.text: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.
Unto Him [with] my mouth I have called, And exaltation [is] under my tongue.

66.he: אָ֭וֶן אִם־רָאִ֣יתִי בְלִבִּ֑י לֹ֖א יִשְׁמַ֣ע ׀ אֲדֹנָֽי׃

lines.text: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.
Iniquity, if I have seen in my heart, The Lord doth not hear.

66.he: אָ֭כֵן שָׁמַ֣ע אֱלֹהִ֑ים הִ֝קְשִׁ֗יב בְּק֣וֹל תְּפִלָּתִֽי׃

lines.text: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.
But God hath heard, He hath attended to the voice of my prayer.

66.he: בָּר֥וּךְ אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־הֵסִ֘יר תְּפִלָּתִ֥י וְ֝חַסְדּ֗וֹ מֵאִתִּֽי׃

lines.text: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.
Blessed [is] God, Who hath not turned aside my prayer, And His loving-kindness, from me!
To the Overseer, with stringed instruments. — A Psalm, a Song. God doth favour us and bless us, Doth cause His face to shine with us. Selah.

67.he: אֱלֹהִ֗ים יְחָנֵּ֥נוּ וִֽיבָרְכֵ֑נוּ יָ֤אֵ֥ר פָּנָ֖יו אִתָּ֣נוּ סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us.
To the Overseer, with stringed instruments. — A Psalm, a Song. God doth favour us and bless us, Doth cause His face to shine with us. Selah.
That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,
For the knowledge in earth of Thy way, among all nations of Thy salvation.

67.he: יוֹד֖וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים ׀ אֱלֹהִ֑ים י֝וֹד֗וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים כֻּלָּֽם׃

lines.text: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
Praise Thee do peoples, O God, Praise Thee do peoples, all of them.

67.he: יִֽשְׂמְח֥וּ וִֽירַנְּנ֗וּ לְאֻ֫מִּ֥ים כִּֽי־תִשְׁפֹּ֣ט עַמִּ֣ים מִישׁ֑וֹר וּלְאֻמִּ֓ים ׀ בָּאָ֖רֶץ תַּנְחֵ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth.
Rejoice and sing do nations, For Thou judgest peoples uprightly, And peoples on earth comfortest. Selah.

67.he: יוֹד֖וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים ׀ אֱלֹהִ֑ים י֝וֹד֗וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים כֻּלָּֽם׃

lines.text: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
Confess Thee do peoples, O God, Confess Thee do peoples — all of them.

67.he: אֶ֭רֶץ נָתְנָ֣ה יְבוּלָ֑הּ יְ֝בָרְכֵ֗נוּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

lines.text: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.
Earth hath given her increase, God doth bless us — our God,
God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.
God doth bless us, and all ends of earth fear Him!

68.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ לְדָוִ֗ד מִזְמ֥וֹר שִֽׁיר׃

lines.text: To the Overseer. — A Psalm, a song of David. Rise doth God — scattered are His enemies! And those hating Him flee from His face.

68.he: יָק֣וּם אֱ֭לֹהִים יָפ֣וּצוּ אוֹיְבָ֑יו וְיָנ֥וּסוּ מְ֝שַׂנְאָ֗יו מִפָּנָֽיו׃

lines.text: Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.
To the Overseer. — A Psalm, a song of David. Rise doth God — scattered are His enemies! And those hating Him flee from His face.

68.he: כְּהִנְדֹּ֥ף עָשָׁ֗ן תִּ֫נְדֹּ֥ף כְּהִמֵּ֣ס דּ֭וֹנַג מִפְּנֵי־אֵ֑שׁ יֹאבְד֥וּ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים מִפְּנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃

lines.text: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
As the driving away of smoke Thou drivest away, As the melting of wax before fire, The wicked perish at the presence of God.

68.he: וְֽצַדִּיקִ֗ים יִשְׂמְח֣וּ יַֽ֭עַלְצוּ לִפְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִ֗ים וְיָשִׂ֥ישׂוּ בְשִׂמְחָֽה׃

lines.text: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.
And the righteous rejoice, they exult before God, And they joy with gladness.

68.he: שִׁ֤ירוּ ׀ לֵֽאלֹהִים֮ זַמְּר֪וּ שְׁ֫מ֥וֹ סֹ֡לּוּ לָרֹכֵ֣ב בָּ֭עֲרָבוֹת בְּיָ֥הּ שְׁמ֗וֹ וְעִלְז֥וּ לְפָנָֽיו׃

lines.text: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to Yah, his name! Rejoice before him!
Sing ye to God — praise His name, Raise up a highway for Him who is riding in deserts, In Jah [is] His name, and exult before Him.

68.he: אֲבִ֣י יְ֭תוֹמִים וְדַיַּ֣ן אַלְמָנ֑וֹת אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בִּמְע֥וֹן קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃

lines.text: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
Father of the fatherless, and judge of the widows, [Is] God in His holy habitation.

68.he: אֱלֹהִ֤ים ׀ מ֘וֹשִׁ֤יב יְחִידִ֨ים ׀ בַּ֗יְתָה מוֹצִ֣יא אֲ֭סִירִים בַּכּוֹשָׁר֑וֹת אַ֥ךְ ס֝וֹרֲרִ֗ים שָׁכְנ֥וּ צְחִיחָֽה׃

lines.text: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
God — causing the lonely to dwell at home, Bringing out bound ones into prosperity, Only — the refractory have inhabited a dry place.

68.he: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים בְּ֭צֵאתְךָ לִפְנֵ֣י עַמֶּ֑ךָ בְּצַעְדְּךָ֖ בִֽישִׁימ֣וֹן סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness...
O God, in Thy going forth before Thy people, In Thy stepping through the wilderness, Selah.

68.he: אֶ֤רֶץ רָעָ֨שָׁה ׀ אַף־שָׁמַ֣יִם נָטְפוּ֮ מִפְּנֵ֪י אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים זֶ֥ה סִינַ֑י מִפְּנֵ֥י אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

lines.text: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
The earth hath shaken, Yea, the heavens have dropped before God, This Sinai — before God, the God of Israel.

68.he: גֶּ֣שֶׁם נְ֭דָבוֹת תָּנִ֣יף אֱלֹהִ֑ים נַחֲלָתְךָ֥ וְ֝נִלְאָ֗ה אַתָּ֥ה כֽוֹנַנְתָּֽהּ׃

lines.text: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.
A shower of free-will gifts thou shakest out, O God. Thine inheritance, when it hath been weary, Thou hast established it.

68.he: חַיָּתְךָ֥ יָֽשְׁבוּ־בָ֑הּ תָּ֤כִ֥ין בְּטוֹבָתְךָ֖ לֶעָנִ֣י אֱלֹהִֽים׃

lines.text: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.
Thy company have dwelt in it, Thou preparest in Thy goodness for the poor, O God.

68.he: אֲדֹנָ֥י יִתֶּן־אֹ֑מֶר הַֽ֝מְבַשְּׂר֗וֹת צָבָ֥א רָֽב׃

lines.text: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.
The Lord doth give the saying, The female proclaimers [are] a numerous host.

68.he: מַלְכֵ֣י צְ֭בָאוֹת יִדֹּד֣וּן יִדֹּד֑וּן וּנְוַת בַּ֝֗יִת תְּחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁלָֽל׃

lines.text: “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,
Kings of hosts flee utterly away, And a female inhabitant of the house apportioneth spoil.

68.he: אִֽם־תִּשְׁכְּבוּן֮ בֵּ֪ין שְׁפַ֫תָּ֥יִם כַּנְפֵ֣י י֭וֹנָה נֶחְפָּ֣ה בַכֶּ֑סֶף וְ֝אֶבְרוֹתֶ֗יהָ בִּֽירַקְרַ֥ק חָרֽוּץ׃

lines.text: while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.
Though ye do lie between two boundaries, Wings of a dove covered with silver, And her pinions with yellow gold.

68.he: בְּפָ֘רֵ֤שׂ שַׁדַּ֓י מְלָ֘כִ֤ים בָּ֗הּ תַּשְׁלֵ֥ג בְּצַלְמֽוֹן׃

lines.text: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.
When the Mighty spreadeth kings in it, It doth snow in Salmon.

68.he: הַר־אֱ֭לֹהִים הַר־בָּשָׁ֑ן הַ֥ר גַּ֝בְנֻנִּ֗ים הַר־בָּשָֽׁן׃

lines.text: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.
A hill of God [is] the hill of Bashan, A hill of heights [is] the hill of Bashan.

68.he: לָ֤מָּה ׀ תְּֽרַצְּדוּן֮ הָרִ֪ים גַּבְנֻ֫נִּ֥ים הָהָ֗ר חָמַ֣ד אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְשִׁבְתּ֑וֹ אַף־יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָנֶֽצַח׃

lines.text: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, Yahweh will dwell there forever.
Why do ye envy, O high hills, The hill God hath desired for His seat? Jehovah also doth tabernacle for ever.

68.he: רֶ֤כֶב אֱלֹהִ֗ים רִבֹּתַ֣יִם אַלְפֵ֣י שִׁנְאָ֑ן אֲדֹנָ֥י בָ֝֗ם סִינַ֥י בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

lines.text: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.
The chariots of God [are] myriads, thousands of changes, The Lord [is] among them, in Sinai, in the sanctuary.

68.he: עָ֘לִ֤יתָ לַמָּר֨וֹם ׀ שָׁ֘בִ֤יתָ שֶּׁ֗בִי לָקַ֣חְתָּ מַ֭תָּנוֹת בָּאָדָ֑ם וְאַ֥ף ס֝וֹרְרִ֗ים לִשְׁכֹּ֤ן ׀ יָ֬הּ אֱלֹהִֽים׃

lines.text: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that Yah God might dwell there.
Thou hast ascended on high, Thou hast taken captive captivity, Thou hast taken gifts for men, That even the refractory may rest, O Jah God.

68.he: בָּ֤ר֣וּךְ אֲדֹנָי֮ י֤וֹם ׀ י֥וֹם יַֽעֲמָס־לָ֗נוּ הָ֘אֵ֤ל יְֽשׁוּעָתֵ֬נוּ סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation.
Blessed [is] the Lord, day by day He layeth on us. God Himself [is] our salvation. Selah.

68.he: הָ֤אֵ֣ל ׀ לָנוּ֮ אֵ֤ל לְֽמוֹשָׁ֫ע֥וֹת וְלֵיהוִ֥ה אֲדֹנָ֑י לַ֝מָּ֗וֶת תּוֹצָאֽוֹת׃

lines.text: God is to us a God of deliverance. To Yahweh, the Lord, belongs escape from death.
God Himself [is] to us a God for deliverances, And Jehovah Lord hath the outgoings of death.

68.he: אַךְ־אֱלֹהִ֗ים יִמְחַץ֮ רֹ֤אשׁ אֹ֫יְבָ֥יו קָדְקֹ֥ד שֵׂעָ֑ר מִ֝תְהַלֵּ֗ךְ בַּאֲשָׁמָֽיו׃

lines.text: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.
Only — God doth smite The head of His enemies, The hairy crown of a habitual walker in his guilt.

68.he: אָמַ֣ר אֲ֭דֹנָי מִבָּשָׁ֣ן אָשִׁ֑יב אָ֝שִׁ֗יב מִֽמְּצֻל֥וֹת יָֽם׃

lines.text: The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea,
The Lord said: 'From Bashan I bring back, I bring back from the depths of the sea.

68.he: לְמַ֤עַן ׀ תִּֽמְחַ֥ץ רַגְלְךָ֗ בְּ֫דָ֥ם לְשׁ֥וֹן כְּלָבֶ֑יךָ מֵאֹיְבִ֥ים מִנֵּֽהוּ׃

lines.text: that you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”
So that thou dashest thy foot in blood, [In the blood of] enemies — the tongue of Thy dogs.'

68.he: רָא֣וּ הֲלִיכוֹתֶ֣יךָ אֱלֹהִ֑ים הֲלִ֘יכ֤וֹת אֵלִ֖י מַלְכִּ֣י בַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

lines.text: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
They have seen Thy goings, O God, Goings of my God, my king, in the sanctuary.

68.he: קִדְּמ֣וּ שָׁ֭רִים אַחַ֣ר נֹגְנִ֑ים בְּת֥וֹךְ עֲ֝לָמ֗וֹת תּוֹפֵפֽוֹת׃

lines.text: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,
Singers have been before, Behind [are] players on instruments, In the midst virgins playing with timbrels.

68.he: בְּֽ֭מַקְהֵלוֹת בָּרְכ֣וּ אֱלֹהִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה מִמְּק֥וֹר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

lines.text: “Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”
In assemblies bless ye God, The Lord — from the fountain of Israel.

68.he: שָׁ֤ם בִּנְיָמִ֨ן ׀ צָעִ֡יר רֹדֵ֗ם שָׂרֵ֣י יְ֭הוּדָה רִגְמָתָ֑ם שָׂרֵ֥י זְ֝בֻל֗וּן שָׂרֵ֥י נַפְתָּלִֽי׃

lines.text: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
There [is] little Benjamin their ruler, Heads of Judah their defence, Heads of Zebulun — heads of Naphtali.

68.he: צִוָּ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ עֻ֫זֶּ֥ךָ עוּזָּ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים ז֝֗וּ פָּעַ֥לְתָּ לָּֽנוּ׃

lines.text: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.
Thy God hath commanded thy strength, Be strong, O God, this Thou hast wrought for us.

68.he: מֵֽ֭הֵיכָלֶךָ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לְךָ֤ יוֹבִ֖ילוּ מְלָכִ֣ים שָֽׁי׃

lines.text: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings shall bring presents to you.
Because of Thy temple at Jerusalem, To Thee do kings bring a present.

68.he: גְּעַ֨ר חַיַּ֪ת קָנֶ֡ה עֲדַ֤ת אַבִּירִ֨ים ׀ בְּעֶגְלֵ֬י עַמִּ֗ים מִתְרַפֵּ֥ס בְּרַצֵּי־כָ֑סֶף בִּזַּ֥ר עַ֝מִּ֗ים קְרָב֥וֹת יֶחְפָּֽצוּ׃

lines.text: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the peoples. Being humbled, may it bring bars of silver. Scatter the nations that delight in war.
Rebuke a beast of the reeds, a company of bulls, With calves of the peoples, Each humbling himself with pieces of silver, Scatter Thou peoples delighting in conflicts.

68.he: יֶאֱתָ֣יוּ חַ֭שְׁמַנִּים מִנִּ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם כּ֥וּשׁ תָּרִ֥יץ יָ֝דָ֗יו לֵאלֹהִֽים׃

lines.text: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.
Come do fat ones out of Egypt, Cush causeth her hands to run to God.

68.he: מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָ֭אָרֶץ שִׁ֣ירוּ לֵאלֹהִ֑ים זַמְּר֖וּ אֲדֹנָ֣י סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord!
Kingdoms of the earth, sing ye to God, Praise ye the Lord. Selah.

68.he: לָ֭רֹכֵב בִּשְׁמֵ֣י שְׁמֵי־קֶ֑דֶם הֵ֥ן יִתֵּ֥ן בְּ֝קוֹלוֹ ק֣וֹל עֹֽז׃

lines.text: To him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.
To him who is riding on the heavens of the heavens of old, Lo, He giveth with His voice a strong voice.

68.he: תְּנ֥וּ עֹ֗ז לֵֽאלֹ֫הִ֥ים עַֽל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל גַּאֲוָת֑וֹ וְ֝עֻזּ֗וֹ בַּשְּׁחָקִֽים׃

lines.text: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.
Ascribe ye strength to God, Over Israel [is] His excellency, and His strength in the clouds.

68.he: נ֤וֹרָ֥א אֱלֹהִ֗ים מִֽמִּקְדָּ֫שֶׁ֥יךָ אֵ֤ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל ה֤וּא נֹתֵ֨ן ׀ עֹ֖ז וְתַעֲצֻמ֥וֹת לָעָ֗ם בָּר֥וּךְ אֱלֹהִֽים׃

lines.text: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!
Fearful, O God, out of Thy sanctuaries, The God of Israel Himself, Giving strength and might to the people. Blessed [is] God!

69.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ עַֽל־שׁוֹשַׁנִּ֬ים לְדָוִֽד׃

lines.text: To the Overseer. — 'On the Lilies,' by David. Save me, O God, for come have waters unto the soul.

69.he: הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥נִי אֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֤י בָ֖אוּ מַ֣יִם עַד־נָֽפֶשׁ׃

lines.text: Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!
To the Overseer. — 'On the Lilies,' by David. Save me, O God, for come have waters unto the soul.

69.he: טָבַ֤עְתִּי ׀ בִּיוֵ֣ן מְ֭צוּלָה וְאֵ֣ין מָעֳמָ֑ד בָּ֥אתִי בְמַעֲמַקֵּי־מַ֝֗יִם וְשִׁבֹּ֥לֶת שְׁטָפָֽתְנִי׃

lines.text: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
I have sunk in deep mire, And there is no standing, I have come into the depths of the waters, And a flood hath overflown me.

69.he: יָגַ֣עְתִּי בְקָרְאִי֮ נִחַ֪ר גְּר֫וֹנִ֥י כָּל֥וּ עֵינַ֑י מְ֝יַחֵ֗ל לֵאלֹהָֽי׃

lines.text: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God.
I have been wearied with my calling, Burnt hath been my throat, Consumed have been mine eyes, waiting for my God.

69.he: רַבּ֤וּ ׀ מִשַּׂעֲר֣וֹת רֹאשִׁי֮ שֹׂנְאַ֪י חִ֫נָּ֥ם עָצְמ֣וּ מַ֭צְמִיתַי אֹיְבַ֣י שֶׁ֑קֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־גָ֝זַ֗לְתִּי אָ֣ז אָשִֽׁיב׃

lines.text: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I didn’t take away.
Those hating me without cause Have been more than the hairs of my head, Mighty have been my destroyers, My lying enemies, That which I took not away — I bring back.

69.he: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים אַתָּ֣ה יָ֭דַעְתָּ לְאִוַּלְתִּ֑י וְ֝אַשְׁמוֹתַ֗י מִמְּךָ֥ לֹא־נִכְחָֽדוּ׃

lines.text: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren’t hidden from you.
O God, Thou — Thou hast known Concerning my overturn, And my desolations from Thee have not been hid.

69.he: אַל־יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ בִ֨י ׀ קֹוֶיךָ֮ אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֗ה צְבָ֫א֥וֹת אַל־יִכָּ֣לְמוּ בִ֣י מְבַקְשֶׁ֑יךָ אֱ֝לֹהֵ֗י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

lines.text: Don’t let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord Yahweh of Armies. Don’t let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.
Let not those waiting on Thee be ashamed because of me, O Lord, Jehovah of Hosts, Let not those seeking Thee Blush because of me, O God of Israel.

69.he: כִּֽי־עָ֭לֶיךָ נָשָׂ֣אתִי חֶרְפָּ֑ה כִּסְּתָ֖ה כְלִמָּ֣ה פָנָֽי׃

lines.text: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.
For because of Thee I have borne reproach, Shame hath covered my face.

69.he: מ֭וּזָר הָיִ֣יתִי לְאֶחָ֑י וְ֝נָכְרִ֗י לִבְנֵ֥י אִמִּֽי׃

lines.text: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother’s children.
A stranger I have been to my brother, And a foreigner to sons of my mother.

69.he: כִּֽי־קִנְאַ֣ת בֵּיתְךָ֣ אֲכָלָ֑תְנִי וְחֶרְפּ֥וֹת ח֝וֹרְפֶ֗יךָ נָפְל֥וּ עָלָֽי׃

lines.text: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.
For zeal for Thy house hath consumed me, And the reproaches of Thy reproachers Have fallen upon me.

69.he: וָאֶבְכֶּ֣ה בַצּ֣וֹם נַפְשִׁ֑י וַתְּהִ֖י לַחֲרָפ֣וֹת לִֽי׃

lines.text: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.
And I weep in the fasting of my soul, And it is for a reproach to me.

69.he: וָאֶתְּנָ֣ה לְבוּשִׁ֣י שָׂ֑ק וָאֱהִ֖י לָהֶ֣ם לְמָשָֽׁל׃

lines.text: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.
And I make my clothing sackcloth, And I am to them for a simile.

69.he: יָשִׂ֣יחוּ בִ֭י יֹ֣שְׁבֵי שָׁ֑עַר וּ֝נְגִינ֗וֹת שׁוֹתֵ֥י שֵׁכָֽר׃

lines.text: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.
Those sitting at the gate meditate concerning me, And those drinking strong drink, Play on instruments.

69.he: וַאֲנִ֤י תְפִלָּתִֽי־לְךָ֨ ׀ יְהוָ֡ה עֵ֤ת רָצ֗וֹן אֱלֹהִ֥ים בְּרָב־חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ עֲ֝נֵ֗נִי בֶּאֱמֶ֥ת יִשְׁעֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: But as for me, my prayer is to you, Yahweh, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.
And I — my prayer [is] to Thee, O Jehovah, A time of good pleasure, O God, In the abundance of Thy kindness, Answer me in the truth of Thy salvation.

69.he: הַצִּילֵ֣נִי מִ֭טִּיט וְאַל־אֶטְבָּ֑עָה אִנָּצְלָ֥ה מִ֝שֹּֽׂנְאַ֗י וּמִמַּֽעֲמַקֵּי־מָֽיִם׃

lines.text: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.
Deliver me from the mire, and let me not sink, Let me be delivered from those hating me, And from deep places of waters.

69.he: אַל־תִּשְׁטְפֵ֤נִי ׀ שִׁבֹּ֣לֶת מַ֭יִם וְאַל־תִּבְלָעֵ֣נִי מְצוּלָ֑ה וְאַל־תֶּאְטַר־עָלַ֖י בְּאֵ֣ר פִּֽיהָ׃

lines.text: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.
Let not a flood of waters overflow me, Nor let the deep swallow me up, Nor let the pit shut her mouth upon me.

69.he: עֲנֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה כִּי־ט֣וֹב חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ כְּרֹ֥ב רַ֝חֲמֶ֗יךָ פְּנֵ֣ה אֵלָֽי׃

lines.text: Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.
Answer me, O Jehovah, for good [is] Thy kindness, According to the abundance Of Thy mercies turn Thou unto me,

69.he: וְאַל־תַּסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נֶיךָ מֵֽעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי־צַר־לִ֝֗י מַהֵ֥ר עֲנֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!
And hide not Thy face from Thy servant, For I am in distress — haste, answer me.

69.he: קָרְבָ֣ה אֶל־נַפְשִׁ֣י גְאָלָ֑הּ לְמַ֖עַן אֹיְבַ֣י פְּדֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: Draw near to my soul and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.
Be near unto my soul — redeem it, Because of mine enemies ransom me.

69.he: אַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתָּ חֶרְפָּתִ֣י וּ֭בָשְׁתִּי וּכְלִמָּתִ֑י נֶ֝גְדְּךָ֗ כָּל־צוֹרְרָֽי׃

lines.text: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.
Thou — Thou hast known my reproach, And my shame, and my blushing, Before Thee [are] all mine adversaries.

69.he: חֶרְפָּ֤ה ׀ שָֽׁבְרָ֥ה לִבִּ֗י וָֽאָ֫נ֥וּשָׁה וָאֲקַוֶּ֣ה לָנ֣וּד וָאַ֑יִן וְ֝לַמְנַחֲמִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א מָצָֽאתִי׃

lines.text: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.
Reproach hath broken my heart, and I am sick, And I look for a bemoaner, and there is none, And for comforters, and I have found none.

69.he: וַיִּתְּנ֣וּ בְּבָרוּתִ֣י רֹ֑אשׁ וְ֝לִצְמָאִ֗י יַשְׁק֥וּנִי חֹֽמֶץ׃

lines.text: They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.
And they give for my food gall, And for my thirst cause me to drink vinegar.

69.he: יְהִֽי־שֻׁלְחָנָ֣ם לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם לְפָ֑ח וְלִשְׁלוֹמִ֥ים לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃

lines.text: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.
Their table before them is for a snare, And for a recompence — for a trap.

69.he: תֶּחְשַׁ֣כְנָה עֵ֭ינֵיהֶם מֵרְא֑וֹת וּ֝מָתְנֵ֗יהֶם תָּמִ֥יד הַמְעַֽד׃

lines.text: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.
Darkened are their eyes from seeing, And their loins continually shake Thou.

69.he: שְׁפָךְ־עֲלֵיהֶ֥ם זַעְמֶ֑ךָ וַחֲר֥וֹן אַ֝פְּךָ֗ יַשִּׂיגֵֽם׃

lines.text: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.
Pour upon them Thine indignation, And the fierceness of Thine anger doth seize them.

69.he: תְּהִי־טִֽירָתָ֥ם נְשַׁמָּ֑ה בְּ֝אָהֳלֵיהֶ֗ם אַל־יְהִ֥י יֹשֵֽׁב׃

lines.text: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.
Their tower is desolated, In their tents there is no dweller.

69.he: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה אֲשֶׁר־הִכִּ֣יתָ רָדָ֑פוּ וְאֶל־מַכְא֖וֹב חֲלָלֶ֣יךָ יְסַפֵּֽרוּ׃

lines.text: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.
For they have pursued him Thou hast smitten, And recount of the pain of Thy pierced ones.

69.he: תְּֽנָה־עָ֭וֺן עַל־עֲוֺנָ֑ם וְאַל־יָ֝בֹ֗אוּ בְּצִדְקָתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don’t let them come into your righteousness.
Give punishment for their iniquity, And they enter not into Thy righteousness.

69.he: יִ֭מָּחֽוּ מִסֵּ֣פֶר חַיִּ֑ים וְעִ֥ם צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים אַל־יִכָּתֵֽבוּ׃

lines.text: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.
They are blotted out of the book of life, And with the righteous are not written.

69.he: וַ֭אֲנִי עָנִ֣י וְכוֹאֵ֑ב יְשׁוּעָתְךָ֖ אֱלֹהִ֣ים תְּשַׂגְּבֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.
And I [am] afflicted and pained, Thy salvation, O God, doth set me on high.

69.he: אֲהַֽלְלָ֣ה שֵׁם־אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּשִׁ֑יר וַאֲגַדְּלֶ֥נּוּ בְתוֹדָֽה׃

lines.text: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
I praise the name of God with a song, And I magnify Him with thanksgiving,

69.he: וְתִיטַ֣ב לַֽ֭יהוָה מִשּׁ֥וֹר פָּ֗ר מַקְרִ֥ן מַפְרִֽיס׃

lines.text: It will please Yahweh better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.
And it is better to Jehovah than an ox, A bullock — horned — hoofed.

69.he: רָא֣וּ עֲנָוִ֣ים יִשְׂמָ֑חוּ דֹּרְשֵׁ֥י אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים וִיחִ֥י לְבַבְכֶֽם׃

lines.text: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.
The humble have seen — they rejoice, Ye who seek God — and your heart liveth.

69.he: כִּֽי־שֹׁמֵ֣עַ אֶל־אֶבְיוֹנִ֣ים יְהוָ֑ה וְאֶת־אֲ֝סִירָ֗יו לֹ֣א בָזָֽה׃

lines.text: For Yahweh hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.
For Jehovah hearkeneth unto the needy, And His bound ones He hath not despised.

69.he: יְֽ֭הַלְלוּהוּ שָׁמַ֣יִם וָאָ֑רֶץ יַ֝מִּ֗ים וְֽכָל־רֹמֵ֥שׂ בָּֽם׃

lines.text: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!
The heavens and earth do praise Him, Seas, and every moving thing in them.

69.he: כִּ֤י אֱלֹהִ֨ים ׀ י֘וֹשִׁ֤יעַ צִיּ֗וֹן וְ֭יִבְנֶה עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וְיָ֥שְׁבוּ שָׁ֝֗ם וִירֵשֽׁוּהָ׃

lines.text: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.
For God doth save Zion, And doth build the cities of Judah, And they have dwelt there, and possess it.

69.he: וְזֶ֣רַע עֲ֭בָדָיו יִנְחָל֑וּהָ וְאֹהֲבֵ֥י שְׁ֝מ֗וֹ יִשְׁכְּנוּ־בָֽהּ׃

lines.text: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein.
And the seed of His servants inherit it, And those loving His name dwell in it!
To the Overseer, by David. — 'To cause to remember.' O God, to deliver me, O Jehovah, for my help, haste.
Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, Yahweh.
To the Overseer, by David. — 'To cause to remember.' O God, to deliver me, O Jehovah, for my help, haste.

70.he: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֪י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָ֭חוֹר וְיִכָּלְמ֑וּ חֲ֝פֵצֵ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃

lines.text: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.
Let them be ashamed and confounded Who are seeking my soul, Let them be turned backward and blush Who are desiring my evil.

70.he: יָ֭שׁוּבוּ עַל־עֵ֣קֶב בָּשְׁתָּ֑ם הָ֝אֹמְרִ֗ים הֶ֘אָ֥ח ׀ הֶאָֽח׃

lines.text: Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”
Let them turn back because of their shame, Who are saying, 'Aha, aha.'

70.he: יָ֘שִׂ֤ישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ ׀ בְּךָ֗ כָּֽל־מְבַ֫קְשֶׁ֥יךָ וְיֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֹ֝הֲבֵ֗י יְשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”
Let all those seeking Thee joy and be glad in Thee, And let those loving Thy salvation Say continually, 'God is magnified.'

70.he: וַאֲנִ֤י ׀ עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְיוֹן֮ אֱלֹהִ֪ים חֽוּשָׁ֫ה־לִּ֥י עֶזְרִ֣י וּמְפַלְטִ֣י אַ֑תָּה יְ֝הוָ֗ה אַל־תְּאַחַֽר׃

lines.text: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. Yahweh, don’t delay.
And I [am] poor and needy, O God, haste to me, My help and my deliverer [art] Thou, O Jehovah, tarry Thou not!

71.he: בְּךָֽ־יְהוָ֥ה חָסִ֑יתִי אַל־אֵב֥וֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָֽם׃

lines.text: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.
In Thee, O Jehovah, I have trusted, Let me not be ashamed to the age.

71.he: בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֗ תַּצִּילֵ֥נִי וּֽתְפַלְּטֵ֑נִי הַטֵּֽה־אֵלַ֥י אָ֝זְנְךָ֗ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.
In Thy righteousness Thou dost deliver me, And dost cause me to escape, Incline unto me Thine ear, and save me.

71.he: הֱיֵ֤ה לִ֨י ׀ לְצ֥וּר מָע֡וֹן לָב֗וֹא תָּמִ֗יד צִוִּ֥יתָ לְהוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי כִּֽי־סַלְעִ֖י וּמְצוּדָתִ֣י אָֽתָּה׃

lines.text: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
Be to me for a rock — a habitation, To go in continually, Thou hast given command to save me, For my rock and my bulwark [art] Thou.

71.he: אֱֽלֹהַ֗י פַּ֭לְּטֵנִי מִיַּ֣ד רָשָׁ֑ע מִכַּ֖ף מְעַוֵּ֣ל וְחוֹמֵץ׃

lines.text: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
O my God, cause me to escape From the hand of the wicked, From the hand of the perverse and violent.

71.he: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֥ה תִקְוָתִ֑י אֲדֹנָ֥י יְ֝הוִ֗ה מִבְטַחִ֥י מִנְּעוּרָֽי׃

lines.text: For you are my hope, Lord Yahweh, my confidence from my youth.
For Thou [art] my hope, O Lord Jehovah, My trust from my youth.

71.he: עָלֶ֤יךָ ׀ נִסְמַ֬כְתִּי מִבֶּ֗טֶן מִמְּעֵ֣י אִ֭מִּי אַתָּ֣ה גוֹזִ֑י בְּךָ֖ תְהִלָּתִ֣י תָמִֽיד׃

lines.text: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.
By Thee I have been supported from the womb, From my mother's bowels Thou dost cut me out, In Thee [is] my praise continually.

71.he: כְּ֭מוֹפֵת הָיִ֣יתִי לְרַבִּ֑ים וְ֝אַתָּ֗ה מַֽחֲסִי־עֹֽז׃

lines.text: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.
As a wonder I have been to many, And Thou [art] my strong refuge.

71.he: יִמָּ֣לֵא פִ֭י תְּהִלָּתֶ֑ךָ כָּל־הַ֝יּ֗וֹם תִּפְאַרְתֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.
Filled is my mouth [with] Thy praise, All the day [with] Thy beauty.

71.he: אַֽל־תַּ֭שְׁלִיכֵנִי לְעֵ֣ת זִקְנָ֑ה כִּכְל֥וֹת כֹּ֝חִ֗י אַֽל־תַּעַזְבֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.
Cast me not off at the time of old age, According to the consumption of my power forsake me not.

71.he: כִּֽי־אָמְר֣וּ אוֹיְבַ֣י לִ֑י וְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י נוֹעֲצ֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו׃

lines.text: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,
For mine enemies have spoken against me, And those watching my soul have taken counsel together,

71.he: לֵ֭אמֹר אֱלֹהִ֣ים עֲזָב֑וֹ רִֽדְפ֥וּ וְ֝תִפְשֻׂ֗וּהוּ כִּי־אֵ֥ין מַצִּֽיל׃

lines.text: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”
Saying, 'God hath forsaken him, Pursue and catch him, for there is no deliverer.'

71.he: אֱ֭לֹהִים אַל־תִּרְחַ֣ק מִמֶּ֑נִּי אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חישה׃

lines.text: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.
O God, be not far from me, O my God, for my help make haste.

71.he: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ יִכְלוּ֮ שֹׂטְנֵ֪י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יַֽעֲט֣וּ חֶ֭רְפָּה וּכְלִמָּ֑ה מְ֝בַקְשֵׁ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃

lines.text: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.
They are ashamed, they are consumed, Who are opposing my soul, They are covered [with] reproach and blushing, Who are seeking my evil,

71.he: וַ֭אֲנִי תָּמִ֣יד אֲיַחֵ֑ל וְ֝הוֹסַפְתִּ֗י עַל־כָּל־תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.
And I continually do wait with hope, And have added unto all Thy praise.

71.he: פִּ֤י ׀ יְסַפֵּ֬ר צִדְקָתֶ֗ךָ כָּל־הַיּ֥וֹם תְּשׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י לֹ֖א יָדַ֣עְתִּי סְפֹרֽוֹת׃

lines.text: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.
My mouth recounteth Thy righteousness, All the day Thy salvation, For I have not known the numbers.

71.he: אָב֗וֹא בִּ֭גְבֻרוֹת אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה אַזְכִּ֖יר צִדְקָתְךָ֣ לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Yahweh. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.
I come in the might of the Lord Jehovah, I mention Thy righteousness — Thine only.

71.he: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים לִמַּדְתַּ֥נִי מִנְּעוּרָ֑י וְעַד־הֵ֝֗נָּה אַגִּ֥יד נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.
God, Thou hast taught me from my youth, And hitherto I declare Thy wonders.

71.he: וְגַ֤ם עַד־זִקְנָ֨ה ׀ וְשֵׂיבָה֮ אֱלֹהִ֪ים אַֽל־תַּעַ֫זְבֵ֥נִי עַד־אַגִּ֣יד זְרוֹעֲךָ֣ לְד֑וֹר לְכָל־יָ֝ב֗וֹא גְּבוּרָתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.
And also unto old age and grey hairs, O God, forsake me not, Till I declare Thy strength to a generation, To every one that cometh Thy might.

71.he: וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ אֱלֹהִ֗ים עַד־מָ֫ר֥וֹם אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂ֥יתָ גְדֹל֑וֹת אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים מִ֣י כָמֽוֹךָ׃

lines.text: Your righteousness also, God, reaches to the heavens; you have done great things. God, who is like you?
And Thy righteousness, O God, [is] unto the heights, Because Thou hast done great things, O God, who [is] like Thee?

71.he: אֲשֶׁ֤ר הראיתנו ׀ צָר֥וֹת רַבּ֗וֹת וְרָ֫ע֥וֹת תָּשׁ֥וּב תחיינו וּֽמִתְּהֹמ֥וֹת הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ תָּשׁ֥וּב תַּעֲלֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.
Because Thou hast showed me many and sad distresses, Thou turnest back — Thou revivest me, And from the depths of the earth, Thou turnest back — Thou bringest me up.

71.he: תֶּ֤רֶב ׀ גְּֽדֻלָּתִ֗י וְתִסֹּ֥ב תְּֽנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: Increase my honor and comfort me again.
Thou dost increase my greatness, And Thou surroundest — Thou comfortest me,

71.he: גַּם־אֲנִ֤י ׀ אוֹדְךָ֣ בִכְלִי־נֶבֶל֮ אֲמִתְּךָ֪ אֱלֹ֫הָ֥י אֲזַמְּרָ֣ה לְךָ֣ בְכִנּ֑וֹר קְ֝ד֗וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

lines.text: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.
I also thank Thee with a vessel of psaltery, Thy truth, O my God, I sing to Thee with a harp, O Holy One of Israel,

71.he: תְּרַנֵּ֣נָּ֣ה שְׂ֭פָתַי כִּ֣י אֲזַמְּרָה־לָּ֑ךְ וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּדִֽיתָ׃

lines.text: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!
My lips cry aloud when I sing praise to Thee, And my soul that Thou hast redeemed,

71.he: גַּם־לְשׁוֹנִ֗י כָּל־הַ֭יּוֹם תֶּהְגֶּ֣ה צִדְקָתֶ֑ךָ כִּי־בֹ֥שׁוּ כִֽי־חָ֝פְר֗וּ מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י רָעָתִֽי׃

lines.text: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.
My tongue also all the day uttereth Thy righteousness, Because ashamed — because confounded, Have been those seeking my evil!

72.he: לִשְׁלֹמֹ֨ה ׀ אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶיךָ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ תֵּ֑ן וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ לְבֶן־מֶֽלֶךְ׃

lines.text: God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.
By Solomon. O God, Thy judgments to the king give, And Thy righteousness to the king's son.

72.he: יָדִ֣ין עַמְּךָ֣ בְצֶ֑דֶק וַעֲנִיֶּ֥יךָ בְמִשְׁפָּֽט׃

lines.text: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.
He judgeth Thy people with righteousness, And Thy poor with judgment.

72.he: יִשְׂא֤וּ הָרִ֓ים שָׁ֘ל֥וֹם לָעָ֑ם וּ֝גְבָע֗וֹת בִּצְדָקָֽה׃

lines.text: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.
The mountains bear peace to the people, And the heights by righteousness.

72.he: יִשְׁפֹּ֤ט ׀ עֲֽנִיֵּי־עָ֗ם י֭וֹשִׁיעַ לִבְנֵ֣י אֶבְי֑וֹן וִ֖ידַכֵּ֣א עוֹשֵֽׁק׃

lines.text: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.
He judgeth the poor of the people, Giveth deliverance to the sons of the needy, And bruiseth the oppressor.

72.he: יִֽירָא֥וּךָ עִם־שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וְלִפְנֵ֥י יָ֝רֵ֗חַ דּ֣וֹר דּוֹרִֽים׃

lines.text: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.
They fear Thee with the sun, and before the moon, Generation — generations.

72.he: יֵ֭רֵד כְּמָטָ֣ר עַל־גֵּ֑ז כִּ֝רְבִיבִ֗ים זַרְזִ֥יף אָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.
He cometh down as rain on mown grass, As showers — sprinkling the earth.

72.he: יִֽפְרַח־בְּיָמָ֥יו צַדִּ֑יק וְרֹ֥ב שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם עַד־בְּלִ֥י יָרֵֽחַ׃

lines.text: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.
Flourish in his days doth the righteous, And abundance of peace till the moon is not.

72.he: וְ֭יֵרְדְּ מִיָּ֣ם עַד־יָ֑ם וּ֝מִנָּהָ֗ר עַד־אַפְסֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.
And he ruleth from sea unto sea, And from the river unto the ends of earth.

72.he: לְ֭פָנָיו יִכְרְע֣וּ צִיִּ֑ים וְ֝אֹיְבָ֗יו עָפָ֥ר יְלַחֵֽכוּ׃

lines.text: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.
Before him bow do the inhabitants of the dry places, And his enemies lick the dust.

72.he: מַלְכֵ֬י תַרְשִׁ֣ישׁ וְ֭אִיִּים מִנְחָ֣ה יָשִׁ֑יבוּ מַלְכֵ֥י שְׁבָ֥א וּ֝סְבָ֗א אֶשְׁכָּ֥ר יַקְרִֽיבוּ׃

lines.text: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
Kings of Tarshish and of the isles send back a present. Kings of Sheba and Seba a reward bring near.

72.he: וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ־ל֥וֹ כָל־מְלָכִ֑ים כָּל־גּוֹיִ֥ם יַֽעַבְדֽוּהוּ׃

lines.text: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.
And all kings do bow themselves to him, All nations do serve him,

72.he: כִּֽי־יַ֭צִּיל אֶבְי֣וֹן מְשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וְ֝עָנִ֗י וְֽאֵין־עֹזֵ֥ר לֽוֹ׃

lines.text: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.
For he delivereth the needy who crieth, And the poor when he hath no helper,

72.he: יָ֭חֹס עַל־דַּ֣ל וְאֶבְי֑וֹן וְנַפְשׁ֖וֹת אֶבְיוֹנִ֣ים יוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃

lines.text: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.
He hath pity on the poor and needy, And the souls of the needy he saveth,

72.he: מִתּ֣וֹךְ וּ֭מֵחָמָס יִגְאַ֣ל נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְיֵיקַ֖ר דָּמָ֣ם בְּעֵינָֽיו׃

lines.text: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.
From fraud and from violence he redeemeth their soul, And precious is their blood in his eyes.

72.he: וִיחִ֗י וְיִתֶּן־לוֹ֮ מִזְּהַ֪ב שְׁ֫בָ֥א וְיִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל בַּעֲד֣וֹ תָמִ֑יד כָּל־הַ֝יּ֗וֹם יְבָרֲכֶֽנְהֽוּ׃

lines.text: They shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba. Men shall pray for him continually. They shall bless him all day long.
And he liveth, and giveth to him of the gold of Sheba, And prayeth for him continually, All the day he doth bless him.

72.he: יְהִ֤י פִסַּת־בַּ֨ר ׀ בָּאָרֶץ֮ בְּרֹ֪אשׁ הָ֫רִ֥ים יִרְעַ֣שׁ כַּלְּבָנ֣וֹן פִּרְי֑וֹ וְיָצִ֥יצוּ מֵ֝עִ֗יר כְּעֵ֣שֶׂב הָאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.
There is a handful of corn in the earth, On the top of mountains, Shake like Lebanon doth its fruit, And they flourish out of the city as the herb of the earth.

72.he: יְהִ֤י שְׁמ֨וֹ לְֽעוֹלָ֗ם לִפְנֵי־שֶׁמֶשׁ֮ ינין שְׁ֫מ֥וֹ וְיִתְבָּ֥רְכוּ ב֑וֹ כָּל־גּוֹיִ֥ם יְאַשְּׁרֽוּהוּ׃

lines.text: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.
His name is to the age, Before the sun is his name continued, And they bless themselves in him, All nations do pronounce him happy.

72.he: בָּר֤וּךְ ׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עֹשֵׂ֖ה נִפְלָא֣וֹת לְבַדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Praise be to Yahweh God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
Blessed is Jehovah God, God of Israel, He alone is doing wonders,

72.he: וּבָר֤וּךְ ׀ שֵׁ֥ם כְּבוֹד֗וֹ לְע֫וֹלָ֥ם וְיִמָּלֵ֣א כְ֭בוֹדוֹ אֶת־כֹּ֥ל הָאָ֗רֶץ אָ֘מֵ֥ן ׀ וְאָמֵֽן׃

lines.text: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.
And blessed [is] the Name of His honour to the age, And the whole earth is filled [with] His honour. Amen, and amen!

72.he: כָּלּ֥וּ תְפִלּ֑וֹת דָּ֝וִ֗ד בֶּן־יִשָֽׁי׃

lines.text: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.
The prayers of David son of Jesse have been ended.

73.he: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אַ֤ךְ ט֖וֹב לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אֱלֹהִ֗ים לְבָרֵ֥י לֵבָֽב׃

lines.text: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
A Psalm of Asaph. Only — good to Israel [is] God, to the clean of heart. And I — as a little thing, My feet have been turned aside,

73.he: וַאֲנִ֗י כִּ֭מְעַט נטוי רַגְלָ֑י כְּ֝אַ֗יִן שפכה אֲשֻׁרָֽי׃

lines.text: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.
As nothing, have my steps slipped, For I have been envious of the boastful,

73.he: כִּֽי־קִ֭נֵּאתִי בַּֽהוֹלְלִ֑ים שְׁל֖וֹם רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֶרְאֶֽה׃

lines.text: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
The peace of the wicked I see, That there are no bands at their death,

73.he: כִּ֤י אֵ֖ין חַרְצֻבּ֥וֹת לְמוֹתָ֗ם וּבָרִ֥יא אוּלָֽם׃

lines.text: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.
And their might [is] firm.

73.he: בַּעֲמַ֣ל אֱנ֣וֹשׁ אֵינֵ֑מוֹ וְעִם־אָ֝דָ֗ם לֹ֣א יְנֻגָּֽעוּ׃

lines.text: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.
In the misery of mortals they are not, And with common men they are not plagued.

73.he: לָ֭כֵן עֲנָקַ֣תְמוֹ גַאֲוָ֑ה יַעֲטָף־שִׁ֝֗ית חָמָ֥ס לָֽמוֹ׃

lines.text: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.
Therefore hath pride encircled them, Violence covereth them as a dress.

73.he: יָ֭צָא מֵחֵ֣לֶב עֵינֵ֑מוֹ עָ֝בְר֗וּ מַשְׂכִּיּ֥וֹת לֵבָֽב׃

lines.text: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.
Their eye hath come out from fat. The imaginations of the heart transgressed;

73.he: יָמִ֤יקוּ ׀ וִידַבְּר֣וּ בְרָ֣ע עֹ֑שֶׁק מִמָּר֥וֹם יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃

lines.text: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.
They do corruptly, And they speak in the wickedness of oppression, From on high they speak.

73.he: שַׁתּ֣וּ בַשָּׁמַ֣יִם פִּיהֶ֑ם וּ֝לְשׁוֹנָ֗ם תִּֽהֲלַ֥ךְ בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.
They have set in the heavens their mouth, And their tongue walketh in the earth.

73.he: לָכֵ֤ן ׀ ישיב עַמּ֣וֹ הֲלֹ֑ם וּמֵ֥י מָ֝לֵ֗א יִמָּ֥צוּ לָֽמוֹ׃
