lines.text: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.
Therefore do His people return hither, And waters of fulness are wrung out to them.

73.he: וְֽאָמְר֗וּ אֵיכָ֥ה יָדַֽע־אֵ֑ל וְיֵ֖שׁ דֵּעָ֣ה בְעֶלְיֽוֹן׃

lines.text: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”
And they have said, 'How hath God known? And is there knowledge in the Most High?'

73.he: הִנֵּה־אֵ֥לֶּה רְשָׁעִ֑ים וְשַׁלְוֵ֥י ע֝וֹלָ֗ם הִשְׂגּוּ־חָֽיִל׃

lines.text: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.
Lo, these [are] the wicked and easy ones of the age, They have increased strength.

73.he: אַךְ־רִ֭יק זִכִּ֣יתִי לְבָבִ֑י וָאֶרְחַ֖ץ בְּנִקָּי֣וֹן כַּפָּֽי׃

lines.text: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,
Only — a vain thing! I have purified my heart, And I wash in innocency my hands,

73.he: וָאֱהִ֣י נָ֭גוּעַ כָּל־הַיּ֑וֹם וְ֝תוֹכַחְתִּ֗י לַבְּקָרִֽים׃

lines.text: For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.
And I am plagued all the day, And my reproof [is] every morning.

73.he: אִם־אָ֭מַרְתִּי אֲסַפְּרָ֥ה כְמ֑וֹ הִנֵּ֤ה ד֭וֹר בָּנֶ֣יךָ בָגָֽדְתִּי׃

lines.text: If I had said, “I will speak thus”; behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.
If I have said, 'I recount thus,' Lo, a generation of Thy sons I have deceived.

73.he: וָֽ֭אֲחַשְּׁבָה לָדַ֣עַת זֹ֑את עָמָ֖ל היא בְעֵינָֽי׃

lines.text: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me,
And I think to know this, Perverseness it [is] in mine eyes,

73.he: עַד־אָ֭בוֹא אֶל־מִקְדְּשֵׁי־אֵ֑ל אָ֝בִ֗ינָה לְאַחֲרִיתָֽם׃

lines.text: until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.
Till I come in to the sanctuaries of God, I attend to their latter end.

73.he: אַ֣ךְ בַּ֭חֲלָקוֹת תָּשִׁ֣ית לָ֑מוֹ הִ֝פַּלְתָּ֗ם לְמַשּׁוּאֽוֹת׃

lines.text: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
Only, in slippery places Thou dost set them, Thou hast caused them to fall to desolations.

73.he: אֵ֤יךְ הָי֣וּ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה כְרָ֑גַע סָ֥פוּ תַ֝֗מּוּ מִן־בַּלָּהֽוֹת׃

lines.text: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.
How have they become a desolation as in a moment, They have been ended — consumed from terrors.

73.he: כַּחֲל֥וֹם מֵהָקִ֑יץ אֲ֝דֹנָי בָּעִ֤יר ׀ צַלְמָ֬ם תִּבְזֶֽה׃

lines.text: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.
As a dream from awakening, O Lord, In awaking, their image Thou despisest.

73.he: כִּ֭י יִתְחַמֵּ֣ץ לְבָבִ֑י וְ֝כִלְיוֹתַ֗י אֶשְׁתּוֹנָֽן׃

lines.text: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.
For my heart doth show itself violent, And my reins prick themselves,

73.he: וַאֲנִי־בַ֭עַר וְלֹ֣א אֵדָ֑ע בְּ֝הֵמ֗וֹת הָיִ֥יתִי עִמָּֽךְ׃

lines.text: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.
And I am brutish, and do not know. A beast I have been with Thee.

73.he: וַאֲנִ֣י תָמִ֣יד עִמָּ֑ךְ אָ֝חַ֗זְתָּ בְּיַד־יְמִינִֽי׃

lines.text: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.
And I [am] continually with Thee, Thou hast laid hold on my right hand.

73.he: בַּעֲצָתְךָ֥ תַנְחֵ֑נִי וְ֝אַחַ֗ר כָּב֥וֹד תִּקָּחֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
With Thy counsel Thou dost lead me, And after honour dost receive me.

73.he: מִי־לִ֥י בַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ֝עִמְּךָ֗ לֹא־חָפַ֥צְתִּי בָאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.
Whom have I in the heavens? And with Thee none I have desired in earth.

73.he: כָּלָ֥ה שְׁאֵרִ֗י וּלְבָ֫בִ֥י צוּר־לְבָבִ֥י וְחֶלְקִ֗י אֱלֹהִ֥ים לְעוֹלָֽם׃

lines.text: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
Consumed hath been my flesh and my heart, The rock of my heart and my portion [is] God to the age.

73.he: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֣ה רְחֵקֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ הִ֝צְמַ֗תָּה כָּל־זוֹנֶ֥ה מִמֶּֽךָּ׃

lines.text: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.
For, lo, those far from Thee do perish, Thou hast cut off every one, Who is going a whoring from Thee.

73.he: וַאֲנִ֤י ׀ קִֽרֲבַ֥ת אֱלֹהִ֗ים לִ֫י־ט֥וֹב שַׁתִּ֤י ׀ בַּאדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֣ה מַחְסִ֑י לְ֝סַפֵּ֗ר כָּל־מַלְאֲכוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord Yahweh my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.
And I — nearness of God to me [is] good, I have placed in the Lord Jehovah my refuge, To recount all Thy works!

74.he: מַשְׂכִּ֗יל לְאָ֫סָ֥ף לָמָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים זָנַ֣חְתָּ לָנֶ֑צַח יֶעְשַׁ֥ן אַ֝פְּךָ֗ בְּצֹ֣אן מַרְעִיתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
An Instruction of Asaph. Why, O God, hast Thou cast off for ever? Thine anger smoketh against the flock of Thy pasture.

74.he: זְכֹ֤ר עֲדָתְךָ֨ ׀ קָ֘נִ֤יתָ קֶּ֗דֶם גָּ֭אַלְתָּ שֵׁ֣בֶט נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ הַר־צִ֝יּ֗וֹן זֶ֤ה ׀ שָׁכַ֬נְתָּ בּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance: Mount Zion, in which you have lived.
Remember Thy company. Thou didst purchase of old, Thou didst redeem the rod of Thy inheritance, This mount Zion — Thou didst dwell in it.

74.he: הָרִ֣ימָה פְ֭עָמֶיךָ לְמַשֻּׁא֣וֹת נֶ֑צַח כָּל־הֵרַ֖ע אוֹיֵ֣ב בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

lines.text: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.
Lift up Thy steps to the perpetual desolations, Everything the enemy did wickedly in the sanctuary.

74.he: שָׁאֲג֣וּ צֹ֭רְרֶיךָ בְּקֶ֣רֶב מוֹעֲדֶ֑ךָ שָׂ֖מוּ אוֹתֹתָ֣ם אֹתֽוֹת׃

lines.text: Your adversaries have roared in the middle of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.
Roared have thine adversaries, In the midst of Thy meeting-places, They have set their ensigns as ensigns.

74.he: יִ֭וָּדַע כְּמֵבִ֣יא לְמָ֑עְלָה בִּֽסֲבָךְ־עֵ֝֗ץ קַרְדֻּמּֽוֹת׃

lines.text: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.
He is known as one bringing in on high Against a thicket of wood — axes.

74.he: ועת פִּתּוּחֶ֣יהָ יָּ֑חַד בְּכַשִּׁ֥יל וְ֝כֵֽילַפֹּ֗ת יַהֲלֹמֽוּן׃

lines.text: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.
And now, its carvings together With axe and hatchet they break down,

74.he: שִׁלְח֣וּ בָ֭אֵשׁ מִקְדָּשֶׁ֑ךָ לָ֝אָ֗רֶץ חִלְּל֥וּ מִֽשְׁכַּן־שְׁמֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.
They have sent into fire Thy sanctuary, to the earth they polluted the tabernacle of Thy name,

74.he: אָמְר֣וּ בְ֭לִבָּם נִינָ֣ם יָ֑חַד שָׂרְפ֖וּ כָל־מוֹעֲדֵי־אֵ֣ל בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.
They said in their hearts, 'Let us oppress them together,' They did burn all the meeting-places of God in the land.

74.he: אֽוֹתֹתֵ֗ינוּ לֹ֥א רָ֫אִ֥ינוּ אֵֽין־ע֥וֹד נָבִ֑יא וְלֹֽא־אִ֝תָּ֗נוּ יֹדֵ֥עַ עַד־מָֽה׃

lines.text: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.
Our ensigns we have not seen, There is no more a prophet, Nor with us is one knowing how long.

74.he: עַד־מָתַ֣י אֱ֭לֹהִים יְחָ֣רֶף צָ֑ר יְנָ֘אֵ֤ץ אוֹיֵ֖ב שִׁמְךָ֣ לָנֶֽצַח׃

lines.text: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?
Till when, O God, doth an adversary reproach? Doth an enemy despise thy name for ever?

74.he: לָ֤מָּה תָשִׁ֣יב יָ֭דְךָ וִֽימִינֶ֑ךָ מִקֶּ֖רֶב חוקך כַלֵּֽה׃

lines.text: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!
Why dost Thou turn back Thy hand, Even Thy right hand? From the midst of Thy bosom remove [it].

74.he: וֵ֭אלֹהִים מַלְכִּ֣י מִקֶּ֑דֶם פֹּעֵ֥ל יְ֝שׁוּע֗וֹת בְּקֶ֣רֶב הָאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation throughout the earth.
And God [is] my king of old, Working salvation in the midst of the earth.

74.he: אַתָּ֤ה פוֹרַ֣רְתָּ בְעָזְּךָ֣ יָ֑ם שִׁבַּ֖רְתָּ רָאשֵׁ֥י תַ֝נִּינִ֗ים עַל־הַמָּֽיִם׃

lines.text: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.
Thou hast broken by Thy strength a sea -[monster], Thou hast shivered Heads of dragons by the waters,

74.he: אַתָּ֣ה רִ֭צַּצְתָּ רָאשֵׁ֣י לִוְיָתָ֑ן תִּתְּנֶ֥נּוּ מַ֝אֲכָ֗ל לְעָ֣ם לְצִיִּֽים׃

lines.text: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.
Thou hast broken the heads of leviathan, Thou makest him food, For the people of the dry places.

74.he: אַתָּ֣ה בָ֭קַעְתָּ מַעְיָ֣ן וָנָ֑חַל אַתָּ֥ה ה֝וֹבַ֗שְׁתָּ נַהֲר֥וֹת אֵיתָֽן׃

lines.text: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.
Thou hast cleaved a fountain and a stream, Thou hast dried up perennial flowings.

74.he: לְךָ֣ י֭וֹם אַף־לְךָ֥ לָ֑יְלָה אַתָּ֥ה הֲ֝כִינ֗וֹתָ מָא֥וֹר וָשָֽׁמֶשׁ׃

lines.text: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.
Thine [is] the day, also Thine [is] the night, Thou hast prepared a light giver — the sun.

74.he: אַתָּ֣ה הִ֭צַּבְתָּ כָּל־גְּבוּל֣וֹת אָ֑רֶץ קַ֥יִץ וָ֝חֹ֗רֶף אַתָּ֥ה יְצַרְתָּם׃

lines.text: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.
Thou hast set up all the borders of earth, Summer and winter Thou hast formed them.

74.he: זְכָר־זֹ֗את א֭וֹיֵב חֵרֵ֣ף ׀ יְהוָ֑ה וְעַ֥ם נָ֝בָ֗ל נִֽאֲצ֥וּ שְׁמֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, Yahweh. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.
Remember this — an enemy reproached Jehovah, And a foolish people have despised Thy name.

74.he: אַל־תִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭חַיַּת נֶ֣פֶשׁ תּוֹרֶ֑ךָ חַיַּ֥ת עֲ֝נִיֶּ֗יךָ אַל־תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח לָנֶֽצַח׃

lines.text: Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.
Give not up to a company, The soul of Thy turtle-dove, The company of Thy poor ones forget not for ever.

74.he: הַבֵּ֥ט לַבְּרִ֑ית כִּ֥י מָלְא֥וּ מַחֲשַׁכֵּי־אֶ֝֗רֶץ נְא֣וֹת חָמָֽס׃

lines.text: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.
Look attentively to the covenant, For the dark places of earth, Have been full of habitations of violence.

74.he: אַל־יָשֹׁ֣ב דַּ֣ךְ נִכְלָ֑ם עָנִ֥י וְ֝אֶבְי֗וֹן יְֽהַלְל֥וּ שְׁמֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.
Let not the oppressed turn back ashamed, Let the poor and needy praise Thy name,

74.he: קוּמָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים רִיבָ֣ה רִיבֶ֑ךָ זְכֹ֥ר חֶרְפָּתְךָ֥ מִנִּי־נָ֝בָ֗ל כָּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃

lines.text: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.
Arise, O God, plead Thy plea, Remember Thy reproach from a fool all the day.

74.he: אַל־תִּ֭שְׁכַּח ק֣וֹל צֹרְרֶ֑יךָ שְׁא֥וֹן קָ֝מֶ֗יךָ עֹלֶ֥ה תָמִֽיד׃

lines.text: Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.
Forget not the voice of Thine adversaries, The noise of Thy withstanders is going up continually!
To the Overseer. — 'Destroy not.' — A Psalm of Asaph. — A Song. We have given thanks to Thee, O God, We have given thanks, and near [is] Thy name, They have recounted Thy wonders.

75.he: ה֘וֹדִ֤ינּוּ לְּךָ֨ ׀ אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים ה֭וֹדִינוּ וְקָר֣וֹב שְׁמֶ֑ךָ סִ֝פְּר֗וּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.
To the Overseer. — 'Destroy not.' — A Psalm of Asaph. — A Song. We have given thanks to Thee, O God, We have given thanks, and near [is] Thy name, They have recounted Thy wonders.

75.he: כִּ֭י אֶקַּ֣ח מוֹעֵ֑ד אֲ֝נִ֗י מֵישָׁרִ֥ים אֶשְׁפֹּֽט׃

lines.text: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.
When I receive an appointment, I — I do judge uprightly.

75.he: נְֽמֹגִ֗ים אֶ֥רֶץ וְכָל־יֹשְׁבֶ֑יהָ אָנֹכִ֨י תִכַּ֖נְתִּי עַמּוּדֶ֣יהָ סֶּֽלָה׃

lines.text: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars.
Melted is the earth and all its inhabitants, I — I have pondered its pillars. Selah.

75.he: אָמַ֣רְתִּי לַֽ֭הוֹלְלִים אַל־תָּהֹ֑לּוּ וְ֝לָרְשָׁעִ֗ים אַל־תָּרִ֥ימוּ קָֽרֶן׃

lines.text: I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.
I have said to the boastful, 'Be not boastful,' And to the wicked, 'Raise not up a horn.'

75.he: אַל־תָּרִ֣ימוּ לַמָּר֣וֹם קַרְנְכֶ֑ם תְּדַבְּר֖וּ בְצַוָּ֣אר עָתָֽק׃

lines.text: Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”
Raise not up on high your horn, (Ye speak with a stiff neck.)

75.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א מִ֭מּוֹצָא וּמִֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב וְ֝לֹ֗א מִמִּדְבַּ֥ר הָרִֽים׃

lines.text: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.
For not from the east, or from the west, Nor from the wilderness — [is] elevation.

75.he: כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֥ים שֹׁפֵ֑ט זֶ֥ה יַ֝שְׁפִּ֗יל וְזֶ֣ה יָרִֽים׃

lines.text: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.
But God [is] judge, This He maketh low — and this He lifteth up.

75.he: כִּ֤י כ֪וֹס בְּֽיַד־יְהוָ֡ה וְיַ֤יִן חָמַ֨ר ׀ מָ֥לֵא מֶסֶךְ֮ וַיַּגֵּ֪ר מִ֫זֶּ֥ה אַךְ־שְׁ֭מָרֶיהָ יִמְצ֣וּ יִשְׁתּ֑וּ כֹּ֝֗ל רִשְׁעֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: For in Yahweh’s hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.
For a cup [is] in the hand of Jehovah, And the wine hath foamed, It is full of mixture, and He poureth out of it, Only its dregs wring out, and drink, Do all the wicked of the earth,

75.he: וַ֭אֲנִי אַגִּ֣יד לְעֹלָ֑ם אֲ֝זַמְּרָ֗ה לֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃

lines.text: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
And I — I declare [it] to the age, I sing praise to the God of Jacob.

75.he: וְכָל־קַרְנֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֲגַדֵּ֑עַ תְּ֝רוֹמַ֗מְנָה קַֽרְנ֥וֹת צַדִּֽיק׃

lines.text: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
And all horns of the wicked I cut off, Exalted are the horns of the righteous!
To the Overseer with stringed instruments. — A Psalm of Asaph. — A Song. In Judah [is] God known, in Israel His name [is] great.

76.he: נוֹדָ֣ע בִּֽיהוּדָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל גָּד֥וֹל שְׁמֽוֹ׃

lines.text: In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.
To the Overseer with stringed instruments. — A Psalm of Asaph. — A Song. In Judah [is] God known, in Israel His name [is] great.
His tabernacle is also in Salem; His dwelling place in Zion.
And His tabernacle is in Salem, And His habitation in Zion.

76.he: שָׁ֭מָּה שִׁבַּ֣ר רִשְׁפֵי־קָ֑שֶׁת מָגֵ֬ן וְחֶ֖רֶב וּמִלְחָמָ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war.
There he hath shivered arrows of a bow, Shield, and sword, and battle. Selah.
Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.
Bright [art] Thou, honourable above hills of prey.

76.he: אֶשְׁתּוֹלְל֨וּ ׀ אַבִּ֣ירֵי לֵ֭ב נָמ֣וּ שְׁנָתָ֑ם וְלֹא־מָצְא֖וּ כָל־אַנְשֵׁי־חַ֣יִל יְדֵיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.
Spoiled themselves have the mighty of heart, They have slept their sleep, And none of the men of might found their hands.

76.he: מִ֭גַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֑ב נִ֝רְדָּ֗ם וְרֶ֣כֶב וָסֽוּס׃

lines.text: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
From Thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, Both rider and horse have been fast asleep.

76.he: אַתָּ֤ה ׀ נ֥וֹרָא אַ֗תָּה וּמִֽי־יַעֲמֹ֥ד לְפָנֶ֗יךָ מֵאָ֥ז אַפֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?
Thou, fearful [art] Thou, And who doth stand before Thee, Since Thou hast been angry!

76.he: מִ֭שָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁמַ֣עְתָּ דִּ֑ין אֶ֖רֶץ יָֽרְאָ֣ה וְשָׁקָֽטָה׃

lines.text: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,
From heaven Thou hast sounded judgment, Earth hath feared, and hath been still,
when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth.
In the rising of God to judgment, To save all the humble of earth. Selah.

76.he: כִּֽי־חֲמַ֣ת אָדָ֣ם תּוֹדֶ֑ךָּ שְׁאֵרִ֖ית חֵמֹ֣ת תַּחְגֹּֽר׃

lines.text: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.
For the fierceness of man praiseth Thee, The remnant of fierceness Thou girdest on.

76.he: נִֽדֲר֣וּ וְשַׁלְּמוּ֮ לַיהוָ֪ה אֱֽלֹהֵ֫יכֶ֥ם כָּל־סְבִיבָ֑יו יוֹבִ֥ילוּ שַׁ֝֗י לַמּוֹרָֽא׃

lines.text: Make vows to Yahweh your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.
Vow and complete to Jehovah your God, All ye surrounding him. They bring presents to the Fearful One.
He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.
He doth gather the spirit of leaders, Fearful to the kings of earth!

77.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־ידיתון לְאָסָ֥ף מִזְמֽוֹר׃

lines.text: To the Overseer, for Jeduthun. — A Psalm of Asaph. My voice [is] to God, and I cry, my voice [is] to God, And He hath given ear unto me.

77.he: קוֹלִ֣י אֶל־אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְאֶצְעָ֑קָה קוֹלִ֥י אֶל־אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים וְהַאֲזִ֥ין אֵלָֽי׃

lines.text: My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.
To the Overseer, for Jeduthun. — A Psalm of Asaph. My voice [is] to God, and I cry, my voice [is] to God, And He hath given ear unto me.

77.he: בְּי֥וֹם צָרָתִי֮ אֲדֹנָ֪י דָּ֫רָ֥שְׁתִּי יָדִ֤י ׀ לַ֣יְלָה נִ֭גְּרָה וְלֹ֣א תָפ֑וּג מֵאֲנָ֖ה הִנָּחֵ֣ם נַפְשִֽׁי׃

lines.text: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.
In a day of my distress the Lord I sought, My hand by night hath been spread out, And it doth not cease, My soul hath refused to be comforted.

77.he: אֶזְכְּרָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְאֶֽהֱמָיָ֑ה אָשִׂ֓יחָה ׀ וְתִתְעַטֵּ֖ף רוּחִ֣י סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed.
I remember God, and make a noise, I meditate, and feeble is my spirit. Selah.

77.he: אָ֭חַזְתָּ שְׁמֻר֣וֹת עֵינָ֑י נִ֝פְעַ֗מְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אֲדַבֵּֽר׃

lines.text: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.
Thou hast taken hold of the watches of mine eyes, I have been moved, and I speak not.

77.he: חִשַּׁ֣בְתִּי יָמִ֣ים מִקֶּ֑דֶם שְׁ֝נ֗וֹת עוֹלָמִֽים׃

lines.text: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
I have reckoned the days of old, The years of the ages.

77.he: אֶֽזְכְּרָ֥ה נְגִינָתִ֗י בַּ֫לָּ֥יְלָה עִם־לְבָבִ֥י אָשִׂ֑יחָה וַיְחַפֵּ֥שׂ רוּחִֽי׃

lines.text: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:
I remember my music in the night, With my heart I meditate, and my spirit doth search diligently:

77.he: הַֽ֭לְעוֹלָמִים יִזְנַ֥ח ׀ אֲדֹנָ֑י וְלֹֽא־יֹסִ֖יף לִרְצ֣וֹת עֽוֹד׃

lines.text: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?
To the ages doth the Lord cast off? Doth He add to be pleased no more?

77.he: הֶאָפֵ֣ס לָנֶ֣צַח חַסְדּ֑וֹ גָּ֥מַר אֹ֝֗מֶר לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃

lines.text: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?
Hath His kindness ceased for ever? The saying failed to all generations?

77.he: הֲשָׁכַ֣ח חַנּ֣וֹת אֵ֑ל אִם־קָפַ֥ץ בְּ֝אַ֗ף רַחֲמָ֥יו סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?”
Hath God forgotten [His] favours? Hath He shut up in anger His mercies? Selah.

77.he: וָ֭אֹמַר חַלּ֣וֹתִי הִ֑יא שְׁ֝נ֗וֹת יְמִ֣ין עֶלְיֽוֹן׃

lines.text: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”
And I say: 'My weakness is, The changes of the right hand of the Most High.'

77.he: אזכיר מַֽעַלְלֵי־יָ֑הּ כִּֽי־אֶזְכְּרָ֖ה מִקֶּ֣דֶם פִּלְאֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: I will remember Yah’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.
I mention the doings of Jah, For I remember of old Thy wonders,

77.he: וְהָגִ֥יתִי בְכָל־פָּעֳלֶ֑ךָ וּֽבַעֲלִ֖ילוֹתֶ֣יךָ אָשִֽׂיחָה׃

lines.text: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.
And I have meditated on all Thy working, And I talk concerning Thy doings.

77.he: אֱ֭לֹהִים בַּקֹּ֣דֶשׁ דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ מִי־אֵ֥ל גָּ֝ד֗וֹל כֵּֽאלֹהִֽים׃

lines.text: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?
O God, in holiness [is] Thy way, Who [is] a great god like God?

77.he: אַתָּ֣ה הָ֭אֵל עֹ֣שֵׂה פֶ֑לֶא הוֹדַ֖עְתָּ בָעַמִּ֣ים עֻזֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.
Thou [art] the God doing wonders. Thou hast made known among the peoples Thy strength,

77.he: גָּאַ֣לְתָּ בִּזְר֣וֹעַ עַמֶּ֑ךָ בְּנֵי־יַעֲקֹ֖ב וְיוֹסֵ֣ף סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph.
Thou hast redeemed with strength Thy people, The sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

77.he: רָ֘א֤וּךָ מַּ֨יִם ׀ אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים רָא֣וּךָ מַּ֣יִם יָחִ֑ילוּ אַ֝֗ף יִרְגְּז֥וּ תְהֹמֽוֹת׃

lines.text: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.
The waters have seen Thee, O God, The waters have seen Thee, They are afraid — also depths are troubled.

77.he: זֹ֤רְמוּ מַ֨יִם ׀ עָב֗וֹת ק֭וֹל נָתְנ֣וּ שְׁחָקִ֑ים אַף־חֲ֝צָצֶ֗יךָ יִתְהַלָּֽכוּ׃

lines.text: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.
Poured out waters have thick clouds, The skies have given forth a noise, Also — Thine arrows go up and down.

77.he: ק֤וֹל רַעַמְךָ֨ ׀ בַּגַּלְגַּ֗ל הֵאִ֣ירוּ בְרָקִ֣ים תֵּבֵ֑ל רָגְזָ֖ה וַתִּרְעַ֣שׁ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.
The voice of Thy thunder [is] in the spheres, Lightnings have lightened the world, The earth hath trembled, yea, it shaketh.

77.he: בַּיָּ֤ם דַּרְכֶּ֗ךָ ושביליך בְּמַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝עִקְּבוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א נֹדָֽעוּ׃

lines.text: Your way was through the sea; your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.
In the sea [is] Thy way, And Thy paths [are] in many waters, And Thy tracks have not been known.

77.he: נָחִ֣יתָ כַצֹּ֣אן עַמֶּ֑ךָ בְּֽיַד־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאַהֲרֹֽן׃

lines.text: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
Thou hast led as a flock Thy people, By the hand of Moses and Aaron!

78.he: מַשְׂכִּ֗יל לְאָ֫סָ֥ף הַאֲזִ֣ינָה עַ֭מִּי תּוֹרָתִ֑י הַטּ֥וּ אָ֝זְנְכֶ֗ם לְאִמְרֵי־פִֽי׃

lines.text: Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.
An Instruction of Asaph. Give ear, O my people, to my law, Incline your ear to sayings of my mouth.

78.he: אֶפְתְּחָ֣ה בְמָשָׁ֣ל פִּ֑י אַבִּ֥יעָה חִ֝יד֗וֹת מִנִּי־קֶֽדֶם׃

lines.text: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,
I open with a simile my mouth, I bring forth hidden things of old,

78.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁ֭מַעְנוּ וַנֵּדָעֵ֑ם וַ֝אֲבוֹתֵ֗ינוּ סִפְּרוּ־לָֽנוּ׃

lines.text: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
That we have heard and do know, And our fathers have recounted to us.

78.he: לֹ֤א נְכַחֵ֨ד ׀ מִבְּנֵיהֶ֗ם לְד֥וֹר אַחֲר֗וֹן מְֽ֭סַפְּרִים תְּהִלּ֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה וֶעֱזוּז֥וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָֽׂה׃

lines.text: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of Yahweh, his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.
We do not hide from their sons, To a later generation recounting praises of Jehovah, And His strength, and His wonders that He hath done.

78.he: וַיָּ֤קֶם עֵד֨וּת ׀ בְּֽיַעֲקֹ֗ב וְתוֹרָה֮ שָׂ֤ם בְּיִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִ֭וָּה אֶת־אֲבוֹתֵ֑ינוּ לְ֝הוֹדִיעָ֗ם לִבְנֵיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: For he established a covenant in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;
And He raiseth up a testimony in Jacob, And a law hath placed in Israel, That He commanded our fathers, To make them known to their sons.

78.he: לְמַ֤עַן יֵדְע֨וּ ׀ דּ֣וֹר אַ֭חֲרוֹן בָּנִ֣ים יִוָּלֵ֑דוּ יָ֝קֻ֗מוּ וִֽיסַפְּר֥וּ לִבְנֵיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,
So that a later generation doth know, Sons who are born, do rise and recount to their sons,

78.he: וְיָשִׂ֥ימוּ בֵֽאלֹהִ֗ים כִּ֫סְלָ֥ם וְלֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁכְּחוּ מַֽעַלְלֵי־אֵ֑ל וּמִצְוֺתָ֥יו יִנְצֹֽרוּ׃

lines.text: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget God’s deeds, but keep his commandments,
And place in God their confidence, And forget not the doings of God, But keep His commands.

78.he: וְלֹ֤א יִהְי֨וּ ׀ כַּאֲבוֹתָ֗ם דּוֹר֮ סוֹרֵ֪ר וּמֹ֫רֶ֥ה דּ֭וֹר לֹא־הֵכִ֣ין לִבּ֑וֹ וְלֹא־נֶאֶמְנָ֖ה אֶת־אֵ֣ל רוּחֽוֹ׃

lines.text: and might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.
And they are not like their fathers, A generation apostate and rebellious, A generation! it hath not prepared its heart, Nor stedfast with God [is] its spirit.

78.he: בְּֽנֵי־אֶפְרַ֗יִם נוֹשְׁקֵ֥י רוֹמֵי־קָ֑שֶׁת הָ֝פְכ֗וּ בְּי֣וֹם קְרָֽב׃

lines.text: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
Sons of Ephraim — armed bearers of bow, Have turned in a day of conflict.

78.he: לֹ֣א שָׁ֭מְרוּ בְּרִ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים וּ֝בְתוֹרָת֗וֹ מֵאֲנ֥וּ לָלֶֽכֶת׃

lines.text: They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.
They have not kept the covenant of God, And in His law they have refused to walk,

78.he: וַיִּשְׁכְּח֥וּ עֲלִילוֹתָ֑יו וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶרְאָֽם׃

lines.text: They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.
And they forget His doings, And His wonders that He shewed them.

78.he: נֶ֣גֶד אֲ֭בוֹתָם עָ֣שָׂה פֶ֑לֶא בְּאֶ֖רֶץ מִצְרַ֣יִם שְׂדֵה־צֹֽעַן׃

lines.text: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
Before their fathers He hath done wonders, In the land of Egypt — the field of Zoan.

78.he: בָּ֣קַע יָ֭ם וַיַּֽעֲבִירֵ֑ם וַֽיַּצֶּב־מַ֥יִם כְּמוֹ־נֵֽד׃

lines.text: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.
He cleft a sea, and causeth them to pass over, Yea, He causeth waters to stand as a heap.

78.he: וַיַּנְחֵ֣ם בֶּעָנָ֣ן יוֹמָ֑ם וְכָל־הַ֝לַּ֗יְלָה בְּא֣וֹר אֵֽשׁ׃

lines.text: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.
And leadeth them with a cloud by day, And all the night with a light of fire.

78.he: יְבַקַּ֣ע צֻ֭רִים בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַ֝יַּ֗שְׁקְ כִּתְהֹמ֥וֹת רַבָּֽה׃

lines.text: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.
He cleaveth rocks in a wilderness, And giveth drink — as the great deep.

78.he: וַיּוֹצִ֣א נוֹזְלִ֣ים מִסָּ֑לַע וַיּ֖וֹרֶד כַּנְּהָר֣וֹת מָֽיִם׃

lines.text: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
And bringeth out streams from a rock, And causeth waters to come down as rivers.

78.he: וַיּוֹסִ֣יפוּ ע֭וֹד לַחֲטֹא־ל֑וֹ לַֽמְר֥וֹת עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן בַּצִּיָּֽה׃

lines.text: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.
And they add still to sin against Him, To provoke the Most High in the dry place.

78.he: וַיְנַסּוּ־אֵ֥ל בִּלְבָבָ֑ם לִֽשְׁאָל־אֹ֥כֶל לְנַפְשָֽׁם׃

lines.text: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.
And they try God in their heart, To ask food for their lust.

78.he: וַֽיְדַבְּר֗וּ בֵּֽאלֹ֫הִ֥ים אָ֭מְרוּ הֲי֣וּכַל אֵ֑ל לַעֲרֹ֥ךְ שֻׁ֝לְחָ֗ן בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

lines.text: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?
And they speak against God — they said: 'Is God able to array a table in a wilderness?'

78.he: הֵ֤ן הִכָּה־צ֨וּר ׀ וַיָּז֣וּבוּ מַיִם֮ וּנְחָלִ֪ים יִ֫שְׁטֹ֥פוּ הֲגַם־לֶ֭חֶם י֣וּכַל תֵּ֑ת אִם־יָכִ֖ין שְׁאֵ֣ר לְעַמּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide meat for his people?”
Lo, He hath smitten a rock, And waters flow, yea, streams overflow. 'Also — bread [is] He able to give? Doth He prepare flesh for His people?'

78.he: לָכֵ֤ן ׀ שָׁמַ֥ע יְהוָ֗ה וַֽיִּתְעַבָּ֥ר וְ֭אֵשׁ נִשְּׂקָ֣ה בְיַעֲקֹ֑ב וְגַם־אַ֝֗ף עָלָ֥ה בְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

lines.text: Therefore Yahweh heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,
Therefore hath Jehovah heard, And He sheweth Himself wroth, And fire hath been kindled against Jacob, And anger also hath gone up against Israel,

78.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א הֶ֭אֱמִינוּ בֵּאלֹהִ֑ים וְלֹ֥א בָ֝טְח֗וּ בִּֽישׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.
For they have not believed in God, Nor have they trusted in His salvation.

78.he: וַיְצַ֣ו שְׁחָקִ֣ים מִמָּ֑עַל וְדַלְתֵ֖י שָׁמַ֣יִם פָּתָֽח׃

lines.text: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.
And He commandeth clouds from above, Yea, doors of the heavens He hath opened.

78.he: וַיַּמְטֵ֬ר עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם מָ֣ן לֶאֱכֹ֑ל וּדְגַן־שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם נָ֣תַן לָֽמוֹ׃

lines.text: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.
And He raineth on them manna to eat, Yea, corn of heaven He hath given to them.

78.he: לֶ֣חֶם אַ֭בִּירִים אָ֣כַל אִ֑ישׁ צֵידָ֬ה שָׁלַ֖ח לָהֶ֣ם לָשֹֽׂבַע׃

lines.text: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.
Food of the mighty hath each eaten, Venison He sent to them to satiety.

78.he: יַסַּ֣ע קָ֭דִים בַּשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַיְנַהֵ֖ג בְּעֻזּ֣וֹ תֵימָֽן׃

lines.text: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.
He causeth an east wind to journey in the heavens, And leadeth by His strength a south wind,

78.he: וַיַּמְטֵ֬ר עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם כֶּעָפָ֣ר שְׁאֵ֑ר וּֽכְח֥וֹל יַ֝מִּ֗ים ע֣וֹף כָּנָֽף׃

lines.text: He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.
And He raineth on them flesh as dust, And as sand of the seas — winged fowl,

78.he: וַ֭יַּפֵּל בְּקֶ֣רֶב מַחֲנֵ֑הוּ סָ֝בִ֗יב לְמִשְׁכְּנֹתָֽיו׃

lines.text: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.
And causeth [it] to fall in the midst of His camp, Round about His tabernacles.

78.he: וַיֹּאכְל֣וּ וַיִּשְׂבְּע֣וּ מְאֹ֑ד וְ֝תַֽאֲוָתָ֗ם יָבִ֥א לָהֶֽם׃

lines.text: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.
And they eat, and are greatly satisfied, And their desire He bringeth to them.

78.he: לֹא־זָ֥רוּ מִתַּאֲוָתָ֑ם ע֝֗וֹד אָכְלָ֥ם בְּפִיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,
They have not been estranged from their desire, Yet [is] their food in their mouth,

78.he: וְאַ֤ף אֱלֹהִ֨ים ׀ עָ֘לָ֤ה בָהֶ֗ם וַֽ֭יַּהֲרֹג בְּמִשְׁמַנֵּיהֶ֑ם וּבַחוּרֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל הִכְרִֽיעַ׃

lines.text: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their fattest, and struck down the young men of Israel.
And the anger of God hath gone up against them, And He slayeth among their fat ones, And youths of Israel He caused to bend.

78.he: בְּכָל־זֹ֥את חָֽטְאוּ־ע֑וֹד וְלֹֽא־הֶ֝אֱמִ֗ינוּ בְּנִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו׃

lines.text: For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.
With all this they have sinned again, And have not believed in His wonders.

78.he: וַיְכַל־בַּהֶ֥בֶל יְמֵיהֶ֑ם וּ֝שְׁנוֹתָ֗ם בַּבֶּהָלָֽה׃

lines.text: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.
And He consumeth in vanity their days, And their years in trouble.

78.he: אִם־הֲרָגָ֥ם וּדְרָשׁ֑וּהוּ וְ֝שָׁ֗בוּ וְשִֽׁחֲרוּ־אֵֽל׃

lines.text: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.
If He slew them, then they sought Him, And turned back, and sought God earnestly,

78.he: וַֽ֭יִּזְכְּרוּ כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֣ים צוּרָ֑ם וְאֵ֥ל עֶ֝לְיוֹן גֹּאֲלָֽם׃

lines.text: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.
And they remember that God [is] their rock, And God Most High their redeemer.

78.he: וַיְפַתּ֥וּהוּ בְּפִיהֶ֑ם וּ֝בִלְשׁוֹנָ֗ם יְכַזְּבוּ־לֽוֹ׃

lines.text: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.
And — they deceive Him with their mouth, And with their tongue do lie to Him,

78.he: וְ֭לִבָּם לֹא־נָכ֣וֹן עִמּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א נֶ֝אֶמְנ֗וּ בִּבְרִיתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.
And their heart hath not been right with Him, And they have not been stedfast in His covenant.

78.he: וְה֤וּא רַח֨וּם ׀ יְכַפֵּ֥ר עָוֺן֮ וְֽלֹא־יַ֫שְׁחִ֥ית וְ֭הִרְבָּה לְהָשִׁ֣יב אַפּ֑וֹ וְלֹֽא־יָ֝עִיר כָּל־חֲמָתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.
And He — the Merciful One, Pardoneth iniquity, and destroyeth not, And hath often turned back His anger, And waketh not up all His fury.

78.he: וַ֭יִּזְכֹּר כִּי־בָשָׂ֣ר הֵ֑מָּה ר֥וּחַ ה֝וֹלֵ֗ךְ וְלֹ֣א יָשֽׁוּב׃

lines.text: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.
And He remembereth that they [are] flesh, A wind going on — and it returneth not.

78.he: כַּ֭מָּה יַמְר֣וּהוּ בַמִּדְבָּ֑ר יַ֝עֲצִיב֗וּהוּ בִּֽישִׁימֽוֹן׃

lines.text: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!
How often do they provoke Him in the wilderness, Grieve Him in the desolate place?

78.he: וַיָּשׁ֣וּבוּ וַיְנַסּ֣וּ אֵ֑ל וּקְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל הִתְווּ׃

lines.text: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
Yea, they turn back, and try God, And the Holy One of Israel have limited.

78.he: לֹא־זָכְר֥וּ אֶת־יָד֑וֹ י֝֗וֹם אֲֽשֶׁר־פָּדָ֥ם מִנִּי־צָֽר׃

lines.text: They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;
They have not remembered His hand The day He ransomed them from the adversary.

78.he: אֲשֶׁר־שָׂ֣ם בְּ֭מִצְרַיִם אֹֽתוֹתָ֑יו וּ֝מוֹפְתָ֗יו בִּשְׂדֵה־צֹֽעַן׃

lines.text: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,
When He set His signs in Egypt, And His wonders in the field of Zoan,

78.he: וַיַּהֲפֹ֣ךְ לְ֭דָם יְאֹרֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝נֹזְלֵיהֶ֗ם בַּל־יִשְׁתָּיֽוּן׃

lines.text: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.
And He turneth to blood their streams, And their floods they drink not.

78.he: יְשַׁלַּ֬ח בָּהֶ֣ם עָ֭רֹב וַיֹּאכְלֵ֑ם וּ֝צְפַרְדֵּ֗עַ וַתַּשְׁחִיתֵֽם׃

lines.text: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
He sendeth among them the beetle, and it consumeth them, And the frog, and it destroyeth them,

78.he: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לֶחָסִ֣יל יְבוּלָ֑ם וִֽ֝יגִיעָ֗ם לָאַרְבֶּֽה׃

lines.text: He gave also their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.
And giveth to the caterpillar their increase, And their labour to the locust.

78.he: יַהֲרֹ֣ג בַּבָּרָ֣ד גַּפְנָ֑ם וְ֝שִׁקְמוֹתָ֗ם בַּֽחֲנָמַֽל׃

lines.text: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.
He destroyeth with hail their vine, And their sycamores with frost,

78.he: וַיַּסְגֵּ֣ר לַבָּרָ֣ד בְּעִירָ֑ם וּ֝מִקְנֵיהֶ֗ם לָרְשָׁפִֽים׃

lines.text: He gave over their livestock also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
And delivereth up to the hail their beasts, And their cattle to the burning flames.

78.he: יְשַׁלַּח־בָּ֨ם ׀ חֲר֬וֹן אַפּ֗וֹ עֶבְרָ֣ה וָזַ֣עַם וְצָרָ֑ה מִ֝שְׁלַ֗חַת מַלְאֲכֵ֥י רָעִֽים׃

lines.text: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.
He sendeth on them the fury of His anger, Wrath, and indignation, and distress — A discharge of evil messengers.

78.he: יְפַלֵּ֥ס נָתִ֗יב לְאַ֫פּ֥וֹ לֹא־חָשַׂ֣ךְ מִמָּ֣וֶת נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְ֝חַיָּתָ֗ם לַדֶּ֥בֶר הִסְגִּֽיר׃

lines.text: He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,
He pondereth a path for His anger, He kept not back their soul from death, Yea, their life to the pestilence He delivered up.

78.he: וַיַּ֣ךְ כָּל־בְּכ֣וֹר בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם רֵאשִׁ֥ית א֝וֹנִ֗ים בְּאָהֳלֵי־חָֽם׃

lines.text: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.
And He smiteth every first-born in Egypt, The first-fruit of the strong in tents of Ham.

78.he: וַיַּסַּ֣ע כַּצֹּ֣אן עַמּ֑וֹ וַֽיְנַהֲגֵ֥ם כַּ֝עֵ֗דֶר בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

lines.text: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
And causeth His people to journey as a flock, And guideth them as a drove in a wilderness,

78.he: וַיַּנְחֵ֣ם לָ֭בֶטַח וְלֹ֣א פָחָ֑דוּ וְאֶת־א֝וֹיְבֵיהֶ֗ם כִּסָּ֥ה הַיָּֽם׃

lines.text: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
And He leadeth them confidently, And they have not been afraid, And their enemies hath the sea covered.

78.he: וַ֭יְבִיאֵם אֶל־גְּב֣וּל קָדְשׁ֑וֹ הַר־זֶ֝֗ה קָנְתָ֥ה יְמִינֽוֹ׃

lines.text: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.
And He bringeth them in unto the border of His sanctuary, This mountain His right hand had got,

78.he: וַיְגָ֤רֶשׁ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֨ם ׀ גּוֹיִ֗ם וַֽ֭יַּפִּילֵם בְּחֶ֣בֶל נַחֲלָ֑ה וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֥ן בְּ֝אָהֳלֵיהֶ֗ם שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

lines.text: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
And casteth out nations from before them, And causeth them to fall in the line of inheritance, And causeth the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents,

78.he: וַיְנַסּ֣וּ וַ֭יַּמְרוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהִ֣ים עֶלְי֑וֹן וְ֝עֵדוֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א שָׁמָֽרוּ׃

lines.text: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies,
And they tempt and provoke God Most High, And His testimonies have not kept.

78.he: וַיִּסֹּ֣גוּ וַֽ֭יִּבְגְּדוּ כַּאֲבוֹתָ֑ם נֶ֝הְפְּכ֗וּ כְּקֶ֣שֶׁת רְמִיָּֽה׃

lines.text: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.
And they turn back, And deal treacherously like their fathers, They have been turned like a deceitful bow,

78.he: וַיַּכְעִיס֥וּהוּ בְּבָמוֹתָ֑ם וּ֝בִפְסִילֵיהֶ֗ם יַקְנִיאֽוּהוּ׃

lines.text: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.
And make Him angry with their high places, And with their graven images make Him zealous,

78.he: שָׁמַ֣ע אֱ֭לֹהִים וַֽיִּתְעַבָּ֑ר וַיִּמְאַ֥ס מְ֝אֹ֗ד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

lines.text: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,
God hath heard, and sheweth Himself wroth. And kicketh exceedingly against Israel.
so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men,
And He leaveth the tabernacle of Shiloh, The tent He had placed among men,

78.he: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לַשְּׁבִ֣י עֻזּ֑וֹ וְֽתִפְאַרְתּ֥וֹ בְיַד־צָֽר׃

lines.text: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.
And He giveth His strength to captivity, And His beauty into the hand of an adversary,

78.he: וַיַּסְגֵּ֣ר לַחֶ֣רֶב עַמּ֑וֹ וּ֝בְנַחֲלָת֗וֹ הִתְעַבָּֽר׃

lines.text: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.
And delivereth up to the sword His people, And with His inheritance shewed Himself angry.

78.he: בַּחוּרָ֥יו אָֽכְלָה־אֵ֑שׁ וּ֝בְתוּלֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א הוּלָּֽלוּ׃

lines.text: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.
His young men hath fire consumed, And His virgins have not been praised.

78.he: כֹּ֭הֲנָיו בַּחֶ֣רֶב נָפָ֑לוּ וְ֝אַלְמְנֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִבְכֶּֽינָה׃

lines.text: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.
His priests by the sword have fallen, And their widows weep not.

78.he: וַיִּקַ֖ץ כְּיָשֵׁ֥ן ׀ אֲדֹנָ֑י כְּ֝גִבּ֗וֹר מִתְרוֹנֵ֥ן מִיָּֽיִן׃

lines.text: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.
And the Lord waketh as a sleeper, As a mighty one crying aloud from wine.

78.he: וַיַּךְ־צָרָ֥יו אָח֑וֹר חֶרְפַּ֥ת ע֝וֹלָ֗ם נָ֣תַן לָֽמוֹ׃

lines.text: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.
And He smiteth His adversaries backward, A reproach age-during He hath put on them,

78.he: וַ֭יִּמְאַס בְּאֹ֣הֶל יוֹסֵ֑ף וּֽבְשֵׁ֥בֶט אֶ֝פְרַ֗יִם לֹ֣א בָחָֽר׃

lines.text: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,
And He kicketh against the tent of Joseph, And on the tribe of Ephraim hath not fixed.

78.he: וַ֭יִּבְחַר אֶת־שֵׁ֣בֶט יְהוּדָ֑ה אֶֽת־הַ֥ר צִ֝יּ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָהֵֽב׃

lines.text: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.
And He chooseth the tribe of Judah, With mount Zion that He loved,

78.he: וַיִּ֣בֶן כְּמוֹ־רָ֭מִים מִקְדָּשׁ֑וֹ כְּ֝אֶ֗רֶץ יְסָדָ֥הּ לְעוֹלָֽם׃

lines.text: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.
And buildeth His sanctuary as a high place, Like the earth, He founded it to the age.

78.he: וַ֭יִּבְחַר בְּדָוִ֣ד עַבְדּ֑וֹ וַ֝יִּקָּחֵ֗הוּ מִֽמִּכְלְאֹ֥ת צֹֽאן׃

lines.text: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;
And He fixeth on David His servant, And taketh him from the folds of a flock,

78.he: מֵאַחַ֥ר עָל֗וֹת הֱבִ֫יא֥וֹ לִ֭רְעוֹת בְּיַעֲקֹ֣ב עַמּ֑וֹ וּ֝בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.
From behind suckling ones He hath brought him in, To rule over Jacob His people, And over Israel His inheritance.

78.he: וַ֭יִּרְעֵם כְּתֹ֣ם לְבָב֑וֹ וּבִתְבוּנ֖וֹת כַּפָּ֣יו יַנְחֵֽם׃

lines.text: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.
And he ruleth them according to the integrity of his heart, And by the skilfulness of his hands leadeth them!

79.he: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אֱֽלֹהִ֡ים בָּ֤אוּ גוֹיִ֨ם ׀ בְּֽנַחֲלָתֶ֗ךָ טִ֭מְּאוּ אֶת־הֵיכַ֣ל קָדְשֶׁ֑ךָ שָׂ֖מוּ אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַ֣ם לְעִיִּֽים׃

lines.text: God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.
A Psalm of Asaph. O God, nations have come into Thy inheritance, They have defiled Thy holy temple, They made Jerusalem become heaps,

79.he: נָֽתְנ֡וּ אֶת־נִבְלַ֬ת עֲבָדֶ֗יךָ מַ֭אֲכָל לְע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם בְּשַׂ֥ר חֲ֝סִידֶ֗יךָ לְחַיְתוֹ־אָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.
They gave the dead bodies of Thy servants Food for the fowls of the heavens, The flesh of Thy saints For the wild beast of the earth.

79.he: שָׁפְכ֬וּ דָמָ֨ם ׀ כַּמַּ֗יִם סְֽבִ֘יב֤וֹת יְֽרוּשָׁלִָ֗ם וְאֵ֣ין קוֹבֵֽר׃

lines.text: They have shed their blood like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.
They have shed their blood As water round about Jerusalem, And there is none burying.

79.he: הָיִ֣ינוּ חֶ֭רְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵ֑ינוּ לַ֥עַג וָ֝קֶ֗לֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵֽינוּ׃

lines.text: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.
We have been a reproach to our neighbours, A scorn and a derision to our surrounders.

79.he: עַד־מָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תֶּאֱנַ֣ף לָנֶ֑צַח תִּבְעַ֥ר כְּמוֹ־אֵ֝֗שׁ קִנְאָתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: How long, Yahweh? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?
Till when, O Jehovah? art Thou angry for ever? Thy jealousy doth burn as fire.

79.he: שְׁפֹ֤ךְ חֲמָתְךָ֗ אֶֽל־הַגּוֹיִם֮ אֲשֶׁ֪ר לֹא־יְדָ֫ע֥וּךָ וְעַ֥ל מַמְלָכ֑וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ֝שִׁמְךָ֗ לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ׃

lines.text: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name;
Pour Thy fury on the nations who have not known Thee, And on kingdoms that have not called in Thy name.
for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.
For [one] hath devoured Jacob, And his habitation they have made desolate.

79.he: אַֽל־תִּזְכָּר־לָנוּ֮ עֲוֺנֹ֪ת רִאשֹׁ֫נִ֥ים מַ֭הֵר יְקַדְּמ֣וּנוּ רַחֲמֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י דַלּ֣וֹנוּ מְאֹֽד׃

lines.text: Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.
Remember not for us the iniquities of forefathers, Haste, let Thy mercies go before us, For we have been very weak.

79.he: עָזְרֵ֤נוּ ׀ אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י יִשְׁעֵ֗נוּ עַל־דְּבַ֥ר כְּבֽוֹד־שְׁמֶ֑ךָ וְהַצִּילֵ֥נוּ וְכַפֵּ֥ר עַל־חַ֝טֹּאתֵ֗ינוּ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.
Help us, O God of our salvation, Because of the honour of Thy name, And deliver us, and cover over our sins, For Thy name's sake.

79.he: לָ֤מָּה ׀ יֹאמְר֣וּ הַגּוֹיִם֮ אַיֵּ֪ה אֱֽלֹהֵ֫יהֶ֥ם יִוָּדַ֣ע בגיים לְעֵינֵ֑ינוּ נִ֝קְמַ֗ת דַּֽם־עֲבָדֶ֥יךָ הַשָּׁפֽוּךְ׃

lines.text: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.
Why do the nations say, 'Where [is] their God?' Let be known among the nations before our eyes, The vengeance of the blood of Thy servants that is shed.

79.he: תָּ֤ב֣וֹא לְפָנֶיךָ֮ אֶנְקַ֪ת אָ֫סִ֥יר כְּגֹ֥דֶל זְרוֹעֲךָ֑ ה֝וֹתֵ֗ר בְּנֵ֣י תְמוּתָֽה׃

lines.text: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.
Let the groaning of the prisoner come in before Thee, According to the greatness of Thine arm, Leave Thou the sons of death.

79.he: וְהָ֘שֵׁ֤ב לִשְׁכֵנֵ֣ינוּ שִׁ֭בְעָתַיִם אֶל־חֵיקָ֑ם חֶרְפָּ֘תָ֤ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר חֵרְפ֣וּךָ אֲדֹנָֽי׃

lines.text: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.
And turn Thou back to our neighbours, Sevenfold unto their bosom, their reproach, Wherewith they reproached Thee, O Lord.

79.he: וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ עַמְּךָ֨ ׀ וְצֹ֥אן מַרְעִיתֶךָ֮ נ֤וֹדֶ֥ה לְּךָ֗ לְע֫וֹלָ֥ם לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֑ר נְ֝סַפֵּ֗ר תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.
And we, Thy people, and the flock of Thy pasture, We give thanks to Thee to the age, To all generations we recount Thy praise!

80.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אֶל־שֹׁשַׁנִּ֑ים עֵד֖וּת לְאָסָ֣ף מִזְמֽוֹר׃

lines.text: To the Overseer. — 'On the Lilies.' A testimony of Asaph. — A Psalm. Shepherd of Israel, give ear, Leading Joseph as a flock, Inhabiting the cherubs — shine forth,

80.he: רֹ֘עֵ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל ׀ הַאֲזִ֗ינָה נֹהֵ֣ג כַּצֹּ֣אן יוֹסֵ֑ף יֹשֵׁ֖ב הַכְּרוּבִ֣ים הוֹפִֽיעָה׃

lines.text: Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.
To the Overseer. — 'On the Lilies.' A testimony of Asaph. — A Psalm. Shepherd of Israel, give ear, Leading Joseph as a flock, Inhabiting the cherubs — shine forth,

80.he: לִפְנֵ֤י אֶפְרַ֨יִם ׀ וּבִנְיָ֘מִ֤ן וּמְנַשֶּׁ֗ה עוֹרְרָ֥ה אֶת־גְּבֽוּרָתֶ֑ךָ וּלְכָ֖ה לִישֻׁעָ֣תָה לָּֽנוּ׃

lines.text: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!
Before Ephraim, and Benjamin, and Manasseh, Wake up Thy might, and come for our salvation.

80.he: אֱלֹהִ֥ים הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נוּ וְהָאֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעָה׃

lines.text: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
O God, cause us to turn back, And cause Thy face to shine, and we are saved.

80.he: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָא֑וֹת עַד־מָתַ֥י עָ֝שַׁ֗נְתָּ בִּתְפִלַּ֥ת עַמֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: Yahweh God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?
Jehovah, God of Hosts, till when? Thou hast burned against the prayer of Thy people.

80.he: הֶ֭אֱכַלְתָּם לֶ֣חֶם דִּמְעָ֑ה וַ֝תַּשְׁקֵ֗מוֹ בִּדְמָע֥וֹת שָׁלִֽישׁ׃

lines.text: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.
Thou hast caused them to eat bread of tears, And causest them to drink With tears a third time.

80.he: תְּשִׂימֵ֣נוּ מָ֭דוֹן לִשְׁכֵנֵ֑ינוּ וְ֝אֹיְבֵ֗ינוּ יִלְעֲגוּ־לָֽמוֹ׃

lines.text: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.
Thou makest us a strife to our neighbours, And our enemies mock at it.

80.he: אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָא֣וֹת הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נוּ וְהָאֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעָה׃

lines.text: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
God of Hosts, turn us back, And cause Thy face to shine, and we are saved.

80.he: גֶּ֭פֶן מִמִּצְרַ֣יִם תַּסִּ֑יעַ תְּגָרֵ֥שׁ גּ֝וֹיִ֗ם וַתִּטָּעֶֽהָ׃

lines.text: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.
A vine out of Egypt Thou dost bring, Thou dost cast out nations, and plantest it.

80.he: פִּנִּ֥יתָ לְפָנֶ֑יהָ וַתַּשְׁרֵ֥שׁ שָׁ֝רָשֶׁ֗יהָ וַתְּמַלֵּא־אָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.
Thou hast looked before it, and dost root it, And it filleth the land,

80.he: כָּסּ֣וּ הָרִ֣ים צִלָּ֑הּ וַ֝עֲנָפֶ֗יהָ אַֽרְזֵי־אֵֽל׃

lines.text: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.
Covered have been hills [with] its shadow, And its boughs [are] cedars of God.

80.he: תְּשַׁלַּ֣ח קְצִירֶ֣הָ עַד־יָ֑ם וְאֶל־נָ֝הָ֗ר יֽוֹנְקוֹתֶֽיהָ׃

lines.text: It sent out its branches to the sea, its shoots to the River.
It sendeth forth its branches unto the sea, And unto the river its sucklings.

80.he: לָ֭מָּה פָּרַ֣צְתָּ גְדֵרֶ֑יהָ וְ֝אָר֗וּהָ כָּל־עֹ֥בְרֵי דָֽרֶךְ׃

lines.text: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?
Why hast Thou broken down its hedges, And all passing by the way have plucked it?

80.he: יְכַרְסְמֶ֣נָּֽה חֲזִ֣יר מִיָּ֑עַר וְזִ֖יז שָׂדַ֣י יִרְעֶֽנָּה׃

lines.text: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.
A boar out of the forest doth waste it, And a wild beast of the fields consumeth it.

80.he: אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָאוֹת֮ שֽׁ֫וּב־נָ֥א הַבֵּ֣ט מִשָּׁמַ֣יִם וּרְאֵ֑ה וּ֝פְקֹ֗ד גֶּ֣פֶן זֹֽאת׃

lines.text: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,
God of Hosts, turn back, we beseech Thee, Look from heaven, and see, and inspect this vine,

80.he: וְ֭כַנָּה אֲשֶׁר־נָטְעָ֣ה יְמִינֶ֑ךָ וְעַל־בֵּ֝֗ן אִמַּ֥צְתָּה לָּֽךְ׃

lines.text: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.
And the root that Thy right hand planted, And the branch Thou madest strong for Thee,

80.he: שְׂרֻפָ֣ה בָאֵ֣שׁ כְּסוּחָ֑ה מִגַּעֲרַ֖ת פָּנֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃

lines.text: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.
Burnt with fire — cut down, From the rebuke of Thy face they perish.

80.he: תְּֽהִי־יָ֭דְךָ עַל־אִ֣ישׁ יְמִינֶ֑ךָ עַל־בֶּן־אָ֝דָ֗ם אִמַּ֥צְתָּ לָּֽךְ׃

lines.text: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.
Let Thy hand be on the man of Thy right hand, On the son of man Thou hast strengthened for Thyself.

80.he: וְלֹא־נָס֥וֹג מִמֶּ֑ךָּ תְּ֝חַיֵּ֗נוּ וּבְשִׁמְךָ֥ נִקְרָֽא׃

lines.text: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.
And we do not go back from Thee, Thou dost revive us, and in Thy name we call.

80.he: יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָא֣וֹת הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נוּ הָאֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעָה׃

lines.text: Turn us again, Yahweh God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
O Jehovah, God of Hosts, turn us back, Cause Thy face to shine, and we are saved!
To the Overseer. — 'On the Gittith.' By Asaph. Cry aloud to God our strength, Shout to the God of Jacob.

81.he: הַ֭רְנִינוּ לֵאלֹהִ֣ים עוּזֵּ֑נוּ הָ֝רִ֗יעוּ לֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃

lines.text: Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!
To the Overseer. — 'On the Gittith.' By Asaph. Cry aloud to God our strength, Shout to the God of Jacob.
Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.
Lift up a song, and give out a timbrel, A pleasant harp with psaltery.

81.he: תִּקְע֣וּ בַחֹ֣דֶשׁ שׁוֹפָ֑ר בַּ֝כֵּ֗סֶה לְי֣וֹם חַגֵּֽנוּ׃

lines.text: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.
Blow in the month a trumpet, In the new moon, at the day of our festival,

81.he: כִּ֤י חֹ֣ק לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל ה֑וּא מִ֝שְׁפָּ֗ט לֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃

lines.text: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
For a statute to Israel it [is], An ordinance of the God of Jacob.

81.he: עֵד֤וּת ׀ בִּֽיה֘וֹסֵ֤ף שָׂמ֗וֹ בְּ֭צֵאתוֹ עַל־אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם שְׂפַ֖ת לֹא־יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶשְׁמָֽע׃

lines.text: He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.
A testimony on Joseph He hath placed it, In his going forth over the land of Egypt. A lip, I have not known — I hear.

81.he: הֲסִיר֣וֹתִי מִסֵּ֣בֶל שִׁכְמ֑וֹ כַּ֝פָּ֗יו מִדּ֥וּד תַּעֲבֹֽרְנָה׃

lines.text: “I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.
From the burden his shoulder I turned aside, His hands from the basket pass over.

81.he: בַּצָּרָ֥ה קָרָ֗אתָ וָאֲחַ֫לְּצֶ֥ךָּ אֶ֭עֶנְךָ בְּסֵ֣תֶר רַ֑עַם אֶבְחָֽנְךָ֨ עַל־מֵ֖י מְרִיבָ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah.”
In distress thou hast called and I deliver thee, I answer thee in the secret place of thunder, I try thee by the waters of Meribah. Selah.

81.he: שְׁמַ֣ע עַ֭מִּי וְאָעִ֣ידָה בָּ֑ךְ יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל אִם־תִּֽשְׁמַֽע־לִֽי׃

lines.text: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!
Hear, O My people, and I testify to thee, O Israel, if thou dost hearken to me:

81.he: לֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֣ה בְ֭ךָ אֵ֣ל זָ֑ר וְלֹ֥א תִ֝שְׁתַּחֲוֶ֗ה לְאֵ֣ל נֵכָֽר׃

lines.text: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.
There is not in thee a strange god, And thou bowest not thyself to a strange god.

81.he: אָנֹכִ֨י ׀ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ הַֽ֭מַּעַלְךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם הַרְחֶב־פִּ֝֗יךָ וַאֲמַּלְאֵֽהוּ׃

lines.text: I am Yahweh, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
I [am] Jehovah thy God, Who bringeth thee up out of the land of Egypt. Enlarge thy mouth, and I fill it.

81.he: וְלֹא־שָׁמַ֣ע עַמִּ֣י לְקוֹלִ֑י וְ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֹא־אָ֥בָה לִֽי׃

lines.text: But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.
But, My people hearkened not to My voice, And Israel hath not consented to Me.
So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.
And I send them away in the enmity of their heart, They walk in their own counsels.

81.he: ל֗וּ עַ֭מִּי שֹׁמֵ֣עַֽ לִ֑י יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל בִּדְרָכַ֥י יְהַלֵּֽכוּ׃

lines.text: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!
O that My people were hearkening to Me, Israel in My ways would walk.

81.he: כִּ֭מְעַט אוֹיְבֵיהֶ֣ם אַכְנִ֑יעַ וְעַ֥ל צָ֝רֵיהֶ֗ם אָשִׁ֥יב יָדִֽי׃

lines.text: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.
As a little thing their enemies I cause to bow, And against their adversaries I turn back My hand,

81.he: מְשַׂנְאֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה יְכַֽחֲשׁוּ־ל֑וֹ וִיהִ֖י עִתָּ֣ם לְעוֹלָֽם׃

lines.text: The haters of Yahweh would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.
Those hating Jehovah feign obedience to Him, But their time is — to the age.

81.he: וַֽ֭יַּאֲכִילֵהוּ מֵחֵ֣לֶב חִטָּ֑ה וּ֝מִצּ֗וּר דְּבַ֣שׁ אַשְׂבִּיעֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”
He causeth him to eat of the fat of wheat, And [with] honey from a rock I satisfy thee!

82.he: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים נִצָּ֥ב בַּעֲדַת־אֵ֑ל בְּקֶ֖רֶב אֱלֹהִ֣ים יִשְׁפֹּֽט׃

lines.text: God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.
— A Psalm of Asaph. God hath stood in the company of God, In the midst God doth judge.
“How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?”
Till when do ye judge perversely? And the face of the wicked lift up? Selah.
“Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.
Judge ye the weak and fatherless, The afflicted and the poor declare righteous.
Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”
Let the weak and needy escape, From the hand of the wicked deliver them.

82.he: לֹ֤א יָֽדְע֨וּ ׀ וְלֹ֥א יָבִ֗ינוּ בַּחֲשֵׁכָ֥ה יִתְהַלָּ֑כוּ יִ֝מּ֗וֹטוּ כָּל־מ֥וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.
They knew not, nor do they understand, In darkness they walk habitually, Moved are all the foundations of earth.

82.he: אֲֽנִי־אָ֭מַרְתִּי אֱלֹהִ֣ים אַתֶּ֑ם וּבְנֵ֖י עֶלְי֣וֹן כֻּלְּכֶֽם׃

lines.text: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.
I — I have said, 'Gods ye [are], And sons of the Most High — all of you,

82.he: אָ֭כֵן כְּאָדָ֣ם תְּמוּת֑וּן וּכְאַחַ֖ד הַשָּׂרִ֣ים תִּפֹּֽלוּ׃

lines.text: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”
But as man ye die, and as one of the heads ye fall,

82.he: קוּמָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים שָׁפְטָ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֥ה תִ֝נְחַ֗ל בְּכָל־הַגּוֹיִֽם׃

lines.text: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.
Rise, O God, judge the earth, For Thou hast inheritance among all the nations!
A Song, — A Psalm of Asaph. O God, let there be no silence to Thee, Be not silent, nor be quiet, O God.
God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.
A Song, — A Psalm of Asaph. O God, let there be no silence to Thee, Be not silent, nor be quiet, O God.

83.he: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֣ה א֭וֹיְבֶיךָ יֶהֱמָי֑וּן וּ֝מְשַׂנְאֶ֗יךָ נָ֣שְׂאוּ רֹֽאשׁ׃

lines.text: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.
For, lo, Thine enemies do roar, And those hating Thee have lifted up the head,
They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.
Against Thy people they take crafty counsel, And consult against Thy hidden ones.

83.he: אָמְר֗וּ לְ֭כוּ וְנַכְחִידֵ֣ם מִגּ֑וֹי וְלֹֽא־יִזָּכֵ֖ר שֵֽׁם־יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עֽוֹד׃

lines.text: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”
They have said, 'Come, And we cut them off from [being] a nation, And the name of Israel is not remembered any more.'

83.he: כִּ֤י נוֹעֲצ֣וּ לֵ֣ב יַחְדָּ֑ו עָ֝לֶ֗יךָ בְּרִ֣ית יִכְרֹֽתוּ׃

lines.text: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.
For they consulted in heart together, Against Thee a covenant they make,
The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;
Tents of Edom, and Ishmaelites, Moab, and the Hagarenes,

83.he: גְּבָ֣ל וְ֭עַמּוֹן וַעֲמָלֵ֑ק פְּ֝לֶ֗שֶׁת עִם־יֹ֥שְׁבֵי צֽוֹר׃

lines.text: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;
Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek, Philistia with inhabitants of Tyre,

83.he: גַּם־אַ֭שּׁוּר נִלְוָ֣ה עִמָּ֑ם הָ֤י֥וּ זְר֖וֹעַ לִבְנֵי־ל֣וֹט סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot.
Asshur also is joined with them, They have been an arm to sons of Lot. Selah.

83.he: עֲשֵֽׂה־לָהֶ֥ם כְּמִדְיָ֑ן כְּֽסִֽיסְרָ֥א כְ֝יָבִ֗ין בְּנַ֣חַל קִישֽׁוֹן׃

lines.text: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;
Do to them as [to] Midian, As [to] Sisera, as [to] Jabin, at the stream Kishon.
who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.
They were destroyed at Endor, They were dung for the ground!

83.he: שִׁיתֵ֣מוֹ נְ֭דִיבֵמוֹ כְּעֹרֵ֣ב וְכִזְאֵ֑ב וּֽכְזֶ֥בַח וּ֝כְצַלְמֻנָּ֗ע כָּל־נְסִיכֵֽמוֹ׃

lines.text: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
Make their nobles as Oreb and as Zeeb, And as Zebah and Zalmunna all their princes,

83.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָ֭מְרוּ נִ֣ירֲשָׁה לָּ֑נוּ אֵ֝֗ת נְא֣וֹת אֱלֹהִֽים׃

lines.text: who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”
Who have said, 'Let us occupy for ourselves The comely places of God.'
My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind.
O my God, make them as a rolling thing, As stubble before wind.
As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,
As a fire doth burn a forest, And as a flame setteth hills on fire,
so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.
So dost Thou pursue them with Thy whirlwind, And with Thy hurricane troublest them.

83.he: מַלֵּ֣א פְנֵיהֶ֣ם קָל֑וֹן וִֽיבַקְשׁ֖וּ שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, Yahweh.
Fill their faces [with] shame, And they seek Thy name, O Jehovah.
Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;
They are ashamed and troubled for ever, Yea, they are confounded and lost.

83.he: וְֽיֵדְע֗וּ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֬ה שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה לְבַדֶּ֑ךָ עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן עַל־כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: that they may know that you alone, whose name is Yahweh, are the Most High over all the earth.
And they know that Thou — (Thy name [is] Jehovah — by Thyself,) [Art] the Most High over all the earth!
To the Overseer. — 'On the Gittith By sons of Korah.' — A Psalm. How beloved Thy tabernacles, Jehovah of Hosts!
How lovely are your dwellings, Yahweh of Armies!
To the Overseer. — 'On the Gittith By sons of Korah.' — A Psalm. How beloved Thy tabernacles, Jehovah of Hosts!

84.he: נִכְסְפָ֬ה וְגַם־כָּלְתָ֨ה ׀ נַפְשִׁי֮ לְחַצְר֪וֹת יְה֫וָ֥ה לִבִּ֥י וּבְשָׂרִ֑י יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ אֶ֣ל אֵֽל־חָֽי׃

lines.text: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of Yahweh. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
My soul desired, yea, it hath also been consumed, For the courts of Jehovah, My heart and my flesh cry aloud unto the living God,

84.he: גַּם־צִפּ֨וֹר ׀ מָ֪צְאָה בַ֡יִת וּדְר֤וֹר ׀ קֵ֥ן לָהּ֮ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁ֪תָה אֶפְרֹ֫חֶ֥יהָ אֶֽת־מִ֭זְבְּחוֹתֶיךָ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת מַ֝לְכִּ֗י וֵאלֹהָֽי׃

lines.text: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, Yahweh of Armies, my King, and my God.
(Even a sparrow hath found a house, And a swallow a nest for herself, Where she hath placed her brood,) Thine altars, O Jehovah of Hosts, My king and my God.

84.he: אַ֭שְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י בֵיתֶ֑ךָ ע֝֗וֹד יְֽהַלְל֥וּךָ סֶּֽלָה׃

lines.text: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you.
O the happiness of those inhabiting Thy house, Yet do they praise Thee. Selah.

84.he: אַשְׁרֵ֣י אָ֭דָם עֽוֹז־ל֥וֹ בָ֑ךְ מְ֝סִלּ֗וֹת בִּלְבָבָֽם׃

lines.text: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.
O the happiness of a man whose strength is in Thee, Highways [are] in their heart.

84.he: עֹבְרֵ֤י ׀ בְּעֵ֣מֶק הַ֭בָּכָא מַעְיָ֣ן יְשִׁית֑וּהוּ גַּם־בְּ֝רָכ֗וֹת יַעְטֶ֥ה מוֹרֶֽה׃

lines.text: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.
Those passing through a valley of weeping, A fountain do make it, Blessings also cover the director.

84.he: יֵ֭לְכוּ מֵחַ֣יִל אֶל־חָ֑יִל יֵרָאֶ֖ה אֶל־אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּצִיּֽוֹן׃

lines.text: They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.
They go from strength unto strength, He appeareth unto God in Zion.

84.he: יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְ֭בָאוֹת שִׁמְעָ֣ה תְפִלָּתִ֑י הַאֲזִ֨ינָה אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: Yahweh, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob.
O Jehovah, God of Hosts, hear my prayer, Give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.

84.he: מָ֭גִנֵּנוּ רְאֵ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ֝הַבֵּ֗ט פְּנֵ֣י מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.
Our shield, see, O God, And behold the face of Thine anointed,

84.he: כִּ֤י טֽוֹב־י֥וֹם בַּחֲצֵרֶ֗יךָ מֵ֫אָ֥לֶף בָּחַ֗רְתִּי הִ֭סְתּוֹפֵף בְּבֵ֣ית אֱלֹהַ֑י מִ֝דּ֗וּר בְּאָהֳלֵי־רֶֽשַׁע׃

lines.text: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
For good [is] a day in Thy courts, O Teacher! I have chosen rather to be at the threshold, In the house of my God, Than to dwell in tents of wickedness.

84.he: כִּ֤י שֶׁ֨מֶשׁ ׀ וּמָגֵן֮ יְהוָ֪ה אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים חֵ֣ן וְ֭כָבוֹד יִתֵּ֣ן יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֥א יִמְנַע־ט֝֗וֹב לַֽהֹלְכִ֥ים בְּתָמִֽים׃

lines.text: For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.
For a sun and a shield [is] Jehovah God, Grace and honour doth Jehovah give. He withholdeth not good To those walking in uprightness.

84.he: יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֑וֹת אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י אָ֝דָ֗ם בֹּטֵ֥חַ בָּֽךְ׃

lines.text: Yahweh of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.
Jehovah of Hosts! O the happiness of a man trusting in Thee.
To the Overseer. — By sons of Korah. A Psalm. Thou hast accepted, O Jehovah, Thy land, Thou hast turned [to] the captivity of Jacob.

85.he: רָצִ֣יתָ יְהוָ֣ה אַרְצֶ֑ךָ שַׁ֝֗בְתָּ שבות יַעֲקֹֽב׃

lines.text: Yahweh, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.
To the Overseer. — By sons of Korah. A Psalm. Thou hast accepted, O Jehovah, Thy land, Thou hast turned [to] the captivity of Jacob.

85.he: נָ֭שָׂאתָ עֲוֺ֣ן עַמֶּ֑ךָ כִּסִּ֖יתָ כָל־חַטָּאתָ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin.
Thou hast borne away the iniquity of Thy people, Thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.
You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.
Thou hast gathered up all Thy wrath, Thou hast turned back from the fierceness of Thine anger.

85.he: שׁ֭וּבֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֑נוּ וְהָפֵ֖ר כַּֽעַסְךָ֣ עִמָּֽנוּ׃

lines.text: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.
Turn back [to] us, O God of our salvation, And make void Thine anger with us.

85.he: הַלְעוֹלָ֥ם תֶּֽאֱנַף־בָּ֑נוּ תִּמְשֹׁ֥ךְ אַ֝פְּךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃

lines.text: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?
To the age art Thou angry against us? Dost Thou draw out Thine anger To generation and generation?
Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
Dost Thou not turn back? Thou revivest us, And Thy people do rejoice in Thee.
Show us your loving kindness, Yahweh. Grant us your salvation.
Show us, O Jehovah, thy kindness, And Thy salvation Thou dost give to us.

85.he: אֶשְׁמְעָ֗ה מַה־יְדַבֵּר֮ הָאֵ֪ל ׀ יְה֫וָ֥ה כִּ֤י ׀ יְדַבֵּ֬ר שָׁל֗וֹם אֶל־עַמּ֥וֹ וְאֶל־חֲסִידָ֑יו וְֽאַל־יָשׁ֥וּבוּ לְכִסְלָֽה׃

lines.text: I will hear what God, Yahweh, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.
I hear what God Jehovah speaketh, For He speaketh peace unto His people, And unto His saints, and they turn not back to folly.

85.he: אַ֤ךְ ׀ קָר֣וֹב לִירֵאָ֣יו יִשְׁע֑וֹ לִשְׁכֹּ֖ן כָּב֣וֹד בְּאַרְצֵֽנוּ׃

lines.text: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.
Only, near to those fearing Him [is] His salvation, That honour may dwell in our land.
Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
Kindness and truth have met, Righteousness and peace have kissed,

85.he: אֱ֭מֶת מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תִּצְמָ֑ח וְ֝צֶ֗דֶק מִשָּׁמַ֥יִם נִשְׁקָֽף׃

lines.text: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.
Truth from the earth springeth up, And righteousness from heaven looketh out,

85.he: גַּם־יְ֭הוָה יִתֵּ֣ן הַטּ֑וֹב וְ֝אַרְצֵ֗נוּ תִּתֵּ֥ן יְבוּלָֽהּ׃

lines.text: Yes, Yahweh will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.
Jehovah also giveth that which is good, And our land doth give its increase.

85.he: צֶ֭דֶק לְפָנָ֣יו יְהַלֵּ֑ךְ וְיָשֵׂ֖ם לְדֶ֣רֶךְ פְּעָמָֽיו׃

lines.text: Righteousness goes before him, And prepares the way for his steps.
Righteousness before Him goeth, And maketh His footsteps for a way!

86.he: תְּפִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד הַטֵּֽה־יְהוָ֣ה אָזְנְךָ֣ עֲנֵ֑נִי כִּֽי־עָנִ֖י וְאֶבְי֣וֹן אָֽנִי׃

lines.text: Hear, Yahweh, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
A Prayer of David. Incline, O Jehovah, Thine ear, Answer me, for I [am] poor and needy.

86.he: שָֽׁמְרָ֣ה נַפְשִׁי֮ כִּֽי־חָסִ֪יד אָ֥נִי הוֹשַׁ֣ע עַ֭בְדְּךָ אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֑י הַבּוֹטֵ֥חַ אֵלֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.
Keep my soul, for I [am] pious, Save Thy servant — who is trusting to Thee, O Thou, my God.

86.he: חָנֵּ֥נִי אֲדֹנָ֑י כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֥יךָ אֶ֝קְרָ֗א כָּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃

lines.text: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.
Favour me, O Lord, for to Thee I call all the day.

86.he: שַׂ֭מֵּחַ נֶ֣פֶשׁ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֥יךָ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י נַפְשִׁ֥י אֶשָּֽׂא׃

lines.text: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.
Rejoice the soul of Thy servant, For unto Thee, O Lord, my soul I lift up.

86.he: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי ט֣וֹב וְסַלָּ֑ח וְרַב־חֶ֝֗סֶד לְכָל־קֹרְאֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
For Thou, Lord, [art] good and forgiving. And abundant in kindness to all calling Thee.

86.he: הַאֲזִ֣ינָה יְ֭הוָה תְּפִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝הַקְשִׁ֗יבָה בְּק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנוֹתָֽי׃

lines.text: Hear, Yahweh, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.
Hear, O Jehovah, my prayer, And attend to the voice of my supplications.
In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.
In a day of my distress I call Thee, For Thou dost answer me.
There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.
There is none like Thee among the gods, O Lord, And like Thy works there are none.

86.he: כָּל־גּוֹיִ֤ם ׀ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֗יתָ יָב֤וֹאוּ ׀ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לְפָנֶ֣יךָ אֲדֹנָ֑י וִ֖יכַבְּד֣וּ לִשְׁמֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.
All nations that Thou hast made Come and bow themselves before Thee, O Lord, And give honour to Thy name.

86.he: כִּֽי־גָד֣וֹל אַ֭תָּה וְעֹשֵׂ֣ה נִפְלָא֑וֹת אַתָּ֖ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.
For great [art] Thou, and doing wonders, Thou [art] God Thyself alone.

86.he: ה֘וֹרֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֨ה ׀ דַּרְכֶּ֗ךָ אֲהַלֵּ֥ךְ בַּאֲמִתֶּ֑ךָ יַחֵ֥ד לְ֝בָבִ֗י לְיִרְאָ֥ה שְׁמֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.
Show me, O Jehovah, Thy way, I walk in Thy truth, My heart doth rejoice to fear Thy name.

86.he: אוֹדְךָ֤ ׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י אֱ֭לֹהַי בְּכָל־לְבָבִ֑י וַאֲכַבְּדָ֖ה שִׁמְךָ֣ לְעוֹלָֽם׃

lines.text: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.
I confess Thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart, And I honour Thy name to the age.

86.he: כִּֽי־חַ֭סְדְּךָ גָּד֣וֹל עָלָ֑י וְהִצַּ֥לְתָּ נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י מִשְּׁא֥וֹל תַּחְתִּיָּֽה׃

lines.text: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
For Thy kindness [is] great toward me, And Thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.

86.he: אֱלֹהִ֤ים ׀ זֵ֘דִ֤ים קָֽמוּ־עָלַ֗י וַעֲדַ֣ת עָ֭רִיצִים בִּקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י וְלֹ֖א שָׂמ֣וּךָ לְנֶגְדָּֽם׃

lines.text: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.
O God, the proud have risen up against me, And a company of the terrible sought my soul, And have not placed Thee before them,

86.he: וְאַתָּ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי אֵל־רַח֣וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם וְרַב־חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׃

lines.text: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.
And Thou, O Lord, [art] God, merciful and gracious, Slow to anger, and abundant in kindness and truth.

86.he: פְּנֵ֥ה אֵלַ֗י וְחָ֫נֵּ֥נִי תְּנָֽה־עֻזְּךָ֥ לְעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝הוֹשִׁ֗יעָה לְבֶן־אֲמָתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.
Look unto me, and favour me, Give Thy strength to Thy servant, And give salvation to a son of Thine handmaid.

86.he: עֲשֵֽׂה־עִמִּ֥י א֗וֹת לְט֫וֹבָ֥ה וְיִרְא֣וּ שֹׂנְאַ֣י וְיֵבֹ֑שׁוּ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה עֲזַרְתַּ֥נִי וְנִחַמְתָּֽנִי׃

lines.text: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, Yahweh, have helped me, and comforted me.
Do with me a sign for good, And those hating me see and are ashamed, For Thou, O Jehovah, hast helped me, Yea, Thou hast comforted me!
His foundation is in the holy mountains.
By sons of Korah. — A Psalm, a song. His foundation [is] in holy mountains.

87.he: אֹהֵ֣ב יְ֭הוָה שַׁעֲרֵ֣י צִיּ֑וֹן מִ֝כֹּ֗ל מִשְׁכְּנ֥וֹת יַעֲקֹֽב׃

lines.text: Yahweh loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
Jehovah is loving the gates of Zion Above all the tabernacles of Jacob.

87.he: נִ֭כְבָּדוֹת מְדֻבָּ֣ר בָּ֑ךְ עִ֖יר הָאֱלֹהִ֣ים סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God.
Honourable things are spoken in Thee, O city of God. Selah.

87.he: אַזְכִּ֤יר ׀ רַ֥הַב וּבָבֶ֗ל לְֽיֹ֫דְעָ֥י הִנֵּ֤ה פְלֶ֣שֶׁת וְצ֣וֹר עִם־כּ֑וּשׁ זֶ֝֗ה יֻלַּד־שָֽׁם׃

lines.text: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”
I mention Rahab and Babel to those knowing Me, Lo, Philistia, and Tyre, with Cush! This [one] was born there.

87.he: וּֽלֲצִיּ֨וֹן ׀ יֵאָמַ֗ר אִ֣ישׁ וְ֭אִישׁ יֻלַּד־בָּ֑הּ וְה֖וּא יְכוֹנְנֶ֣הָ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃

lines.text: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;” the Most High himself will establish her.
And of Zion it is said: Each one was born in her, And He, the Most High, doth establish her.

87.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה יִ֭סְפֹּר בִּכְת֣וֹב עַמִּ֑ים זֶ֖ה יֻלַּד־שָׁ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: Yahweh will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.”
Jehovah doth recount in the describing of the peoples, 'This [one] was born there.' Selah.
Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”
Singers also as players on instruments, All my fountains [are] in Thee!

88.he: שִׁ֥יר מִזְמ֗וֹר לִבְנֵ֫י קֹ֥רַח לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ עַל־מָחֲלַ֣ת לְעַנּ֑וֹת מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל לְהֵימָ֥ן הָאֶזְרָחִֽי׃

lines.text: A Song, a Psalm, by sons of Korah, to the Overseer, 'Concerning the Sickness of Afflictions.' — An instruction, by Heman the Ezrahite. O Jehovah, God of my salvation, Daily I have cried, nightly before Thee,

88.he: יְ֭הוָה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יְשׁוּעָתִ֑י יוֹם־צָעַ֖קְתִּי בַלַּ֣יְלָה נֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: Yahweh, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.

A Song, a Psalm, by sons of Korah, to the Overseer, 'Concerning the Sickness of Afflictions.' — An instruction, by Heman the Ezrahite. O Jehovah, God of my salvation, Daily I have cried, nightly before Thee,
Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.
My prayer cometh in before Thee, Incline Thine ear to my loud cry,

88.he: כִּֽי־שָֽׂבְעָ֣ה בְרָע֣וֹת נַפְשִׁ֑י וְ֝חַיַּ֗י לִשְׁא֥וֹל הִגִּֽיעוּ׃

lines.text: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.
For my soul hath been full of evils, And my life hath come to Sheol.

88.he: נֶ֭חְשַׁבְתִּי עִם־י֣וֹרְדֵי ב֑וֹר הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כְּגֶ֣בֶר אֵֽין־אֱיָֽל׃

lines.text: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,
I have been reckoned with those going down [to] the pit, I have been as a man without strength.

88.he: בַּמֵּתִ֗ים חָ֫פְשִׁ֥י כְּמ֤וֹ חֲלָלִ֨ים ׀ שֹׁ֥כְבֵי קֶ֗בֶר אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹ֣א זְכַרְתָּ֣ם ע֑וֹד וְ֝הֵ֗מָּה מִיָּדְךָ֥ נִגְזָֽרוּ׃

lines.text: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.
Among the dead — free, As pierced ones lying in the grave, Whom Thou hast not remembered any more, Yea, they by Thy hand have been cut off.
You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.
Thou hast put me in the lowest pit, In dark places, in depths.

88.he: עָ֭לַי סָמְכָ֣ה חֲמָתֶ֑ךָ וְכָל־מִ֝שְׁבָּרֶ֗יךָ עִנִּ֥יתָ סֶּֽלָה׃

lines.text: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves.
Upon me hath Thy fury lain, And [with] all Thy breakers Thou hast afflicted. Selah.

88.he: הִרְחַ֥קְתָּ מְיֻדָּעַ֗י מִ֫מֶּ֥נִּי שַׁתַּ֣נִי תוֹעֵב֣וֹת לָ֑מוֹ כָּ֝לֻ֗א וְלֹ֣א אֵצֵֽא׃

lines.text: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.
Thou hast put mine acquaintance far from me, Thou hast made me an abomination to them, Shut up — I go not forth.

88.he: עֵינִ֥י דָאֲבָ֗ה מִנִּ֫י עֹ֥נִי קְרָאתִ֣יךָ יְהוָ֣ה בְּכָל־י֑וֹם שִׁטַּ֖חְתִּי אֵלֶ֣יךָ כַפָּֽי׃

lines.text: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, Yahweh. I have spread out my hands to you.
Mine eye hath grieved because of affliction, I called Thee, O Jehovah, all the day, I have spread out unto Thee my hands.

88.he: הֲלַמֵּתִ֥ים תַּעֲשֶׂה־פֶּ֑לֶא אִם־רְ֝פָאִ֗ים יָק֤וּמוּ ׀ יוֹד֬וּךָ סֶּֽלָה׃

lines.text: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you?
To the dead dost Thou do wonders? Do Rephaim rise? do they thank Thee? Selah.
Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?
Is Thy kindness recounted in the grave? Thy faithfulness in destruction?

88.he: הֲיִוָּדַ֣ע בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ פִּלְאֶ֑ךָ וְ֝צִדְקָתְךָ֗ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ נְשִׁיָּֽה׃

lines.text: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
Are Thy wonders known in the darkness? And Thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

88.he: וַאֲנִ֤י ׀ אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְהוָ֣ה שִׁוַּ֑עְתִּי וּ֝בַבֹּ֗קֶר תְּֽפִלָּתִ֥י תְקַדְּמֶֽךָּ׃

lines.text: But to you, Yahweh, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.
And I, unto Thee, O Jehovah, I have cried, And in the morning doth my prayer come before Thee.

88.he: לָמָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תִּזְנַ֣ח נַפְשִׁ֑י תַּסְתִּ֖יר פָּנֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

lines.text: Yahweh, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?
Why, O Jehovah, castest Thou off my soul? Thou hidest Thy face from me.

88.he: עָ֘נִ֤י אֲנִ֣י וְגֹוֵ֣עַ מִנֹּ֑עַר נָשָׂ֖אתִי אֵמֶ֣יךָ אָפֽוּנָה׃

lines.text: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.
I [am] afflicted, and expiring from youth, I have borne Thy terrors — I pine away.
Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.
Over me hath Thy wrath passed, Thy terrors have cut me off,

88.he: סַבּ֣וּנִי כַ֭מַּיִם כָּל־הַיּ֑וֹם הִקִּ֖יפוּ עָלַ֣י יָֽחַד׃

lines.text: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.
They have surrounded me as waters all the day, They have gone round against me together,

88.he: הִרְחַ֣קְתָּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי אֹהֵ֣ב וָרֵ֑עַ מְֽיֻדָּעַ֥י מַחְשָֽׁךְ׃

lines.text: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.
Thou hast put far from me lover and friend, Mine acquaintance [is] the place of darkness!

89.he: מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל לְאֵיתָ֥ן הָֽאֶזְרָחִֽי׃

lines.text: An instruction, by Ethan the Ezrahite. Of the kind acts of Jehovah, to the age I sing, To all generations I make known Thy faithfulness with my mouth,

89.he: חַֽסְדֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה עוֹלָ֣ם אָשִׁ֑ירָה לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֓ר ׀ אוֹדִ֖יעַ אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ בְּפִֽי׃

lines.text: I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
