An instruction, by Ethan the Ezrahite. Of the kind acts of Jehovah, to the age I sing, To all generations I make known Thy faithfulness with my mouth,

89.he: כִּֽי־אָמַ֗רְתִּי ע֭וֹלָם חֶ֣סֶד יִבָּנֶ֑ה שָׁמַ֓יִם ׀ תָּכִ֖ן אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ בָהֶֽם׃

lines.text: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”
For I said, 'To the age is kindness built, The heavens! Thou dost establish Thy faithfulness in them.'

89.he: כָּרַ֣תִּֽי בְ֭רִית לִבְחִירִ֑י נִ֝שְׁבַּ֗עְתִּי לְדָוִ֥ד עַבְדִּֽי׃

lines.text: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,
I have made a covenant for My chosen, I have sworn to David My servant:

89.he: עַד־ע֭וֹלָם אָכִ֣ין זַרְעֶ֑ךָ וּבָנִ֨יתִי לְדֹר־וָד֖וֹר כִּסְאֲךָ֣ סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’ ”
'Even to the age do I establish thy seed, And have built to generation and generation thy throne. Selah.

89.he: וְי֘וֹד֤וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם פִּלְאֲךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה אַף־אֱ֝מֽוּנָתְךָ֗ בִּקְהַ֥ל קְדֹשִֽׁים׃

lines.text: The heavens will praise your wonders, Yahweh, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
and the heavens confess Thy wonders, O Jehovah, Thy faithfulness also [is] in an assembly of holy ones.

89.he: כִּ֤י מִ֣י בַ֭שַּׁחַק יַעֲרֹ֣ךְ לַיהוָ֑ה יִדְמֶ֥ה לַ֝יהוָ֗ה בִּבְנֵ֥י אֵלִים׃

lines.text: For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like Yahweh,
For who in the sky, Compareth himself to Jehovah? Is like to Jehovah among sons of the mighty?

89.he: אֵ֣ל נַ֭עֲרָץ בְּסוֹד־קְדֹשִׁ֣ים רַבָּ֑ה וְ֝נוֹרָ֗א עַל־כָּל־סְבִיבָֽיו׃

lines.text: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?
God is very terrible, In the secret counsel of His holy ones, And fearful over all surrounding Him.

89.he: יְהוָ֤ה ׀ אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י צְבָא֗וֹת מִֽי־כָֽמ֖וֹךָ חֲסִ֥ין ׀ יָ֑הּ וֶ֝אֱמ֥וּנָתְךָ֗ סְבִיבוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Yahweh, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? Yah, your faithfulness is around you.
O Jehovah, God of Hosts, Who [is] like Thee — a strong Jah? And Thy faithfulness [is] round about Thee.

89.he: אַתָּ֣ה מ֭וֹשֵׁל בְּגֵא֣וּת הַיָּ֑ם בְּשׂ֥וֹא גַ֝לָּ֗יו אַתָּ֥ה תְשַׁבְּחֵֽם׃

lines.text: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.
Thou [art] ruler over the pride of the sea, In the lifting up of its billows Thou dost restrain them.

89.he: אַתָּ֤ה דִכִּ֣אתָ כֶחָלָ֣ל רָ֑הַב בִּזְר֥וֹעַ עֻ֝זְּךָ֗ פִּזַּ֥רְתָּ אוֹיְבֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.
Thou hast bruised Rahab, as one wounded. With the arm of Thy strength Thou hast scattered Thine enemies.

89.he: לְךָ֣ שָׁ֭מַיִם אַף־לְךָ֥ אָ֑רֶץ תֵּבֵ֥ל וּ֝מְלֹאָ֗הּ אַתָּ֥ה יְסַדְתָּֽם׃

lines.text: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them.
Thine [are] the heavens — the earth also [is] Thine, The habitable world and its fulness, Thou hast founded them.

89.he: צָפ֣וֹן וְ֭יָמִין אַתָּ֣ה בְרָאתָ֑ם תָּב֥וֹר וְ֝חֶרְמ֗וֹן בְּשִׁמְךָ֥ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃

lines.text: You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.
North and south Thou hast appointed them, Tabor and Hermon in Thy name do sing.

89.he: לְךָ֣ זְ֭רוֹעַ עִם־גְּבוּרָ֑ה תָּעֹ֥ז יָ֝דְךָ֗ תָּר֥וּם יְמִינֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.
Thou hast an arm with might, Strong is Thy hand — high Thy right hand.

89.he: צֶ֣דֶק וּ֭מִשְׁפָּט מְכ֣וֹן כִּסְאֶ֑ךָ חֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝אֱמֶ֗ת יְֽקַדְּמ֥וּ פָנֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.
Righteousness and judgment [Are] the fixed place of Thy throne, Kindness and truth go before Thy face.

89.he: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הָ֭עָם יוֹדְעֵ֣י תְרוּעָ֑ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה בְּֽאוֹר־פָּנֶ֥יךָ יְהַלֵּכֽוּן׃

lines.text: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, Yahweh.
O the happiness of the people knowing the shout, O Jehovah, in the light of Thy face they walk habitually.

89.he: בְּ֭שִׁמְךָ יְגִיל֣וּן כָּל־הַיּ֑וֹם וּבְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ יָרֽוּמוּ׃

lines.text: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.
In Thy name they rejoice all the day, And in Thy righteousness they are exalted,

89.he: כִּֽי־תִפְאֶ֣רֶת עֻזָּ֣מוֹ אָ֑תָּה וּ֝בִרְצֹנְךָ֗ תרים קַרְנֵֽנוּ׃

lines.text: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.
For the beauty of their strength [art] Thou, And in Thy good will is our horn exalted,

89.he: כִּ֣י לַֽ֭יהוָה מָֽגִנֵּ֑נוּ וְלִקְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מַלְכֵּֽנוּ׃

lines.text: For our shield belongs to Yahweh, our king to the Holy One of Israel.
For of Jehovah [is] our shield, And of the Holy One of Israel our king.

89.he: אָ֤ז דִּבַּ֥רְתָּֽ־בְחָז֡וֹן לַֽחֲסִידֶ֗יךָ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר שִׁוִּ֣יתִי עֵ֭זֶר עַל־גִּבּ֑וֹר הֲרִימ֖וֹתִי בָח֣וּר מֵעָֽם׃

lines.text: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.
Then Thou hast spoken in vision, To Thy saint, yea, Thou sayest, I have placed help upon a mighty one, Exalted a chosen one out of the people,

89.he: מָ֭צָאתִי דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֑י בְּשֶׁ֖מֶן קָדְשִׁ֣י מְשַׁחְתִּֽיו׃

lines.text: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,
I have found David My servant, With My holy oil I have anointed him.

89.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָ֭דִי תִּכּ֣וֹן עִמּ֑וֹ אַף־זְרוֹעִ֥י תְאַמְּצֶֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.
With whom My hand is established, My arm also doth strengthen him.

89.he: לֹֽא־יַשִּׁ֣א אוֹיֵ֣ב בּ֑וֹ וּבֶן־עַ֝וְלָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְעַנֶּֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.
An enemy exacteth not upon him, And a son of perverseness afflicteth him not.

89.he: וְכַתּוֹתִ֣י מִפָּנָ֣יו צָרָ֑יו וּמְשַׂנְאָ֥יו אֶגּֽוֹף׃

lines.text: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.
And I have beaten down before him his adversaries, And those hating him I plague,

89.he: וֶֽאֶֽמוּנָתִ֣י וְחַסְדִּ֣י עִמּ֑וֹ וּ֝בִשְׁמִ֗י תָּר֥וּם קַרְנֽוֹ׃

lines.text: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.
And My faithfulness and kindness [are] with him, And in My name is his horn exalted.

89.he: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י בַיָּ֣ם יָד֑וֹ וּֽבַנְּהָר֥וֹת יְמִינֽוֹ׃

lines.text: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.
And I have set on the sea his hand, And on the rivers his right hand.

89.he: ה֣וּא יִ֭קְרָאֵנִי אָ֣בִי אָ֑תָּה אֵ֝לִ֗י וְצ֣וּר יְשׁוּעָתִֽי׃

lines.text: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’
He proclaimeth me: 'Thou [art] my Father, My God, and the rock of my salvation.'

89.he: אַף־אָ֭נִי בְּכ֣וֹר אֶתְּנֵ֑הוּ עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן לְמַלְכֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
I also first-born do appoint him, Highest of the kings of the earth.

89.he: לְ֭עוֹלָ֗ם אשמור־ל֣וֹ חַסְדִּ֑י וּ֝בְרִיתִ֗י נֶאֱמֶ֥נֶת לֽוֹ׃

lines.text: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.
To the age I keep for him My kindness, And My covenant [is] stedfast with him.

89.he: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י לָעַ֣ד זַרְע֑וֹ וְ֝כִסְא֗וֹ כִּימֵ֥י שָׁמָֽיִם׃

lines.text: I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
And I have set his seed for ever, And his throne as the days of the heavens.

89.he: אִם־יַֽעַזְב֣וּ בָ֭נָיו תּוֹרָתִ֑י וּ֝בְמִשְׁפָּטַ֗י לֹ֣א יֵלֵכֽוּן׃

lines.text: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;
If his sons forsake My law, And in My judgments do not walk;

89.he: אִם־חֻקֹּתַ֥י יְחַלֵּ֑לוּ וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י לֹ֣א יִשְׁמֹֽרוּ׃

lines.text: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;
If My statutes they pollute, And My commands do not keep,

89.he: וּפָקַדְתִּ֣י בְשֵׁ֣בֶט פִּשְׁעָ֑ם וּבִנְגָעִ֥ים עֲוֺנָֽם׃

lines.text: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
I have looked after with a rod their transgression, And with strokes their iniquity,

89.he: וְ֭חַסְדִּי לֹֽא־אָפִ֣יר מֵֽעִמּ֑וֹ וְלֹֽא־אֲ֝שַׁקֵּ֗ר בֶּאֱמוּנָתִֽי׃

lines.text: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.
And My kindness I break not from him, Nor do I deal falsely in My faithfulness.

89.he: לֹא־אֲחַלֵּ֥ל בְּרִיתִ֑י וּמוֹצָ֥א שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י לֹ֣א אֲשַׁנֶּֽה׃

lines.text: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.
I profane not My covenant, And that which is going forth from My lips I change not.

89.he: אַ֭חַת נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתִּי בְקָדְשִׁ֑י אִֽם־לְדָוִ֥ד אֲכַזֵּֽב׃

lines.text: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.
Once I have sworn by My holiness, I lie not to David,

89.he: זַ֭רְעוֹ לְעוֹלָ֣ם יִהְיֶ֑ה וְכִסְא֖וֹ כַשֶּׁ֣מֶשׁ נֶגְדִּֽי׃

lines.text: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.
His seed is to the age, And his throne [is] as the sun before Me,

89.he: כְּ֭יָרֵחַ יִכּ֣וֹן עוֹלָ֑ם וְעֵ֥ד בַּ֝שַּׁ֗חַק נֶאֱמָ֥ן סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.”
As the moon it is established — to the age, And the witness in the sky is stedfast. Selah.

89.he: וְאַתָּ֣ה זָ֭נַחְתָּ וַתִּמְאָ֑ס הִ֝תְעַבַּ֗רְתָּ עִם־מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.
And Thou, Thou hast cast off, and dost reject, Thou hast shown Thyself wroth With Thine anointed,

89.he: נֵ֭אַרְתָּה בְּרִ֣ית עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ חִלַּ֖לְתָּ לָאָ֣רֶץ נִזְרֽוֹ׃

lines.text: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.
Hast rejected the covenant of Thy servant, Thou hast polluted to the earth his crown,

89.he: פָּרַ֥צְתָּ כָל־גְּדֵרֹתָ֑יו שַׂ֖מְתָּ מִבְצָרָ֣יו מְחִתָּה׃

lines.text: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.
Thou hast broken down all his hedges, Thou hast made his fenced places a ruin.

89.he: שַׁ֭סֻּהוּ כָּל־עֹ֣בְרֵי דָ֑רֶךְ הָיָ֥ה חֶ֝רְפָּ֗ה לִשְׁכֵנָֽיו׃

lines.text: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.
Spoiled him have all passing by the way, He hath been a reproach to his neighbours,

89.he: הֲ֭רִימוֹתָ יְמִ֣ין צָרָ֑יו הִ֝שְׂמַ֗חְתָּ כָּל־אוֹיְבָֽיו׃

lines.text: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.
Thou hast exalted the right hand of his adversaries, Thou hast caused all his enemies to rejoice.

89.he: אַף־תָּ֭שִׁיב צ֣וּר חַרְבּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א הֲ֝קֵימֹת֗וֹ בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃

lines.text: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.
Also — Thou turnest back the sharpness of his sword, And hast not established him in battle,

89.he: הִשְׁבַּ֥תָּ מִטְּהָר֑וֹ וְ֝כִסְא֗וֹ לָאָ֥רֶץ מִגַּֽרְתָּה׃

lines.text: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.
Hast caused [him] to cease from his brightness, And his throne to the earth hast cast down.

89.he: הִ֭קְצַרְתָּ יְמֵ֣י עֲלוּמָ֑יו הֶֽעֱטִ֨יתָ עָלָ֖יו בּוּשָׁ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame.
Thou hast shortened the days of his youth, Hast covered him over [with] shame. Selah.

89.he: עַד־מָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תִּסָּתֵ֣ר לָנֶ֑צַח תִּבְעַ֖ר כְּמוֹ־אֵ֣שׁ חֲמָתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: How long, Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?
Till when, O Jehovah, art Thou hidden? For ever doth Thy fury burn as fire?

89.he: זְכָר־אֲנִ֥י מֶה־חָ֑לֶד עַל־מַה־שָּׁ֝֗וְא בָּרָ֥אתָ כָל־בְּנֵי־אָדָֽם׃

lines.text: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!
Remember, I pray Thee, what [is] life-time? Wherefore in vain hast Thou created All the sons of men?

89.he: מִ֤י גֶ֣בֶר יִֽ֭חְיֶה וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֶה־מָּ֑וֶת יְמַלֵּ֨ט נַפְשׁ֖וֹ מִיַּד־שְׁא֣וֹל סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol?
Who [is] the man that liveth, and doth not see death? He delivereth his soul from the hand of Sheol. Selah.

89.he: אַיֵּ֤ה ׀ חֲסָדֶ֖יךָ הָרִאשֹׁנִ֥ים ׀ אֲדֹנָ֑י נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתָּ לְ֝דָוִ֗ד בֶּאֱמוּנָתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?
Where [are] Thy former kindnesses, O Lord. Thou hast sworn to David in Thy faithfulness,

89.he: זְכֹ֣ר אֲ֭דֹנָי חֶרְפַּ֣ת עֲבָדֶ֑יךָ שְׂאֵתִ֥י בְ֝חֵיקִ֗י כָּל־רַבִּ֥ים עַמִּֽים׃

lines.text: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,
Remember, O Lord, the reproach of Thy servants, I have borne in my bosom all the strivings of the peoples,

89.he: אֲשֶׁ֤ר חֵרְפ֖וּ אוֹיְבֶ֥יךָ ׀ יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר חֵ֝רְפ֗וּ עִקְּב֥וֹת מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: With which your enemies have mocked, Yahweh, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.
Wherewith Thine enemies reproached, O Jehovah, Wherewith they have reproached The steps of Thine anointed.

89.he: בָּר֖וּךְ יְהוָ֥ה לְ֝עוֹלָ֗ם אָ֘מֵ֥ן ׀ וְאָמֵֽן׃

lines.text: Blessed be Yahweh forever more. Amen, and Amen.
Blessed [is] Jehovah to the age. Amen, and amen!

90.he: תְּפִלָּה֮ לְמֹשֶׁ֪ה אִֽישׁ־הָאֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים אֲֽדֹנָ֗י מָע֣וֹן אַ֭תָּה הָיִ֥יתָ לָּ֗נוּ בְּדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃

lines.text: Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.
A Prayer of Moses, the man of God. Lord, a habitation Thou — Thou hast been, To us — in generation and generation,

90.he: בְּטֶ֤רֶם ׀ הָ֘רִ֤ים יֻלָּ֗דוּ וַתְּח֣וֹלֵֽל אֶ֣רֶץ וְתֵבֵ֑ל וּֽמֵעוֹלָ֥ם עַד־ע֝וֹלָ֗ם אַתָּ֥ה אֵֽל׃

lines.text: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.
Before mountains were brought forth, And Thou dost form the earth and the world, Even from age unto age Thou [art] God.

90.he: תָּשֵׁ֣ב אֱ֭נוֹשׁ עַד־דַּכָּ֑א וַ֝תֹּ֗אמֶר שׁ֣וּבוּ בְנֵי־אָדָֽם׃

lines.text: You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”
Thou turnest man unto a bruised thing, And sayest, Turn back, ye sons of men.

90.he: כִּ֤י אֶ֪לֶף שָׁנִ֡ים בְּֽעֵינֶ֗יךָ כְּי֣וֹם אֶ֭תְמוֹל כִּ֣י יַעֲבֹ֑ר וְאַשְׁמוּרָ֥ה בַלָּֽיְלָה׃

lines.text: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.
For a thousand years in Thine eyes [are] as yesterday, For it passeth on, yea, a watch by night.

90.he: זְ֭רַמְתָּם שֵׁנָ֣ה יִהְי֑וּ בַּ֝בֹּ֗קֶר כֶּחָצִ֥יר יַחֲלֹֽף׃

lines.text: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.
Thou hast inundated them, they are asleep, In the morning as grass he changeth.

90.he: בַּ֭בֹּקֶר יָצִ֣יץ וְחָלָ֑ף לָ֝עֶ֗רֶב יְמוֹלֵ֥ל וְיָבֵֽשׁ׃

lines.text: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.
In the morning it flourisheth, and hath changed, At evening it is cut down, and hath withered.
For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.
For we were consumed in Thine anger, And in Thy fury we have been troubled.

90.he: שת עֲוֺנֹתֵ֣ינוּ לְנֶגְדֶּ֑ךָ עֲ֝לֻמֵ֗נוּ לִמְא֥וֹר פָּנֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.
Thou hast set our iniquities before Thee, Our hidden things at the light of Thy face,

90.he: כִּ֣י כָל־יָ֭מֵינוּ פָּנ֣וּ בְעֶבְרָתֶ֑ךָ כִּלִּ֖ינוּ שָׁנֵ֣ינוּ כְמוֹ־הֶֽגֶה׃

lines.text: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.
For all our days pined away in Thy wrath, We consumed our years as a meditation.

90.he: יְמֵֽי־שְׁנוֹתֵ֨ינוּ בָהֶ֥ם שִׁבְעִ֪ים שָׁנָ֡ה וְאִ֤ם בִּגְבוּרֹ֨ת ׀ שְׁמ֘וֹנִ֤ים שָׁנָ֗ה וְ֭רָהְבָּם עָמָ֣ל וָאָ֑וֶן כִּי־גָ֥ז חִ֝֗ישׁ וַנָּעֻֽפָה׃

lines.text: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.
Days of our years, in them [are] seventy years, And if, by reason of might, eighty years, Yet [is] their enlargement labour and vanity, For it hath been cut off hastily, and we fly away.
Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?
Who knoweth the power of Thine anger? And according to Thy fear — Thy wrath?

90.he: לִמְנ֣וֹת יָ֭מֵינוּ כֵּ֣ן הוֹדַ֑ע וְ֝נָבִ֗א לְבַ֣ב חָכְמָֽה׃

lines.text: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
To number our days aright let [us] know, And we bring the heart to wisdom.
Relent, Yahweh! How long? Have compassion on your servants!
Turn back, O Jehovah, till when? And repent concerning Thy servants.

90.he: שַׂבְּעֵ֣נוּ בַבֹּ֣קֶר חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וּֽנְרַנְּנָ֥ה וְ֝נִשְׂמְחָ֗ה בְּכָל־יָמֵֽינוּ׃

lines.text: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
Satisfy us at morn [with] Thy kindness, And we sing and rejoice all our days.

90.he: שַׂ֭מְּחֵנוּ כִּימ֣וֹת עִנִּיתָ֑נוּ שְׁ֝נ֗וֹת רָאִ֥ינוּ רָעָֽה׃

lines.text: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
Cause us to rejoice according to the days Wherein Thou hast afflicted us, The years we have seen evil.
Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children.
Let Thy work appear unto Thy servants, And Thine honour on their sons.

90.he: וִיהִ֤י ׀ נֹ֤עַם אֲדֹנָ֥י אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ עָ֫לֵ֥ינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָ֭דֵינוּ כּוֹנְנָ֥ה עָלֵ֑ינוּ וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָ֝דֵ֗ינוּ כּוֹנְנֵֽהוּ׃

lines.text: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.
And let the pleasantness of Jehovah our God be upon us, And the work of our hands establish on us, Yea, the work of our hands establish it!

91.he: יֹ֭שֵׁב בְּסֵ֣תֶר עֶלְי֑וֹן בְּצֵ֥ל שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יִתְלוֹנָֽן׃

lines.text: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
He who is dwelling In the secret place of the Most High, In the shade of the Mighty lodgeth habitually,

91.he: אֹמַ֗ר לַֽ֭יהוָה מַחְסִ֣י וּמְצוּדָתִ֑י אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אֶבְטַח־בּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
He is saying of Jehovah, 'My refuge, and my bulwark, my God, I trust in Him,'

91.he: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא יַ֭צִּֽילְךָ מִפַּ֥ח יָק֗וּשׁ מִדֶּ֥בֶר הַוּֽוֹת׃

lines.text: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.
For He delivereth thee from the snare of a fowler, From a calamitous pestilence.

91.he: בְּאֶבְרָת֨וֹ ׀ יָ֣סֶךְ לָ֭ךְ וְתַֽחַת־כְּנָפָ֣יו תֶּחְסֶ֑ה צִנָּ֖ה וְֽסֹחֵרָ֣ה אֲמִתּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.
With His pinion He covereth thee over, And under His wings thou dost trust, A shield and buckler [is] His truth.

91.he: לֹא־תִ֭ירָא מִפַּ֣חַד לָ֑יְלָה מֵ֝חֵ֗ץ יָע֥וּף יוֹמָֽם׃

lines.text: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day,
Thou art not afraid of fear by night, Of arrow that flieth by day,

91.he: מִ֭דֶּבֶר בָּאֹ֣פֶל יַהֲלֹ֑ךְ מִ֝קֶּ֗טֶב יָשׁ֥וּד צָהֳרָֽיִם׃

lines.text: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.
Of pestilence in thick darkness that walketh, Of destruction that destroyeth at noon,

91.he: יִפֹּ֤ל מִצִּדְּךָ֨ ׀ אֶ֗לֶף וּרְבָבָ֥ה מִימִינֶ֑ךָ אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִגָּֽשׁ׃

lines.text: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.
There fall at thy side a thousand, And a myriad at thy right hand, Unto thee it cometh not nigh.

91.he: רַ֭ק בְּעֵינֶ֣יךָ תַבִּ֑יט וְשִׁלֻּמַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּרְאֶֽה׃

lines.text: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.
But with thine eyes thou lookest, And the reward of the wicked thou seest,

91.he: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה מַחְסִ֑י עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן שַׂ֣מְתָּ מְעוֹנֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Because you have made Yahweh your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,
(For Thou, O Jehovah, [art] my refuge,) The Most High thou madest thy habitation.

91.he: לֹֽא־תְאֻנֶּ֣ה אֵלֶ֣יךָ רָעָ֑ה וְ֝נֶ֗גַע לֹא־יִקְרַ֥ב בְּאָהֳלֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.
Evil happeneth not unto thee, And a plague cometh not near thy tent,
For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.
For His messengers He chargeth for thee, To keep thee in all thy ways,
They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.
On the hands they bear thee up, Lest thou smite against a stone thy foot.

91.he: עַל־שַׁ֣חַל וָפֶ֣תֶן תִּדְרֹ֑ךְ תִּרְמֹ֖ס כְּפִ֣יר וְתַנִּֽין׃

lines.text: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.
On lion and asp thou treadest, Thou trampest young lion and dragon.

91.he: כִּ֤י בִ֣י חָ֭שַׁק וַאֲפַלְּטֵ֑הוּ אֲ֝שַׂגְּבֵ֗הוּ כִּֽי־יָדַ֥ע שְׁמִֽי׃

lines.text: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.
Because in Me he hath delighted, I also deliver him — I set him on high, Because he hath known My name.

91.he: יִקְרָאֵ֨נִי ׀ וְֽאֶעֱנֵ֗הוּ עִמּֽוֹ־אָנֹכִ֥י בְצָרָ֑ה אֲ֝חַלְּצֵ֗הוּ וַֽאֲכַבְּדֵֽהוּ׃

lines.text: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.
He doth call Me, and I answer him, I [am] with him in distress, I deliver him, and honour him.
I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”
With length of days I satisfy him, And I cause him to look on My salvation!
A Psalm. — A Song for the sabbath-day. Good to give thanks to Jehovah, And to sing praises to Thy name, O Most High,

92.he: ט֗וֹב לְהֹד֥וֹת לַיהוָ֑ה וּלְזַמֵּ֖ר לְשִׁמְךָ֣ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃

lines.text: It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh, to sing praises to your name, Most High,
A Psalm. — A Song for the sabbath-day. Good to give thanks to Jehovah, And to sing praises to Thy name, O Most High,
to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,
To declare in the morning Thy kindness, And Thy faithfulness in the nights.
with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.
On ten strings and on psaltery, On higgaion, with harp.

92.he: כִּ֤י שִׂמַּחְתַּ֣נִי יְהוָ֣ה בְּפָעֳלֶ֑ךָ בְּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖י יָדֶ֣יךָ אֲרַנֵּֽן׃

lines.text: For you, Yahweh, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.
For Thou hast caused me to rejoice, O Jehovah, in Thy work, Concerning the works of Thy hands I sing.

92.he: מַה־גָּדְל֣וּ מַעֲשֶׂ֣יךָ יְהוָ֑ה מְ֝אֹ֗ד עָמְק֥וּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: How great are your works, Yahweh! Your thoughts are very deep.
How great have been Thy works, O Jehovah, Very deep have been Thy thoughts.

92.he: אִֽישׁ־בַּ֭עַר לֹ֣א יֵדָ֑ע וּ֝כְסִ֗יל לֹא־יָבִ֥ין אֶת־זֹֽאת׃

lines.text: A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:
A brutish man doth not know, And a fool understandeth not this; —

92.he: בִּפְרֹ֤חַ רְשָׁעִ֨ים ׀ כְּמ֥וֹ עֵ֗שֶׂב וַ֭יָּצִיצוּ כָּל־פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן לְהִשָּֽׁמְדָ֥ם עֲדֵי־עַֽד׃

lines.text: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
When the wicked flourish as a herb, And blossom do all workers of iniquity — For their being destroyed for ever and ever!
But you, Yahweh, are on high forever more.
And Thou [art] high to the age, O Jehovah.

92.he: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה אֹיְבֶ֡יךָ ׀ יְֽהוָ֗ה כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֣ה אֹיְבֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ יִ֝תְפָּרְד֗וּ כָּל־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

lines.text: For, behold, your enemies, Yahweh, for, behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.
For, lo, Thine enemies, O Jehovah, For, lo, Thine enemies, do perish, Separate themselves do all workers of iniquity.

92.he: וַתָּ֣רֶם כִּרְאֵ֣ים קַרְנִ֑י בַּ֝לֹּתִ֗י בְּשֶׁ֣מֶן רַעֲנָֽן׃

lines.text: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.
And Thou exaltest as a reem my horn, I have been anointed with fresh oil.

92.he: וַתַּבֵּ֥ט עֵינִ֗י בְּשׁ֫וּרָ֥י בַּקָּמִ֖ים עָלַ֥י מְרֵעִ֗ים תִּשְׁמַ֥עְנָה אָזְנָֽי׃

lines.text: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.
And mine eye looketh on mine enemies, Of those rising up against me, The evil doers, do mine ears hear.

92.he: צַ֭דִּיק כַּתָּמָ֣ר יִפְרָ֑ח כְּאֶ֖רֶז בַּלְּבָנ֣וֹן יִשְׂגֶּֽה׃

lines.text: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
The righteous as a palm-tree flourisheth, As a cedar in Lebanon he groweth.

92.he: שְׁ֭תוּלִים בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בְּחַצְר֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ יַפְרִֽיחוּ׃

lines.text: They are planted in Yahweh’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.
Those planted in the house of Jehovah, In the courts of our God do flourish.

92.he: ע֭וֹד יְנוּב֣וּן בְּשֵׂיבָ֑ה דְּשֵׁנִ֖ים וְרַֽעֲנַנִּ֣ים יִהְיֽוּ׃

lines.text: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,
Still they bring forth in old age, Fat and flourishing are they,

92.he: לְ֭הַגִּיד כִּֽי־יָשָׁ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה צ֝וּרִ֗י וְֽלֹא־עלתה בּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: to show that Yahweh is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
To declare that upright [is] Jehovah my rock, And there is no perverseness in Him!

93.he: יְהוָ֣ה מָלָךְ֮ גֵּא֪וּת לָ֫בֵ֥שׁ לָבֵ֣שׁ יְ֭הוָה עֹ֣ז הִתְאַזָּ֑ר אַף־תִּכּ֥וֹן תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל בַּל־תִּמּֽוֹט׃

lines.text: Yahweh reigns! He is clothed with majesty! Yahweh is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.
Jehovah hath reigned, Excellency He hath put on, Jehovah put on strength, He girded Himself, Also — established is the world, unmoved.
Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.
Established is Thy throne since then, From the age Thou [art].

93.he: נָשְׂא֤וּ נְהָר֨וֹת ׀ יְֽהוָ֗ה נָשְׂא֣וּ נְהָר֣וֹת קוֹלָ֑ם יִשְׂא֖וּ נְהָר֣וֹת דָּכְיָֽם׃

lines.text: The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
Floods have lifted up, O Jehovah, Floods have lifted up their voice, Floods lift up their breakers.

93.he: מִקֹּל֨וֹת ׀ מַ֤יִם רַבִּ֗ים אַדִּירִ֣ים מִשְׁבְּרֵי־יָ֑ם אַדִּ֖יר בַּמָּר֣וֹם יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.
Than the voices of many mighty waters, Breakers of a sea, mighty on high [is] Jehovah,

93.he: עֵֽדֹתֶ֨יךָ ׀ נֶאֶמְנ֬וּ מְאֹ֗ד לְבֵיתְךָ֥ נַאֲוָה־קֹ֑דֶשׁ יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְאֹ֣רֶךְ יָמִֽים׃

lines.text: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, Yahweh, forever more.
Thy testimonies have been very stedfast, To Thy house comely [is] holiness, O Jehovah, for length of days!

94.he: אֵל־נְקָמ֥וֹת יְהוָ֑ה אֵ֖ל נְקָמ֣וֹת הוֹפִֽיַע׃

lines.text: Yahweh, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.
God of vengeance — Jehovah! God of vengeance, shine forth.

94.he: הִ֭נָּשֵׂא שֹׁפֵ֣ט הָאָ֑רֶץ הָשֵׁ֥ב גְּ֝מ֗וּל עַל־גֵּאִֽים׃

lines.text: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.
Be lifted up, O Judge of the earth, Send back a recompence on the proud.

94.he: עַד־מָתַ֖י רְשָׁעִ֥ים ׀ יְהוָ֑ה עַד־מָ֝תַ֗י רְשָׁעִ֥ים יַעֲלֹֽזוּ׃

lines.text: Yahweh, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?
Till when [do] the wicked, O Jehovah? Till when do the wicked exult?

94.he: יַבִּ֣יעוּ יְדַבְּר֣וּ עָתָ֑ק יִֽ֝תְאַמְּר֗וּ כָּל־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

lines.text: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.
They utter — they speak an old saw, All working iniquity do boast themselves.

94.he: עַמְּךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה יְדַכְּא֑וּ וְֽנַחֲלָתְךָ֥ יְעַנּֽוּ׃

lines.text: They break your people in pieces, Yahweh, and afflict your heritage.
Thy people, O Jehovah, they bruise, And Thine inheritance they afflict.

94.he: אַ֭לְמָנָה וְגֵ֣ר יַהֲרֹ֑גוּ וִ֖יתוֹמִ֣ים יְרַצֵּֽחוּ׃

lines.text: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.
Widow and sojourner they slay, And fatherless ones they murder.

94.he: וַ֭יֹּ֣אמְרוּ לֹ֣א יִרְאֶה־יָּ֑הּ וְלֹא־יָ֝בִ֗ין אֱלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃

lines.text: They say, “Yah will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”
And they say, 'Jehovah doth not see, And the God of Jacob doth not consider.'

94.he: בִּ֭ינוּ בֹּעֲרִ֣ים בָּעָ֑ם וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים מָתַ֥י תַּשְׂכִּֽילוּ׃

lines.text: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?
Consider, ye brutish among the people, And ye foolish, when do ye act wisely?

94.he: הֲנֹ֣טַֽע אֹ֭זֶן הֲלֹ֣א יִשְׁמָ֑ע אִֽם־יֹ֥צֵֽר עַ֝֗יִן הֲלֹ֣א יַבִּֽיט׃

lines.text: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?
He who planteth the ear doth He not hear? He who formeth the eye doth He not see?

94.he: הֲיֹסֵ֣ר גּ֭וֹיִם הֲלֹ֣א יוֹכִ֑יחַ הַֽמְלַמֵּ֖ד אָדָ֣ם דָּֽעַת׃

lines.text: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.
He who is instructing nations, Doth He not reprove? He who is teaching man knowledge [is] Jehovah.

94.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה יֹ֭דֵעַ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת אָדָ֑ם כִּי־הֵ֥מָּה הָֽבֶל׃

lines.text: Yahweh knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
He knoweth the thoughts of man, that they [are] vanity.

94.he: אַשְׁרֵ֤י ׀ הַגֶּ֣בֶר אֲשֶׁר־תְּיַסְּרֶ֣נּוּ יָּ֑הּ וּֽמִתּוֹרָתְךָ֥ תְלַמְּדֶֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah, and teach out of your law,
O the happiness of the man Whom Thou instructest, O Jah, And out of Thy law teachest him,

94.he: לְהַשְׁקִ֣יט ל֭וֹ מִ֣ימֵי רָ֑ע עַ֤ד יִכָּרֶ֖ה לָרָשָׁ֣ע שָֽׁחַת׃

lines.text: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.
To give rest to him from days of evil, While a pit is digged for the wicked.

94.he: כִּ֤י ׀ לֹא־יִטֹּ֣שׁ יְהוָ֣ה עַמּ֑וֹ וְ֝נַחֲלָת֗וֹ לֹ֣א יַעֲזֹֽב׃

lines.text: For Yahweh won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
For Jehovah leaveth not His people, And His inheritance forsaketh not.

94.he: כִּֽי־עַד־צֶ֭דֶק יָשׁ֣וּב מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ֝אַחֲרָ֗יו כָּל־יִשְׁרֵי־לֵֽב׃

lines.text: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.
For to righteousness judgment turneth back, And after it all the upright of heart,

94.he: מִֽי־יָק֣וּם לִ֭י עִם־מְרֵעִ֑ים מִֽי־יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב לִ֝י עִם־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

lines.text: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?
Who riseth up for me with evil doers? Who stationeth himself for me with workers of iniquity?

94.he: לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה עֶזְרָ֣תָה לִּ֑י כִּמְעַ֓ט ׀ שָֽׁכְנָ֖ה דוּמָ֣ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃

lines.text: Unless Yahweh had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.
Unless Jehovah [were] a help to me, My soul had almost inhabited silence.

94.he: אִם־אָ֭מַרְתִּי מָ֣טָה רַגְלִ֑י חַסְדְּךָ֥ יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִסְעָדֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.
If I have said, 'My foot hath slipped,' Thy kindness, O Jehovah, supporteth me.

94.he: בְּרֹ֣ב שַׂרְעַפַּ֣י בְּקִרְבִּ֑י תַּ֝נְחוּמֶ֗יךָ יְֽשַׁעַשְׁע֥וּ נַפְשִֽׁי׃

lines.text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
In the abundance of my thoughts within me, Thy comforts delight my soul.

94.he: הַֽ֭יְחָבְרְךָ כִּסֵּ֣א הַוּ֑וֹת יֹצֵ֖ר עָמָ֣ל עֲלֵי־חֹֽק׃

lines.text: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?
Is a throne of mischief joined [with] Thee? A framer of perverseness by statute?

94.he: יָ֭גוֹדּוּ עַל־נֶ֣פֶשׁ צַדִּ֑יק וְדָ֖ם נָקִ֣י יַרְשִֽׁיעוּ׃

lines.text: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
They decree against the soul of the righteous, And innocent blood declare wicked.

94.he: וַיְהִ֬י יְהוָ֣ה לִ֣י לְמִשְׂגָּ֑ב וֵ֝אלֹהַ֗י לְצ֣וּר מַחְסִֽי׃

lines.text: But Yahweh has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.
And Jehovah is for a high place to me, And my God [is] for a rock — my refuge,

94.he: וַיָּ֤שֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶ֨ם ׀ אֶת־אוֹנָ֗ם וּבְרָעָתָ֥ם יַצְמִיתֵ֑ם יַ֝צְמִיתֵ֗ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

lines.text: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. Yahweh, our God, will cut them off.
And turneth back on them their iniquity, And in their wickedness cutteth them off; Jehovah our God doth cut them off!

95.he: לְ֭כוּ נְרַנְּנָ֣ה לַיהוָ֑ה נָ֝רִ֗יעָה לְצ֣וּר יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ׃

lines.text: Oh come, let’s sing to Yahweh. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!
Come, we sing to Jehovah, We shout to the rock of our salvation.

95.he: נְקַדְּמָ֣ה פָנָ֣יו בְּתוֹדָ֑ה בִּ֝זְמִר֗וֹת נָרִ֥יעַֽ לֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!
We come before His face with thanksgiving, With psalms we shout to Him.

95.he: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ל גָּד֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וּמֶ֥לֶךְ גָּ֝ד֗וֹל עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃

lines.text: For Yahweh is a great God, a great King above all gods.
For a great God [is] Jehovah, And a great king over all gods.

95.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ֭יָדוֹ מֶחְקְרֵי־אָ֑רֶץ וְתוֹעֲפ֖וֹת הָרִ֣ים לֽוֹ׃

lines.text: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.
In whose hand [are] the deep places of earth, And the strong places of hills [are] His.

95.he: אֲשֶׁר־ל֣וֹ הַ֭יָּם וְה֣וּא עָשָׂ֑הוּ וְ֝יַבֶּ֗שֶׁת יָדָ֥יו יָצָֽרוּ׃

lines.text: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.
Whose is the sea, and He made it, And His hands formed the dry land.

95.he: בֹּ֭אוּ נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֣ה וְנִכְרָ֑עָה נִ֝בְרְכָ֗ה לִֽפְנֵי־יְהוָ֥ה עֹשֵֽׂנוּ׃

lines.text: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before Yahweh, our Maker,
Come in, we bow ourselves, and we bend, We kneel before Jehovah our Maker.

95.he: כִּ֘י ה֤וּא אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ עַ֣ם מַ֭רְעִיתוֹ וְצֹ֣אן יָד֑וֹ הַ֝יּ֗וֹם אִֽם־בְּקֹל֥וֹ תִשְׁמָֽעוּ׃

lines.text: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!
For He [is] our God, and we the people of His pasture, And the flock of His hand, To-day, if to His voice ye hearken,

95.he: אַל־תַּקְשׁ֣וּ לְ֭בַבְכֶם כִּמְרִיבָ֑ה כְּי֥וֹם מַ֝סָּ֗ה בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

lines.text: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,
Harden not your heart as [in] Meribah, As [in] the day of Massah in the wilderness,

95.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֭סּוּנִי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּ֝חָנ֗וּנִי גַּם־רָא֥וּ פָעֳלִֽי׃

lines.text: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.
Where your fathers have tried Me, Have proved Me, yea, have seen My work.

95.he: אַרְבָּ֘עִ֤ים שָׁנָ֨ה ׀ אָ֘ק֤וּט בְּד֗וֹר וָאֹמַ֗ר עַ֤ם תֹּעֵ֣י לֵבָ֣ב הֵ֑ם וְ֝הֵ֗ם לֹא־יָדְע֥וּ דְרָכָֽי׃

lines.text: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “It is a people that errs in their heart. They have not known my ways.”
Forty years I am weary of the generation, And I say, 'A people erring in heart — they! And they have not known My ways:'
Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”
Where I sware in Mine anger, 'If they come in unto My rest — !'

96.he: שִׁ֣ירוּ לַ֭יהוָה שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ שִׁ֥ירוּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: Sing to Yahweh a new song! Sing to Yahweh, all the earth.
Sing to Jehovah a new song, Sing to Jehovah all the earth.

96.he: שִׁ֣ירוּ לַ֭יהוָה בָּרֲכ֣וּ שְׁמ֑וֹ בַּשְּׂר֥וּ מִיּֽוֹם־לְ֝י֗וֹם יְשׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Sing to Yahweh! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!
Sing to Jehovah, bless His name, Proclaim from day to day His salvation.
Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.
Declare among nations His honour, Among all the peoples His wonders.

96.he: כִּ֥י גָ֘ד֤וֹל יְהוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד נוֹרָ֥א ה֝֗וּא עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃

lines.text: For Yahweh is great, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.
For great [is] Jehovah, and praised greatly, Fearful He [is] over all gods.

96.he: כִּ֤י ׀ כָּל־אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָעַמִּ֣ים אֱלִילִ֑ים וַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם עָשָֽׂה׃

lines.text: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but Yahweh made the heavens.
For all the gods of the peoples [are] nought, And Jehovah made the heavens.
Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
Honour and majesty [are] before Him, Strength and beauty in His sanctuary.

96.he: הָב֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת עַמִּ֑ים הָב֥וּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז׃

lines.text: Ascribe to Yahweh, you families of nations, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.
Ascribe to Jehovah, O families of the peoples, Ascribe to Jehovah honour and strength.

96.he: הָב֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ שְׂאֽוּ־מִ֝נְחָ֗ה וּבֹ֥אוּ לְחַצְרוֹתָֽיו׃

lines.text: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.
Ascribe to Jehovah the honour of His name, Lift up a present and come in to His courts.

96.he: הִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה בְּהַדְרַת־קֹ֑דֶשׁ חִ֥ילוּ מִ֝פָּנָ֗יו כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: Worship Yahweh in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.
Bow yourselves to Jehovah, In the honour of holiness, Be afraid of His presence, all the earth.

96.he: אִמְר֤וּ בַגּוֹיִ֨ם ׀ יְה֘וָ֤ה מָלָ֗ךְ אַף־תִּכּ֣וֹן תֵּ֭בֵל בַּל־תִּמּ֑וֹט יָדִ֥ין עַ֝מִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃

lines.text: Say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.
Say among nations, 'Jehovah hath reigned, Also — established is the world, unmoved, He judgeth the peoples in uprightness.'

96.he: יִשְׂמְח֣וּ הַ֭שָּׁמַיִם וְתָגֵ֣ל הָאָ֑רֶץ יִֽרְעַ֥ם הַ֝יָּ֗ם וּמְלֹאֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!
The heavens joy, and the earth is joyful, The sea and its fulness roar.

96.he: יַעֲלֹ֣ז שָׂ֭דַי וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־בּ֑וֹ אָ֥ז יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ כָּל־עֲצֵי־יָֽעַר׃

lines.text: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy
The field exulteth, and all that [is] in it, Then sing do all trees of the forest,

96.he: לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָ֨ה ׀ כִּ֬י בָ֗א כִּ֥י בָא֮ לִשְׁפֹּ֪ט הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ יִשְׁפֹּֽט־תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק וְ֝עַמִּ֗ים בֶּאֱמוּנָתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: before Yahweh; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.
Before Jehovah, for He hath come, For He hath come to judge the earth. He judgeth the world in righteousness, And the peoples in His faithfulness!

97.he: יְהוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ תָּגֵ֣ל הָאָ֑רֶץ יִ֝שְׂמְח֗וּ אִיִּ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃

lines.text: Yahweh reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!
Jehovah hath reigned, The earth is joyful, many isles rejoice.

97.he: עָנָ֣ן וַעֲרָפֶ֣ל סְבִיבָ֑יו צֶ֥דֶק וּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט מְכ֣וֹן כִּסְאֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
Cloud and darkness [are] round about Him, Righteousness and judgment the basis of His throne.

97.he: אֵ֭שׁ לְפָנָ֣יו תֵּלֵ֑ךְ וּתְלַהֵ֖ט סָבִ֣יב צָרָֽיו׃

lines.text: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.
Fire before Him goeth, And burneth round about His adversaries.

97.he: הֵאִ֣ירוּ בְרָקָ֣יו תֵּבֵ֑ל רָאֲתָ֖ה וַתָּחֵ֣ל הָאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.
Lightened have His lightnings the world, The earth hath seen, and is pained.

97.he: הָרִ֗ים כַּדּוֹנַ֗ג נָ֭מַסּוּ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מִ֝לִּפְנֵ֗י אֲד֣וֹן כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of Yahweh, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
Hills, like wax, melted before Jehovah, Before the Lord of all the earth.

97.he: הִגִּ֣ידוּ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם צִדְק֑וֹ וְרָא֖וּ כָל־הָעַמִּ֣ים כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃

lines.text: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.
The heavens declared His righteousness, And all the peoples have seen His honour.

97.he: יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ ׀ כָּל־עֹ֬בְדֵי פֶ֗סֶל הַמִּֽתְהַלְלִ֥ים בָּאֱלִילִ֑ים הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ־ל֝וֹ כָּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃

lines.text: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!
Ashamed are all servants of a graven image, Those boasting themselves in idols, Bow yourselves to him, all ye gods.

97.he: שָׁמְעָ֬ה וַתִּשְׂמַ֨ח ׀ צִיּ֗וֹן וַ֭תָּגֵלְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה לְמַ֖עַן מִשְׁפָּטֶ֣יךָ יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, Yahweh.
Zion hath heard and rejoiceth, And daughters of Judah are joyful, Because of Thy judgments, O Jehovah.

97.he: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה עֶלְי֥וֹן עַל־כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ מְאֹ֥ד נַ֝עֲלֵ֗יתָ עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃

lines.text: For you, Yahweh, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.
For Thou, Jehovah, [art] Most High over all the earth, Greatly Thou hast been exalted over all gods.

97.he: אֹהֲבֵ֥י יְהוָ֗ה שִׂנְא֫וּ רָ֥ע שֹׁ֭מֵר נַפְשׁ֣וֹת חֲסִידָ֑יו מִיַּ֥ד רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יַצִּילֵֽם׃

lines.text: You who love Yahweh, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
Ye who love Jehovah, hate evil, He is keeping the souls of His saints, From the hand of the wicked he delivereth them.
Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
Light [is] sown for the righteous, And for the upright of heart — joy.

97.he: שִׂמְח֣וּ צַ֭דִּיקִים בַּֽיהוָ֑ה וְ֝הוֹד֗וּ לְזֵ֣כֶר קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃

lines.text: Be glad in Yahweh, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.
Rejoice, ye righteous, in Jehovah, And give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness!

98.he: מִזְמ֡וֹר שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽיהוָ֨ה ׀ שִׁ֣יר חָ֭דָשׁ כִּֽי־נִפְלָא֣וֹת עָשָׂ֑ה הוֹשִֽׁיעָה־לּ֥וֹ יְ֝מִינ֗וֹ וּזְר֥וֹעַ קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃

lines.text: Sing to Yahweh a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.
A Psalm. Sing ye to Jehovah a new song, For wonders He hath done, Given salvation to Him hath His right hand and His holy arm.

98.he: הוֹדִ֣יעַ יְ֭הוָה יְשׁוּעָת֑וֹ לְעֵינֵ֥י הַ֝גּוֹיִ֗ם גִּלָּ֥ה צִדְקָתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Yahweh has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.
Jehovah hath made known His salvation, Before the eyes of the nations, He hath revealed His righteousness,

98.he: זָ֘כַ֤ר חַסְדּ֨וֹ ׀ וֶֽאֱֽמוּנָתוֹ֮ לְבֵ֪ית יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל רָא֥וּ כָל־אַפְסֵי־אָ֑רֶץ אֵ֝֗ת יְשׁוּעַ֥ת אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

lines.text: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
He hath remembered His kindness, And His faithfulness to the house of Israel, All ends of earth have seen the salvation of our God.

98.he: הָרִ֣יעוּ לַֽ֭יהוָה כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ פִּצְח֖וּ וְרַנְּנ֣וּ וְזַמֵּֽרוּ׃

lines.text: Make a joyful noise to Yahweh, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!
Shout to Jehovah, all the earth, Break forth, and cry aloud, and sing.

98.he: זַמְּר֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה בְּכִנּ֑וֹר בְּ֝כִנּ֗וֹר וְק֣וֹל זִמְרָֽה׃

lines.text: Sing praises to Yahweh with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.
Sing to Jehovah with harp, With harp, and voice of praise,

98.he: בַּ֭חֲצֹ֣צְרוֹת וְק֣וֹל שׁוֹפָ֑ר הָ֝רִ֗יעוּ לִפְנֵ֤י ׀ הַמֶּ֬לֶךְ יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, Yahweh.
With trumpets, and voice of a cornet, Shout ye before the king Jehovah.

98.he: יִרְעַ֣ם הַ֭יָּם וּמְלֹא֑וֹ תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל וְיֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃

lines.text: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.
Roar doth the sea and its fulness, The world and the inhabitants in it.
Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.
Floods clap hand, together hills cry aloud,

98.he: לִֽפְֽנֵי־יְהוָ֗ה כִּ֥י בָא֮ לִשְׁפֹּ֪ט הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ יִשְׁפֹּֽט־תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק וְ֝עַמִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃

lines.text: Let them sing before Yahweh, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.
Before Jehovah, For He hath come to judge the earth, He judgeth the world in righteousness, And the people in uprightness!

99.he: יְהוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ יִרְגְּז֣וּ עַמִּ֑ים יֹשֵׁ֥ב כְּ֝רוּבִ֗ים תָּנ֥וּט הָאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: Yahweh reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.
Jehovah hath reigned, peoples tremble, The Inhabitant of the cherubs, the earth shaketh.

99.he: יְ֭הוָה בְּצִיּ֣וֹן גָּד֑וֹל וְרָ֥ם ה֝֗וּא עַל־כָּל־הָֽעַמִּֽים׃

lines.text: Yahweh is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.
Jehovah in Zion [is] great, And high He [is] over all the peoples.

99.he: יוֹד֣וּ שִׁ֭מְךָ גָּד֥וֹל וְנוֹרָ֗א קָד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא׃

lines.text: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!
They praise Thy name, 'Great, and fearful, holy [it] is.'

99.he: וְעֹ֥ז מֶלֶךְ֮ מִשְׁפָּ֪ט אָ֫הֵ֥ב אַ֭תָּה כּוֹנַ֣נְתָּ מֵישָׁרִ֑ים מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה בְּיַעֲקֹ֤ב ׀ אַתָּ֬ה עָשִֽׂיתָ׃

lines.text: The King’s strength also loves justice. You establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.
And the strength of the king Hath loved judgment, Thou — Thou hast established uprightness; Judgment and righteousness in Jacob, Thou — Thou hast done.

99.he: רֽוֹמְמ֡וּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְֽ֭הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַהֲדֹ֥ם רַגְלָ֗יו קָד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא׃

lines.text: Exalt Yahweh our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!
Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And bow yourselves at His footstool, holy [is] He.

99.he: מֹ֘שֶׁ֤ה וְאַהֲרֹ֨ן ׀ בְּֽכֹהֲנָ֗יו וּ֭שְׁמוּאֵל בְּקֹרְאֵ֣י שְׁמ֑וֹ קֹרִ֥אים אֶל־יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְה֣וּא יַעֲנֵֽם׃

lines.text: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who call on his name. They called on Yahweh, and he answered them.
Moses and Aaron among His priests, And Samuel among those proclaiming His name. They are calling unto Jehovah, And He doth answer them.

99.he: בְּעַמּ֣וּד עָ֭נָן יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם שָׁמְר֥וּ עֵ֝דֹתָ֗יו וְחֹ֣ק נָֽתַן־לָֽמוֹ׃

lines.text: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.
In a pillar of cloud He speaketh unto them, They have kept His testimonies, And the statute He hath given to them.

99.he: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵינוּ֮ אַתָּ֪ה עֲנִ֫יתָ֥ם אֵ֣ל נֹ֭שֵׂא הָיִ֣יתָ לָהֶ֑ם וְ֝נֹקֵ֗ם עַל־עֲלִילוֹתָֽם׃

lines.text: You answered them, Yahweh our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.
O Jehovah, our God, Thou hast afflicted them, A God forgiving Thou hast been to them, And taking vengeance on their actions.

99.he: רֽוֹמְמ֡וּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְ֭הִֽשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְהַ֣ר קָדְשׁ֑וֹ כִּֽי־קָ֝ד֗וֹשׁ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

lines.text: Exalt Yahweh, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for Yahweh, our God, is holy!
Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And bow yourselves at His holy hill, For holy [is] Jehovah our God!
Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands!
A Psalm of Thanksgiving. Shout to Jehovah, all the earth.

100.he: עִבְד֣וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה בְּשִׂמְחָ֑ה בֹּ֥אוּ לְ֝פָנָ֗יו בִּרְנָנָֽה׃

lines.text: Serve Yahweh with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.
Serve Jehovah with joy, come before him with singing.

100.he: דְּע֗וּ כִּֽי־יְהוָה֮ ה֤וּא אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים הֽוּא־עָ֭שָׂנוּ ולא אֲנַ֑חְנוּ עַ֝מּ֗וֹ וְצֹ֣אן מַרְעִיתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Know that Yahweh, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
Know that Jehovah He [is] God, He made us, and we are His, His people — and the flock of His pasture.

100.he: בֹּ֤אוּ שְׁעָרָ֨יו ׀ בְּתוֹדָ֗ה חֲצֵרֹתָ֥יו בִּתְהִלָּ֑ה הֽוֹדוּ־ל֝֗וֹ בָּרֲכ֥וּ שְׁמֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
Enter ye His gates with thanksgiving, His courts with praise, Give ye thanks to Him, bless ye His Name.

100.he: כִּי־ט֣וֹב יְ֭הֹוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְעַד־דֹּ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר אֱמוּנָֽתוֹ׃

lines.text: For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
For good [is] Jehovah, to the age His kindness, And to generation and generation His faithfulness!

101.he: לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר חֶֽסֶד־וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט אָשִׁ֑ירָה לְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֲזַמֵּֽרָה׃

lines.text: I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, Yahweh, I will sing praises.
A Psalm of David. Kindness and judgment I sing, To Thee, O Jehovah, I sing praise.

101.he: אַשְׂכִּ֤ילָה ׀ בְּדֶ֬רֶךְ תָּמִ֗ים מָ֭תַי תָּב֣וֹא אֵלָ֑י אֶתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בְּתָם־לְ֝בָבִ֗י בְּקֶ֣רֶב בֵּיתִֽי׃

lines.text: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.
I act wisely in a perfect way, When dost Thou come in unto me? I walk habitually in the integrity of my heart, In the midst of my house.

101.he: לֹֽא־אָשִׁ֨ית ׀ לְנֶ֥גֶד עֵינַ֗י דְּֽבַר־בְּלִ֫יָּ֥עַל עֲשֹֽׂה־סֵטִ֥ים שָׂנֵ֑אתִי לֹ֖א יִדְבַּ֣ק בִּֽי׃

lines.text: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.
I set not before mine eyes a worthless thing, The work of those turning aside I have hated, It adhereth not to me.

101.he: לֵבָ֣ב עִ֭קֵּשׁ יָס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נִּי רָ֝֗ע לֹ֣א אֵדָֽע׃

lines.text: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.
A perverse heart turneth aside from me, Wickedness I know not.

101.he: מלושני בַסֵּ֨תֶר ׀ רֵעֵהוּ֮ אוֹת֪וֹ אַ֫צְמִ֥ית גְּֽבַהּ־עֵ֭ינַיִם וּרְחַ֣ב לֵבָ֑ב אֹ֝ת֗וֹ לֹ֣א אוּכָֽל׃

lines.text: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.
Whoso slandereth in secret his neighbour, Him I cut off, The high of eyes and proud of heart, him I endure not.

101.he: עֵינַ֤י ׀ בְּנֶֽאֶמְנֵי־אֶרֶץ֮ לָשֶׁ֪בֶת עִמָּ֫דִ֥י הֹ֭לֵךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ תָּמִ֑ים ה֝֗וּא יְשָׁרְתֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.
Mine eyes are on the faithful of the land, To dwell with me, Whoso is walking in a perfect way, he serveth me.

101.he: לֹֽא־יֵשֵׁ֨ב ׀ בְּקֶ֥רֶב בֵּיתִי֮ עֹשֵׂ֪ה רְמִ֫יָּ֥ה דֹּבֵ֥ר שְׁקָרִ֑ים לֹֽא־יִ֝כּ֗וֹן לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽי׃

lines.text: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.
He dwelleth not in my house who is working deceit, Whoso is speaking lies Is not established before mine eyes.

101.he: לַבְּקָרִ֗ים אַצְמִ֥ית כָּל־רִשְׁעֵי־אָ֑רֶץ לְהַכְרִ֥ית מֵֽעִיר־יְ֝הוָ֗ה כָּל־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

lines.text: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from Yahweh’s city.
At morning I cut off all the wicked of the land, To cut off from the city of Jehovah All the workers of iniquity!

102.he: תְּ֭פִלָּה לְעָנִ֣י כִֽי־יַעֲטֹ֑ף וְלִפְנֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ שִׂיחֽוֹ׃

lines.text: A Prayer of the afflicted when he is feeble, and before Jehovah poureth out his plaint. O Jehovah, hear my prayer, yea, my cry to Thee cometh.

102.he: יְ֭הוָה שִׁמְעָ֣ה תְפִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝שַׁוְעָתִ֗י אֵלֶ֥יךָ תָבֽוֹא׃

lines.text: Hear my prayer, Yahweh! Let my cry come to you.
A Prayer of the afflicted when he is feeble, and before Jehovah poureth out his plaint. O Jehovah, hear my prayer, yea, my cry to Thee cometh.

102.he: אַל־תַּסְתֵּ֬ר פָּנֶ֨יךָ ׀ מִמֶּנִּי֮ בְּי֪וֹם צַ֫ר לִ֥י הַטֵּֽה־אֵלַ֥י אָזְנֶ֑ךָ בְּי֥וֹם אֶ֝קְרָ֗א מַהֵ֥ר עֲנֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.
Hide not Thou Thy face from me, In a day of mine adversity, Incline unto me Thine ear, In the day I call, haste, answer me.

102.he: כִּֽי־כָל֣וּ בְעָשָׁ֣ן יָמָ֑י וְ֝עַצְמוֹתַ֗י כְּמוֹ־קֵ֥ד נִחָֽרוּ׃

lines.text: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.
For consumed in smoke have been my days, And my bones as a fire-brand have burned.

102.he: הוּכָּֽה־כָ֭עֵשֶׂב וַיִּבַ֣שׁ לִבִּ֑י כִּֽי־שָׁ֝כַ֗חְתִּי מֵאֲכֹ֥ל לַחְמִֽי׃

lines.text: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.
Smitten as the herb, and withered, is my heart, For I have forgotten to eat my bread.

102.he: מִקּ֥וֹל אַנְחָתִ֑י דָּבְקָ֥ה עַ֝צְמִ֗י לִבְשָׂרִֽי׃

lines.text: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.
From the voice of my sighing Hath my bone cleaved to my flesh.

102.he: דָּ֭מִיתִי לִקְאַ֣ת מִדְבָּ֑ר הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כְּכ֣וֹס חֳרָבֽוֹת׃

lines.text: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.
I have been like to a pelican of the wilderness, I have been as an owl of the dry places.

102.he: שָׁקַ֥דְתִּי וָאֶֽהְיֶ֑ה כְּ֝צִפּ֗וֹר בּוֹדֵ֥ד עַל־גָּֽג׃

lines.text: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.
I have watched, and I am As a bird alone on the roof.

102.he: כָּל־הַ֭יּוֹם חֵרְפ֣וּנִי אוֹיְבָ֑י מְ֝הוֹלָלַ֗י בִּ֣י נִשְׁבָּֽעוּ׃

lines.text: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.
All the day mine enemies reproached me, Those mad at me have sworn against me.

102.he: כִּי־אֵ֭פֶר כַּלֶּ֣חֶם אָכָ֑לְתִּי וְ֝שִׁקֻּוַ֗י בִּבְכִ֥י מָסָֽכְתִּי׃

lines.text: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
Because ashes as bread I have eaten, And my drink with weeping have mingled,

102.he: מִפְּנֵֽי־זַֽעַמְךָ֥ וְקִצְפֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י נְ֝שָׂאתַ֗נִי וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.
From Thine indignation and Thy wrath, For Thou hast lifted me up, And dost cast me down.

102.he: יָ֭מַי כְּצֵ֣ל נָט֑וּי וַ֝אֲנִ֗י כָּעֵ֥שֶׂב אִיבָֽשׁ׃

lines.text: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
My days as a shadow [are] stretched out, And I — as the herb I am withered.

102.he: וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם תֵּשֵׁ֑ב וְ֝זִכְרְךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃

lines.text: But you, Yahweh, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.
And Thou, O Jehovah, to the age abidest, And Thy memorial to all generations.

102.he: אַתָּ֣ה תָ֭קוּם תְּרַחֵ֣ם צִיּ֑וֹן כִּי־עֵ֥ת לְ֝חֶֽנְנָ֗הּ כִּי־בָ֥א מוֹעֵֽד׃

lines.text: You will arise and have mercy on Zion; for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.
Thou — Thou risest — Thou pitiest Zion, For the time to favour her, For the appointed time hath come.

102.he: כִּֽי־רָצ֣וּ עֲ֭בָדֶיךָ אֶת־אֲבָנֶ֑יהָ וְֽאֶת־עֲפָרָ֥הּ יְחֹנֵֽנוּ׃

lines.text: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.
For Thy servants have been pleased with her stones, And her dust they favour.

102.he: וְיִֽירְא֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וְֽכָל־מַלְכֵ֥י הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ אֶת־כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: So the nations will fear Yahweh’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.
And nations fear the name of Jehovah, And all kings of the earth Thine honour,

102.he: כִּֽי־בָנָ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה צִיּ֑וֹן נִ֝רְאָ֗ה בִּכְבוֹדֽוֹ׃

lines.text: For Yahweh has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.
For Jehovah hath builded Zion, He hath been seen in His honour,

102.he: פָּ֭נָה אֶל־תְּפִלַּ֣ת הָעַרְעָ֑ר וְלֹֽא־בָ֝זָ֗ה אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָֽם׃

lines.text: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
He turned unto the prayer of the destitute, And He hath not despised their prayer.

102.he: תִּכָּ֣תֶב זֹ֭את לְד֣וֹר אַחֲר֑וֹן וְעַ֥ם נִ֝בְרָ֗א יְהַלֶּל־יָֽהּ׃

lines.text: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise Yah.
This is written for a later generation, And the people created do praise Jah.

102.he: כִּֽי־הִ֭שְׁקִיף מִמְּר֣וֹם קָדְשׁ֑וֹ יְ֝הוָ֗ה מִשָּׁמַ֤יִם ׀ אֶל־אֶ֬רֶץ הִבִּֽיט׃

lines.text: For he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, Yahweh saw the earth;
For He hath looked From the high place of His sanctuary. Jehovah from heaven unto earth looked attentively,

102.he: לִ֭שְׁמֹעַ אֶנְקַ֣ת אָסִ֑יר לְ֝פַתֵּ֗חַ בְּנֵ֣י תְמוּתָֽה׃

lines.text: to hear the groans of the prisoner; to free those who are condemned to death;
To hear the groan of the prisoner, To loose sons of death,

102.he: לְסַפֵּ֣ר בְּ֭צִיּוֹן שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝תְהִלָּת֗וֹ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

lines.text: that men may declare Yahweh’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
To declare in Zion the name of Jehovah, And His praise in Jerusalem,

102.he: בְּהִקָּבֵ֣ץ עַמִּ֣ים יַחְדָּ֑ו וּ֝מַמְלָכ֗וֹת לַעֲבֹ֥ד אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve Yahweh.
In the peoples being gathered together, And the kingdoms — to serve Jehovah.

102.he: עִנָּ֖ה בַדֶּ֥רֶךְ כחו קִצַּ֥ר יָמָֽי׃

lines.text: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.
He hath humbled in the way my power, He hath shortened my days.

102.he: אֹמַ֗ר אֵלִ֗י אַֽל־תַּ֭עֲלֵנִי בַּחֲצִ֣י יָמָ֑י בְּד֖וֹר דּוֹרִ֣ים שְׁנוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.
I say, 'My God, take me not up in the midst of my days,' Through all generations [are] Thine years.

102.he: לְ֭פָנִים הָאָ֣רֶץ יָסַ֑דְתָּ וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣יךָ שָׁמָֽיִם׃

lines.text: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.
Beforetime the earth Thou didst found, And the work of Thy hands [are] the heavens.

102.he: הֵ֤מָּה ׀ יֹאבֵדוּ֮ וְאַתָּ֪ה תַ֫עֲמֹ֥ד וְ֭כֻלָּם כַּבֶּ֣גֶד יִבְל֑וּ כַּלְּב֖וּשׁ תַּחֲלִיפֵ֣ם וְֽיַחֲלֹֽפוּ׃

lines.text: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.
They — They perish, and Thou remainest, And all of them as a garment become old, As clothing Thou changest them, And they are changed.

102.he: וְאַתָּה־ה֑וּא וּ֝שְׁנוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִתָּֽמּוּ׃

lines.text: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.
And Thou [art] the same, and Thine years are not finished.

102.he: בְּנֵֽי־עֲבָדֶ֥יךָ יִשְׁכּ֑וֹנוּ וְ֝זַרְעָ֗ם לְפָנֶ֥יךָ יִכּֽוֹן׃

lines.text: The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”
The sons of Thy servants do continue, And their seed before Thee is established!

103.he: לְדָוִ֨ד ׀ בָּרֲכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה וְכָל־קְ֝רָבַ֗י אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃

lines.text: Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
By David. Bless, O my soul, Jehovah, And all my inward parts — His Holy Name.

103.he: בָּרְכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה וְאַל־תִּ֝שְׁכְּחִ֗י כָּל־גְּמוּלָֽיו׃

lines.text: Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,
Bless, O my soul, Jehovah, And forget not all His benefits,

103.he: הַסֹּלֵ֥חַ לְכָל־עֲוֺנֵ֑כִי הָ֝רֹפֵ֗א לְכָל־תַּחֲלֻאָֽיְכִי׃

lines.text: who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,
Who is forgiving all thine iniquities, Who is healing all thy diseases,

103.he: הַגּוֹאֵ֣ל מִשַּׁ֣חַת חַיָּ֑יְכִי הַֽ֝מְעַטְּרֵ֗כִי חֶ֣סֶד וְרַחֲמִֽים׃

lines.text: who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,
Who is redeeming from destruction thy life, Who is crowning thee — kindness and mercies,

103.he: הַמַּשְׂבִּ֣יעַ בַּטּ֣וֹב עֶדְיֵ֑ךְ תִּתְחַדֵּ֖שׁ כַּנֶּ֣שֶׁר נְעוּרָֽיְכִי׃

lines.text: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
Who is satisfying with good thy desire, Renew itself as an eagle doth thy youth.

103.he: עֹשֵׂ֣ה צְדָק֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטִ֗ים לְכָל־עֲשׁוּקִֽים׃

lines.text: Yahweh executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.
Jehovah is doing righteousness and judgments For all the oppressed.

103.he: יוֹדִ֣יעַ דְּרָכָ֣יו לְמֹשֶׁ֑ה לִבְנֵ֥י יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל עֲלִילֽוֹתָיו׃

lines.text: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.
He maketh known His ways to Moses, To the sons of Israel His acts.

103.he: רַח֣וּם וְחַנּ֣וּן יְהוָ֑ה אֶ֖רֶךְ אַפַּ֣יִם וְרַב־חָֽסֶד׃

lines.text: Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
Merciful and gracious [is] Jehovah, Slow to anger, and abundant in mercy.

103.he: לֹֽא־לָנֶ֥צַח יָרִ֑יב וְלֹ֖א לְעוֹלָ֣ם יִטּֽוֹר׃

lines.text: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.
Not for ever doth He strive, Nor to the age doth He watch.

103.he: לֹ֣א כַ֭חֲטָאֵינוּ עָ֣שָׂה לָ֑נוּ וְלֹ֥א כַ֝עֲוֺנֹתֵ֗ינוּ גָּמַ֥ל עָלֵֽינוּ׃

lines.text: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.
Not according to our sins hath He done to us, Nor according to our iniquities Hath He conferred benefits upon us.

103.he: כִּ֤י כִגְבֹ֣הַּ שָׁ֭מַיִם עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ גָּבַ֥ר חַ֝סְדּ֗וֹ עַל־יְרֵאָֽיו׃

lines.text: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.
For, as the height of the heavens [is] above the earth, His kindness hath been mighty over those fearing Him.

103.he: כִּרְחֹ֣ק מִ֭זְרָח מִֽמַּֽעֲרָ֑ב הִֽרְחִ֥יק מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ אֶת־פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ׃

lines.text: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
As the distance of east from west He hath put far from us our transgressions.

103.he: כְּרַחֵ֣ם אָ֭ב עַל־בָּנִ֑ים רִחַ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה עַל־יְרֵאָֽיו׃

lines.text: Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.
As a father hath mercy on sons, Jehovah hath mercy on those fearing Him.

103.he: כִּי־ה֭וּא יָדַ֣ע יִצְרֵ֑נוּ זָ֝כ֗וּר כִּי־עָפָ֥ר אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃

lines.text: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.
For He hath known our frame, Remembering that we [are] dust.

103.he: אֱ֭נוֹשׁ כֶּחָצִ֣יר יָמָ֑יו כְּצִ֥יץ הַ֝שָּׂדֶ֗ה כֵּ֣ן יָצִֽיץ׃

lines.text: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.
Mortal man! as grass [are] his days, As a flower of the field so he flourisheth;

103.he: כִּ֤י ר֣וּחַ עָֽבְרָה־בּ֣וֹ וְאֵינֶ֑נּוּ וְלֹא־יַכִּירֶ֖נּוּ ע֣וֹד מְקוֹמֽוֹ׃

lines.text: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.
For a wind hath passed over it, and it is not, And its place doth not discern it any more.

103.he: וְחֶ֤סֶד יְהוָ֨ה ׀ מֵעוֹלָ֣ם וְעַד־ע֭וֹלָם עַל־יְרֵאָ֑יו וְ֝צִדְקָת֗וֹ לִבְנֵ֥י בָנִֽים׃

lines.text: But Yahweh’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children,
And the kindness of Jehovah [Is] from age even unto age on those fearing Him, And His righteousness to sons' sons,

103.he: לְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י בְרִית֑וֹ וּלְזֹכְרֵ֥י פִ֝קֻּדָ֗יו לַעֲשׂוֹתָֽם׃

lines.text: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.
To those keeping His covenant, And to those remembering His precepts to do them.

103.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה בַּ֭שָּׁמַיִם הֵכִ֣ין כִּסְא֑וֹ וּ֝מַלְכוּת֗וֹ בַּכֹּ֥ל מָשָֽׁלָה׃

lines.text: Yahweh has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.
Jehovah in the heavens Hath established His throne, And His kingdom over all hath ruled.

103.he: בָּרֲכ֥וּ יְהוָ֗ה מַלְאָ֫כָ֥יו גִּבֹּ֣רֵי כֹ֭חַ עֹשֵׂ֣י דְבָר֑וֹ לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗עַ בְּק֣וֹל דְּבָרֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Praise Yahweh, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.
Bless Jehovah, ye His messengers, Mighty in power — doing His word, To hearken to the voice of His Word.

103.he: בָּרֲכ֣וּ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־צְבָאָ֑יו מְ֝שָׁרְתָ֗יו עֹשֵׂ֥י רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Praise Yahweh, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.
Bless Jehovah, all ye His hosts, His ministers — doing His pleasure.

103.he: בָּרֲכ֤וּ יְהוָ֨ה ׀ כָּֽל־מַעֲשָׂ֗יו בְּכָל־מְקֹמ֥וֹת מֶמְשַׁלְתּ֑וֹ בָּרֲכִ֥י נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: Praise Yahweh, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise Yahweh, my soul!
Bless Jehovah, all ye His works, In all places of His dominion. Bless, O my soul, Jehovah!

104.he: בָּרֲכִ֥י נַפְשִׁ֗י אֶת־יְה֫וָ֥ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי גָּדַ֣לְתָּ מְּאֹ֑ד ה֖וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר לָבָֽשְׁתָּ׃

lines.text: Bless Yahweh, my soul. Yahweh, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.
Bless, O my soul, Jehovah! Jehovah, my God, Thou hast been very great, Honour and majesty Thou hast put on.

104.he: עֹֽטֶה־א֭וֹר כַּשַּׂלְמָ֑ה נוֹטֶ֥ה שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם כַּיְרִיעָֽה׃

lines.text: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.
Covering himself [with] light as a garment, Stretching out the heavens as a curtain,

104.he: הַ֥מְקָרֶֽה בַמַּ֗יִם עֲֽלִיּ֫וֹתָ֥יו הַשָּׂם־עָבִ֥ים רְכוּב֑וֹ הַֽ֝מְהַלֵּ֗ךְ עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רֽוּחַ׃

lines.text: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.
Who is laying the beam of His upper chambers in the waters, Who is making thick clouds His chariot, Who is walking on wings of wind,

104.he: עֹשֶׂ֣ה מַלְאָכָ֣יו רוּח֑וֹת מְ֝שָׁרְתָ֗יו אֵ֣שׁ לֹהֵֽט׃

lines.text: He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.
Making His messengers — the winds, His ministers — the flaming fire.

104.he: יָֽסַד־אֶ֭רֶץ עַל־מְכוֹנֶ֑יהָ בַּל־תִּ֝מּ֗וֹט עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃

lines.text: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.
He hath founded earth on its bases, It is not moved to the age and for ever.

104.he: תְּ֭הוֹם כַּלְּב֣וּשׁ כִּסִּית֑וֹ עַל־הָ֝רִ֗ים יַ֖עַמְדוּ־מָֽיִם׃

lines.text: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.
The abyss! as with clothing Thou hast covered it, Above hills do waters stand.

104.he: מִן־גַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ֣ יְנוּס֑וּן מִן־ק֥וֹל רַֽ֝עַמְךָ֗ יֵחָפֵזֽוּן׃

lines.text: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.
From Thy rebuke they flee, From the voice of Thy thunder haste away.

104.he: יַעֲל֣וּ הָ֭רִים יֵרְד֣וּ בְקָע֑וֹת אֶל־מְ֝ק֗וֹם זֶ֤ה ׀ יָסַ֬דְתָּ לָהֶֽם׃

lines.text: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.
They go up hills — they go down valleys, Unto a place Thou hast founded for them.

104.he: גְּֽבוּל־שַׂ֭מְתָּ בַּל־יַֽעֲבֹר֑וּן בַּל־יְ֝שׁוּב֗וּן לְכַסּ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.
A border Thou hast set, they pass not over, They turn not back to cover the earth.

104.he: הַֽמְשַׁלֵּ֣חַ מַ֭עְיָנִים בַּנְּחָלִ֑ים בֵּ֥ין הָ֝רִ֗ים יְהַלֵּכֽוּן׃

lines.text: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.
Who is sending forth fountains in valleys, Between hills they go on.

104.he: יַ֭שְׁקוּ כָּל־חַיְת֣וֹ שָׂדָ֑י יִשְׁבְּר֖וּ פְרָאִ֣ים צְמָאָֽם׃

lines.text: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.
They water every beast of the field, Wild asses break their thirst.

104.he: עֲ֭לֵיהֶם עוֹף־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִשְׁכּ֑וֹן מִבֵּ֥ין עֳ֝פָאיִ֗ם יִתְּנוּ־קֽוֹל׃

lines.text: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.
By them the fowl of the heavens doth dwell, From between the branches They give forth the voice.

104.he: מַשְׁקֶ֣ה הָ֭רִים מֵעֲלִיּוֹתָ֑יו מִפְּרִ֥י מַ֝עֲשֶׂ֗יךָ תִּשְׂבַּ֥ע הָאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.
Watering hills from His upper chambers, From the fruit of Thy works is the earth satisfied.

104.he: מַצְמִ֤יחַ חָצִ֨יר ׀ לַבְּהֵמָ֗ה וְ֭עֵשֶׂב לַעֲבֹדַ֣ת הָאָדָ֑ם לְה֥וֹצִיא לֶ֝֗חֶם מִן־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:
Causing grass to spring up for cattle, And herb for the service of man, To bring forth bread from the earth,

104.he: וְיַ֤יִן ׀ יְשַׂמַּ֬ח לְֽבַב־אֱנ֗וֹשׁ לְהַצְהִ֣יל פָּנִ֣ים מִשָּׁ֑מֶן וְ֝לֶ֗חֶם לְֽבַב־אֱנ֥וֹשׁ יִסְעָֽד׃

lines.text: wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.
And wine — it rejoiceth the heart of man, To cause the face to shine from oil, And bread — the heart of man it supporteth.

104.he: יִ֭שְׂבְּעוּ עֲצֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אַֽרְזֵ֥י לְ֝בָנ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָטָֽע׃

lines.text: Yahweh’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted;
Satisfied [are] the trees of Jehovah, Cedars of Lebanon that He hath planted,

104.he: אֲשֶׁר־שָׁ֭ם צִפֳּרִ֣ים יְקַנֵּ֑נוּ חֲ֝סִידָ֗ה בְּרוֹשִׁ֥ים בֵּיתָֽהּ׃

lines.text: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.
Where birds do make nests, The stork — the firs [are] her house.

104.he: הָרִ֣ים הַ֭גְּבֹהִים לַיְּעֵלִ֑ים סְ֝לָעִ֗ים מַחְסֶ֥ה לַֽשְׁפַנִּֽים׃

lines.text: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.
The high hills [are] for wild goats, Rocks [are] a refuge for conies,

104.he: עָשָׂ֣ה יָ֭רֵחַ לְמוֹעֲדִ֑ים שֶׁ֝֗מֶשׁ יָדַ֥ע מְבוֹאֽוֹ׃

lines.text: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.
He made the moon for seasons, The sun hath known his place of entrance.

104.he: תָּֽשֶׁת־חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וִ֣יהִי לָ֑יְלָה בּֽוֹ־תִ֝רְמֹ֗שׂ כָּל־חַיְתוֹ־יָֽעַר׃

lines.text: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.
Thou settest darkness, and it is night, In it doth every beast of the forest creep.

104.he: הַ֭כְּפִירִים שֹׁאֲגִ֣ים לַטָּ֑רֶף וּלְבַקֵּ֖שׁ מֵאֵ֣ל אָכְלָֽם׃

lines.text: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.
The young lions are roaring for prey, And to seek from God their food.

104.he: תִּזְרַ֣ח הַ֭שֶּׁמֶשׁ יֵאָסֵפ֑וּן וְאֶל־מְ֝עוֹנֹתָ֗ם יִרְבָּצֽוּן׃

lines.text: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens.
The sun riseth, they are gathered, And in their dens they crouch.

104.he: יֵצֵ֣א אָדָ֣ם לְפָעֳל֑וֹ וְֽלַעֲבֹ֖דָת֣וֹ עֲדֵי־עָֽרֶב׃

lines.text: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.
Man goeth forth to his work, And to his service — till evening.

104.he: מָֽה־רַבּ֬וּ מַעֲשֶׂ֨יךָ ׀ יְֽהוָ֗ה כֻּ֭לָּם בְּחָכְמָ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ מָלְאָ֥ה הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ קִנְיָנֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Yahweh, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
How many have been Thy works, O Jehovah, All of them in wisdom Thou hast made, Full is the earth of thy possessions.

104.he: זֶ֤ה ׀ הַיָּ֥ם גָּדוֹל֮ וּרְחַ֪ב יָ֫דָ֥יִם שָֽׁם־רֶ֭מֶשׂ וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר חַיּ֥וֹת קְ֝טַנּ֗וֹת עִם־גְּדֹלֽוֹת׃

lines.text: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.
This, the sea, great and broad of sides, There [are] moving things — innumerable, Living creatures — small with great.

104.he: שָׁ֭ם אֳנִיּ֣וֹת יְהַלֵּכ֑וּן לִ֝וְיָתָ֗ן זֶֽה־יָצַ֥רְתָּ לְשַֽׂחֶק־בּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.
There do ships go: leviathan, That Thou hast formed to play in it.

104.he: כֻּ֭לָּם אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְשַׂבֵּר֑וּן לָתֵ֖ת אָכְלָ֣ם בְּעִתּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.
All of them unto Thee do look, To give their food in its season.

104.he: תִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם יִלְקֹט֑וּן תִּפְתַּ֥ח יָֽ֝דְךָ֗ יִשְׂבְּע֥וּן טֽוֹב׃

lines.text: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.
Thou dost give to them — they gather, Thou dost open Thy hand — they [are] satisfied [with] good.

104.he: תַּסְתִּ֥יר פָּנֶיךָ֮ יִֽבָּהֵ֫ל֥וּן תֹּסֵ֣ף ר֭וּחָם יִגְוָע֑וּן וְֽאֶל־עֲפָרָ֥ם יְשׁוּבֽוּן׃

lines.text: You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.
Thou hidest Thy face — they are troubled, Thou gatherest their spirit — they expire, And unto their dust they turn back.

104.he: תְּשַׁלַּ֣ח ר֭וּחֲךָ יִבָּרֵא֑וּן וּ֝תְחַדֵּ֗שׁ פְּנֵ֣י אֲדָמָֽה׃

lines.text: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.
Thou sendest out Thy Spirit, they are created, And Thou renewest the face of the ground.

104.he: יְהִ֤י כְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֣ה לְעוֹלָ֑ם יִשְׂמַ֖ח יְהוָ֣ה בְּמַעֲשָֽׂיו׃

lines.text: Let Yahweh’s glory endure forever. Let Yahweh rejoice in his works.
The honour of Jehovah is to the age, Jehovah rejoiceth in His works,

104.he: הַמַּבִּ֣יט לָ֭אָרֶץ וַתִּרְעָ֑ד יִגַּ֖ע בֶּהָרִ֣ים וְֽיֶעֱשָֽׁנוּ׃

lines.text: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
Who is looking to earth, and it trembleth, He cometh against hills, and they smoke.

104.he: אָשִׁ֣ירָה לַיהוָ֣ה בְּחַיָּ֑י אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה לֵאלֹהַ֣י בְּעוֹדִֽי׃

lines.text: I will sing to Yahweh as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
I sing to Jehovah during my life, I sing praise to my God while I exist.

104.he: יֶעֱרַ֣ב עָלָ֣יו שִׂיחִ֑י אָ֝נֹכִ֗י אֶשְׂמַ֥ח בַּיהוָֽה׃

lines.text: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in Yahweh.
Sweet is my meditation on Him, I — I do rejoice in Jehovah.

104.he: יִתַּ֤מּוּ חַטָּאִ֨ים ׀ מִן־הָאָ֡רֶץ וּרְשָׁעִ֤ים ׀ ע֤וֹד אֵינָ֗ם בָּרֲכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָ֗ה הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃

lines.text: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless Yahweh, my soul. Praise Yah!
Consumed are sinners from the earth, And the wicked are no more. Bless, O my soul, Jehovah. Praise ye Jehovah!

105.he: הוֹד֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה קִרְא֣וּ בִשְׁמ֑וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ בָ֝עַמִּ֗ים עֲלִילוֹתָֽיו׃

lines.text: Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
Give ye thanks to Jehovah — call ye in His name, Make known among the peoples His acts.

105.he: שִֽׁירוּ־ל֭וֹ זַמְּרוּ־ל֑וֹ שִׂ֝֗יחוּ בְּכָל־נִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו׃

lines.text: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
Sing ye to Him — sing praise to Him, Meditate ye on all His wonders.

105.he: הִֽ֭תְהַלְלוּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשׁ֑וֹ יִ֝שְׂמַ֗ח לֵ֤ב ׀ מְבַקְשֵׁ֬י יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.
Boast yourselves in His Holy Name, The heart of those seeking Jehovah rejoiceth.

105.he: דִּרְשׁ֣וּ יְהוָ֣ה וְעֻזּ֑וֹ בַּקְּשׁ֖וּ פָנָ֣יו תָּמִֽיד׃

lines.text: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
Seek ye Jehovah and His strength, Seek ye His face continually.

105.he: זִכְר֗וּ נִפְלְאוֹתָ֥יו אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֑ה מֹ֝פְתָ֗יו וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי־פִֽיו׃

lines.text: Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
Remember His wonders that He did, His signs and the judgments of His mouth.

105.he: זֶ֭רַע אַבְרָהָ֣ם עַבְדּ֑וֹ בְּנֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב בְּחִירָֽיו׃

lines.text: you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
O seed of Abraham, His servant, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.

105.he: ה֭וּא יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ בְּכָל־הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ מִשְׁפָּטָֽיו׃

lines.text: He is Yahweh, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.
He [is] Jehovah our God, In all the earth [are] His judgments.

105.he: זָכַ֣ר לְעוֹלָ֣ם בְּרִית֑וֹ דָּבָ֥ר צִ֝וָּ֗ה לְאֶ֣לֶף דּֽוֹר׃

lines.text: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
He hath remembered to the age His covenant, The word He commanded to a thousand generations,

105.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּ֭רַת אֶת־אַבְרָהָ֑ם וּשְׁב֖וּעָת֣וֹ לְיִשְׂחָֽק׃

lines.text: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,
That He hath made with Abraham, And His oath to Isaac,

105.he: וַיַּֽעֲמִידֶ֣הָ לְיַעֲקֹ֣ב לְחֹ֑ק לְ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל בְּרִ֣ית עוֹלָֽם׃

lines.text: and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
And doth establish it to Jacob for a statute, To Israel — a covenant age-during,

105.he: לֵאמֹ֗ר לְךָ֗ אֶתֵּ֥ן אֶת־אֶֽרֶץ־כְּנָ֑עַן חֶ֝֗בֶל נַחֲלַתְכֶֽם׃

lines.text: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”
Saying, 'To thee I give the land of Canaan, The portion of your inheritance,'

105.he: בִּֽ֭הְיוֹתָם מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֑ר כִּ֝מְעַ֗ט וְגָרִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃

lines.text: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.
In their being few in number, But a few, and sojourners in it.

105.he: וַֽ֭יִּתְהַלְּכוּ מִגּ֣וֹי אֶל־גּ֑וֹי מִ֝מַּמְלָכָ֗ה אֶל־עַ֥ם אַחֵֽר׃

lines.text: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
And they go up and down, from nation unto nation, From a kingdom unto another people.

105.he: לֹֽא־הִנִּ֣יחַ אָדָ֣ם לְעָשְׁקָ֑ם וַיּ֖וֹכַח עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם מְלָכִֽים׃

lines.text: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
He hath not suffered any to oppress them And He reproveth for their sakes kings.

105.he: אַֽל־תִּגְּע֥וּ בִמְשִׁיחָ֑י וְ֝לִנְבִיאַי אַל־תָּרֵֽעוּ׃

lines.text: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
'Strike not against Mine anointed, And to My prophets do not evil.'

105.he: וַיִּקְרָ֣א רָ֭עָב עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ כָּֽל־מַטֵּה־לֶ֥חֶם שָׁבָֽר׃

lines.text: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.
And He calleth a famine on the land, The whole staff of bread He hath broken.

105.he: שָׁלַ֣ח לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם אִ֑ישׁ לְ֝עֶ֗בֶד נִמְכַּ֥ר יוֹסֵֽף׃

lines.text: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.
He hath sent before them a man, For a servant hath Joseph been sold.

105.he: עִנּ֣וּ בַכֶּ֣בֶל רגליו בַּ֝רְזֶ֗ל בָּ֣אָה נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

lines.text: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,
They have afflicted with fetters his feet, Iron hath entered his soul,

105.he: עַד־עֵ֥ת בֹּֽא־דְבָר֑וֹ אִמְרַ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה צְרָפָֽתְהוּ׃

lines.text: until the time that his word happened, and Yahweh’s word proved him true.
Till the time of the coming of His word The saying of Jehovah hath tried him.

105.he: שָׁ֣לַח מֶ֭לֶךְ וַיַּתִּירֵ֑הוּ מֹשֵׁ֥ל עַ֝מִּ֗ים וַֽיְפַתְּחֵֽהוּ׃

lines.text: The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.
The king hath sent, and looseth him, The ruler of the peoples, and draweth him out.

105.he: שָׂמ֣וֹ אָד֣וֹן לְבֵית֑וֹ וּ֝מֹשֵׁ֗ל בְּכָל־קִנְיָנֽוֹ׃

lines.text: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,
He hath made him lord of his house, And ruler over all his possessions.

105.he: לֶאְסֹ֣ר שָׂרָ֣יו בְּנַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּזְקֵנָ֥יו יְחַכֵּֽם׃

lines.text: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.
To bind his chiefs at his pleasure, And his elders he maketh wise.

105.he: וַיָּבֹ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ֝יַעֲקֹ֗ב גָּ֣ר בְּאֶֽרֶץ־חָֽם׃

lines.text: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.
And Israel cometh in to Egypt, And Jacob hath sojourned in the land of Ham.

105.he: וַיֶּ֣פֶר אֶת־עַמּ֣וֹ מְאֹ֑ד וַ֝יַּֽעֲצִמֵהוּ מִצָּרָֽיו׃

lines.text: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.
And He maketh His people very fruitful, And maketh it mightier than its adversaries.

105.he: הָפַ֣ךְ לִ֭בָּם לִשְׂנֹ֣א עַמּ֑וֹ לְ֝הִתְנַכֵּ֗ל בַּעֲבָדָֽיו׃

lines.text: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.
He turned their heart to hate His people, To conspire against His servants.

105.he: שָׁ֭לַח מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדּ֑וֹ אַ֝הֲרֹ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּֽחַר־בּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
He hath sent Moses His servant, Aaron whom He had fixed on.

105.he: שָֽׂמוּ־בָ֭ם דִּבְרֵ֣י אֹתוֹתָ֑יו וּ֝מֹפְתִ֗ים בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חָֽם׃

lines.text: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
They have set among them the matters of His signs, And wonders in the land of Ham.

105.he: שָׁ֣לַֽח חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וַיַּחְשִׁ֑ךְ וְלֹֽא־מָ֝ר֗וּ אֶת־דברוו׃
