lines.text: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.
He hath sent darkness, and it is dark, And they have not provoked His word.

105.he: הָפַ֣ךְ אֶת־מֵימֵיהֶ֣ם לְדָ֑ם וַ֝יָּ֗מֶת אֶת־דְּגָתָֽם׃

lines.text: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.
He hath turned their waters to blood, And putteth to death their fish.

105.he: שָׁרַ֣ץ אַרְצָ֣ם צְפַרְדְּעִ֑ים בְּ֝חַדְרֵ֗י מַלְכֵיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.
Teemed hath their land [with] frogs, In the inner chambers of their kings.

105.he: אָ֭מַר וַיָּבֹ֣א עָרֹ֑ב כִּ֝נִּ֗ים בְּכָל־גְּבוּלָֽם׃

lines.text: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.
He hath said, and the beetle cometh, Lice into all their border.

105.he: נָתַ֣ן גִּשְׁמֵיהֶ֣ם בָּרָ֑ד אֵ֖שׁ לֶהָב֣וֹת בְּאַרְצָֽם׃

lines.text: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.
He hath made their showers hail, A flaming fire [is] in their land.

105.he: וַיַּ֣ךְ גַּ֭פְנָם וּתְאֵנָתָ֑ם וַ֝יְשַׁבֵּ֗ר עֵ֣ץ גְּבוּלָֽם׃

lines.text: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.
And He smiteth their vine and their fig, And shivereth the trees of their border.

105.he: אָ֭מַר וַיָּבֹ֣א אַרְבֶּ֑ה וְ֝יֶ֗לֶק וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר׃

lines.text: He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number,
He hath said, and the locust cometh, And the cankerworm — innumerable,

105.he: וַיֹּ֣אכַל כָּל־עֵ֣שֶׂב בְּאַרְצָ֑ם וַ֝יֹּ֗אכַל פְּרִ֣י אַדְמָתָֽם׃

lines.text: ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.
And it consumeth every herb in their land, And it consumeth the fruit of their ground.

105.he: וַיַּ֣ךְ כָּל־בְּכ֣וֹר בְּאַרְצָ֑ם רֵ֝אשִׁ֗ית לְכָל־אוֹנָֽם׃

lines.text: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.
And He smiteth every first-born in their land, The first-fruit of all their strength,

105.he: וַֽ֭יּוֹצִיאֵם בְּכֶ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב וְאֵ֖ין בִּשְׁבָטָ֣יו כּוֹשֵֽׁל׃

lines.text: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.
And bringeth them out with silver and gold, And there is not in its tribes a feeble one.

105.he: שָׂמַ֣ח מִצְרַ֣יִם בְּצֵאתָ֑ם כִּֽי־נָפַ֖ל פַּחְדָּ֣ם עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.
Rejoiced hath Egypt in their going forth, For their fear had fallen upon them.

105.he: פָּרַ֣שׂ עָנָ֣ן לְמָסָ֑ךְ וְ֝אֵ֗שׁ לְהָאִ֥יר לָֽיְלָה׃

lines.text: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.
He hath spread a cloud for a covering, And fire to enlighten the night.

105.he: שָׁאַ֣ל וַיָּבֵ֣א שְׂלָ֑ו וְלֶ֥חֶם שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם יַשְׂבִּיעֵֽם׃

lines.text: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.
They have asked, and He bringeth quails, And [with] bread of heaven satisfieth them.

105.he: פָּ֣תַח צ֭וּר וַיָּז֣וּבוּ מָ֑יִם הָ֝לְכ֗וּ בַּצִּיּ֥וֹת נָהָֽר׃

lines.text: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.
He hath opened a rock, and waters issue, They have gone on in dry places — a river.

105.he: כִּֽי־זָ֭כַר אֶת־דְּבַ֣ר קָדְשׁ֑וֹ אֶֽת־אַבְרָהָ֥ם עַבְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.
For He hath remembered His holy word, With Abraham His servant,

105.he: וַיּוֹצִ֣א עַמּ֣וֹ בְשָׂשׂ֑וֹן בְּ֝רִנָּ֗ה אֶת־בְּחִירָֽיו׃

lines.text: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.
And He bringeth forth His people with joy, With singing His chosen ones.

105.he: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם אַרְצ֣וֹת גּוֹיִ֑ם וַעֲמַ֖ל לְאֻמִּ֣ים יִירָֽשׁוּ׃

lines.text: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,
And He giveth to them the lands of nations, And the labour of peoples they possess,

105.he: בַּעֲב֤וּר ׀ יִשְׁמְר֣וּ חֻ֭קָּיו וְתוֹרֹתָ֥יו יִנְצֹ֗רוּ הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃

lines.text: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise Yah!
That they may observe His statutes, And His laws may keep. Praise ye Jehovah!

106.he: הַֽלְלְויָ֨הּ ׀ הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Praise Yahweh! Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
Praise ye Jah, give thanks to Jehovah, For good, for to the age, [is] His kindness.

106.he: מִ֗י יְ֭מַלֵּל גְּבוּר֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה יַ֝שְׁמִ֗יעַ כָּל־תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Who can utter the mighty acts of Yahweh, or fully declare all his praise?
Who doth utter the mighty acts of Jehovah? Soundeth all His praise?

106.he: אַ֭שְׁרֵי שֹׁמְרֵ֣י מִשְׁפָּ֑ט עֹשֵׂ֖ה צְדָקָ֣ה בְכָל־עֵֽת׃

lines.text: Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times.
O the happiness of those keeping judgment, Doing righteousness at all times.

106.he: זָכְרֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה בִּרְצ֣וֹן עַמֶּ֑ךָ פָּ֝קְדֵ֗נִי בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Remember me, Yahweh, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,
Remember me, O Jehovah, With the favour of Thy people, Look after me in Thy salvation.

106.he: לִרְא֤וֹת ׀ בְּט֘וֹבַ֤ת בְּחִירֶ֗יךָ לִ֭שְׂמֹחַ בְּשִׂמְחַ֣ת גּוֹיֶ֑ךָ לְ֝הִתְהַלֵּ֗ל עִם־נַחֲלָתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.
To look on the good of Thy chosen ones, To rejoice in the joy of Thy nation, To boast myself with Thine inheritance.

106.he: חָטָ֥אנוּ עִם־אֲבוֹתֵ֗ינוּ הֶעֱוִ֥ינוּ הִרְשָֽׁעְנוּ׃

lines.text: We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.
We have sinned with our fathers, We have done perversely, we have done wickedly.

106.he: אֲב֘וֹתֵ֤ינוּ בְמִצְרַ֨יִם ׀ לֹא־הִשְׂכִּ֬ילוּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א זָ֭כְרוּ אֶת־רֹ֣ב חֲסָדֶ֑יךָ וַיַּמְר֖וּ עַל־יָ֣ם בְּיַם־סֽוּף׃

lines.text: Our fathers didn’t understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn’t remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.
Our fathers in Egypt, Have not considered wisely Thy wonders, They have not remembered The abundance of Thy kind acts, And provoke by the sea, at the sea of Suph.

106.he: וַֽ֭יּוֹשִׁיעֵם לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמ֑וֹ לְ֝הוֹדִ֗יעַ אֶת־גְּבוּרָתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.
And He saveth them for His name's sake, To make known His might,

106.he: וַיִּגְעַ֣ר בְּיַם־ס֭וּף וַֽיֶּחֱרָ֑ב וַיּוֹלִיכֵ֥ם בַּ֝תְּהֹמ֗וֹת כַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

lines.text: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.
And rebuketh the sea of Suph, and it is dried up, And causeth them to go Through depths as a wilderness.

106.he: וַֽ֭יּוֹשִׁיעֵם מִיַּ֣ד שׂוֹנֵ֑א וַ֝יִּגְאָלֵ֗ם מִיַּ֥ד אוֹיֵֽב׃

lines.text: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
And He saveth them from the hand Of him who is hating, And redeemeth them from the hand of the enemy.

106.he: וַיְכַסּוּ־מַ֥יִם צָרֵיהֶ֑ם אֶחָ֥ד מֵ֝הֶ֗ם לֹ֣א נוֹתָֽר׃

lines.text: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.
And waters cover their adversaries, One of them hath not been left.

106.he: וַיַּאֲמִ֥ינוּ בִדְבָרָ֑יו יָ֝שִׁ֗ירוּ תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.
And they believe in His words, they sing His praise,

106.he: מִֽ֭הֲרוּ שָׁכְח֣וּ מַעֲשָׂ֑יו לֹֽא־חִ֝כּ֗וּ לַעֲצָתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,
They have hasted — forgotten His works, They have not waited for His counsel.

106.he: וַיִּתְאַוּ֣וּ תַ֭אֲוָה בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַיְנַסּוּ־אֵ֝֗ל בִּֽישִׁימֽוֹן׃

lines.text: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.
And they lust greatly in a wilderness, And try God in a desert.

106.he: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם שֶׁאֱלָתָ֑ם וַיְשַׁלַּ֖ח רָז֣וֹן בְּנַפְשָֽׁם׃

lines.text: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.
And He giveth to them their request, And sendeth leanness into their soul.

106.he: וַיְקַנְא֣וּ לְ֭מֹשֶׁה בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה לְ֝אַהֲרֹ֗ן קְד֣וֹשׁ יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, Yahweh’s saint.
And they are envious of Moses in the camp, Of Aaron, Jehovah's holy one.

106.he: תִּפְתַּח־אֶ֭רֶץ וַתִּבְלַ֣ע דָּתָ֑ן וַ֝תְּכַ֗ס עַל־עֲדַ֥ת אֲבִירָֽם׃

lines.text: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
Earth openeth, and swalloweth up Dathan, And covereth over the company of Abiram.

106.he: וַתִּבְעַר־אֵ֥שׁ בַּעֲדָתָ֑ם לֶ֝הָבָ֗ה תְּלַהֵ֥ט רְשָׁעִֽים׃

lines.text: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.
And fire burneth among their company, A flame setteth on fire the wicked.

106.he: יַעֲשׂוּ־עֵ֥גֶל בְּחֹרֵ֑ב וַ֝יִּשְׁתַּחֲו֗וּ לְמַסֵּכָֽה׃

lines.text: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.
They make a calf in Horeb, And bow themselves to a molten image,

106.he: וַיָּמִ֥ירוּ אֶת־כְּבוֹדָ֑ם בְּתַבְנִ֥ית שׁ֝֗וֹר אֹכֵ֥ל עֵֽשֶׂב׃

lines.text: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.
And change their Honour Into the form of an ox eating herbs.

106.he: שָׁ֭כְחוּ אֵ֣ל מוֹשִׁיעָ֑ם עֹשֶׂ֖ה גְדֹל֣וֹת בְּמִצְרָֽיִם׃

lines.text: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,
They have forgotten God their saviour, The doer of great things in Egypt,

106.he: נִ֭פְלָאוֹת בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חָ֑ם נ֝וֹרָא֗וֹת עַל־יַם־סֽוּף׃

lines.text: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.
Of wonderful things in the land of Ham, Of fearful things by the sea of Suph.

106.he: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לְֽהַשְׁמִ֫ידָ֥ם לוּלֵ֡י מֹ֘שֶׁ֤ה בְחִיר֗וֹ עָמַ֣ד בַּפֶּ֣רֶץ לְפָנָ֑יו לְהָשִׁ֥יב חֲ֝מָת֗וֹ מֵֽהַשְׁחִֽית׃

lines.text: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn’t destroy them.
And He saith to destroy them, Unless Moses, His chosen one, Had stood in the breach before Him, To turn back His wrath from destroying.

106.he: וַֽ֭יִּמְאֲסוּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חֶמְדָּ֑ה לֹֽא־הֶ֝אֱמִ֗ינוּ לִדְבָרֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn’t believe his word,
And they kick against the desirable land, They have not given credence to His word.

106.he: וַיֵּרָגְנ֥וּ בְאָהֳלֵיהֶ֑ם לֹ֥א שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: but murmured in their tents, and didn’t listen to Yahweh’s voice.
And they murmur in their tents, They have not hearkened to the voice of Jehovah.

106.he: וַיִשָּׂ֣א יָד֣וֹ לָהֶ֑ם לְהַפִּ֥יל א֝וֹתָ֗ם בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

lines.text: Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,
And He lifteth up His hand to them, To cause them to fall in a wilderness,

106.he: וּלְהַפִּ֣יל זַ֭רְעָם בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם וּ֝לְזָרוֹתָ֗ם בָּאֲרָצֽוֹת׃

lines.text: that he would overthrow their offspring among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.
And to cause their seed to fall among nations, And to scatter them through lands.

106.he: וַ֭יִּצָּ֣מְדוּ לְבַ֣עַל פְּע֑וֹר וַ֝יֹּאכְל֗וּ זִבְחֵ֥י מֵתִֽים׃

lines.text: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
And they are coupled to Baal-Peor, And eat the sacrifices of the dead,

106.he: וַ֭יַּכְעִיסוּ בְּמַ֥עַלְלֵיהֶ֑ם וַתִּפְרָץ־בָּ֝֗ם מַגֵּפָֽה׃

lines.text: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.
And they provoke to anger by their actions, And a plague breaketh forth upon them,

106.he: וַיַּעֲמֹ֣ד פִּֽ֭ינְחָס וַיְפַלֵּ֑ל וַ֝תֵּעָצַ֗ר הַמַּגֵּפָֽה׃

lines.text: Then Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.
And Phinehas standeth, and executeth judgment, And the plague is restrained,

106.he: וַתֵּחָ֣שֶׁב ל֭וֹ לִצְדָקָ֑ה לְדֹ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

lines.text: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.
And it is reckoned to him to righteousness, To all generations — unto the age.

106.he: וַ֭יַּקְצִיפוּ עַל־מֵ֥י מְרִיבָ֑ה וַיֵּ֥רַע לְ֝מֹשֶׁ֗ה בַּעֲבוּרָֽם׃

lines.text: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;
And they cause wrath by the waters of Meribah, And it is evil to Moses for their sakes,

106.he: כִּֽי־הִמְר֥וּ אֶת־רוּח֑וֹ וַ֝יְבַטֵּ֗א בִּשְׂפָתָֽיו׃

lines.text: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.
For they have provoked his spirit, And he speaketh wrongfully with his lips.

106.he: לֹֽא־הִ֭שְׁמִידוּ אֶת־הָֽעַמִּ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה לָהֶֽם׃

lines.text: They didn’t destroy the peoples, as Yahweh commanded them,
They have not destroyed the peoples, As Jehovah had said to them,

106.he: וַיִּתְעָרְב֥וּ בַגּוֹיִ֑ם וַֽ֝יִּלְמְד֗וּ מַֽעֲשֵׂיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.
And mix themselves among nations, and learn their works,

106.he: וַיַּעַבְד֥וּ אֶת־עֲצַבֵּיהֶ֑ם וַיִּהְי֖וּ לָהֶ֣ם לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃

lines.text: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.
And serve their idols, And they are to them for a snare.

106.he: וַיִּזְבְּח֣וּ אֶת־בְּ֭נֵיהֶם וְאֶת־בְּנֽוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם לַשֵּֽׁדִים׃

lines.text: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
And they sacrifice their sons And their daughters to destroyers,

106.he: וַיִּֽשְׁפְּכ֨וּ דָ֪ם נָקִ֡י דַּם־בְּנֵ֘יהֶ֤ם וּֽבְנוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר זִ֭בְּחוּ לַעֲצַבֵּ֣י כְנָ֑עַן וַתֶּחֱנַ֥ף הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ בַּדָּמִֽים׃

lines.text: They shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan. The land was polluted with blood.
And they shed innocent blood — Blood of their sons and of their daughters, Whom they have sacrificed to idols of Canaan, And the land is profaned with blood.

106.he: וַיִּטְמְא֥וּ בְמַעֲשֵׂיהֶ֑ם וַ֝יִּזְנ֗וּ בְּמַ֥עַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: Thus they were defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.
And they are defiled with their works, And commit whoredom in their habitual doings.

106.he: וַיִּֽחַר־אַ֣ף יְהוָ֣ה בְּעַמּ֑וֹ וַ֝יְתָעֵ֗ב אֶת־נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Therefore Yahweh burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.
And the anger of Jehovah Is kindled against His people, And He doth abominate His inheritance.

106.he: וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם בְּיַד־גּוֹיִ֑ם וַֽיִּמְשְׁל֥וּ בָ֝הֶ֗ם שֹׂנְאֵיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them.
And giveth them into the hand of nations, And those hating them rule over them,

106.he: וַיִּלְחָצ֥וּם אוֹיְבֵיהֶ֑ם וַ֝יִּכָּנְע֗וּ תַּ֣חַת יָדָֽם׃

lines.text: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.
And their enemies oppress them, And they are humbled under their hand.

106.he: פְּעָמִ֥ים רַבּ֗וֹת יַצִּ֫ילֵ֥ם וְ֭הֵמָּה יַמְר֣וּ בַעֲצָתָ֑ם וַ֝יָּמֹ֗כּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָֽם׃

lines.text: He rescued them many times, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.
Many times He doth deliver them, And they rebel in their counsel, And they are brought low in their iniquity.

106.he: וַ֭יַּרְא בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם בְּ֝שָׁמְע֗וֹ אֶת־רִנָּתָֽם׃

lines.text: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.
And He looketh on their distress When He heareth their cry,

106.he: וַיִּזְכֹּ֣ר לָהֶ֣ם בְּרִית֑וֹ וַ֝יִּנָּחֵ֗ם כְּרֹ֣ב חסדו׃

lines.text: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
And remembereth for them His covenant, And is comforted, According to the abundance of His kindness.

106.he: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אוֹתָ֣ם לְרַחֲמִ֑ים לִ֝פְנֵ֗י כָּל־שׁוֹבֵיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.
And He appointeth them for mercies Before all their captors.

106.he: הוֹשִׁיעֵ֨נוּ ׀ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְקַבְּצֵנוּ֮ מִֽן־הַגּ֫וֹיִ֥ם לְ֭הֹדוֹת לְשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשֶׁ֑ךָ לְ֝הִשְׁתַּבֵּ֗חַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Save us, Yahweh, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!
Save us, O Jehovah our God, and gather us from the nations, To give thanks to Thy holy name, To glory in Thy praise.

106.he: בָּר֤וּךְ־יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֪י יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל מִן־הָ֤עוֹלָ֨ם ׀ וְעַ֬ד הָעוֹלָ֗ם וְאָמַ֖ר כָּל־הָעָ֥ם אָמֵ֗ן הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃

lines.text: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! Let all the people say, “Amen.” Praise Yah!
Blessed [is] Jehovah, God of Israel, From the age even unto the age. And all the people said, 'Amen, praise Jah!'

107.he: הֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
'Give ye thanks to Jehovah, For good, for to the age [is] His kindness:'

107.he: יֹ֭אמְרוּ גְּאוּלֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר גְּ֝אָלָ֗ם מִיַּד־צָֽר׃

lines.text: Let the redeemed by Yahweh say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,
Let the redeemed of Jehovah say, Whom He redeemed from the hand of an adversary.

107.he: וּֽמֵאֲרָצ֗וֹת קִ֫בְּצָ֥ם מִמִּזְרָ֥ח וּמִֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב מִצָּפ֥וֹן וּמִיָּֽם׃

lines.text: And gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.
And from the lands hath gathered them, From east and from west, From north, and from the sea.

107.he: תָּע֣וּ בַ֭מִּדְבָּר בִּישִׁימ֣וֹן דָּ֑רֶךְ עִ֥יר מ֝וֹשָׁ֗ב לֹ֣א מָצָֽאוּ׃

lines.text: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.
They wandered in a wilderness, in a desert by the way, A city of habitation they have not found.

107.he: רְעֵבִ֥ים גַּם־צְמֵאִ֑ים נַ֝פְשָׁ֗ם בָּהֶ֥ם תִּתְעַטָּֽף׃

lines.text: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
Hungry — yea — thirsty, Their soul in them becometh feeble,

107.he: וַיִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֽוּקוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יַצִּילֵֽם׃

lines.text: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses,
And they cry unto Jehovah in their adversity, From their distress He delivereth them,

107.he: וַ֭יַּֽדְרִיכֵם בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יְשָׁרָ֑ה לָ֝לֶ֗כֶת אֶל־עִ֥יר מוֹשָֽׁב׃

lines.text: he led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.
And causeth them to tread in a right way, To go unto a city of habitation.

107.he: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

lines.text: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
They confess to Jehovah His kindness, And His wonders to the sons of men.

107.he: כִּי־הִ֭שְׂבִּיעַ נֶ֣פֶשׁ שֹׁקֵקָ֑ה וְנֶ֥פֶשׁ רְ֝עֵבָה מִלֵּא־טֽוֹב׃

lines.text: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.
For He hath satisfied a longing soul, And a hungry soul hath filled [with] goodness.

107.he: יֹ֭שְׁבֵי חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָ֑וֶת אֲסִירֵ֖י עֳנִ֣י וּבַרְזֶֽל׃

lines.text: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,
Inhabitants of dark places and death-shade, Prisoners of affliction and of iron,

107.he: כִּֽי־הִמְר֥וּ אִמְרֵי־אֵ֑ל וַעֲצַ֖ת עֶלְי֣וֹן נָאָֽצוּ׃

lines.text: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.
Because they changed the saying of God, And the counsel of the Most High despised.

107.he: וַיַּכְנַ֣ע בֶּעָמָ֣ל לִבָּ֑ם כָּ֝שְׁל֗וּ וְאֵ֣ין עֹזֵֽר׃

lines.text: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.
And He humbleth with labour their heart, They have been feeble, and there is no helper.

107.he: וַיִּזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֻֽקוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃

lines.text: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
And they cry unto Jehovah in their adversity, From their distresses He saveth them.

107.he: יֽ֭וֹצִיאֵם מֵחֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָ֑וֶת וּמוֹסְר֖וֹתֵיהֶ֣ם יְנַתֵּֽק׃

lines.text: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.
He bringeth them out from the dark place, And death-shade, And their bands He draweth away.

107.he: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

lines.text: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
They confess to Jehovah His kindness, And His wonders to the sons of men.

107.he: כִּֽי־שִׁ֭בַּר דַּלְת֣וֹת נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וּבְרִיחֵ֖י בַרְזֶ֣ל גִּדֵּֽעַ׃

lines.text: For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.
For He hath broken doors of brass, And bars of iron He hath cut.

107.he: אֱ֭וִלִים מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ פִּשְׁעָ֑ם וּֽ֝מֵעֲוֺֽנֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יִתְעַנּֽוּ׃

lines.text: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.
Fools, by means of their transgression, And by their iniquities, afflict themselves.

107.he: כָּל־אֹ֭כֶל תְּתַעֵ֣ב נַפְשָׁ֑ם וַ֝יַּגִּ֗יעוּ עַד־שַׁ֥עֲרֵי מָֽוֶת׃

lines.text: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.
All food doth their soul abominate, And they come nigh unto the gates of death,

107.he: וַיִּזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֻֽקוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃

lines.text: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, he saves them out of their distresses.
And cry unto Jehovah in their adversity, From their distresses He saveth them,

107.he: יִשְׁלַ֣ח דְּ֭בָרוֹ וְיִרְפָּאֵ֑ם וִֽ֝ימַלֵּ֗ט מִשְּׁחִיתוֹתָֽם׃

lines.text: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.
He sendeth His word and healeth them, And delivereth from their destructions.

107.he: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

lines.text: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
They confess to Jehovah His kindness, And His wonders to the sons of men,

107.he: וְ֭יִזְבְּחוּ זִבְחֵ֣י תוֹדָ֑ה וִֽיסַפְּר֖וּ מַעֲשָׂ֣יו בְּרִנָּֽה׃

lines.text: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.
And they sacrifice sacrifices of thanksgiving, And recount His works with singing.

107.he: יוֹרְדֵ֣י הַ֭יָּם בָּאֳנִיּ֑וֹת עֹשֵׂ֥י מְ֝לָאכָ֗ה בְּמַ֣יִם רַבִּֽים׃

lines.text: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters;
Those going down [to] the sea in ships, Doing business in many waters,

107.he: הֵ֣מָּה רָ֭אוּ מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו בִּמְצוּלָֽה׃

lines.text: These see Yahweh’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.
They have seen the works of Jehovah, And His wonders in the deep.

107.he: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר וַֽ֭יַּעֲמֵד ר֣וּחַ סְעָרָ֑ה וַתְּרוֹמֵ֥ם גַּלָּֽיו׃

lines.text: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.
And He saith, and appointeth a tempest, And it lifteth up its billows,

107.he: יַעֲל֣וּ שָׁ֭מַיִם יֵרְד֣וּ תְהוֹמ֑וֹת נַ֝פְשָׁ֗ם בְּרָעָ֥ה תִתְמוֹגָֽג׃

lines.text: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.
They go up [to] the heavens, they go down [to] the depths, Their soul in evil is melted.

107.he: יָח֣וֹגּוּ וְ֭יָנוּעוּ כַּשִּׁכּ֑וֹר וְכָל־חָ֝כְמָתָ֗ם תִּתְבַּלָּֽע׃

lines.text: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.
They reel to and fro, and move as a drunkard, And all their wisdom is swallowed up.

107.he: וַיִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם וּֽ֝מִמְּצֽוּקֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹצִיאֵֽם׃

lines.text: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.
And they cry to Jehovah in their adversity, And from their distresses He bringeth them out.

107.he: יָקֵ֣ם סְ֭עָרָה לִדְמָמָ֑ה וַ֝יֶּחֱשׁ֗וּ גַּלֵּיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.
He establisheth a whirlwind to a calm, And hushed are their billows.

107.he: וַיִּשְׂמְח֥וּ כִֽי־יִשְׁתֹּ֑קוּ וַ֝יַּנְחֵ֗ם אֶל־מְח֥וֹז חֶפְצָֽם׃

lines.text: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.
And they rejoice because they are quiet, And He leadeth them to the haven of their desire.

107.he: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

lines.text: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!
They confess to Jehovah His kindness, And His wonders to the sons of men,

107.he: וִֽ֭ירֹמְמוּהוּ בִּקְהַל־עָ֑ם וּבְמוֹשַׁ֖ב זְקֵנִ֣ים יְהַלְלֽוּהוּ׃

lines.text: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.
And they exalt Him in the assembly of the people, And in the seat of the elders praise Him.

107.he: יָשֵׂ֣ם נְהָר֣וֹת לְמִדְבָּ֑ר וּמֹצָ֥אֵי מַ֝֗יִם לְצִמָּאֽוֹן׃

lines.text: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,
He maketh rivers become a wilderness, And fountains of waters become dry land.

107.he: אֶ֣רֶץ פְּ֭רִי לִמְלֵחָ֑ה מֵ֝רָעַ֗ת יֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃

lines.text: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
A fruitful land becometh a barren place, For the wickedness of its inhabitants.

107.he: יָשֵׂ֣ם מִ֭דְבָּר לַֽאֲגַם־מַ֑יִם וְאֶ֥רֶץ צִ֝יָּ֗ה לְמֹצָ֥אֵי מָֽיִם׃

lines.text: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.
He maketh a wilderness become a pool of water, And a dry land become fountains of waters.

107.he: וַיּ֣וֹשֶׁב שָׁ֣ם רְעֵבִ֑ים וַ֝יְכוֹנְנ֗וּ עִ֣יר מוֹשָֽׁב׃

lines.text: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,
And He causeth the hungry to dwell there, And they prepare a city of habitation.

107.he: וַיִּזְרְע֣וּ שָׂ֭דוֹת וַיִּטְּע֣וּ כְרָמִ֑ים וַ֝יַּעֲשׂ֗וּ פְּרִ֣י תְבֽוּאָה׃

lines.text: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.
And they sow fields, and plant vineyards, And they make fruits of increase.

107.he: וַיְבָרֲכֵ֣ם וַיִּרְבּ֣וּ מְאֹ֑ד וּ֝בְהֶמְתָּ֗ם לֹ֣א יַמְעִֽיט׃

lines.text: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.
And He blesseth them, and they multiply exceedingly, And their cattle He doth not diminish.

107.he: וַיִּמְעֲט֥וּ וַיָּשֹׁ֑חוּ מֵעֹ֖צֶר רָעָ֣ה וְיָגֽוֹן׃

lines.text: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.
And they are diminished, and bow down, By restraint, evil, and sorrow.

107.he: שֹׁפֵ֣ךְ בּ֭וּז עַל־נְדִיבִ֑ים וַ֝יַּתְעֵ֗ם בְּתֹ֣הוּ לֹא־דָֽרֶךְ׃

lines.text: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.
He is pouring contempt upon nobles, And causeth them to wander in vacancy — no way.

107.he: וַיְשַׂגֵּ֣ב אֶבְי֣וֹן מֵע֑וֹנִי וַיָּ֥שֶׂם כַּ֝צֹּ֗אן מִשְׁפָּחֽוֹת׃

lines.text: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.
And setteth on high the needy from affliction, And placeth families as a flock.

107.he: יִרְא֣וּ יְשָׁרִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ וְכָל־עַ֝וְלָ֗ה קָ֣פְצָה פִּֽיהָ׃

lines.text: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.
The upright do see and rejoice, And all perversity hath shut her mouth.

107.he: מִי־חָכָ֥ם וְיִשְׁמָר־אֵ֑לֶּה וְ֝יִתְבּֽוֹנְנ֗וּ חַֽסְדֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of Yahweh.
Who [is] wise, and observeth these? They understand the kind acts of Jehovah!
A Song, a Psalm of David. Prepared is my heart, O God, I sing, yea, I sing praise, also my honour.

108.he: נָכ֣וֹן לִבִּ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָשִׁ֥ירָה וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה אַף־כְּבוֹדִֽי׃

lines.text: My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.
A Song, a Psalm of David. Prepared is my heart, O God, I sing, yea, I sing praise, also my honour.
Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.
Awake, psaltery and harp, I awake the dawn.
I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.
I thank Thee among peoples, O Jehovah, And I praise Thee among the nations.
For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
For great above the heavens [is] Thy kindness, And unto the clouds Thy truth.

108.he: ר֣וּמָה עַל־שָׁמַ֣יִם אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְעַ֖ל כָּל־הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.
Be Thou exalted above the heavens, O God, And above all the earth Thy honour.

108.he: לְ֭מַעַן יֵחָלְצ֣וּן יְדִידֶ֑יךָ הוֹשִׁ֖יעָה יְמִֽינְךָ֣ וַעֲנֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
That Thy beloved ones may be delivered, Save [with] Thy right hand, and answer us.

108.he: אֱלֹהִ֤ים ׀ דִּבֶּ֥ר בְּקָדְשׁ֗וֹ אֶ֫עְלֹ֥זָה אֲחַלְּקָ֥ה שְׁכֶ֑ם וְעֵ֖מֶק סֻכּ֣וֹת אֲמַדֵּֽד׃

lines.text: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
God hath spoken in His holiness: I exult, I apportion Shechem, And the valley of Succoth I measure,

108.he: לִ֤י גִלְעָ֨ד ׀ לִ֤י מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה וְ֭אֶפְרַיִם מָע֣וֹז רֹאשִׁ֑י יְ֝הוּדָ֗ה מְחֹקְקִֽי׃

lines.text: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.
Mine [is] Gilead, mine [is] Manasseh, And Ephraim [is] the strength of my head, Judah [is] my lawgiver,

108.he: מוֹאָ֤ב ׀ סִ֬יר רַחְצִ֗י עַל־אֱ֭דוֹם אַשְׁלִ֣יךְ נַעֲלִ֑י עֲלֵֽי־פְ֝לֶ֗שֶׁת אֶתְרוֹעָֽע׃

lines.text: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”
Moab [is] a pot for my washing, Upon Edom I cast my shoe, Over Philistia I shout habitually.

108.he: מִ֣י יֹ֭בִלֵנִי עִ֣יר מִבְצָ֑ר מִ֖י נָחַ֣נִי עַד־אֱדֽוֹם׃

lines.text: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who has led me to Edom?
Who doth bring me in to the fenced city? Who hath led me unto Edom?
Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.
Hast not Thou, O God, cast us off? And Thou goest not out, O God, with our hosts!

108.he: הָֽבָה־לָּ֣נוּ עֶזְרָ֣ת מִצָּ֑ר וְ֝שָׁ֗וְא תְּשׁוּעַ֥ת אָדָֽם׃

lines.text: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.
Give to us help from adversity, And vain is the salvation of man.
Through God, we will do valiantly. For it is he who will tread down our enemies.
In God we do mightily, And He doth tread down our adversaries!

109.he: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִ֣ד מִזְמ֑וֹר אֱלֹהֵ֥י תְ֝הִלָּתִ֗י אַֽל־תֶּחֱרַֽשׁ׃

lines.text: God of my praise, don’t remain silent,
To the Overseer. — A Psalm of David. O God of my praise, be not silent,

109.he: כִּ֤י פִ֪י רָשָׁ֡ע וּֽפִי־מִ֭רְמָה עָלַ֣י פָּתָ֑חוּ דִּבְּר֥וּ אִ֝תִּ֗י לְשׁ֣וֹן שָֽׁקֶר׃

lines.text: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.
For the mouth of wickedness, and the mouth of deceit, Against me they have opened, They have spoken with me — A tongue of falsehood, and words of hatred!

109.he: וְדִבְרֵ֣י שִׂנְאָ֣ה סְבָב֑וּנִי וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֥וּנִי חִנָּֽם׃

lines.text: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.
They have compassed me about, And they fight me without cause.

109.he: תַּֽחַת־אַהֲבָתִ֥י יִשְׂטְנ֗וּנִי וַאֲנִ֥י תְפִלָּֽה׃

lines.text: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
For my love they oppose me, and I — prayer!

109.he: וַיָּ֘שִׂ֤ימוּ עָלַ֣י רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה וְ֝שִׂנְאָ֗ה תַּ֣חַת אַהֲבָתִֽי׃

lines.text: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
And they set against me evil for good, And hatred for my love.

109.he: הַפְקֵ֣ד עָלָ֣יו רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝שָׂטָ֗ן יַעֲמֹ֥ד עַל־יְמִינֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.
Appoint Thou over him the wicked, And an adversary standeth at his right hand.

109.he: בְּ֭הִשָּׁ֣פְטוֹ יֵצֵ֣א רָשָׁ֑ע ו֝תְפִלָּת֗וֹ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לַֽחֲטָאָֽה׃

lines.text: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.
In his being judged, he goeth forth wicked, And his prayer is for sin.

109.he: יִֽהְיֽוּ־יָמָ֥יו מְעַטִּ֑ים פְּ֝קֻדָּת֗וֹ יִקַּ֥ח אַחֵֽר׃

lines.text: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.
His days are few, his oversight another taketh,

109.he: יִֽהְיוּ־בָנָ֥יו יְתוֹמִ֑ים וְ֝אִשְׁתּוֹ אַלְמָנָֽה׃

lines.text: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
His sons are fatherless, and his wife a widow.

109.he: וְנ֤וֹעַ יָנ֣וּעוּ בָנָ֣יו וְשִׁאֵ֑לוּ וְ֝דָרְשׁ֗וּ מֵחָרְבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.
And wander continually do his sons, Yea, they have begged, And have sought out of their dry places.

109.he: יְנַקֵּ֣שׁ נ֭וֹשֶׁה לְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־ל֑וֹ וְיָבֹ֖זּוּ זָרִ֣ים יְגִיעֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.
An exactor layeth a snare for all that he hath, And strangers spoil his labour.

109.he: אַל־יְהִי־ל֭וֹ מֹשֵׁ֣ךְ חָ֑סֶד וְֽאַל־יְהִ֥י ח֝וֹנֵ֗ן לִיתוֹמָֽיו׃

lines.text: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.
He hath none to extend kindness, Nor is there one showing favour to his orphans.

109.he: יְהִֽי־אַחֲרִית֥וֹ לְהַכְרִ֑ית בְּד֥וֹר אַ֝חֵ֗ר יִמַּ֥ח שְׁמָֽם׃

lines.text: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
His posterity is for cutting off, In another generation is their name blotted out.

109.he: יִזָּכֵ֤ר ׀ עֲוֺ֣ן אֲ֭בֹתָיו אֶל־יְהוָ֑ה וְחַטַּ֥את אִ֝מּ֗וֹ אַל־תִּמָּֽח׃

lines.text: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by Yahweh. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.
The iniquity of his fathers Is remembered unto Jehovah, And the sin of his mother is not blotted out.

109.he: יִהְי֣וּ נֶֽגֶד־יְהוָ֣ה תָּמִ֑יד וְיַכְרֵ֖ת מֵאֶ֣רֶץ זִכְרָֽם׃

lines.text: Let them be before Yahweh continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;
They are before Jehovah continually, And He cutteth off from earth their memorial.

109.he: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר ׀ לֹ֥א זָכַר֮ עֲשׂ֪וֹת חָ֥סֶד וַיִּרְדֹּ֡ף אִישׁ־עָנִ֣י וְ֭אֶבְיוֹן וְנִכְאֵ֨ה לֵבָ֬ב לְמוֹתֵֽת׃

lines.text: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.
Because that he hath not remembered to do kindness, And pursueth the poor man and needy, And the smitten of heart — to slay,

109.he: וַיֶּאֱהַ֣ב קְ֭לָלָה וַתְּבוֹאֵ֑הוּ וְֽלֹא־חָפֵ֥ץ בִּ֝בְרָכָ֗ה וַתִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.
And he loveth reviling, and it meeteth him, And he hath not delighted in blessing, And it is far from him.

109.he: וַיִּלְבַּ֥שׁ קְלָלָ֗ה כְּמַ֫דּ֥וֹ וַתָּבֹ֣א כַמַּ֣יִם בְּקִרְבּ֑וֹ וְ֝כַשֶּׁ֗מֶן בְּעַצְמוֹתָֽיו׃

lines.text: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.
And he putteth on reviling as his robe, And it cometh in as water into his midst, And as oil into his bones.

109.he: תְּהִי־ל֭וֹ כְּבֶ֣גֶד יַעְטֶ֑ה וּ֝לְמֵ֗זַח תָּמִ֥יד יַחְגְּרֶֽהָ׃

lines.text: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.
It is to him as apparel — he covereth himself, And for a continual girdle he girdeth it on.

109.he: זֹ֤את פְּעֻלַּ֣ת שֹׂ֭טְנַי מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְהַדֹּבְרִ֥ים רָ֝֗ע עַל־נַפְשִֽׁי׃

lines.text: This is the reward of my adversaries from Yahweh, of those who speak evil against my soul.
This [is] the wage of mine accusers from Jehovah, And of those speaking evil against my soul.

109.he: וְאַתָּ֤ה ׀ יְה֘וִ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֗י עֲֽשֵׂה־אִ֭תִּי לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּי־ט֥וֹב חַ֝סְדְּךָ֗ הַצִּילֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: But deal with me, Yahweh the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;
And Thou, O Jehovah Lord, Deal with me for Thy name's sake, Because Thy kindness [is] good, deliver me.

109.he: כִּֽי־עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְי֣וֹן אָנֹ֑כִי וְ֝לִבִּ֗י חָלַ֥ל בְּקִרְבִּֽי׃

lines.text: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.
For I [am] poor and needy, And my heart hath been pierced in my midst.

109.he: כְּצֵל־כִּנְטוֹת֥וֹ נֶהֱלָ֑כְתִּי נִ֝נְעַ֗רְתִּי כָּֽאַרְבֶּֽה׃

lines.text: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.
As a shadow when it is stretched out I have gone, I have been driven away as a locust.

109.he: בִּ֭רְכַּי כָּשְׁל֣וּ מִצּ֑וֹם וּ֝בְשָׂרִ֗י כָּחַ֥שׁ מִשָּֽׁמֶן׃

lines.text: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.
My knees have been feeble from fasting, And my flesh hath failed of fatness.

109.he: וַאֲנִ֤י ׀ הָיִ֣יתִי חֶרְפָּ֣ה לָהֶ֑ם יִ֝רְא֗וּנִי יְנִיע֥וּן רֹאשָֽׁם׃

lines.text: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.
And I — I have been a reproach to them, They see me, they shake their head.

109.he: עָ֭זְרֵנִי יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י ה֖וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי כְחַסְדֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: Help me, Yahweh, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;
Help me, O Jehovah my God, Save me, according to Thy kindness.

109.he: וְֽ֭יֵדְעוּ כִּי־יָ֣דְךָ זֹּ֑את אַתָּ֖ה יְהוָ֣ה עֲשִׂיתָֽהּ׃

lines.text: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, Yahweh, have done it.
And they know that this [is] Thy hand, Thou, O Jehovah, Thou hast done it.

109.he: יְקַֽלְלוּ־הֵמָּה֮ וְאַתָּ֪ה תְבָ֫רֵ֥ךְ קָ֤מוּ ׀ וַיֵּבֹ֗שׁוּ וְֽעַבְדְּךָ֥ יִשְׂמָֽח׃

lines.text: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.
They revile, and Thou dost bless, They have risen, and are ashamed, And Thy servant doth rejoice.

109.he: יִלְבְּשׁ֣וּ שׂוֹטְנַ֣י כְּלִמָּ֑ה וְיַעֲט֖וּ כַמְעִ֣יל בָּשְׁתָּֽם׃

lines.text: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
Mine accusers put on blushing, and are covered, As an upper robe [is] their shame.

109.he: א֘וֹדֶ֤ה יְהוָ֣ה מְאֹ֣ד בְּפִ֑י וּבְת֖וֹךְ רַבִּ֣ים אֲהַֽלְלֶֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: I will give great thanks to Yahweh with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.
I thank Jehovah greatly with my mouth, And in the midst of many I praise Him,

109.he: כִּֽי־יַ֭עֲמֹד לִימִ֣ין אֶבְי֑וֹן לְ֝הוֹשִׁ֗יעַ מִשֹּׁפְטֵ֥י נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

lines.text: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.
For He standeth at the right hand of the needy, To save from those judging his soul.

110.he: לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר נְאֻ֤ם יְהוָ֨ה ׀ לַֽאדֹנִ֗י שֵׁ֥ב לִֽימִינִ֑י עַד־אָשִׁ֥ית אֹ֝יְבֶ֗יךָ הֲדֹ֣ם לְרַגְלֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Yahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
A Psalm of David. The affirmation of Jehovah to my Lord: 'Sit at My right hand, Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.'

110.he: מַטֵּֽה־עֻזְּךָ֗ יִשְׁלַ֣ח יְ֭הוָה מִצִיּ֑וֹן רְ֝דֵ֗ה בְּקֶ֣רֶב אֹיְבֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Yahweh will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.
The rod of thy strength doth Jehovah send from Zion, Rule in the midst of thine enemies.

110.he: עַמְּךָ֣ נְדָבֹת֮ בְּי֪וֹם חֵ֫ילֶ֥ךָ בְּֽהַדְרֵי־קֹ֭דֶשׁ מֵרֶ֣חֶם מִשְׁחָ֑ר לְ֝ךָ֗ טַ֣ל יַלְדֻתֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.
Thy people [are] free-will gifts in the day of Thy strength, in the honours of holiness, From the womb, from the morning, Thou hast the dew of thy youth.

110.he: נִשְׁבַּ֤ע יְהוָ֨ה ׀ וְלֹ֥א יִנָּחֵ֗ם אַתָּֽה־כֹהֵ֥ן לְעוֹלָ֑ם עַל־דִּ֝בְרָתִ֗י מַלְכִּי־צֶֽדֶק׃

lines.text: Yahweh has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
Jehovah hath sworn, and doth not repent, 'Thou [art] a priest to the age, According to the order of Melchizedek.'
The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.
The Lord on thy right hand smote kings In the day of His anger.

110.he: יָדִ֣ין בַּ֭גּוֹיִם מָלֵ֣א גְוִיּ֑וֹת מָ֥חַץ רֹ֝֗אשׁ עַל־אֶ֥רֶץ רַבָּֽה׃

lines.text: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.
He doth judge among the nations, He hath completed the carcases, Hath smitten the head over the mighty earth.

110.he: מִ֭נַּחַל בַּדֶּ֣רֶךְ יִשְׁתֶּ֑ה עַל־כֵּ֝֗ן יָרִ֥ים רֹֽאשׁ׃

lines.text: He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.
From a brook in the way he drinketh, Therefore he doth lift up the head!

111.he: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ ׀ אוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל־לֵבָ֑ב בְּס֖וֹד יְשָׁרִ֣ים וְעֵדָֽה׃

lines.text: Praise Yah! I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
Praise ye Jah! I thank Jehovah with the whole heart, In the secret meeting of the upright, And of the company.
Yahweh’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
Great [are] the works of Jehovah, Sought out by all desiring them.
His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.
Honourable and majestic is His work, And His righteousness is standing for ever.

111.he: זֵ֣כֶר עָ֭שָׂה לְנִפְלְאֹתָ֑יו חַנּ֖וּן וְרַח֣וּם יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. Yahweh is gracious and merciful.
A memorial He hath made of His wonders, Gracious and merciful [is] Jehovah.

111.he: טֶ֭רֶף נָתַ֣ן לִֽירֵאָ֑יו יִזְכֹּ֖ר לְעוֹלָ֣ם בְּרִיתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.
Prey He hath given to those fearing Him, He remembereth to the age His covenant.

111.he: כֹּ֣חַ מַ֭עֲשָׂיו הִגִּ֣יד לְעַמּ֑וֹ לָתֵ֥ת לָ֝הֶ֗ם נַחֲלַ֥ת גּוֹיִֽם׃

lines.text: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.
The power of His works He hath declared to His people, To give to them the inheritance of nations.

111.he: מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יָ֭דָיו אֱמֶ֣ת וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט נֶ֝אֱמָנִ֗ים כָּל־פִּקּוּדָֽיו׃

lines.text: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.
The works of His hands [are] true and just, Stedfast [are] all His appointments.

111.he: סְמוּכִ֣ים לָעַ֣ד לְעוֹלָ֑ם עֲ֝שׂוּיִ֗ם בֶּאֱמֶ֥ת וְיָשָֽׁר׃

lines.text: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.
They are sustained for ever to the age. They are made in truth and uprightness.

111.he: פְּד֤וּת ׀ שָׁ֘לַ֤ח לְעַמּ֗וֹ צִוָּֽה־לְעוֹלָ֥ם בְּרִית֑וֹ קָד֖וֹשׁ וְנוֹרָ֣א שְׁמֽוֹ׃

lines.text: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!
Redemption He hath sent to His people, He hath appointed to the age His covenant, Holy and fearful [is] His name.

111.he: רֵ֘אשִׁ֤ית חָכְמָ֨ה ׀ יִרְאַ֬ת יְהוָ֗ה שֵׂ֣כֶל ט֭וֹב לְכָל־עֹשֵׂיהֶ֑ם תְּ֝הִלָּת֗וֹ עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָעַֽד׃

lines.text: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!
The beginning of wisdom [is] fear of Jehovah, Good understanding have all doing them, His praise [is] standing for ever!

112.he: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ ׀ אַשְׁרֵי־אִ֭ישׁ יָרֵ֣א אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה בְּ֝מִצְוֺתָ֗יו חָפֵ֥ץ מְאֹֽד׃

lines.text: Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.
Praise ye Jah! O the happiness of one fearing Jehovah, In His commands he hath delighted greatly.

112.he: גִּבּ֣וֹר בָּ֭אָרֶץ יִהְיֶ֣ה זַרְע֑וֹ דּ֖וֹר יְשָׁרִ֣ים יְבֹרָֽךְ׃

lines.text: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.
Mighty in the earth is his seed, The generation of the upright is blessed.
Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.
Wealth and riches [are] in his house, And his righteousness is standing for ever.

112.he: זָ֘רַ֤ח בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ א֭וֹר לַיְשָׁרִ֑ים חַנּ֖וּן וְרַח֣וּם וְצַדִּֽיק׃

lines.text: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.
Light hath risen in darkness to the upright, Gracious, and merciful, and righteous.

112.he: טֽוֹב־אִ֭ישׁ חוֹנֵ֣ן וּמַלְוֶ֑ה יְכַלְכֵּ֖ל דְּבָרָ֣יו בְּמִשְׁפָּֽט׃

lines.text: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.
Good [is] the man — gracious and lending, He sustaineth his matters in judgment.

112.he: כִּֽי־לְעוֹלָ֥ם לֹא־יִמּ֑וֹט לְזֵ֥כֶר ע֝וֹלָ֗ם יִהְיֶ֥ה צַדִּֽיק׃

lines.text: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.
For — to the age he is not moved; For a memorial age-during is the righteous.

112.he: מִשְּׁמוּעָ֣ה רָ֭עָה לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א נָכ֥וֹן לִ֝בּ֗וֹ בָּטֻ֥חַ בַּיהוָֽה׃

lines.text: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.
Of an evil report he is not afraid, Prepared is His heart, confident in Jehovah.

112.he: סָמ֣וּךְ לִ֭בּוֹ לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א עַ֖ד אֲשֶׁר־יִרְאֶ֣ה בְצָרָֽיו׃

lines.text: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.
Sustained is his heart — he feareth not, Till that he look on his adversaries.

112.he: פִּזַּ֤ר ׀ נָ֘תַ֤ן לָאֶבְיוֹנִ֗ים צִ֭דְקָתוֹ עֹמֶ֣דֶת לָעַ֑ד קַ֝רְנ֗וֹ תָּר֥וּם בְּכָבֽוֹד׃

lines.text: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.
He hath scattered — hath given to the needy, His righteousness is standing for ever, His horn is exalted with honour.

112.he: רָ֘שָׁ֤ע יִרְאֶ֨ה ׀ וְכָעָ֗ס שִׁנָּ֣יו יַחֲרֹ֣ק וְנָמָ֑ס תַּאֲוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃

lines.text: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.
The wicked seeth, and hath been angry, His teeth he gnasheth, and hath melted, The desire of the wicked doth perish!

113.he: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ ׀ הַ֭לְלוּ עַבְדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הַֽ֝לְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: Praise Yah! Praise, you servants of Yahweh, praise Yahweh’s name.
Praise ye Jah! Praise, ye servants of Jehovah. Praise the name of Jehovah.

113.he: יְהִ֤י שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֣ה מְבֹרָ֑ךְ מֵֽ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

lines.text: Blessed be Yahweh’s name, from this time forward and forever more.
The name of Jehovah is blessed, From henceforth, and unto the age.
From the rising of the sun to its going down, Yahweh’s name is to be praised.
From the rising of the sun unto its going in, Praised [is] the name of Jehovah.

113.he: רָ֖ם עַל־כָּל־גּוֹיִ֥ם ׀ יְהוָ֑ה עַ֖ל הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Yahweh is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.
High above all nations [is] Jehovah, Above the heavens [is] his honour.
Who is like Yahweh, our God, who has his seat on high,
Who [is] as Jehovah our God, He is exalting [Himself] to sit?
Who stoops down to see in heaven and in the earth?
He is humbling [Himself] to look On the heavens and on the earth.

113.he: מְקִֽימִ֣י מֵעָפָ֣ר דָּ֑ל מֵֽ֝אַשְׁפֹּ֗ת יָרִ֥ים אֶבְיֽוֹן׃

lines.text: He raises up the poor out of the dust. Lifts up the needy from the ash heap,
He is raising up from the dust the poor, From a dunghill He exalteth the needy.
that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
To cause to sit with princes, With the princes of His people.

113.he: מֽוֹשִׁיבִ֨י ׀ עֲקֶ֬רֶת הַבַּ֗יִת אֵֽם־הַבָּנִ֥ים שְׂמֵחָ֗ה הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃

lines.text: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise Yah!
Causing the barren one of the house to sit, A joyful mother of sons; praise ye Jah!

114.he: בְּצֵ֣את יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם בֵּ֥ית יַ֝עֲקֹ֗ב מֵעַ֥ם לֹעֵֽז׃

lines.text: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language,
In the going out of Israel from Egypt, The house of Jacob from a strange people,
Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
Judah became His sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

114.he: הַיָּ֣ם רָ֭אָה וַיָּנֹ֑ס הַ֝יַּרְדֵּ֗ן יִסֹּ֥ב לְאָחֽוֹר׃

lines.text: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.
The sea hath seen, and fleeth, The Jordan turneth backward.
The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.
The mountains have skipped as rams, Heights as sons of a flock.

114.he: מַה־לְּךָ֣ הַ֭יָּם כִּ֣י תָנ֑וּס הַ֝יַּרְדֵּ֗ן תִּסֹּ֥ב לְאָחֽוֹר׃

lines.text: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?
What — to thee, O sea, that thou fleest? O Jordan, thou turnest back!
You mountains, that you skipped like rams; you little hills, like lambs?
O mountains, ye skip as rams! O heights, as sons of a flock!

114.he: מִלִּפְנֵ֣י אָ֭דוֹן ח֣וּלִי אָ֑רֶץ מִ֝לִּפְנֵ֗י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַעֲקֹֽב׃

lines.text: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
From before the Lord be afraid, O earth, From before the God of Jacob,
who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.
He is turning the rock to a pool of waters, The flint to a fountain of waters!

115.he: לֹ֤א לָ֥נוּ יְהוָ֗ה לֹ֫א לָ֥נוּ כִּֽי־לְ֭שִׁמְךָ תֵּ֣ן כָּב֑וֹד עַל־חַ֝סְדְּךָ֗ עַל־אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: Not to us, Yahweh, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.
Not to us, O Jehovah, not to us, But to Thy name give honour, For Thy kindness, for Thy truth.
Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”
Why do the nations say, 'Where, pray, [is] their God.
But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.
And our God [is] in the heavens, All that He hath pleased He hath done.

115.he: עֲֽ֭צַבֵּיהֶם כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗ה יְדֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃

lines.text: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
Their idols [are] silver and gold, work of man's hands,

115.he: פֶּֽה־לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ עֵינַ֥יִם לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֽוּ׃

lines.text: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.
A mouth they have, and they speak not, Eyes they have, and they see not,

115.he: אָזְנַ֣יִם לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יִשְׁמָ֑עוּ אַ֥ף לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יְרִיחֽוּן׃

lines.text: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.
Ears they have, and they hear not, A nose they have, and they smell not,

115.he: יְדֵיהֶ֤ם ׀ וְלֹ֬א יְמִישׁ֗וּן רַ֭גְלֵיהֶם וְלֹ֣א יְהַלֵּ֑כוּ לֹֽא־יֶ֝הְגּ֗וּ בִּגְרוֹנָֽם׃

lines.text: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.
Their hands, but they handle not, Their feet, and they walk not;

115.he: כְּ֭מוֹהֶם יִהְי֣וּ עֹשֵׂיהֶ֑ם כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־בֹּטֵ֣חַ בָּהֶֽם׃

lines.text: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.
Nor do they mutter through their throat, Like them are their makers, Every one who is trusting in them.

115.he: יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל בְּטַ֣ח בַּיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא׃

lines.text: Israel, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
O Israel, trust in Jehovah, 'Their help and their shield [is] He.'

115.he: בֵּ֣ית אַ֭הֲרֹן בִּטְח֣וּ בַיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא׃

lines.text: House of Aaron, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
O house of Aaron, trust in Jehovah, 'Their help and their shield [is] He.'

115.he: יִרְאֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה בִּטְח֣וּ בַיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא׃

lines.text: You who fear Yahweh, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
Ye fearing Jehovah, trust in Jehovah, 'Their help and their shield [is] He.'

115.he: יְהוָה֮ זְכָרָ֪נוּ יְבָ֫רֵ֥ךְ יְ֭בָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְ֝בָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת־בֵּ֥ית אַהֲרֹֽן׃

lines.text: Yahweh remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.
Jehovah hath remembered us, He blesseth, He blesseth the house of Israel, He blesseth the house of Aaron,
He will bless those who fear Yahweh, both small and great.
He blesseth those fearing Jehovah, The small with the great.
May Yahweh increase you more and more, you and your children.
Jehovah addeth to you, to you, and to your sons.

115.he: בְּרוּכִ֣ים אַ֭תֶּם לַיהוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: Blessed are you by Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
Blessed [are] ye of Jehovah, maker of heaven and earth,

115.he: הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם שָׁ֭מַיִם לַיהוָ֑ה וְ֝הָאָ֗רֶץ נָתַ֥ן לִבְנֵי־אָדָֽם׃

lines.text: The heavens are Yahweh’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.
The heavens — the heavens [are] Jehovah's, And the earth He hath given to sons of men,

115.he: לֹ֣א הַ֭מֵּתִים יְהַֽלְלוּ־יָ֑הּ וְ֝לֹ֗א כָּל־יֹרְדֵ֥י דוּמָֽה׃

lines.text: The dead don’t praise Yah, neither any who go down into silence;
The dead praise not Jah, Nor any going down to silence.

115.he: וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ ׀ נְבָ֘רֵ֤ךְ יָ֗הּ מֵֽעַתָּ֥ה וְעַד־עוֹלָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃

lines.text: but we will bless Yah, from this time forward and forever more. Praise Yah!
And we, we bless Jah, From henceforth, and unto the age. Praise ye Jah!
I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
I have loved, because Jehovah heareth My voice, my supplication,
Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
Because He hath inclined His ear to me, And during my days I call.

116.he: אֲפָפ֤וּנִי ׀ חֶבְלֵי־מָ֗וֶת וּמְצָרֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל מְצָא֑וּנִי צָרָ֖ה וְיָג֣וֹן אֶמְצָֽא׃

lines.text: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.
Compassed me have cords of death, And straits of Sheol have found me, Distress and sorrow I find.

116.he: וּבְשֵֽׁם־יְהוָ֥ה אֶקְרָ֑א אָנָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה מַלְּטָ֥ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃

lines.text: Then I called on Yahweh’s name: “Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
And in the name of Jehovah I call: I pray Thee, O Jehovah, deliver my soul,
Yahweh is Gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.
Gracious [is] Jehovah, and righteous, Yea, our God [is] merciful,

116.he: שֹׁמֵ֣ר פְּתָאיִ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה דַּ֝לּוֹתִ֗י וְלִ֣י יְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃

lines.text: Yahweh preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.
A preserver of the simple [is] Jehovah, I was low, and to me He giveth salvation.

116.he: שׁוּבִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי לִמְנוּחָ֑יְכִי כִּֽי־יְ֝הוָ֗ה גָּמַ֥ל עָלָֽיְכִי׃

lines.text: Return to your rest, my soul, for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you.
Turn back, O my soul, to thy rest, For Jehovah hath conferred benefits on thee.

116.he: כִּ֤י חִלַּ֥צְתָּ נַפְשִׁ֗י מִ֫מָּ֥וֶת אֶת־עֵינִ֥י מִן־דִּמְעָ֑ה אֶת־רַגְלִ֥י מִדֶּֽחִי׃

lines.text: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
For Thou hast delivered my soul from death, My eyes from tears, my feet from overthrowing.
I will walk before Yahweh in the land of the living.
I walk habitually before Jehovah In the lands of the living.

116.he: הֶ֭אֱמַנְתִּי כִּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אֲ֝נִ֗י עָנִ֥יתִי מְאֹֽד׃

lines.text: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”
I have believed, for I speak, I — I have been afflicted greatly.
I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”
I said in my haste, 'Every man [is] a liar.'
What will I give to Yahweh for all his benefits toward me?
What do I return to Jehovah? All His benefits [are] upon me.
I will take the cup of salvation, and call on Yahweh’s name.
The cup of salvation I lift up, And in the name of Jehovah I call.
I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people.
My vows to Jehovah let me complete, I pray you, before all His people.
Precious in Yahweh’s sight is the death of his saints.
Precious in the eyes of Jehovah [is] the death for His saints.

116.he: אָֽנָּ֣ה יְהוָה֮ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֪י עַ֫בְדֶּ֥ךָ אֲֽנִי־עַ֭בְדְּךָ בֶּן־אֲמָתֶ֑ךָ פִּ֝תַּ֗חְתָּ לְמוֹסֵרָֽי׃

lines.text: Yahweh, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.
Cause [it] to come, O Jehovah, for I [am] Thy servant. I [am] Thy servant, son of Thy handmaid, Thou hast opened my bonds.

116.he: לְֽךָ־אֶ֭זְבַּח זֶ֣בַח תּוֹדָ֑ה וּבְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָֽא׃

lines.text: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on Yahweh’s name.
To Thee I sacrifice a sacrifice of thanks, And in the name of Jehovah I call.
I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people,
My vows to Jehovah let me complete, I pray you, before all His people,

116.he: בְּחַצְר֤וֹת ׀ בֵּ֤ית יְהוָ֗ה בְּֽת֘וֹכֵ֤כִי יְֽרוּשָׁלִָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃

lines.text: in the courts of Yahweh’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise Yah!
In the courts of the house of Jehovah, In thy midst, O Jerusalem, praise ye Jah!
Praise Yahweh, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!
Praise Jehovah, all ye nations, Glorify Him, all ye peoples.

117.he: כִּ֥י גָ֘בַ֤ר עָלֵ֨ינוּ ׀ חַסְדּ֗וֹ וֶֽאֱמֶת־יְהוָ֥ה לְעוֹלָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃

lines.text: For his loving kindness is great toward us. Yahweh’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise Yah!
For mighty to us hath been His kindness, And the truth of Jehovah [is] to the age. Praise ye Jah!

118.he: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
Give ye thanks to Jehovah, For good, for to the age [is] His kindness.

118.he: יֹֽאמַר־נָ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
I pray you, let Israel say, That, to the age [is] His kindness.

118.he: יֹֽאמְרוּ־נָ֥א בֵֽית־אַהֲרֹ֑ן כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
I pray you, let the house of Aaron say, That, to the age [is] His kindness.

118.he: יֹֽאמְרוּ־נָ֭א יִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Now let those who fear Yahweh say that his loving kindness endures forever.
I pray you, let those fearing Jehovah say, That, to the age [is] His kindness.

118.he: מִֽן־הַ֭מֵּצַ֥ר קָרָ֣אתִי יָּ֑הּ עָנָ֖נִי בַמֶּרְחָ֣ב יָֽהּ׃

lines.text: Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.
From the straitness I called Jah, Jah answered me in a broad place.

118.he: יְהוָ֣ה לִ֭י לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה לִ֣י אָדָֽם׃

lines.text: Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
Jehovah [is] for me, I do not fear what man doth to me.

118.he: יְהוָ֣ה לִ֭י בְּעֹזְרָ֑י וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶרְאֶ֥ה בְשֹׂנְאָֽי׃

lines.text: Yahweh is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.
Jehovah [is] for me among my helpers, And I — I look on those hating me.

118.he: ט֗וֹב לַחֲס֥וֹת בַּיהוָ֑ה מִ֝בְּטֹ֗חַ בָּאָדָֽם׃

lines.text: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in man.
Better to take refuge in Jehovah than to trust in man,

118.he: ט֗וֹב לַחֲס֥וֹת בַּיהוָ֑ה מִ֝בְּטֹ֗חַ בִּנְדִיבִֽים׃

lines.text: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in princes.
Better to take refuge in Jehovah, Than to trust in princes.

118.he: כָּל־גּוֹיִ֥ם סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃

lines.text: All the nations surrounded me, but in Yahweh’s name, I cut them off.
All nations have compassed me about, In the name of Jehovah I surely cut them off.

118.he: סַבּ֥וּנִי גַם־סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃

lines.text: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In Yahweh’s name I indeed cut them off.
They have compassed me about, Yea, they have compassed me about, In the name of Jehovah I surely cut them off.

118.he: סַבּ֤וּנִי כִדְבוֹרִ֗ים דֹּ֭עֲכוּ כְּאֵ֣שׁ קוֹצִ֑ים בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃

lines.text: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In Yahweh’s name I cut them off.
They compassed me about as bees, They have been extinguished as a fire of thorns, In the name of Jehovah I surely cut them off.

118.he: דַּחֹ֣ה דְחִיתַ֣נִי לִנְפֹּ֑ל וַ֖יהוָ֣ה עֲזָרָֽנִי׃

lines.text: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but Yahweh helped me.
Thou hast sorely thrust me to fall, And Jehovah hath helped me.

118.he: עָזִּ֣י וְזִמְרָ֣ת יָ֑הּ וַֽיְהִי־לִ֝֗י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה׃

lines.text: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
My strength and song [is] Jah, And He is to me for salvation.

118.he: ק֤וֹל ׀ רִנָּ֬ה וִֽישׁוּעָ֗ה בְּאָהֳלֵ֥י צַדִּיקִ֑ים יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל׃

lines.text: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly.
A voice of singing and salvation, [Is] in the tents of the righteous, The right hand of Jehovah is doing valiantly.

118.he: יְמִ֣ין יְ֭הוָה רוֹמֵמָ֑ה יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל׃

lines.text: The right hand of Yahweh is exalted! The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly!”
The right hand of Jehovah is exalted, The right hand of Jehovah is doing valiantly.

118.he: לֹֽא אָמ֥וּת כִּי־אֶֽחְיֶ֑ה וַ֝אֲסַפֵּ֗ר מַֽעֲשֵׂ֥י יָֽהּ׃

lines.text: I will not die, but live, and declare Yah’s works.
I do not die, but live, And recount the works of Jah,

118.he: יַסֹּ֣ר יִסְּרַ֣נִּי יָּ֑הּ וְ֝לַמָּ֗וֶת לֹ֣א נְתָנָֽנִי׃

lines.text: Yah has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.
Jah hath sorely chastened me, And to death hath not given me up.

118.he: פִּתְחוּ־לִ֥י שַׁעֲרֵי־צֶ֑דֶק אָֽבֹא־בָ֝ם אוֹדֶ֥ה יָֽהּ׃

lines.text: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to Yah.
Open ye to me gates of righteousness, I enter into them — I thank Jah.

118.he: זֶֽה־הַשַּׁ֥עַר לַיהוָ֑ה צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים יָבֹ֥אוּ בֽוֹ׃

lines.text: This is the gate of Yahweh; the righteous will enter into it.
This [is] the gate to Jehovah, The righteous enter into it.

118.he: א֭וֹדְךָ כִּ֣י עֲנִיתָ֑נִי וַתְּהִי־לִ֝֗י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה׃

lines.text: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.
I thank Thee, for Thou hast answered me, And art to me for salvation.

118.he: אֶ֭בֶן מָאֲס֣וּ הַבּוֹנִ֑ים הָ֝יְתָ֗ה לְרֹ֣אשׁ פִּנָּֽה׃

lines.text: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
A stone the builders refused Hath become head of a corner.

118.he: מֵאֵ֣ת יְ֭הוָה הָ֣יְתָה זֹּ֑את הִ֖יא נִפְלָ֣את בְּעֵינֵֽינוּ׃

lines.text: This is Yahweh’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.
From Jehovah hath this been, It [is] wonderful in our eyes,

118.he: זֶה־הַ֭יּוֹם עָשָׂ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה נָגִ֖ילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָ֣ה בֽוֹ׃

lines.text: This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
This [is] the day Jehovah hath made, We rejoice and are glad in it.

118.he: אָֽנָּ֣א יְ֭הוָה הוֹשִׁ֘יעָ֥ה נָּ֑א אָֽנָּ֥א יְ֝הוָ֗ה הַצְלִ֘יחָ֥ה נָּֽא׃

lines.text: Save us now, we beg you, Yahweh! Yahweh, we beg you, send prosperity now.
I beseech Thee, O Jehovah, save, I pray Thee, I beseech Thee, O Jehovah, prosper, I pray Thee.

118.he: בָּר֣וּךְ הַ֭בָּא בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה בֵּ֝רַֽכְנוּכֶ֗ם מִבֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: Blessed is he who comes in Yahweh’s name! We have blessed you out of Yahweh’s house.
Blessed [is] he who is coming In the name of Jehovah, We blessed you from the house of Jehovah,

118.he: אֵ֤ל ׀ יְהוָה֮ וַיָּ֢אֶ֫ר לָ֥נוּ אִסְרוּ־חַ֥ג בַּעֲבֹתִ֑ים עַד־קַ֝רְנ֗וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

lines.text: Yahweh is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.
God [is] Jehovah, and He giveth to us light, Direct ye the festal-sacrifice with cords, Unto the horns of the altar.

118.he: אֵלִ֣י אַתָּ֣ה וְאוֹדֶ֑ךָּ אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אֲרוֹמְמֶֽךָּ׃

lines.text: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.
My God Thou [art], and I confess Thee, My God, I exalt Thee.

118.he: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
Give ye thanks to Jehovah, For good, for to the age, [is] His kindness!
Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to Yahweh’s law.
[Aleph.] O the happiness of those perfect in the way, They are walking in the law of Jehovah,
Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.
O the happiness of those keeping His testimonies, With the whole heart they seek Him.
Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.
Yea, they have not done iniquity, In His ways they have walked.
You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.
Thou hast commanded us Thy precepts to keep diligently,
Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!
O that my ways were prepared to keep Thy statutes,
Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
Then I am not ashamed In my looking unto all Thy commands.

119.he: א֭וֹדְךָ בְּיֹ֣שֶׁר לֵבָ֑ב בְּ֝לָמְדִ֗י מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.
I confess Thee with uprightness of heart, In my learning the judgments of Thy righteousness.
I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me.
Thy statutes I keep, leave me not utterly!
How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.
[Beth.] With what doth a young man purify his path? To observe — according to Thy word.
With my whole heart, I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.
With all my heart I have sought Thee, Let me not err from Thy commands.

119.he: בְּ֭לִבִּי צָפַ֣נְתִּי אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֶֽחֱטָא־לָֽךְ׃

lines.text: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
In my heart I have hid Thy saying, That I sin not before Thee.
Blessed are you, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.
Blessed [art] Thou, O Jehovah, teach me Thy statutes.
With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
With my lips I have recounted All the judgments of Thy mouth.
I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.
In the way of Thy testimonies I have joyed, As over all wealth.
I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.
In Thy precepts I meditate, And I behold attentively Thy paths.
I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.
In Thy statutes I delight myself, I do not forget Thy word.
Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.
[Gimel.] Confer benefits on Thy servant, I live, and I keep Thy word.
Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.
Uncover mine eyes, and I behold wonders out of Thy law.

119.he: גֵּ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י בָאָ֑רֶץ אַל־תַּסְתֵּ֥ר מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.
A sojourner I [am] on earth, Hide not from me Thy commands.
My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
Broken hath my soul for desire Unto Thy judgments at all times.
You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.
Thou hast rebuked the cursed proud, Who are erring from Thy commands.

119.he: גַּ֣ל מֵֽ֭עָלַי חֶרְפָּ֣ה וָב֑וּז כִּ֖י עֵדֹתֶ֣יךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי׃

lines.text: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.
Remove from me reproach and contempt, For Thy testimonies I have kept.

119.he: גַּ֤ם יָֽשְׁב֣וּ שָׂ֭רִים בִּ֣י נִדְבָּ֑רוּ עַ֝בְדְּךָ֗ יָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּחֻקֶּֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.
Princes also sat — against me they spoke, Thy servant doth meditate in Thy statutes,
Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors.
Thy testimonies also [are] my delight, The men of my counsel!
My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!
[Daleth.] Cleaved to the dust hath my soul, Quicken me according to Thy word.
I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.
My ways I have recounted, And Thou answerest me, teach me Thy statutes,
Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.
The way of Thy precepts cause me to understand, And I meditate in Thy wonders.
My soul is weary with sorrow: strengthen me according to your word.
My soul hath dropped from affliction, Establish me according to Thy word.
Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!
The way of falsehood turn aside from me And with Thy law favour me.
I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.
The way of faithfulness I have chosen, Thy judgments I have compared,
I cling to your statutes, Yahweh. Don’t let me be disappointed.
I have adhered to Thy testimonies, O Jehovah, put me not to shame.
I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free.
The way of Thy commands I run, For Thou dost enlarge my heart!

119.he: הוֹרֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֥רֶךְ חֻקֶּ֗יךָ וְאֶצְּרֶ֥נָּה עֵֽקֶב׃

lines.text: Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.
[He.] Show me, O Jehovah, the way of Thy statutes, And I keep it — [to] the end.
Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.
Cause me to understand, and I keep Thy law, And observe it with the whole heart.
Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.
Cause me to tread in the path of Thy commands, For in it I have delighted.
Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.
Incline my heart unto Thy testimonies, And not unto dishonest gain.

119.he: הַעֲבֵ֣ר עֵ֭ינַי מֵרְא֣וֹת שָׁ֑וְא בִּדְרָכֶ֥ךָ חַיֵּֽנִי׃

lines.text: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
Remove mine eyes from seeing vanity, In Thy way quicken Thou me.
Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.
Establish to Thy servant Thy saying, That [is] concerning Thy fear.

119.he: הַעֲבֵ֣ר חֶ֭רְפָּתִי אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָגֹ֑רְתִּי כִּ֖י מִשְׁפָּטֶ֣יךָ טוֹבִֽים׃

lines.text: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.
Remove my reproach that I have feared, For Thy judgments [are] good.
Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness.
Lo, I have longed for Thy precepts, In Thy righteousness quicken Thou me,
Let your loving kindness also come to me, Yahweh, your salvation, according to your word.
[Waw.] And meet me doth Thy kindness, O Jehovah, Thy salvation according to Thy saying.
So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.
And I answer him who is reproaching me a word, For I have trusted in Thy word.

119.he: וְֽאַל־תַּצֵּ֬ל מִפִּ֣י דְבַר־אֱמֶ֣ת עַד־מְאֹ֑ד כִּ֖י לְמִשְׁפָּטֶ֣ךָ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃

lines.text: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.
And Thou takest not utterly away From my mouth the word of truth, Because for Thy judgment I have hoped.
So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.
And I keep Thy law continually, To the age and for ever.
I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.
And I walk habitually in a broad place, For Thy precepts I have sought.

119.he: וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה בְ֭עֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶ֥גֶד מְלָכִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א אֵבֽוֹשׁ׃

lines.text: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.
And I speak of Thy testimonies before kings, And I am not ashamed.
I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.
And I delight myself in Thy commands, That I have loved,

119.he: וְאֶשָּֽׂא־כַפַּ֗י אֶֽל־מִ֭צְוֺתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָהָ֗בְתִּי וְאָשִׂ֥יחָה בְחֻקֶּֽיךָ׃

lines.text: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes.
And I lift up my hands unto Thy commands, That I have loved, And I do meditate on Thy statutes!
Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.
[Zain.] Remember the word to Thy servant, On which Thou hast caused me to hope.

119.he: זֹ֣את נֶחָמָתִ֣י בְעָנְיִ֑י כִּ֖י אִמְרָתְךָ֣ חִיָּֽתְנִי׃

lines.text: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.
This [is] my comfort in mine affliction, That Thy saying hath quickened me.

119.he: זֵ֭דִים הֱלִיצֻ֣נִי עַד־מְאֹ֑ד מִ֝תּ֥וֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א נָטִֽיתִי׃

lines.text: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.
The proud have utterly scorned me, From Thy law I have not turned aside.
I remember your ordinances of old, Yahweh, and have comforted myself.
I remembered Thy judgments of old, O Jehovah, And I comfort myself.
Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.
Horror hath seized me, Because of the wicked forsaking Thy law.
Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.
Songs have been to me Thy statutes, In the house of my sojournings.

119.he: זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי בַלַּ֣יְלָה שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה וָֽ֝אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה תּוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: I have remembered your name, Yahweh, in the night, and I obey your law.
I have remembered in the night Thy name, O Jehovah, And I do keep Thy law.
This is my way, that I keep your precepts.
This hath been to me, That Thy precepts I have kept!
Yahweh is my portion. I promised to obey your words.
[Cheth.] My portion [is] Jehovah; I have said — to keep Thy words,
I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.
I appeased Thy face with the whole heart, Favour me according to Thy saying.
I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.
I have reckoned my ways, And turn back my feet unto Thy testimonies.
I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.
I have made haste, And delayed not, to keep Thy commands.

119.he: חֶבְלֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים עִוְּדֻ֑נִי תּ֥֝וֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃

lines.text: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.
Cords of the wicked have surrounded me, Thy law I have not forgotten.

119.he: חֲצֽוֹת־לַ֗יְלָה אָ֭קוּם לְהוֹד֣וֹת לָ֑ךְ עַ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.
At midnight I rise to give thanks to Thee, For the judgments of Thy righteousness.

119.he: חָבֵ֣ר אָ֭נִי לְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְרֵא֑וּךָ וּ֝לְשֹׁמְרֵ֗י פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.
A companion I [am] to all who fear Thee, And to those keeping Thy precepts.

119.he: חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָ֗רֶץ חֻקֶּ֥יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: The earth is full of your loving kindness, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.
Of Thy kindness, O Jehovah, the earth is full, Thy statutes teach Thou me!
Do good to your servant, according to your word, Yahweh.
[Teth.] Good Thou didst with Thy servant, O Jehovah, According to Thy word.

119.he: ט֤וּב טַ֣עַם וָדַ֣עַת לַמְּדֵ֑נִי כִּ֖י בְמִצְוֺתֶ֣יךָ הֶאֱמָֽנְתִּי׃

lines.text: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.
The goodness of reason and knowledge teach me, For in Thy commands I have believed.

119.he: טֶ֣רֶם אֶ֭עֱנֶה אֲנִ֣י שֹׁגֵ֑ג וְ֝עַתָּ֗ה אִמְרָתְךָ֥ שָׁמָֽרְתִּי׃

lines.text: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.
Before I am afflicted, I — I am erring, And now Thy saying I have kept.
You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.
Good Thou [art], and doing good, Teach me Thy statutes.

119.he: טָפְל֬וּ עָלַ֣י שֶׁ֣קֶר זֵדִ֑ים אֲ֝נִ֗י בְּכָל־לֵ֤ב ׀ אֱצֹּ֬ר פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.
Forged against me falsehood have the proud, I with the whole heart keep Thy precepts.

119.he: טָפַ֣שׁ כַּחֵ֣לֶב לִבָּ֑ם אֲ֝נִ֗י תּוֹרָתְךָ֥ שִֽׁעֲשָֽׁעְתִּי׃

lines.text: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.
Insensate as fat hath been their heart, I — in Thy law I have delighted.
It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.
Good for me that I have been afflicted, That I might learn Thy statutes.
The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
Better to me [is] the law of Thy mouth Than thousands of gold and silver!

119.he: יָדֶ֣יךָ עָ֭שׂוּנִי וַֽיְכוֹנְנ֑וּנִי הֲ֝בִינֵ֗נִי וְאֶלְמְדָ֥ה מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.
[Yod.] Thy hands made me and establish me, Cause me to understand, and I learn Thy commands.

119.he: יְ֭רֵאֶיךָ יִרְא֣וּנִי וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ כִּ֖י לִדְבָרְךָ֣ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃

lines.text: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.
Those fearing Thee see me and rejoice, Because for Thy word I have hoped.

119.he: יָדַ֣עְתִּי יְ֭הוָה כִּי־צֶ֣דֶק מִשְׁפָּטֶ֑יךָ וֶ֝אֱמוּנָ֗ה עִנִּיתָֽנִי׃

lines.text: Yahweh, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
I have known, O Jehovah, That righteous [are] Thy judgments, And [in] faithfulness Thou hast afflicted me.
Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.
Let, I pray Thee, Thy kindness be to comfort me, According to Thy saying to Thy servant.
Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.
Meet me do Thy mercies, and I live, For Thy law [is] my delight.

119.he: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ זֵ֭דִים כִּי־שֶׁ֣קֶר עִוְּת֑וּנִי אֲ֝נִ֗י אָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּפִקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.
Ashamed are the proud, For [with] falsehood they dealt perversely with me. I meditate in Thy precepts.
Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.
Those fearing Thee turn back to me, And those knowing Thy testimonies.

119.he: יְהִֽי־לִבִּ֣י תָמִ֣ים בְּחֻקֶּ֑יךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֵבֽוֹשׁ׃

lines.text: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed.
My heart is perfect in Thy statutes, So that I am not ashamed.
My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
[Kaph.] Consumed for Thy salvation hath been my soul, For Thy word I have hoped.

119.he: כָּל֣וּ עֵ֭ינַי לְאִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ לֵ֝אמֹ֗ר מָתַ֥י תְּֽנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”
Consumed have been mine eyes for Thy word, Saying, 'When doth it comfort me?'

119.he: כִּֽי־הָ֭יִיתִי כְּנֹ֣אד בְּקִיט֑וֹר חֻ֝קֶּ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃

lines.text: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.
For I have been as a bottle in smoke, Thy statutes I have not forgotten.

119.he: כַּמָּ֥ה יְמֵֽי־עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ מָתַ֬י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בְרֹדְפַ֣י מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

lines.text: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?
How many [are] the days of Thy servant? When dost Thou execute Against my pursuers judgment?

119.he: כָּֽרוּ־לִ֣י זֵדִ֣ים שִׁיח֑וֹת אֲ֝שֶׁ֗ר לֹ֣א כְתוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.
The proud have digged for me pits, That [are] not according to Thy law.
All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!
All Thy commands [are] faithfulness, [With] falsehood they have pursued me, Help Thou me.

119.he: כִּ֭מְעַט כִּלּ֣וּנִי בָאָ֑רֶץ וַ֝אֲנִ֗י לֹא־עָזַ֥בְתִּי פִקֻּודֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts.
Almost consumed me on earth have they, And I — I have not forsaken Thy precepts.
Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth.
According to Thy kindness quicken Thou me, And I keep the testimony of Thy mouth!
Yahweh, your word is settled in heaven forever.
[Lamed.] To the age, O Jehovah, Thy word is set up in the heavens.

119.he: לְדֹ֣ר וָ֭דֹר אֱמֽוּנָתֶ֑ךָ כּוֹנַ֥נְתָּ אֶ֝֗רֶץ וַֽתַּעֲמֹֽד׃

lines.text: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.
To all generations Thy faithfulness, Thou didst establish earth, and it standeth.

119.he: לְֽ֭מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ עָמְד֣וּ הַיּ֑וֹם כִּ֖י הַכֹּ֣ל עֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.
According to Thine ordinances They have stood this day, for the whole [are] Thy servants.
