119.he: לוּלֵ֣י ת֭וֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָ֑י אָ֝֗ז אָבַ֥דְתִּי בְעָנְיִֽי׃

lines.text: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
Unless Thy law [were] my delights, Then had I perished in mine affliction.

119.he: לְ֭עוֹלָם לֹא־אֶשְׁכַּ֣ח פִּקּוּדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֥י בָ֝֗ם חִיִּיתָֽנִי׃

lines.text: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.
To the age I forget not Thy precepts, For by them Thou hast quickened me.
I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.
I [am] Thine, save Thou me, For Thy precepts I have sought.

119.he: לִ֤י קִוּ֣וּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים לְאַבְּדֵ֑נִי עֵ֝דֹתֶ֗יךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָֽן׃

lines.text: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.
Thy wicked waited for me to destroy me, Thy testimonies I understand.

119.he: לְֽכָל תִּ֭כְלָה רָאִ֣יתִי קֵ֑ץ רְחָבָ֖ה מִצְוָתְךָ֣ מְאֹֽד׃

lines.text: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless.
Of all perfection I have seen an end, Broad [is] Thy command — exceedingly!
How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.
[Mem.] O how I have loved Thy law! All the day it [is] my meditation.

119.he: מֵ֭אֹ֣יְבַי תְּחַכְּמֵ֣נִי מִצְוֺתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם הִיא־לִֽי׃

lines.text: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.
Than mine enemies Thy command maketh me wiser, For it [is] before me to the age.

119.he: מִכָּל־מְלַמְּדַ֥י הִשְׂכַּ֑לְתִּי כִּ֥י עֵ֝דְוֺתֶ֗יךָ שִׂ֣יחָה לִֽֿי׃

lines.text: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.
Above all my teachers I have acted wisely. For Thy testimonies [are] my meditation.
I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.
Above elders I understand more, For Thy precepts I have kept.

119.he: מִכָּל־אֹ֣רַח רָ֭ע כָּלִ֣אתִי רַגְלָ֑י לְ֝מַ֗עַן אֶשְׁמֹ֥ר דְּבָרֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.
From every evil path I restrained my feet, So that I keep Thy word.
I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.
From Thy judgments I turned not aside, For Thou — Thou hast directed me.
How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!
How sweet to my palate hath been Thy saying, Above honey to my mouth.

119.he: מִפִּקּוּדֶ֥יךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָ֑ן עַל־כֵּ֝֗ן שָׂנֵ֤אתִי ׀ כָּל־אֹ֬רַח שָֽׁקֶר׃

lines.text: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.
From Thy precepts I have understanding, Therefore I have hated every false path!
Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
[Nun.] A lamp to my foot [is] Thy word, And a light to my path.
I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.
I have sworn, and I confirm [it], To keep the judgments of Thy righteousness.
I am afflicted very much. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your word.
I have been afflicted very much, O Jehovah, quicken me, according to Thy word.

119.he: נִדְב֣וֹת פִּ֭י רְצֵה־נָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. Yahweh, teach me your ordinances.
Free-will-offerings of my mouth, Accept, I pray Thee, O Jehovah, And Thy judgments teach Thou me.

119.he: נַפְשִׁ֣י בְכַפִּ֣י תָמִ֑יד וְ֝ת֥וֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃

lines.text: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.
My soul [is] in my hand continually, And Thy law I have not forgotten.

119.he: נָתְנ֬וּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים פַּ֣ח לִ֑י וּ֝מִפִּקּוּדֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א תָעִֽיתִי׃

lines.text: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.
The wicked have laid a snare for me, And from thy precepts I wandered not.

119.he: נָחַ֣לְתִּי עֵדְוֺתֶ֣יךָ לְעוֹלָ֑ם כִּֽי־שְׂשׂ֖וֹן לִבִּ֣י הֵֽמָּה׃

lines.text: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
I have inherited Thy testimonies to the age, For the joy of my heart [are] they.

119.he: נָטִ֣יתִי לִ֭בִּי לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת חֻקֶּ֗יךָ לְעוֹלָ֥ם עֵֽקֶב׃

lines.text: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end.
I have inclined my heart To do Thy statutes, to the age — [to] the end!
I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.
[Samech.] Doubting ones I have hated, And Thy law I have loved.
You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.
My hiding place and my shield [art] Thou, For Thy word I have hoped.
Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
Turn aside from me, ye evil-doers, And I keep the commands of my God.
Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.
Sustain me according to Thy saying, And I live, and Thou puttest me not to shame Because of my hope.
Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.
Support Thou me, and I am saved, And I look on Thy statutes continually.
You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.
Thou hast trodden down All going astray from Thy statutes, For falsehood [is] their deceit.

119.he: סִגִ֗ים הִשְׁבַּ֥תָּ כָל־רִשְׁעֵי־אָ֑רֶץ לָ֝כֵ֗ן אָהַ֥בְתִּי עֵדֹתֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.
Dross! Thou hast caused to cease All the wicked of the earth; Therefore I have loved Thy testimonies.
My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments.
Trembled from Thy fear hath my flesh, And from Thy judgments I have been afraid!
I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors.
[Ain.] I have done judgment and righteousness, Leave me not to mine oppressors.
Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.
Make sure Thy servant for good, Let not the proud oppress me.
My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.
Mine eyes have been consumed for Thy salvation. And for the saying of Thy righteousness.
Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.
Do with Thy servant according to Thy kindness. And Thy statutes teach Thou me.
I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.
Thy servant [am] I — cause me to understand, And I know Thy testimonies.
It is time to act, Yahweh, for they break your law.
Time for Jehovah to work! they have made void Thy law.
Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
Therefore I have loved Thy commands Above gold — even fine gold.

119.he: עַל־כֵּ֤ן ׀ כָּל־פִּקּ֣וּדֵי כֹ֣ל יִשָּׁ֑רְתִּי כָּל־אֹ֖רַח שֶׁ֣קֶר שָׂנֵֽאתִי׃

lines.text: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.
Therefore all my appointments I have declared wholly right, Every path of falsehood I have hated!
Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.
[Pe.] Wonderful [are] Thy testimonies, Therefore hath my soul kept them.
The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.
The opening of Thy words enlighteneth, Instructing the simple.
I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.
My mouth I have opened, yea, I pant, For, for Thy commands I have longed.
Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.
Look unto me, and favour me, As customary to those loving Thy name.
Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.
My steps establish by Thy saying, And any iniquity doth not rule over me.
Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.
Ransom me from the oppression of man, And I observe Thy precepts,
Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.
Thy face cause to shine on Thy servant, And teach me Thy statutes.

119.he: פַּלְגֵי־מַ֭יִם יָרְד֣וּ עֵינָ֑י עַ֝֗ל לֹא־שָׁמְר֥וּ תוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law.
Rivulets of waters have come down mine eyes, Because they have not kept Thy law!
You are righteous, Yahweh. Your judgments are upright.
[Tzade.] Righteous [art] Thou, O Jehovah, And upright [are] Thy judgments.
You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.
Thou hast appointed Thy testimonies, Righteous and exceeding faithful,
My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.
Cut me off hath my zeal, For mine adversaries forgot Thy words.
Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.
Tried [is] thy saying exceedingly, And Thy servant hath loved it.

119.he: צָעִ֣יר אָנֹכִ֣י וְנִבְזֶ֑ה פִּ֝קֻּדֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃

lines.text: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.
Small I [am], and despised, Thy precepts I have not forgotten.
Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.
Thy righteousness [is] righteousness to the age, And Thy law [is] truth.
Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.
Adversity and distress have found me, Thy commands [are] my delights.
Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.
The righteousness of Thy testimonies [is] to Cause me to understand, and I live!

119.he: קָרָ֣אתִי בְכָל־לֵ֭ב עֲנֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֗ה חֻקֶּ֥יךָ אֶצֹּֽרָה׃

lines.text: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, Yahweh! I will keep your statutes.
[Koph.] I have called with the whole heart, Answer me, O Jehovah, Thy statutes I keep,
I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.
I have called Thee, save Thou me, And I do keep Thy testimonies.
I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.
I have gone forward in the dawn, and I cry, For Thy word I have hoped.
My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.
Mine eyes have gone before the watches, To meditate in Thy saying.

119.he: ק֭וֹלִי שִׁמְעָ֣ה כְחַסְדֶּ֑ךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה כְּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶ֥ךָ חַיֵּֽנִי׃

lines.text: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your ordinances.
My voice hear, according to Thy kindness, Jehovah, according to Thy judgment quicken me.
They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.
Near have been my wicked pursuers, From Thy law they have been far off.
You are near, Yahweh. All your commandments are truth.
Near [art] Thou, O Jehovah, And all Thy commands [are] truth.

119.he: קֶ֣דֶם יָ֭דַעְתִּי מֵעֵדֹתֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם יְסַדְתָּֽם׃

lines.text: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever.
Of old I have known Thy testimonies, That to the age Thou hast founded them!
Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.
[Resh.] See my affliction, and deliver Thou me, For Thy law I have not forgotten.
Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.
Plead my plea, and redeem me, According to Thy saying quicken me.

119.he: רָח֣וֹק מֵרְשָׁעִ֣ים יְשׁוּעָ֑ה כִּֽי־חֻ֝קֶּיךָ לֹ֣א דָרָֽשׁוּ׃

lines.text: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.
Far from the wicked [is] salvation, For Thy statutes they have not sought.
Great are your tender mercies, Yahweh. Revive me according to your ordinances.
Thy mercies [are] many, O Jehovah, According to Thy judgments quicken me.

119.he: רַ֭בִּים רֹדְפַ֣י וְצָרָ֑י מֵ֝עֵדְוֺתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א נָטִֽיתִי׃

lines.text: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.
Many [are] my pursuers, and adversaries, From Thy testimonies I have not turned aside.

119.he: רָאִ֣יתִי בֹ֭גְדִים וָֽאֶתְקוֹטָ֑טָה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִ֝מְרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁמָֽרוּ׃

lines.text: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.
I have seen treacherous ones, And grieve myself, Because Thy saying they have not kept.

119.he: רְ֭אֵה כִּי־פִקּוּדֶ֣יךָ אָהָ֑בְתִּי יְ֝הוָ֗ה כְּֽחַסְדְּךָ֥ חַיֵּֽנִי׃

lines.text: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your loving kindness.
See, for thy precepts I have loved, Jehovah, According to Thy kindness quicken me.
All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever.
The sum of Thy word [is] truth, And to the age [is] every judgment of Thy righteousness!

119.he: שָׂ֭רִים רְדָפ֣וּנִי חִנָּ֑ם ומדבריך פָּחַ֥ד לִבִּֽי׃

lines.text: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.
[Shin.] Princes have pursued me without cause, And because of Thy words was my heart afraid.

119.he: שָׂ֣שׂ אָ֭נֹכִֽי עַל־אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ כְּ֝מוֹצֵ֗א שָׁלָ֥ל רָֽב׃

lines.text: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.
I do rejoice concerning Thy saying, As one finding abundant spoil.
I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.
Falsehood I have hated, yea I abominate [it], Thy law I have loved.

119.he: שֶׁ֣בַע בַּ֭יּוֹם הִלַּלְתִּ֑יךָ עַ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.
Seven [times] in a day I have praised Thee, Because of the judgments of Thy righteousness.

119.he: שָׁל֣וֹם רָ֭ב לְאֹהֲבֵ֣י תוֹרָתֶ֑ךָ וְאֵֽין־לָ֥מוֹ מִכְשֽׁוֹל׃

lines.text: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.
Abundant peace have those loving Thy law, And they have no stumbling-block.
I have hoped for your salvation, Yahweh. I have done your commandments.
I have waited for Thy salvation, O Jehovah, And Thy commands I have done.
My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.
Kept hath my soul Thy testimonies, And I do love them exceedingly.

119.he: שָׁמַ֣רְתִּי פִ֭קּוּדֶיךָ וְעֵדֹתֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י כָל־דְּרָכַ֣י נֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you.
I have kept Thy precepts and Thy testimonies, For all my ways are before Thee!

119.he: תִּקְרַ֤ב רִנָּתִ֣י לְפָנֶ֣יךָ יְהוָ֑ה כִּדְבָרְךָ֥ הֲבִינֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: Let my cry come before you, Yahweh. Give me understanding according to your word.
[Taw.] My loud cry cometh near before Thee, O Jehovah; According to Thy word cause me to understand.
Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.
My supplication cometh in before Thee, According to Thy saying deliver Thou me.

119.he: תַּבַּ֣עְנָה שְׂפָתַ֣י תְּהִלָּ֑ה כִּ֖י תְלַמְּדֵ֣נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.
My lips do utter praise, For Thou dost teach me Thy statutes.

119.he: תַּ֣עַן לְ֭שׁוֹנִי אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֖י כָל־מִצְוֺתֶ֣יךָ צֶּֽדֶק׃

lines.text: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.
My tongue doth sing of Thy saying, For all Thy commands [are] righteous.
Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.
Thy hand is for a help to me, For Thy commands I have chosen.
I have longed for your salvation, Yahweh. Your law is my delight.
I have longed for Thy salvation, O Jehovah, And Thy law [is] my delight.
Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.
My soul liveth, and it doth praise Thee, And Thy judgments do help me.

119.he: תָּעִ֗יתִי כְּשֶׂ֣ה אֹ֭בֵד בַּקֵּ֣שׁ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י מִ֝צְוֺתֶיךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃

lines.text: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
I wandered as a lost sheep, seek Thy servant, For Thy precepts I have not forgotten!

120.he: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אֶל־יְ֭הוָה בַּצָּרָ֣תָה לִּ֑י קָ֝רָ֗אתִי וַֽיַּעֲנֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: In my distress, I cried to Yahweh. He answered me.
A Song of the Ascents. Unto Jehovah in my distress I have called, And He answereth me.

120.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה הַצִּ֣ילָה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִשְּׂפַת־שֶׁ֑קֶר מִלָּשׁ֥וֹן רְמִיָּֽה׃

lines.text: Deliver my soul, Yahweh, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.
O Jehovah, deliver my soul from a lying lip, From a deceitful tongue!

120.he: מַה־יִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭ךָ וּמַה־יֹּסִ֥יף לָ֗ךְ לָשׁ֥וֹן רְמִיָּֽה׃

lines.text: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?
What doth He give to thee? And what doth He add to thee? O deceitful tongue!

120.he: חִצֵּ֣י גִבּ֣וֹר שְׁנוּנִ֑ים עִ֝֗ם גַּחֲלֵ֥י רְתָמִֽים׃

lines.text: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
Sharp arrows of a mighty one, with broom-coals.

120.he: אֽוֹיָה־לִ֭י כִּי־גַ֣רְתִּי מֶ֑שֶׁךְ שָׁ֝כַ֗נְתִּי עִֽם־אָהֳלֵ֥י קֵדָֽר׃

lines.text: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
Woe to me, for I have inhabited Mesech, I have dwelt with tents of Kedar.

120.he: רַ֭בַּת שָֽׁכְנָה־לָּ֣הּ נַפְשִׁ֑י עִ֝֗ם שׂוֹנֵ֥א שָׁלֽוֹם׃

lines.text: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.
Too much hath my soul dwelt with him who is hating peace.
I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.
I [am] peace, and when I speak they [are] for war!

121.he: שִׁ֗יר לַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אֶשָּׂ֣א עֵ֭ינַי אֶל־הֶהָרִ֑ים מֵ֝אַ֗יִן יָבֹ֥א עֶזְרִֽי׃

lines.text: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
A Song of the Ascents. I lift up mine eyes unto the hills, Whence doth my help come?

121.he: עֶ֭זְרִי מֵעִ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
My help [is] from Jehovah, maker of heaven and earth,
He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
He suffereth not thy foot to be moved, Thy preserver slumbereth not.

121.he: הִנֵּ֣ה לֹֽא־יָ֭נוּם וְלֹ֣א יִישָׁ֑ן שׁ֝וֹמֵ֗ר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

lines.text: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
Lo, He slumbereth not, nor sleepeth, He who is preserving Israel.

121.he: יְהוָ֥ה שֹׁמְרֶ֑ךָ יְהוָ֥ה צִ֝לְּךָ֗ עַל־יַ֥ד יְמִינֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Yahweh is your keeper. Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.
Jehovah [is] thy preserver, Jehovah [is] thy shade on thy right hand,
The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
By day the sun doth not smite thee, Nor the moon by night.
Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.
Jehovah preserveth thee from all evil, He doth preserve thy soul.
Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
Jehovah preserveth thy going out and thy coming in, From henceforth even unto the age!

122.he: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד שָׂ֭מַחְתִּי בְּאֹמְרִ֣ים לִ֑י בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה נֵלֵֽךְ׃

lines.text: I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to Yahweh’s house!”
A Song of the Ascents, by David. I have rejoiced in those saying to me, 'To the house of Jehovah we go.'
Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem,
Our feet have been standing in thy gates, O Jerusalem!
Jerusalem, that is built as a city that is compact together,
Jerusalem — the builded one — [Is] as a city that is joined to itself together.

122.he: שֶׁשָּׁ֨ם עָל֪וּ שְׁבָטִ֡ים שִׁבְטֵי־יָ֭הּ עֵד֣וּת לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְ֝הֹד֗וֹת לְשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: where the tribes go up, even Yah’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to Yahweh’s name.
For thither have tribes gone up, Tribes of Jah, companies of Israel, To give thanks to the name of Jehovah.

122.he: כִּ֤י שָׁ֨מָּה ׀ יָשְׁב֣וּ כִסְא֣וֹת לְמִשְׁפָּ֑ט כִּ֝סְא֗וֹת לְבֵ֣ית דָּוִֽיד׃

lines.text: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.
For there have sat thrones of judgment, Thrones of the house of David.
Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.
Ask ye the peace of Jerusalem, At rest are those loving thee.
Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.
Peace is in thy bulwark, rest in thy high places,

122.he: לְ֭מַעַן אַחַ֣י וְרֵעָ֑י אֲדַבְּרָה־נָּ֖א שָׁל֣וֹם בָּֽךְ׃

lines.text: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”
For the sake of my brethren and my companions, Let me speak, I pray thee, 'Peace [be] in thee.'

122.he: לְ֭מַעַן בֵּית־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ אֲבַקְשָׁ֖ה ט֣וֹב לָֽךְ׃

lines.text: For the sake of the house of Yahweh our God, I will seek your good.
For the sake of the house of Jehovah our God, I seek good for thee!

123.he: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אֵ֭לֶיךָ נָשָׂ֣אתִי אֶת־עֵינַ֑י הַ֝יֹּשְׁבִ֗י בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

lines.text: I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.
A Song of the Ascents. Unto Thee I have lifted up mine eyes, O dweller in the heavens.

123.he: הִנֵּ֨ה כְעֵינֵ֪י עֲבָדִ֡ים אֶל־יַ֤ד אֲֽדוֹנֵיהֶ֗ם כְּעֵינֵ֣י שִׁפְחָה֮ אֶל־יַ֪ד גְּבִ֫רְתָּ֥הּ כֵּ֣ן עֵ֭ינֵינוּ אֶל־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ עַ֝֗ד שֶׁיְּחָנֵּֽנוּ׃

lines.text: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress; so our eyes look to Yahweh, our God, until he has mercy on us.
Lo, as eyes of men-servants [Are] unto the hand of their masters, As eyes of a maid-servant [Are] unto the hand of her mistress, So [are] our eyes unto Jehovah our God, Till that He doth favour us.

123.he: חָנֵּ֣נוּ יְהוָ֣ה חָנֵּ֑נוּ כִּֽי־רַ֝֗ב שָׂבַ֥עְנוּ בֽוּז׃

lines.text: Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.
Favour us, O Jehovah, favour us, For greatly have we been filled with contempt,

123.he: רַבַּת֮ שָֽׂבְעָה־לָּ֪הּ נַ֫פְשֵׁ֥נוּ הַלַּ֥עַג הַשַּׁאֲנַנִּ֑ים הַ֝בּ֗וּז לִגְאֵ֥יוֹנִֽים׃

lines.text: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
Greatly hath our soul been filled With the scorning of the easy ones, With the contempt of the arrogant!

124.he: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה שֶׁהָ֣יָה לָ֑נוּ יֹֽאמַר־נָ֝א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

lines.text: If it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, let Israel now say,
A Song of the Ascents, by David. Save [for] Jehovah — who hath been for us, (Pray, let Israel say),

124.he: לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה שֶׁהָ֣יָה לָ֑נוּ בְּק֖וּם עָלֵ֣ינוּ אָדָֽם׃

lines.text: if it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, when men rose up against us;
Save [for] Jehovah — who hath been for us, In the rising up of man against us,

124.he: אֲ֭זַי חַיִּ֣ים בְּלָע֑וּנוּ בַּחֲר֖וֹת אַפָּ֣ם בָּֽנוּ׃

lines.text: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us;
Then alive they had swallowed us up, In the burning of their anger against us,

124.he: אֲ֭זַי הַמַּ֣יִם שְׁטָפ֑וּנוּ נַ֗֜חְלָה עָבַ֥ר עַל־נַפְשֵֽׁנוּ׃

lines.text: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul;
Then the waters had overflowed us, The stream passed over our soul,
then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.
Then passed over our soul had the proud waters.

124.he: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה שֶׁלֹּ֥א נְתָנָ֥נוּ טֶ֝֗רֶף לְשִׁנֵּיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: Blessed be Yahweh, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.
Blessed [is] Jehovah who hath not given us, A prey to their teeth.

124.he: נַפְשֵׁ֗נוּ כְּצִפּ֥וֹר נִמְלְטָה֮ מִפַּ֪ח י֫וֹקְשִׁ֥ים הַפַּ֥ח נִשְׁבָּ֗ר וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ נִמְלָֽטְנוּ׃

lines.text: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.
Our soul as a bird hath escaped from a snare of fowlers, The snare was broken, and we have escaped.

124.he: עֶ֭זְרֵנוּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: Our help is in Yahweh’s name, who made heaven and earth.
Our help [is] in the name of Jehovah, Maker of the heavens and earth!

125.he: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת הַבֹּטְחִ֥ים בַּיהוָ֑ה כְּֽהַר־צִיּ֥וֹן לֹא־יִ֝מּ֗וֹט לְעוֹלָ֥ם יֵשֵֽׁב׃

lines.text: Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
A Song of the Ascents. Those trusting in Jehovah [are] as Mount Zion, It is not moved — to the age it abideth.

125.he: יְֽרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם הָרִים֮ סָבִ֪יב לָ֥הּ וַ֭יהוָה סָבִ֣יב לְעַמּ֑וֹ מֵ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

lines.text: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so Yahweh surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.
Jerusalem! mountains [are] round about her, And Jehovah [is] round about His people, From henceforth even unto the age.

125.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֪א יָנ֡וּחַ שֵׁ֤בֶט הָרֶ֗שַׁע עַל֮ גּוֹרַ֪ל הַֽצַּדִּ֫יקִ֥ים לְמַ֡עַן לֹא־יִשְׁלְח֖וּ הַצַדִּיקִ֨ים בְּעַוְלָ֬תָה יְדֵיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous; so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.
For the rod of wickedness resteth not On the lot of the righteous, That the righteous put not forth on iniquity their hands.
Do good, Yahweh, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.
Do good, O Jehovah, to the good, And to the upright in their hearts.

125.he: וְהַמַּטִּ֤ים עַֽקַלְקַלּוֹתָ֗ם יוֹלִיכֵ֣ם יְ֭הוָה אֶת־פֹּעֲלֵ֣י הָאָ֑וֶן שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

lines.text: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, Yahweh will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.
As to those turning [to] their crooked ways, Jehovah causeth them to go with workers of iniquity. Peace on Israel!

126.he: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת בְּשׁ֣וּב יְ֭הוָה אֶת־שִׁיבַ֣ת צִיּ֑וֹן הָ֝יִ֗ינוּ כְּחֹלְמִֽים׃

lines.text: When Yahweh brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.
A Song of the Ascents. In Jehovah's turning back [to] the captivity of Zion, We have been as dreamers.

126.he: אָ֤ז יִמָּלֵ֪א שְׂח֡וֹק פִּינוּ֮ וּלְשׁוֹנֵ֪נוּ רִ֫נָּ֥ה אָ֭ז יֹאמְר֣וּ בַגּוֹיִ֑ם הִגְדִּ֥יל יְ֝הוָ֗ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת עִם־אֵֽלֶּה׃

lines.text: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “Yahweh has done great things for them.”
Then filled [with] laughter is our mouth, And our tongue [with] singing, Then do they say among nations, 'Jehovah did great things with these.'

126.he: הִגְדִּ֣יל יְ֭הוָה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת עִמָּ֗נוּ הָיִ֥ינוּ שְׂמֵחִֽים׃

lines.text: Yahweh has done great things for us, and we are glad.
Jehovah did great things with us, We have been joyful.
Restore our fortunes again, Yahweh, like the streams in the Negev.
Turn again, O Jehovah, [to] our captivity, As streams in the south.
Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
Those sowing in tears, with singing do reap,

126.he: הָ֘ל֤וֹךְ יֵלֵ֨ךְ ׀ וּבָכֹה֮ נֹשֵׂ֪א מֶֽשֶׁךְ־הַ֫זָּ֥רַע בֹּֽא־יָב֥וֹא בְרִנָּ֑ה נֹ֝שֵׂ֗א אֲלֻמֹּתָֽיו׃

lines.text: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
Whoso goeth on and weepeth, Bearing the basket of seed, Surely cometh in with singing, bearing his sheaves!

127.he: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּֽעֲל֗וֹת לִשְׁלֹ֫מֹ֥ה אִם־יְהוָ֤ה ׀ לֹא־יִבְנֶ֬ה בַ֗יִת שָׁ֤וְא ׀ עָמְל֣וּ בוֹנָ֣יו בּ֑וֹ אִם־יְהוָ֥ה לֹֽא־יִשְׁמָר־עִ֝֗יר שָׁ֤וְא ׀ שָׁקַ֬ד שׁוֹמֵֽר׃

lines.text: Unless Yahweh builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless Yahweh watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.
A Song of the Ascents, by Solomon. If Jehovah doth not build the house, In vain have its builders laboured at it, If Jehovah doth not watch a city, In vain hath a watchman waked.

127.he: שָׁ֤וְא לָכֶ֨ם ׀ מַשְׁכִּ֪ימֵי ק֡וּם מְאַֽחֲרֵי־שֶׁ֗בֶת אֹ֭כְלֵי לֶ֣חֶם הָעֲצָבִ֑ים כֵּ֤ן יִתֵּ֖ן לִֽידִיד֣וֹ שֵׁנָֽא׃

lines.text: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
Vain for you who are rising early, Who delay sitting, eating the bread of griefs, So He giveth to His beloved one sleep.

127.he: הִנֵּ֤ה נַחֲלַ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה בָּנִ֑ים שָׂ֝כָ֗ר פְּרִ֣י הַבָּֽטֶן׃

lines.text: Behold, children are a heritage of Yahweh. The fruit of the womb is his reward.
Lo, an inheritance of Jehovah [are] sons, A reward [is] the fruit of the womb.
As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.
As arrows in the hand of a mighty one, So [are] the sons of the young men.

127.he: אַשְׁרֵ֤י הַגֶּ֗בֶר אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִלֵּ֥א אֶת־אַשְׁפָּת֗וֹ מֵ֫הֶ֥ם לֹֽא־יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ כִּֽי־יְדַבְּר֖וּ אֶת־אוֹיְבִ֣ים בַּשָּֽׁעַר׃

lines.text: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.
O the happiness of the man Who hath filled his quiver with them, They are not ashamed, For they speak with enemies in the gate!

128.he: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אַ֭שְׁרֵי כָּל־יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה הַ֝הֹלֵ֗ךְ בִּדְרָכָֽיו׃

lines.text: Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, who walks in his ways.
A Song of the Ascents. O the happiness of every one fearing Jehovah, Who is walking in His ways.

128.he: יְגִ֣יעַ כַּ֭פֶּיךָ כִּ֣י תֹאכֵ֑ל אַ֝שְׁרֶ֗יךָ וְט֣וֹב לָֽךְ׃

lines.text: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.
The labour of thy hands thou surely eatest, Happy [art] thou, and good [is] to thee.

128.he: אֶשְׁתְּךָ֤ ׀ כְּגֶ֥פֶן פֹּרִיָּה֮ בְּיַרְכְּתֵ֪י בֵ֫יתֶ֥ךָ בָּ֭נֶיךָ כִּשְׁתִלֵ֣י זֵיתִ֑ים סָ֝בִ֗יב לְשֻׁלְחָנֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive plants around your table.
Thy wife [is] as a fruitful vine in the sides of thy house, Thy sons as olive plants around thy table.

128.he: הִנֵּ֣ה כִי־כֵ֭ן יְבֹ֥רַךְ גָּ֗בֶר יְרֵ֣א יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: Behold, thus is the man blessed who fears Yahweh.
Lo, surely thus is the man blessed who is fearing Jehovah.

128.he: יְבָרֶכְךָ֥ יְהוָ֗ה מִצִ֫יּ֥וֹן וּ֭רְאֵה בְּט֣וּב יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כֹּ֝֗ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּֽיךָ׃

lines.text: May Yahweh bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
Jehovah doth bless thee out of Zion, Look, then, on the good of Jerusalem, All the days of thy life,
Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.
And see the sons of thy sons! Peace on Israel!

129.he: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת רַ֭בַּת צְרָר֣וּנִי מִנְּעוּרַ֑י יֹֽאמַר־נָ֝א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

lines.text: Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say,
A Song of the Ascents. Often they distressed me from my youth, Pray, let Israel say:

129.he: רַ֭בַּת צְרָר֣וּנִי מִנְּעוּרָ֑י גַּ֝ם לֹא־יָ֥כְלוּ לִֽי׃

lines.text: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.
Often they distressed me from my youth, Yet they have not prevailed over me.
The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.
Over my back have ploughers ploughed, They have made long their furrows.
Yahweh is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.
Jehovah [is] righteous, He hath cut asunder cords of the wicked.

129.he: יֵ֭בֹשׁוּ וְיִסֹּ֣גוּ אָח֑וֹר כֹּ֝֗ל שֹׂנְאֵ֥י צִיּֽוֹן׃

lines.text: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.
Confounded and turn backward do all hating Zion.

129.he: יִ֭הְיוּ כַּחֲצִ֣יר גַּגּ֑וֹת שֶׁקַּדְמַ֖ת שָׁלַ֣ף יָבֵֽשׁ׃

lines.text: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up,
They are as grass of the roofs, That before it was drawn out withereth,

129.he: שֶׁלֹּ֤א מִלֵּ֖א כַפּ֥וֹ קוֹצֵ֗ר וְחִצְנ֥וֹ מְעַמֵּֽר׃

lines.text: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.
That hath not filled the hand of a reaper, And the bosom of a binder of sheaves.

129.he: וְלֹ֤א אָֽמְר֨וּ ׀ הָעֹבְרִ֗ים בִּרְכַּֽת־יְהוָ֥ה אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם בֵּרַ֥כְנוּ אֶ֝תְכֶ֗ם בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of Yahweh be on you. We bless you in Yahweh’s name.”
And the passers by have not said, 'The blessing of Jehovah [is] on you, We blessed you in the Name of Jehovah!'
Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.
A Song of the Ascents. From depths I have called Thee, Jehovah.

130.he: אֲדֹנָי֮ שִׁמְעָ֪ה בְק֫וֹלִ֥י תִּהְיֶ֣ינָה אָ֭זְנֶיךָ קַשֻּׁב֑וֹת לְ֝ק֗וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃

lines.text: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
Lord, hearken to my voice, Thine ears are attentive to the voice of my supplications.
If you, Yah, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
If iniquities Thou dost observe, O Lord, who doth stand?
But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.
But with Thee [is] forgiveness, that Thou mayest be feared.

130.he: קִוִּ֣יתִי יְ֭הוָה קִוְּתָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י וְֽלִדְבָר֥וֹ הוֹחָֽלְתִּי׃

lines.text: I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
I hoped [for] Jehovah — hoped hath my soul, And for His word I have waited.

130.he: נַפְשִׁ֥י לַֽאדֹנָ֑י מִשֹּׁמְרִ֥ים לַ֝בֹּ֗קֶר שֹׁמְרִ֥ים לַבֹּֽקֶר׃

lines.text: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.
My soul [is] for the Lord, More than those watching for morning, Watching for morning!

130.he: יַחֵ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶל־יְה֫וָה כִּֽי־עִם־יְהוָ֥ה הַחֶ֑סֶד וְהַרְבֵּ֖ה עִמּ֣וֹ פְדֽוּת׃

lines.text: Israel, hope in Yahweh, for there is loving kindness with Yahweh. Abundant redemption is with him.
Israel doth wait on Jehovah, For with Jehovah [is] kindness, And abundant with Him [is] redemption.
He will redeem Israel from all their sins.
And He doth redeem Israel from all his iniquities!

131.he: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּֽעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד יְהוָ֤ה ׀ לֹא־גָבַ֣הּ לִ֭בִּי וְלֹא־רָמ֣וּ עֵינַ֑י וְלֹֽא־הִלַּ֓כְתִּי ׀ בִּגְדֹל֖וֹת וּבְנִפְלָא֣וֹת מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

lines.text: Yahweh, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.
A Song of the Ascents, by David. Jehovah, my heart hath not been haughty, Nor have mine eyes been high, Nor have I walked in great things, And in things too wonderful for me.

131.he: אִם־לֹ֤א שִׁוִּ֨יתִי ׀ וְדוֹמַ֗מְתִּי נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י כְּ֭גָמֻל עֲלֵ֣י אִמּ֑וֹ כַּגָּמֻ֖ל עָלַ֣י נַפְשִֽׁי׃

lines.text: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
Have I not compared, and kept silent my soul, As a weaned one by its mother? As a weaned one by me [is] my soul.
Israel, hope in Yahweh, from this time forward and forever more.
Israel doth wait on Jehovah, From henceforth, and unto the age!

132.he: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת זְכוֹר־יְהוָ֥ה לְדָוִ֑ד אֵ֝ת כָּל־עֻנּוֹתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Yahweh, remember David and all his affliction,
A Song of the Ascents. Remember, Jehovah, for David, all his afflictions.

132.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֭שְׁבַּע לַיהוָ֑ה נָ֝דַ֗ר לַאֲבִ֥יר יַעֲקֹֽב׃

lines.text: how he swore to Yahweh, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
Who hath sworn to Jehovah. He hath vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:

132.he: אִם־אָ֭בֹא בְּאֹ֣הֶל בֵּיתִ֑י אִם־אֶ֝עֱלֶ֗ה עַל־עֶ֥רֶשׂ יְצוּעָֽי׃

lines.text: “Surely I will not come into the structure of my house, nor go up into my bed;
'If I enter into the tent of my house, If I go up on the couch of my bed,
I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids;
If I give sleep to mine eyes, To mine eyelids — slumber,

132.he: עַד־אֶמְצָ֣א מָ֭קוֹם לַיהוָ֑ה מִ֝שְׁכָּנ֗וֹת לַאֲבִ֥יר יַעֲקֹֽב׃

lines.text: until I find out a place for Yahweh, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
Till I do find a place for Jehovah, Tabernacles for the Mighty One of Jacob.
Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar:
'Lo, we have heard it in Ephratah, We have found it in the fields of the forest.
“We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.
We come in to His tabernacles, We bow ourselves at His footstool.

132.he: קוּמָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה לִמְנוּחָתֶ֑ךָ אַ֝תָּ֗ה וַאֲר֥וֹן עֻזֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: Arise, Yahweh, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.
Arise, O Jehovah, to Thy rest, Thou, and the ark of Thy strength,
Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!”
Thy priests do put on righteousness, And Thy pious ones cry aloud.

132.he: בַּ֭עֲבוּר דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ אַל־תָּ֝שֵׁ֗ב פְּנֵ֣י מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.
For the sake of David Thy servant, Turn not back the face of Thine anointed.

132.he: נִשְׁבַּֽע־יְהוָ֨ה ׀ לְדָוִ֡ד אֱמֶת֮ לֹֽא־יָשׁ֪וּב מִ֫מֶּ֥נָּה מִפְּרִ֥י בִטְנְךָ֑ אָ֝שִׁ֗ית לְכִסֵּא־לָֽךְ׃

lines.text: Yahweh has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.
Jehovah hath sworn truth to David, He turneth not back from it: Of the fruit of thy body, I set on the throne for thee.

132.he: אִֽם־יִשְׁמְר֬וּ בָנֶ֨יךָ ׀ בְּרִיתִי֮ וְעֵדֹתִ֥י ז֗וֹ אֲלַ֫מְּדֵ֥ם גַּם־בְּנֵיהֶ֥ם עֲדֵי־עַ֑ד יֵ֝שְׁב֗וּ לְכִסֵּא־לָֽךְ׃

lines.text: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”
If thy sons keep My covenant, And My testimonies that I teach them, Their sons also for ever and ever, Do sit on the throne for thee.

132.he: כִּֽי־בָחַ֣ר יְהוָ֣ה בְּצִיּ֑וֹן אִ֝וָּ֗הּ לְמוֹשָׁ֥ב לֽוֹ׃

lines.text: For Yahweh has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.
For Jehovah hath fixed on Zion, He hath desired [it] for a seat to Himself,
“This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it.
This [is] My rest for ever and ever, Here do I sit, for I have desired it.

132.he: צֵ֭ידָהּ בָּרֵ֣ךְ אֲבָרֵ֑ךְ אֶ֝בְיוֹנֶ֗יהָ אַשְׂבִּ֥יעַֽ לָֽחֶם׃

lines.text: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.
Her provision I greatly bless, Her needy ones I satisfy [with] bread,

132.he: וְֽ֭כֹהֲנֶיהָ אַלְבִּ֣ישׁ יֶ֑שַׁע וַ֝חֲסִידֶ֗יהָ רַנֵּ֥ן יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃

lines.text: I will also clothe her priests with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.
And her priests I clothe [with] salvation, And her pious ones do sing aloud.

132.he: שָׁ֤ם אַצְמִ֣יחַ קֶ֣רֶן לְדָוִ֑ד עָרַ֥כְתִּי נֵ֝֗ר לִמְשִׁיחִֽי׃

lines.text: I will make the horn of David to bud there. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.
There I cause to spring up a horn for David, I have arranged a lamp for Mine anointed.

132.he: א֭וֹיְבָיו אַלְבִּ֣ישׁ בֹּ֑שֶׁת וְ֝עָלָ֗יו יָצִ֥יץ נִזְרֽוֹ׃

lines.text: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”
His enemies I do clothe [with] shame, And upon him doth his crown flourish!

133.he: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד הִנֵּ֣ה מַה־טּ֭וֹב וּמַה־נָּעִ֑ים שֶׁ֖בֶת אַחִ֣ים גַּם־יָֽחַד׃

lines.text: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
A Song of the Ascents, by David. Lo, how good and how pleasant The dwelling of brethren — even together!

133.he: כַּשֶּׁ֤מֶן הַטּ֨וֹב ׀ עַל־הָרֹ֗אשׁ יֹרֵ֗ד עַֽל־הַזָּקָ֥ן זְקַֽן־אַהֲרֹ֑ן שֶׁ֝יֹּרֵ֗ד עַל־פִּ֥י מִדּוֹתָֽיו׃

lines.text: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,
As the good oil on the head, Coming down on the beard, the beard of Aaron, That cometh down on the skirt of his robes,

133.he: כְּטַל־חֶרְמ֗וֹן שֶּׁיֹּרֵד֮ עַל־הַרְרֵ֪י צִ֫יּ֥וֹן כִּ֤י שָׁ֨ם ׀ צִוָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אֶת־הַבְּרָכָ֑ה חַ֝יִּ֗ים עַד־הָעוֹלָֽם׃

lines.text: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there Yahweh gives the blessing, even life forever more.
As dew of Hermon — That cometh down on hills of Zion, For there Jehovah commanded the blessing — Life unto the age!

134.he: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּעֲ֫ל֥וֹת הִנֵּ֤ה ׀ בָּרֲכ֣וּ אֶת־יְ֭הוָה כָּל־עַבְדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הָעֹמְדִ֥ים בְּבֵית־יְ֝הוָ֗ה בַּלֵּילֽוֹת׃

lines.text: Look! Praise Yahweh, all you servants of Yahweh, who stand by night in Yahweh’s house!
A Song of the Ascents. Lo, bless Jehovah, all servants of Jehovah, Who are standing in the house of Jehovah by night.
Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise Yahweh!
Lift up your hands [in] the sanctuary, And bless ye Jehovah.

134.he: יְבָרֶכְךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה מִצִיּ֑וֹן עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: May Yahweh bless you from Zion, even he who made heaven and earth.
Jehovah doth bless thee out of Zion, The maker of the heavens and earth!

135.he: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ ׀ הַֽ֭לְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה הַֽ֝לְלוּ עַבְדֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh’s name! Praise him, you servants of Yahweh,
Praise ye Jah! Praise ye the name of Jehovah, Praise, ye servants of Jehovah,

135.he: שֶׁ֣֭עֹֽמְדִים בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בְּ֝חַצְר֗וֹת בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

lines.text: you who stand in Yahweh’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.
Who are standing in the house of Jehovah, In the courts of the house of our God.

135.he: הַֽ֭לְלוּ־יָהּ כִּי־ט֣וֹב יְהוָ֑ה זַמְּר֥וּ לִ֝שְׁמ֗וֹ כִּ֣י נָעִֽים׃

lines.text: Praise Yah, for Yahweh is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.
Praise ye Jah! for Jehovah [is] good, Sing praise to His name, for [it is] pleasant.

135.he: כִּֽי־יַעֲקֹ֗ב בָּחַ֣ר ל֣וֹ יָ֑הּ יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל לִסְגֻלָּתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: For Yah has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.
For Jacob hath Jah chosen for Himself, Israel for His peculiar treasure.

135.he: כִּ֤י אֲנִ֣י יָ֭דַעְתִּי כִּי־גָד֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וַ֝אֲדֹנֵ֗ינוּ מִכָּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃

lines.text: For I know that Yahweh is great, that our Lord is above all gods.
For I have known that great [is] Jehovah, Yea, our Lord [is] above all gods.

135.he: כֹּ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־חָפֵ֥ץ יְהוָ֗ה עָ֫שָׂ֥ה בַּשָּׁמַ֥יִם וּבָאָ֑רֶץ בַּ֝יַּמִּ֗ים וְכָל־תְּהוֹמֽוֹת׃

lines.text: Whatever Yahweh pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.
All that Jehovah pleased He hath done, In the heavens and in earth, In the seas and all deep places,

135.he: מַֽעֲלֶ֣ה נְשִׂאִים֮ מִקְצֵ֪ה הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ בְּרָקִ֣ים לַמָּטָ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה מֽוֹצֵא־ר֝וּחַ מֵאֽוֹצְרוֹתָֽיו׃

lines.text: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of his treasuries.
Causing vapours to ascend from the end of the earth, Lightnings for the rain He hath made, Bringing forth wind from His treasures.

135.he: שֶֽׁ֭הִכָּה בְּכוֹרֵ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם מֵ֝אָדָ֗ם עַד־בְּהֵמָֽה׃

lines.text: He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.
Who smote the first-born of Egypt, From man unto beast.

135.he: שָׁלַ֤ח ׀ אֹת֣וֹת וּ֭מֹפְתִים בְּתוֹכֵ֣כִי מִצְרָ֑יִם בְּ֝פַרְעֹ֗ה וּבְכָל־עֲבָדָֽיו׃

lines.text: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.
He sent tokens and wonders into thy midst, O Egypt, On Pharaoh and on all his servants.

135.he: שֶֽׁ֭הִכָּה גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝הָרַ֗ג מְלָכִ֥ים עֲצוּמִֽים׃

lines.text: He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings,
Who smote many nations, and slew strong kings,

135.he: לְסִיח֤וֹן ׀ מֶ֤לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֗י וּ֭לְעוֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֑ן וּ֝לְכֹ֗ל מַמְלְכ֥וֹת כְּנָֽעַן׃

lines.text: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan,
Even Sihon king of the Amorite, And Og king of Bashan, And all kingdoms of Canaan.

135.he: וְנָתַ֣ן אַרְצָ֣ם נַחֲלָ֑ה נַ֝חֲלָ֗ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עַמּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.
And He gave their land an inheritance, An inheritance to Israel His people,

135.he: יְ֭הוָה שִׁמְךָ֣ לְעוֹלָ֑ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה זִכְרְךָ֥ לְדֹר־וָדֹֽר׃

lines.text: Your name, Yahweh, endures forever; your renown, Yahweh, throughout all generations.
O Jehovah, Thy name [is] to the age, O Jehovah, Thy memorial to all generations.

135.he: כִּֽי־יָדִ֣ין יְהוָ֣ה עַמּ֑וֹ וְעַל־עֲ֝בָדָ֗יו יִתְנֶחָֽם׃

lines.text: For Yahweh will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.
For Jehovah doth judge His people, And for His servants comforteth Himself.

135.he: עֲצַבֵּ֣י הַ֭גּוֹיִם כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗ה יְדֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃

lines.text: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
The idols of the nations [are] silver and gold, Work of the hands of man.

135.he: פֶּֽה־לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ עֵינַ֥יִם לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֽוּ׃

lines.text: They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.
A mouth they have, and they speak not, Eyes they have, and they see not,

135.he: אָזְנַ֣יִם לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יַאֲזִ֑ינוּ אַ֝֗ף אֵין־יֶשׁ־ר֥וּחַ בְּפִיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: They have ears, but they can’t hear, neither is there any breath in their mouths.
Ears they have, and they give not ear, Nose — there is no breath in their mouth!

135.he: כְּ֭מוֹהֶם יִהְי֣וּ עֹשֵׂיהֶ֑ם כֹּ֭ל אֲשֶׁר־בֹּטֵ֣חַ בָּהֶֽם׃

lines.text: Those who make them will be like them, yes, everyone who trusts in them.
Like them are their makers, Every one who is trusting in them.

135.he: בֵּ֣ית יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל בָּרֲכ֣וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה בֵּ֥ית אַ֝הֲרֹ֗ן בָּרֲכ֥וּ אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: House of Israel, praise Yahweh! House of Aaron, praise Yahweh!
O house of Israel, bless ye Jehovah, O house of Aaron, bless ye Jehovah,

135.he: בֵּ֣ית הַ֭לֵּוִי בָּרֲכ֣וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה יִֽרְאֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה בָּרֲכ֥וּ אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: House of Levi, praise Yahweh! You who fear Yahweh, praise Yahweh!
O house of Levi, bless ye Jehovah, Those fearing Jehovah, bless ye Jehovah.

135.he: בָּ֘ר֤וּךְ יְהוָ֨ה ׀ מִצִיּ֗וֹן שֹׁ֘כֵ֤ן יְֽרוּשָׁלִָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃

lines.text: Blessed be Yahweh from Zion, who dwells at Jerusalem. Praise Yah!
Blessed [is] Jehovah from Zion, Inhabiting Jerusalem — praise ye Jah!

136.he: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good; for his loving kindness endures forever.
Give ye thanks to Jehovah, For good, for to the age [is] His kindness.

136.he: ה֭וֹדוּ לֵֽאלֹהֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Give thanks to the God of gods; for his loving kindness endures forever.
Give ye thanks to the God of gods, For to the age [is] His kindness.

136.he: ה֭וֹדוּ לַאֲדֹנֵ֣י הָאֲדֹנִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Give thanks to the Lord of lords; for his loving kindness endures forever:
Give ye thanks to the Lord of lords, For to the age [is] His kindness.

136.he: לְעֹ֘שֵׂ֤ה נִפְלָא֣וֹת גְּדֹל֣וֹת לְבַדּ֑וֹ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: to him who alone does great wonders; for his loving kindness endures forever:
To Him doing great wonders by Himself alone, For to the age [is] His kindness.

136.he: לְעֹשֵׂ֣ה הַ֭שָּׁמַיִם בִּתְבוּנָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: to him who by understanding made the heavens; for his loving kindness endures forever:
To Him making the heavens by understanding, For to the age [is] His kindness.

136.he: לְרֹקַ֣ע הָ֭אָרֶץ עַל־הַמָּ֑יִם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: to him who spread out the earth above the waters; for his loving kindness endures forever:
To Him spreading the earth over the waters, For to the age [is] His kindness.

136.he: לְ֭עֹשֵׂה אוֹרִ֣ים גְּדֹלִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: to him who made the great lights; for his loving kindness endures forever:
To Him making great lights, For to the age [is] His kindness.

136.he: אֶת־הַ֭שֶּׁמֶשׁ לְמֶמְשֶׁ֣לֶת בַּיּ֑וֹם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: the sun to rule by day; for his loving kindness endures forever;
The sun to rule by day, For to the age [is] His kindness.

136.he: אֶת־הַיָּרֵ֣חַ וְ֭כוֹכָבִים לְמֶמְשְׁל֣וֹת בַּלָּ֑יְלָה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: the moon and stars to rule by night; for his loving kindness endures forever:
The moon and stars to rule by night, For to the age [is] His kindness.

136.he: לְמַכֵּ֣ה מִ֭צְרַיִם בִּבְכוֹרֵיהֶ֑ם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn; for his loving kindness endures forever;
To Him smiting Egypt in their first-born, For to the age [is] His kindness.

136.he: וַיּוֹצֵ֣א יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל מִתּוֹכָ֑ם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: and brought out Israel from among them; for his loving kindness endures forever;
And bringing forth Israel from their midst, For to the age [is] His kindness.

136.he: בְּיָ֣ד חֲ֭זָקָה וּבִזְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm; for his loving kindness endures forever:
By a strong hand, and a stretched-out-arm, For to the age [is] His kindness.

136.he: לְגֹזֵ֣ר יַם־ס֭וּף לִגְזָרִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: to him who divided the Red Sea apart; for his loving kindness endures forever;
To Him cutting the sea of Suph into parts, For to the age [is] His kindness,

136.he: וְהֶעֱבִ֣יר יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל בְּתוֹכ֑וֹ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: and made Israel to pass through the middle of it; for his loving kindness endures forever;
And caused Israel to pass through its midst, For to the age [is] His kindness,

136.he: וְנִ֘עֵ֤ר פַּרְעֹ֣ה וְחֵיל֣וֹ בְיַם־ס֑וּף כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: but overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea; for his loving kindness endures forever:
And shook out Pharaoh and his force in the sea of Suph, For to the age [is] His kindness.

136.he: לְמוֹלִ֣יךְ עַ֭מּוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: to him who led his people through the wilderness; for his loving kindness endures forever:
To Him leading His people in a wilderness, For to the age [is] His kindness.

136.he: לְ֭מַכֵּה מְלָכִ֣ים גְּדֹלִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: to him who struck great kings; for his loving kindness endures forever;
To Him smiting great kings, For to the age [is] His kindness.

136.he: וַֽ֭יַּהֲרֹג מְלָכִ֣ים אַדִּירִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: and killed mighty kings; for his loving kindness endures forever:
Yea, He doth slay honourable kings, For to the age [is] His kindness.

136.he: לְ֭סִיחוֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֑י כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Sihon king of the Amorites; for his loving kindness endures forever;
Even Sihon king of the Amorite, For to the age [is] His kindness.

136.he: וּ֭לְעוֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֑ן כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Og king of Bashan; for his loving kindness endures forever;
And Og king of Bashan, For to the age [is] His kindness.

136.he: וְנָתַ֣ן אַרְצָ֣ם לְנַחֲלָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: and gave their land as an inheritance; for his loving kindness endures forever;
And He gave their land for inheritance, For to the age [is] His kindness.

136.he: נַ֭חֲלָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עַבְדּ֑וֹ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: even a heritage to Israel his servant; for his loving kindness endures forever:
An inheritance to Israel His servant, For to the age [is] His kindness.

136.he: שֶׁ֭בְּשִׁפְלֵנוּ זָ֣כַר לָ֑נוּ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: who remembered us in our low estate; for his loving kindness endures forever;
Who in our lowliness hath remembered us, For to the age [is] His kindness.

136.he: וַיִּפְרְקֵ֥נוּ מִצָּרֵ֑ינוּ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: and has delivered us from our adversaries; for his loving kindness endures forever:
And He delivereth us from our adversaries, For to the age [is] His kindness.

136.he: נֹתֵ֣ן לֶ֭חֶם לְכָל־בָּשָׂ֑ר כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: who gives food to every creature; for his loving kindness endures forever.
Giving food to all flesh, For to the age [is] His kindness.

136.he: ה֭וֹדוּ לְאֵ֣ל הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven; for his loving kindness endures forever.
Give ye thanks to the God of the heavens, For to the age [is] His kindness!

137.he: עַ֥ל נַהֲר֨וֹת ׀ בָּבֶ֗ל שָׁ֣ם יָ֭שַׁבְנוּ גַּם־בָּכִ֑ינוּ בְּ֝זָכְרֵ֗נוּ אֶת־צִיּֽוֹן׃

lines.text: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
By rivers of Babylon — There we did sit, Yea, we wept when we remembered Zion.
On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.
On willows in its midst we hung our harps.

137.he: כִּ֤י שָׁ֨ם שְֽׁאֵל֪וּנוּ שׁוֹבֵ֡ינוּ דִּבְרֵי־שִׁ֭יר וְתוֹלָלֵ֣ינוּ שִׂמְחָ֑ה שִׁ֥ירוּ לָ֝֗נוּ מִשִּׁ֥יר צִיּֽוֹן׃

lines.text: For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”
For there our captors asked us the words of a song, And our spoilers — joy: 'Sing ye to us of a song of Zion.'

137.he: אֵ֗יךְ נָשִׁ֥יר אֶת־שִׁיר־יְהוָ֑ה עַ֝֗ל אַדְמַ֥ת נֵכָֽר׃

lines.text: How can we sing Yahweh’s song in a foreign land?
How do we sing the song of Jehovah, On the land of a stranger?
If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.
If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, my right hand forgetteth!

137.he: תִּדְבַּֽק־לְשׁוֹנִ֨י ׀ לְחִכִּי֮ אִם־לֹ֪א אֶזְכְּ֫רֵ֥כִי אִם־לֹ֣א אַ֭עֲלֶה אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַ֑ם עַ֝֗ל רֹ֣אשׁ שִׂמְחָתִֽי׃

lines.text: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.
My tongue doth cleave to my palate, If I do not remember thee, If I do not exalt Jerusalem above my chief joy.

137.he: זְכֹ֤ר יְהוָ֨ה ׀ לִבְנֵ֬י אֱד֗וֹם אֵת֮ י֤וֹם יְֽרוּשָׁ֫לִָ֥ם הָ֭אֹ֣מְרִים עָ֤רוּ ׀ עָ֑רוּ עָ֝֗ד הַיְס֥וֹד בָּֽהּ׃

lines.text: Remember, Yahweh, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”
Remember, Jehovah, for the sons of Edom, The day of Jerusalem, Those saying, 'Rase, rase to its foundation!'

137.he: בַּת־בָּבֶ֗ל הַשְּׁד֫וּדָ֥ה אַשְׁרֵ֥י שֶׁיְשַׁלֶּם־לָ֑ךְ אֶת־גְּ֝מוּלֵ֗ךְ שֶׁגָּמַ֥לְתְּ לָֽנוּ׃

lines.text: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.
O daughter of Babylon, O destroyed one, O the happiness of him who repayeth to thee thy deed, That thou hast done to us.
Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.
O the happiness of him who doth seize, And hath dashed thy sucklings on the rock!

138.he: לְדָוִ֨ד ׀ אוֹדְךָ֥ בְכָל־לִבִּ֑י נֶ֖גֶד אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲזַמְּרֶֽךָּ׃

lines.text: I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.
By David. I confess Thee, with all my heart, Before the gods I do praise Thee.

138.he: אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֨ה אֶל־הֵיכַ֪ל קָדְשְׁךָ֡ וְא֘וֹדֶ֤ה אֶת־שְׁמֶ֗ךָ עַל־חַסְדְּךָ֥ וְעַל־אֲמִתֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי־הִגְדַּ֥לְתָּ עַל־כָּל־שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ אִמְרָתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.
I bow myself toward Thy holy temple, And I confess Thy name, For Thy kindness, and for Thy truth, For Thou hast made great Thy saying above all Thy name.

138.he: בְּי֣וֹם קָ֭רָֽאתִי וַֽתַּעֲנֵ֑נִי תַּרְהִבֵ֖נִי בְנַפְשִׁ֣י עֹֽז׃

lines.text: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.
In the day I called, when Thou dost answer me, Thou dost strengthen me in my soul [with] strength.

138.he: יוֹד֣וּךָ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־מַלְכֵי־אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ אִמְרֵי־פִֽיךָ׃

lines.text: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, Yahweh, for they have heard the words of your mouth.
O Jehovah, all kings of earth confess Thee, When they have heard the sayings of Thy mouth.

138.he: וְ֭יָשִׁירוּ בְּדַרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּֽי גָ֝ד֗וֹל כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: Yes, they will sing of the ways of Yahweh, for Yahweh’s glory is great!
And they sing in the ways of Jehovah, For great [is] the honour of Jehovah.

138.he: כִּי־רָ֣ם יְ֭הוָה וְשָׁפָ֣ל יִרְאֶ֑ה וְ֝גָבֹ֗הַּ מִמֶּרְחָ֥ק יְיֵדָֽע׃

lines.text: For though Yahweh is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.
For high [is] Jehovah, and the lowly He seeth, And the haughty from afar He knoweth.

138.he: אִם־אֵלֵ֤ךְ ׀ בְּקֶ֥רֶב צָרָ֗ה תְּחַ֫יֵּ֥נִי עַ֤ל אַ֣ף אֹ֭יְבַי תִּשְׁלַ֣ח יָדֶ֑ךָ וְת֖וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי יְמִינֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.
If I walk in the midst of distress Thou quickenest me, Against the anger of mine enemies Thou sendest forth Thy hand, And Thy right hand doth save me.

138.he: יְהוָה֮ יִגְמֹ֪ר בַּ֫עֲדִ֥י יְ֭הוָה חַסְדְּךָ֣ לְעוֹלָ֑ם מַעֲשֵׂ֖י יָדֶ֣יךָ אַל־תֶּֽרֶף׃

lines.text: Yahweh will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, Yahweh, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.
Jehovah doth perfect for me, O Jehovah, Thy kindness [is] to the age, The works of Thy hands let not fall!

139.he: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִ֣ד מִזְמ֑וֹר יְהוָ֥ה חֲ֝קַרְתַּ֗נִי וַתֵּדָֽע׃

lines.text: Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know me.
To the Overseer. — A Psalm by David. Jehovah, Thou hast searched me, and knowest.

139.he: אַתָּ֣ה יָ֭דַעְתָּ שִׁבְתִּ֣י וְקוּמִ֑י בַּ֥נְתָּה לְ֝רֵעִ֗י מֵרָחֽוֹק׃

lines.text: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.
Thou — Thou hast known my sitting down, And my rising up, Thou hast attended to my thoughts from afar.

139.he: אָרְחִ֣י וְרִבְעִ֣י זֵרִ֑יתָ וְֽכָל־דְּרָכַ֥י הִסְכַּֽנְתָּה׃

lines.text: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.
My path and my couch Thou hast fanned, And [with] all my ways hast been acquainted.

139.he: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין מִ֭לָּה בִּלְשׁוֹנִ֑י הֵ֥ן יְ֝הוָ֗ה יָדַ֥עְתָּ כֻלָּֽהּ׃

lines.text: For there is not a word on my tongue, but, behold, Yahweh, you know it altogether.
For there is not a word in my tongue, Lo, O Jehovah, Thou hast known it all!

139.he: אָח֣וֹר וָקֶ֣דֶם צַרְתָּ֑נִי וַתָּ֖שֶׁת עָלַ֣י כַּפֶּֽכָה׃

lines.text: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.
Behind and before Thou hast besieged me, And Thou dost place on me Thy hand.

139.he: פלאיה דַ֣עַת מִמֶּ֑נִּי נִ֝שְׂגְּבָ֗ה לֹא־א֥וּכַֽל לָֽהּ׃

lines.text: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.
Knowledge too wonderful for me, It hath been set on high, I am not able for it.

139.he: אָ֭נָ֥ה אֵלֵ֣ךְ מֵרוּחֶ֑ךָ וְ֝אָ֗נָה מִפָּנֶ֥יךָ אֶבְרָֽח׃

lines.text: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?
Whither do I go from Thy Spirit? And whither from Thy face do I flee?

139.he: אִם־אֶסַּ֣ק שָׁ֭מַיִם שָׁ֣ם אָ֑תָּה וְאַצִּ֖יעָה שְּׁא֣וֹל הִנֶּֽךָּ׃

lines.text: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!
If I ascend the heavens — there Thou [art], And spread out a couch in Sheol, lo, Thee!

139.he: אֶשָּׂ֥א כַנְפֵי־שָׁ֑חַר אֶ֝שְׁכְּנָ֗ה בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית יָֽם׃

lines.text: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,
I take the wings of morning, I dwell in the uttermost part of the sea,

139.he: גַּם־שָׁ֭ם יָדְךָ֣ תַנְחֵ֑נִי וְֽתֹאחֲזֵ֥נִי יְמִינֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.
Also there Thy hand doth lead me, And Thy right hand doth hold me.

139.he: וָ֭אֹמַר אַךְ־חֹ֣שֶׁךְ יְשׁוּפֵ֑נִי וְ֝לַ֗יְלָה א֣וֹר בַּעֲדֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”
And I say, 'Surely darkness bruiseth me, Then night [is] light to me.

139.he: גַּם־חֹשֶׁךְ֮ לֹֽא־יַחְשִׁ֪יךְ מִ֫מֶּ֥ךָ וְ֭לַיְלָה כַּיּ֣וֹם יָאִ֑יר כַּ֝חֲשֵׁיכָ֗ה כָּאוֹרָֽה׃

lines.text: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.
Also darkness hideth not from Thee, And night as day shineth, as [is] darkness so [is] light.

139.he: כִּֽי־אַ֭תָּה קָנִ֣יתָ כִלְיֹתָ֑י תְּ֝סֻכֵּ֗נִי בְּבֶ֣טֶן אִמִּֽי׃

lines.text: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
For Thou — Thou hast possessed my reins, Thou dost cover me in my mother's belly.

139.he: אֽוֹדְךָ֗ עַ֤ל כִּ֥י נוֹרָא֗וֹת נִ֫פְלֵ֥יתִי נִפְלָאִ֥ים מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י יֹדַ֥עַת מְאֹֽד׃

lines.text: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
I confess Thee, because that [with] wonders I have been distinguished. Wonderful [are] Thy works, And my soul is knowing [it] well.

139.he: לֹא־נִכְחַ֥ד עָצְמִ֗י מִ֫מֶּ֥ךָּ אֲשֶׁר־עֻשֵּׂ֥יתִי בַסֵּ֑תֶר רֻ֝קַּ֗מְתִּי בְּֽתַחְתִּיּ֥וֹת אָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.
My substance was not hid from Thee, When I was made in secret, Curiously wrought in the lower part of earth.

139.he: גָּלְמִ֤י ׀ רָ֘א֤וּ עֵינֶ֗יךָ וְעַֽל־סִפְרְךָ֮ כֻּלָּ֪ם יִכָּ֫תֵ֥בוּ יָמִ֥ים יֻצָּ֑רוּ ולא אֶחָ֣ד בָּהֶֽם׃

lines.text: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.
Mine unformed substance Thine eyes saw, And on Thy book all of them are written, The days they were formed — And not one among them.

139.he: וְלִ֗י מַה־יָּקְר֣וּ רֵעֶ֣יךָ אֵ֑ל מֶ֥ה עָ֝צְמוּ רָאשֵׁיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!
And to me how precious have been Thy thoughts, O God, how great hath been their sum!

139.he: אֶ֭סְפְּרֵם מֵח֣וֹל יִרְבּ֑וּן הֱ֝קִיצֹ֗תִי וְעוֹדִ֥י עִמָּֽךְ׃

lines.text: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.
I recount them! than the sand they are more, I have waked, and I am still with Thee.

139.he: אִם־תִּקְטֹ֖ל אֱל֥וֹהַּ ׀ רָשָׁ֑ע וְאַנְשֵׁ֥י דָ֝מִ֗ים ס֣וּרוּ מֶֽנִּי׃

lines.text: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!
Dost Thou slay, O God, the wicked? Then, men of blood, turn aside from me!

139.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֹ֭אמְרֻךָ לִמְזִמָּ֑ה נָשֻׂ֖א לַשָּׁ֣וְא עָרֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.
Who exchange Thee for wickedness, Lifted up to vanity [are] Thine enemies.

139.he: הֲלֽוֹא־מְשַׂנְאֶ֖יךָ יְהוָ֥ה ׀ אֶשְׂנָ֑א וּ֝בִתְקוֹמְמֶ֗יךָ אֶתְקוֹטָֽט׃

lines.text: Yahweh, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?
Do not I hate, Jehovah, those hating Thee? And with Thy withstanders grieve myself?

139.he: תַּכְלִ֣ית שִׂנְאָ֣ה שְׂנֵאתִ֑ים לְ֝אוֹיְבִ֗ים הָ֣יוּ לִֽי׃

lines.text: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.
[With] perfect hatred I have hated them, Enemies they have become to me.

139.he: חָקְרֵ֣נִי אֵ֭ל וְדַ֣ע לְבָבִ֑י בְּ֝חָנֵ֗נִי וְדַ֣ע שַׂרְעַפָּֽי׃

lines.text: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.
Search me, O God, and know my heart, Try me, and know my thoughts,

139.he: וּרְאֵ֗ה אִם־דֶּֽרֶךְ־עֹ֥צֶב בִּ֑י וּ֝נְחֵ֗נִי בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ עוֹלָֽם׃

lines.text: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
And see if a grievous way be in me, And lead me in a way age-during!
To the Overseer. — A Psalm of David. Deliver me, O Jehovah, from an evil man, From one of violence Thou keepest me.

140.he: חַלְּצֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה מֵאָדָ֣ם רָ֑ע מֵאִ֖ישׁ חֲמָסִ֣ים תִּנְצְרֵֽנִי׃

lines.text: Deliver me, Yahweh, from the evil man. Preserve me from the violent man:
To the Overseer. — A Psalm of David. Deliver me, O Jehovah, from an evil man, From one of violence Thou keepest me.

140.he: אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָשְׁב֣וּ רָע֣וֹת בְּלֵ֑ב כָּל־י֝֗וֹם יָג֥וּרוּ מִלְחָמֽוֹת׃

lines.text: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.
Who have devised evils in the heart, All the day they assemble [for] wars.

140.he: שָֽׁנֲנ֣וּ לְשׁוֹנָם֮ כְּֽמוֹ־נָ֫חָ֥שׁ חֲמַ֥ת עַכְשׁ֑וּב תַּ֖חַת שְׂפָתֵ֣ימוֹ סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips.
They sharpened their tongue as a serpent, Poison of an adder [is] under their lips. Selah.

140.he: שָׁמְרֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֨ה ׀ מִ֘ידֵ֤י רָשָׁ֗ע מֵאִ֣ישׁ חֲמָסִ֣ים תִּנְצְרֵ֑נִי אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָ֝שְׁב֗וּ לִדְח֥וֹת פְּעָמָֽי׃

lines.text: Yahweh, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.
Preserve me, Jehovah, from the hands of the wicked, From one of violence Thou keepest me, Who have devised to overthrow my steps.

140.he: טָֽמְנֽוּ־גֵאִ֨ים ׀ פַּ֡ח לִ֗י וַחֲבָלִ֗ים פָּ֣רְשׂוּ רֶ֭שֶׁת לְיַד־מַעְגָּ֑ל מֹקְשִׁ֖ים שָֽׁתוּ־לִ֣י סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me.
The proud hid a snare for me — and cords, They spread a net by the side of the path, Snares they have set for me. Selah.

140.he: אָמַ֣רְתִּי לַ֭יהוָה אֵ֣לִי אָ֑תָּה הַאֲזִ֥ינָה יְ֝הוָ֗ה ק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃

lines.text: I said to Yahweh, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, Yahweh.
I have said to Jehovah, 'My God [art] Thou, Hear, Jehovah, the voice of my supplications.'

140.he: יְהֹוִ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי עֹ֣ז יְשׁוּעָתִ֑י סַכֹּ֥תָה לְ֝רֹאשִׁ֗י בְּי֣וֹם נָֽשֶׁק׃

lines.text: Yahweh, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.
O Jehovah, my Lord, strength of my salvation, Thou hast covered my head in the day of armour.

140.he: אַל־תִּתֵּ֣ן יְ֭הוָה מַאֲוַיֵּ֣י רָשָׁ֑ע זְמָמ֥וֹ אַל־תָּ֝פֵ֗ק יָר֥וּמוּ סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: Yahweh, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud.
Grant not, O Jehovah, the desires of the wicked, His wicked device bring not forth, They are high. Selah.
As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
The chief of my surrounders, The perverseness of their lips covereth them.

140.he: ימיטו עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם גֶּֽחָ֫לִ֥ים בָּאֵ֥שׁ יַפִּלֵ֑ם בְּ֝מַהֲמֹר֗וֹת בָּל־יָקֽוּמוּ׃

lines.text: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.
They cause to fall on themselves burning coals, Into fire He doth cast them, Into deep pits — they arise not.

140.he: אִ֥ישׁ לָשׁוֹן֮ בַּל־יִכּ֪וֹן בָּ֫אָ֥רֶץ אִישׁ־חָמָ֥ס רָ֑ע יְ֝צוּדֶ֗נּוּ לְמַדְחֵפֹֽת׃

lines.text: An evil speaker won’t be established in the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
A talkative man is not established in the earth, One of violence — evil hunteth to overflowing.

140.he: ידעת כִּֽי־יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יְ֭הוָה דִּ֣ין עָנִ֑י מִ֝שְׁפַּ֗ט אֶבְיֹנִֽים׃

lines.text: I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.
I have known that Jehovah doth execute The judgment of the afflicted, The judgment of the needy.

140.he: אַ֣ךְ צַ֭דִּיקִים יוֹד֣וּ לִשְׁמֶ֑ךָ יֵשְׁב֥וּ יְ֝שָׁרִ֗ים אֶת־פָּנֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.
Only — the righteous give thanks to Thy name, The upright do dwell with Thy presence!

141.he: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥ד יְהוָ֣ה קְ֭רָאתִיךָ ח֣וּשָׁה לִּ֑י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה ק֝וֹלִ֗י בְּקָרְאִי־לָֽךְ׃

lines.text: Yahweh, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.
A Psalm, by David. O Jehovah, I have called Thee, haste to me, Give ear [to] my voice when I call to Thee.

141.he: תִּכּ֤וֹן תְּפִלָּתִ֣י קְטֹ֣רֶת לְפָנֶ֑יךָ מַֽשְׂאַ֥ת כַּ֝פַּ֗י מִנְחַת־עָֽרֶב׃

lines.text: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.
My prayer is prepared — incense before Thee, The lifting up of my hands — the evening present.

141.he: שִׁיתָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה שָׁמְרָ֣ה לְפִ֑י נִ֝צְּרָ֗ה עַל־דַּ֥ל שְׂפָתָֽי׃

lines.text: Set a watch, Yahweh, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.
Set, O Jehovah, a watch for my mouth, Watch Thou over the door of my lips.

141.he: אַל־תַּט־לִבִּ֨י לְדָבָ֪ר ׀ רָ֡ע לְהִתְע֘וֹלֵ֤ל עֲלִל֨וֹת ׀ בְּרֶ֗שַׁע אֶת־אִישִׁ֥ים פֹּֽעֲלֵי־אָ֑וֶן וּבַל־אֶ֝לְחַ֗ם בְּמַנְעַמֵּיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.
Incline not my heart to an evil thing, To do habitually actions in wickedness, With men working iniquity, Yea, I eat not of their pleasant things.

141.he: יֶֽהֶלְמֵֽנִי־צַדִּ֨יק ׀ חֶ֡סֶד וְֽיוֹכִיחֵ֗נִי שֶׁ֣מֶן רֹ֭אשׁ אַל־יָנִ֣י רֹאשִׁ֑י כִּי־ע֥וֹד ו֝תְפִלָּתִ֗י בְּרָעוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.
The righteous doth beat me [in] kindness. And doth reprove me, Oil of the head my head disalloweth not, For still my prayer [is] about their vexations.

141.he: נִשְׁמְט֣וּ בִֽידֵי־סֶ֭לַע שֹׁפְטֵיהֶ֑ם וְשָׁמְע֥וּ אֲ֝מָרַ֗י כִּ֣י נָעֵֽמוּ׃

lines.text: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.
Their judges have been released by the sides of a rock, And they have heard my sayings, For they have been pleasant.

141.he: כְּמ֤וֹ פֹלֵ֣חַ וּבֹקֵ֣עַ בָּאָ֑רֶץ נִפְזְר֥וּ עֲ֝צָמֵ֗ינוּ לְפִ֣י שְׁאֽוֹל׃

lines.text: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”
As one tilling and ripping up in the land, Have our bones been scattered at the command of Saul.

141.he: כִּ֤י אֵלֶ֨יךָ ׀ יְהֹוִ֣ה אֲדֹנָ֣י עֵינָ֑י בְּכָ֥ה חָ֝סִ֗יתִי אַל־תְּעַ֥ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃

lines.text: For my eyes are on you, Yahweh, the Lord. In you, I take refuge. Don’t leave my soul destitute.
But to Thee, O Jehovah, my Lord, [are] mine eyes, In Thee I have trusted, Make not bare my soul.

141.he: שָׁמְרֵ֗נִי מִ֣ידֵי פַ֭ח יָ֣קְשׁוּ לִ֑י וּ֝מֹקְשׁ֗וֹת פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

lines.text: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.
Keep me from the gin they laid for me, Even snares of workers of iniquity.

141.he: יִפְּל֣וּ בְמַכְמֹרָ֣יו רְשָׁעִ֑ים יַ֥חַד אָ֝נֹכִ֗י עַֽד־אֶעֱבֽוֹר׃

lines.text: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by.
The wicked fall in their nets together, till I pass over!
An Instruction of David, a Prayer when he is in the cave. My voice [is] unto Jehovah, I cry, My voice [is] unto Jehovah, I entreat grace.

142.he: ק֭וֹלִי אֶל־יְהוָ֣ה אֶזְעָ֑ק ק֝וֹלִ֗י אֶל־יְהוָ֥ה אֶתְחַנָּֽן׃

lines.text: I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy.
An Instruction of David, a Prayer when he is in the cave. My voice [is] unto Jehovah, I cry, My voice [is] unto Jehovah, I entreat grace.

142.he: אֶשְׁפֹּ֣ךְ לְפָנָ֣יו שִׂיחִ֑י צָ֝רָתִ֗י לְפָנָ֥יו אַגִּֽיד׃

lines.text: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.
I pour forth before Him my meditation, My distress before Him I declare.

142.he: בְּהִתְעַטֵּ֬ף עָלַ֨י ׀ רוּחִ֗י וְאַתָּה֮ יָדַ֪עְתָּ נְֽתִיבָ֫תִ֥י בְּאֹֽרַח־ז֥וּ אֲהַלֵּ֑ךְ טָמְנ֖וּ פַ֣ח לִֽי׃

lines.text: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.
When my spirit hath been feeble in me, Then Thou hast known my path; In the way [in] which I walk, They have hid a snare for me.

142.he: הַבֵּ֤יט יָמִ֨ין ׀ וּרְאֵה֮ וְאֵֽין־לִ֪י מַ֫כִּ֥יר אָבַ֣ד מָנ֣וֹס מִמֶּ֑נִּי אֵ֖ין דּוֹרֵ֣שׁ לְנַפְשִֽׁי׃

lines.text: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.
Looking on the right hand — and seeing, And I have none recognizing; Perished hath refuge from me, There is none inquiring for my soul.

142.he: זָעַ֥קְתִּי אֵלֶ֗יךָ יְה֫וָ֥ה אָ֭מַרְתִּי אַתָּ֣ה מַחְסִ֑י חֶ֝לְקִ֗י בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הַֽחַיִּים׃

lines.text: I cried to you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
I have cried unto thee, O Jehovah, I have said, 'Thou [art] my refuge, My portion in the land of the living.'

142.he: הַקְשִׁ֤יבָה ׀ אֶֽל־רִנָּתִי֮ כִּֽי־דַלּ֪וֹתִ֫י מְאֹ֥ד הַצִּילֵ֥נִי מֵרֹדְפַ֑י כִּ֖י אָמְצ֣וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

lines.text: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.
Attend Thou unto my loud cry, For I have become very low, Deliver Thou me from my pursuers, For they have been stronger than I.

142.he: ה֘וֹצִ֤יאָה מִמַּסְגֵּ֨ר ׀ נַפְשִׁי֮ לְהוֹד֪וֹת אֶת־שְׁ֫מֶ֥ךָ בִּ֭י יַכְתִּ֣רוּ צַדִּיקִ֑ים כִּ֖י תִגְמֹ֣ל עָלָֽי׃

lines.text: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.
Bring forth from prison my soul to confess Thy name, The righteous do compass me about, When Thou conferrest benefits upon me!

143.he: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥ד יְהוָ֤ה ׀ שְׁמַ֬ע תְּפִלָּתִ֗י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה אֶל־תַּחֲנוּנַ֑י בֶּאֱמֻנָתְךָ֥ עֲ֝נֵ֗נִי בְּצִדְקָתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Hear my prayer, Yahweh. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.
A Psalm of David. O Jehovah, hear my prayer, Give ear unto my supplications, In Thy faithfulness answer me — in Thy righteousness.

143.he: וְאַל־תָּב֣וֹא בְ֭מִשְׁפָּט אֶת־עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֤י לֹֽא־יִצְדַּ֖ק לְפָנֶ֣יךָ כָל־חָֽי׃

lines.text: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.
And enter not into judgment with Thy servant, For no one living is justified before Thee.

143.he: כִּ֥י רָ֘דַ֤ף אוֹיֵ֨ב ׀ נַפְשִׁ֗י דִּכָּ֣א לָ֭אָרֶץ חַיָּתִ֑י הוֹשִׁיבַ֥נִי בְ֝מַחֲשַׁכִּ֗ים כְּמֵתֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃

lines.text: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
For an enemy hath pursued my soul, He hath bruised to the earth my life, He hath caused me to dwell in dark places, As the dead of old.

143.he: וַתִּתְעַטֵּ֣ף עָלַ֣י רוּחִ֑י בְּ֝תוֹכִ֗י יִשְׁתּוֹמֵ֥ם לִבִּֽי׃

lines.text: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.
And my spirit in me is become feeble, Within me is my heart become desolate.

143.he: זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי יָמִ֨ים ׀ מִקֶּ֗דֶם הָגִ֥יתִי בְכָל־פָּעֳלֶ֑ךָ בְּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣יךָ אֲשׂוֹחֵֽחַ׃

lines.text: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.
I have remembered days of old, I have meditated on all Thine acts, On the work of Thy hand I muse.

143.he: פֵּרַ֣שְׂתִּי יָדַ֣י אֵלֶ֑יךָ נַפְשִׁ֓י ׀ כְּאֶֽרֶץ־עֲיֵפָ֖ה לְךָ֣ סֶֽלָה׃

lines.text: I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land.
I have spread forth my hands unto Thee, My soul [is] as a weary land for Thee. Selah.

143.he: מַ֘הֵ֤ר עֲנֵ֨נִי ׀ יְהוָה֮ כָּלְתָ֪ה ר֫וּחִ֥י אַל־תַּסְתֵּ֣ר פָּנֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְ֝נִמְשַׁ֗לְתִּי עִם־יֹ֥רְדֵי בֽוֹר׃

lines.text: Hurry to answer me, Yahweh. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit.
Haste, answer me, O Jehovah, My spirit hath been consumed, Hide not Thou Thy face from me, Or I have been compared with those going down [to] the pit.

143.he: הַשְׁמִ֘יעֵ֤נִי בַבֹּ֨קֶר ׀ חַסְדֶּךָ֮ כִּֽי־בְךָ֪ בָ֫טָ֥חְתִּי הוֹדִיעֵ֗נִי דֶּֽרֶךְ־ז֥וּ אֵלֵ֑ךְ כִּֽי־אֵ֝לֶיךָ נָשָׂ֥אתִי נַפְשִֽׁי׃

lines.text: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.
Cause me to hear in the morning Thy kindness, For in Thee I have trusted, Cause me to know the way that I go, For unto Thee I have lifted up my soul.
Deliver me, Yahweh, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.
Deliver me from mine enemies, O Jehovah, Near Thee I am covered.

143.he: לַמְּדֵ֤נִי ׀ לַ֥עֲשׂ֣וֹת רְצוֹנֶךָ֮ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֪ה אֱל֫וֹהָ֥י רוּחֲךָ֥ טוֹבָ֑ה תַּ֝נְחֵ֗נִי בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִישֽׁוֹר׃

lines.text: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.
Teach me to do Thy good pleasure, For Thou [art] my God — Thy Spirit [is] good, Lead me into a land of uprightness.

143.he: לְמַֽעַן־שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה תְּחַיֵּ֑נִי בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֓ ׀ תּוֹצִ֖יא מִצָּרָ֣ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃

lines.text: Revive me, Yahweh, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.
For Thy name's sake O Jehovah, Thou dost quicken me, In Thy righteousness, Thou bringest out from distress my soul,

143.he: וּֽבְחַסְדְּךָ֮ תַּצְמִ֪ית אֹ֫יְבָ֥י וְֽ֭הַאֲבַדְתָּ כָּל־צֹרֲרֵ֣י נַפְשִׁ֑י כִּ֝֗י אֲנִ֣י עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, For I am your servant.
And in Thy kindness cuttest off mine enemies, And hast destroyed all the adversaries of my soul, For I [am] Thy servant!

144.he: לְדָוִ֨ד ׀ בָּ֘ר֤וּךְ יְהוָ֨ה ׀ צוּרִ֗י הַֽמְלַמֵּ֣ד יָדַ֣י לַקְרָ֑ב אֶ֝צְבְּעוֹתַ֗י לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃

lines.text: Blessed be Yahweh, my rock, who teaches my hands to war, and my fingers to battle:
By David. Blessed [is] Jehovah my rock, who is teaching My hands for war, my fingers for battle.

144.he: חַסְדִּ֥י וּמְצוּדָתִי֮ מִשְׂגַּבִּ֪י וּֽמְפַלְטִ֫י לִ֥י מָ֭גִנִּי וּב֣וֹ חָסִ֑יתִי הָרוֹדֵ֖ד עַמִּ֣י תַחְתָּֽי׃

lines.text: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.
My kind one, and my bulwark, My tower, and my deliverer, My shield, and in whom I have trusted, Who is subduing my people under me!
Yahweh, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?
Jehovah, what [is] man that Thou knowest him? Son of man, that Thou esteemest him?

144.he: אָ֭דָם לַהֶ֣בֶל דָּמָ֑ה יָ֝מָ֗יו כְּצֵ֣ל עוֹבֵֽר׃

lines.text: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.
Man to vanity hath been like, His days [are] as a shadow passing by.

144.he: יְ֭הוָה הַט־שָׁמֶ֣יךָ וְתֵרֵ֑ד גַּ֖ע בֶּהָרִ֣ים וְֽיֶעֱשָֽׁנוּ׃

lines.text: Part your heavens, Yahweh, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.
Jehovah, incline Thy heavens and come down, Strike against mountains, and they smoke.

144.he: בְּר֣וֹק בָּ֭רָק וּתְפִיצֵ֑ם שְׁלַ֥ח חִ֝צֶּ֗יךָ וּתְהֻמֵּֽם׃

lines.text: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.
Send forth lightning, and scatter them, Send forth Thine arrows, and trouble them,

144.he: שְׁלַ֥ח יָדֶ֗יךָ מִמָּ֫ר֥וֹם פְּצֵ֣נִי וְ֭הַצִּילֵנִי מִמַּ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים מִ֝יַּ֗ד בְּנֵ֣י נֵכָֽר׃

lines.text: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,
Send forth Thy hand from on high, Free me, and deliver me from many waters, From the hand of sons of a stranger,

144.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר פִּ֭יהֶם דִּבֶּר־שָׁ֑וְא וִֽ֝ימִינָ֗ם יְמִ֣ין שָֽׁקֶר׃

lines.text: whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
Because their mouth hath spoken vanity, And their right hand [is] a right hand of falsehood.

144.he: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים שִׁ֣יר חָ֭דָשׁ אָשִׁ֣ירָה לָּ֑ךְ בְּנֵ֥בֶל עָ֝שׂ֗וֹר אֲזַמְּרָה־לָּֽךְ׃

lines.text: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.
O God, a new song I sing to Thee, On a psaltery of ten strings I sing praise to Thee.

144.he: הַנּוֹתֵ֥ן תְּשׁוּעָ֗ה לַמְּלָ֫כִ֥ים הַ֭פּוֹצֶה אֶת־דָּוִ֥ד עַבְדּ֗וֹ מֵחֶ֥רֶב רָעָֽה׃

lines.text: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.
Who is giving deliverance to kings, Who is freeing David His servant from the sword of evil.

144.he: פְּצֵ֥נִי וְהַצִּילֵנִי֮ מִיַּ֪ד בְּֽנֵי־נֵ֫כָ֥ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר פִּ֭יהֶם דִּבֶּר־שָׁ֑וְא וִֽ֝ימִינָ֗ם יְמִ֣ין שָֽׁקֶר׃

lines.text: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
Free me, and deliver me From the hand of sons of a stranger, Because their mouth hath spoken vanity, And their right hand [is] a right hand of falsehood,

144.he: אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּנֵ֨ינוּ ׀ כִּנְטִעִים֮ מְגֻדָּלִ֪ים בִּֽנְעוּרֵ֫יהֶ֥ם בְּנוֹתֵ֥ינוּ כְזָוִיֹּ֑ת מְ֝חֻטָּב֗וֹת תַּבְנִ֥ית הֵיכָֽל׃

lines.text: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.
Because our sons [are] as plants, Becoming great in their youth, Our daughters as hewn stones, Polished — the likeness of a palace,

144.he: מְזָוֵ֣ינוּ מְלֵאִים֮ מְפִיקִ֥ים מִזַּ֗ן אֶ֫ל־זַ֥ן צֹאונֵ֣נוּ מַ֭אֲלִיפוֹת מְרֻבָּב֗וֹת בְּחוּצוֹתֵֽינוּ׃

lines.text: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.
Our garners [are] full, bringing out from kind to kind, Our flocks are bringing forth thousands, Ten thousands in our out-places,

144.he: אַלּוּפֵ֗ינוּ מְֽסֻבָּ֫לִ֥ים אֵֽין־פֶּ֭רֶץ וְאֵ֣ין יוֹצֵ֑את וְאֵ֥ין צְ֝וָחָ֗ה בִּרְחֹבֹתֵֽינוּ׃

lines.text: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.
Our oxen are carrying, there is no breach, And there is no outgoing, And there is no crying in our broad places.

144.he: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הָ֭עָם שֶׁכָּ֣כָה לּ֑וֹ אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י הָ֝עָ֗ם שֶׁיֲהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
