lines.text: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is Yahweh.
O the happiness of the people that is thus, O the happiness of the people whose God [is] Jehovah!

145.he: תְּהִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲרוֹמִמְךָ֣ אֱלוֹהַ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַאֲבָרֲכָ֥ה שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃

lines.text: I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.
Praise by David. I exalt Thee, my God, O king, And bless Thy name to the age and for ever.

145.he: בְּכָל־י֥וֹם אֲבָרֲכֶ֑ךָּ וַאֲהַלְלָ֥ה שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃

lines.text: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.
Every day do I bless Thee, And praise Thy name to the age and for ever.

145.he: גָּ֘ד֤וֹל יְהוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד וְ֝לִגְדֻלָּת֗וֹ אֵ֣ין חֵֽקֶר׃

lines.text: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
Great [is] Jehovah, and praised greatly, And of His greatness there is no searching.

145.he: דּ֣וֹר לְ֭דוֹר יְשַׁבַּ֣ח מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וּגְב֖וּרֹתֶ֣יךָ יַגִּֽידוּ׃

lines.text: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.
Generation to generation praiseth Thy works, And Thy mighty acts they declare.

145.he: הֲ֭דַר כְּב֣וֹד הוֹדֶ֑ךָ וְדִבְרֵ֖י נִפְלְאוֹתֶ֣יךָ אָשִֽׂיחָה׃

lines.text: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.
The honour — the glory of Thy majesty, And the matters of Thy wonders I declare.

145.he: וֶעֱז֣וּז נוֹרְאֹתֶ֣יךָ יֹאמֵ֑רוּ וגדולתיך אֲסַפְּרֶֽנָּה׃

lines.text: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.
And the strength of Thy fearful acts they tell, And Thy greatness I recount.

145.he: זֵ֣כֶר רַב־טוּבְךָ֣ יַבִּ֑יעוּ וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃

lines.text: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.
The memorial of the abundance of Thy goodness they send forth. And Thy righteousness they sing.

145.he: חַנּ֣וּן וְרַח֣וּם יְהוָ֑ה אֶ֥רֶךְ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם וּגְדָל־חָֽסֶד׃

lines.text: Yahweh is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.
Gracious and merciful [is] Jehovah, Slow to anger, and great in kindness.

145.he: טוֹב־יְהוָ֥ה לַכֹּ֑ל וְ֝רַחֲמָ֗יו עַל־כָּל־מַעֲשָֽׂיו׃

lines.text: Yahweh is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.
Good [is] Jehovah to all, And His mercies [are] over all His works.

145.he: יוֹד֣וּךָ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וַ֝חֲסִידֶ֗יךָ יְבָרֲכֽוּכָה׃

lines.text: All your works will give thanks to you, Yahweh. Your saints will extol you.
Confess Thee O Jehovah, do all Thy works, And Thy saints do bless Thee.

145.he: כְּב֣וֹד מַלְכוּתְךָ֣ יֹאמֵ֑רוּ וּגְבוּרָתְךָ֥ יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃

lines.text: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,
The honour of Thy kingdom they tell, And [of] Thy might they speak,

145.he: לְהוֹדִ֤יעַ ׀ לִבְנֵ֣י הָ֭אָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָ֑יו וּ֝כְב֗וֹד הֲדַ֣ר מַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.
To make known to sons of men His mighty acts, The honour of the majesty of His kingdom.

145.he: מַֽלְכוּתְךָ֗ מַלְכ֥וּת כָּל־עֹֽלָמִ֑ים וּ֝מֶֽמְשֶׁלְתְּךָ֗ בְּכָל־דּ֥וֹר וָדֽוֹר׃

lines.text: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. Yahweh is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.
Thy kingdom [is] a kingdom of all ages, And Thy dominion [is] in all generations.

145.he: סוֹמֵ֣ךְ יְ֭הוָה לְכָל־הַנֹּפְלִ֑ים וְ֝זוֹקֵ֗ף לְכָל־הַכְּפוּפִֽים׃

lines.text: Yahweh upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
Jehovah is supporting all who are falling, And raising up all who are bowed down.

145.he: עֵֽינֵי־כֹ֭ל אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְשַׂבֵּ֑רוּ וְאַתָּ֤ה נֽוֹתֵן־לָהֶ֖ם אֶת־אָכְלָ֣ם בְּעִתּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.
The eyes of all unto Thee do look, And Thou art giving to them their food in its season,

145.he: פּוֹתֵ֥חַ אֶת־יָדֶ֑ךָ וּמַשְׂבִּ֖יעַ לְכָל־חַ֣י רָצֽוֹן׃

lines.text: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
Opening Thy hand, and satisfying The desire of every living thing.

145.he: צַדִּ֣יק יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל־דְּרָכָ֑יו וְ֝חָסִ֗יד בְּכָל־מַעֲשָֽׂיו׃

lines.text: Yahweh is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.
Righteous [is] Jehovah in all His ways, And kind in all His works.

145.he: קָר֣וֹב יְ֭הוָה לְכָל־קֹרְאָ֑יו לְכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִקְרָאֻ֣הוּ בֶאֱמֶֽת׃

lines.text: Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
Near [is] Jehovah to all those calling Him, To all who call Him in truth.

145.he: רְצוֹן־יְרֵאָ֥יו יַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְֽאֶת־שַׁוְעָתָ֥ם יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע וְיוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃

lines.text: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
The desire of those fearing Him He doth, And their cry He heareth, and saveth them.

145.he: שׁוֹמֵ֣ר יְ֭הוָה אֶת־כָּל־אֹהֲבָ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־הָרְשָׁעִ֣ים יַשְׁמִֽיד׃

lines.text: Yahweh preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.
Jehovah preserveth all those loving Him, And all the wicked He destroyeth.

145.he: תְּהִלַּ֥ת יְהוָ֗ה יְֽדַבֶּ֫ר־פִּ֥י וִיבָרֵ֣ךְ כָּל־בָּ֭שָׂר שֵׁ֥ם קָדְשׁ֗וֹ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃

lines.text: My mouth will speak the praise of Yahweh. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
The praise of Jehovah my mouth speaketh, And all flesh doth bless His holy name, To the age and for ever!
Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh, my soul.
Praise ye Jah! Praise, O my soul, Jehovah.

146.he: אֲהַלְלָ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה בְּחַיָּ֑י אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה לֵֽאלֹהַ֣י בְּעוֹדִֽי׃

lines.text: While I live, I will praise Yahweh. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.
I praise Jehovah during my life, I sing praise to my God while I exist.

146.he: אַל־תִּבְטְח֥וּ בִנְדִיבִ֑ים בְּבֶן־אָדָ֓ם ׀ שֶׁ֤אֵֽין ל֥וֹ תְשׁוּעָֽה׃

lines.text: Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.
Trust not in princes — in a son of man, For he hath no deliverance.

146.he: תֵּצֵ֣א ר֭וּחוֹ יָשֻׁ֣ב לְאַדְמָת֑וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַ֝ה֗וּא אָבְד֥וּ עֶשְׁתֹּנֹתָֽיו׃

lines.text: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.
His spirit goeth forth, he returneth to his earth, In that day have his thoughts perished.

146.he: אַשְׁרֵ֗י שֶׁ֤אֵ֣ל יַעֲקֹ֣ב בְּעֶזְר֑וֹ שִׂ֝בְר֗וֹ עַל־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃

lines.text: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahweh, his God:
O the happiness of him Who hath the God of Jacob for his help, His hope [is] on Jehovah his God,

146.he: עֹשֶׂ֤ה ׀ שָׁ֘מַ֤יִם וָאָ֗רֶץ אֶת־הַיָּ֥ם וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֑ם הַשֹּׁמֵ֖ר אֱמֶ֣ת לְעוֹלָֽם׃

lines.text: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;
Making the heavens and earth, The sea and all that [is] in them, Who is keeping truth to the age,

146.he: עֹשֶׂ֤ה מִשְׁפָּ֨ט ׀ לָעֲשׁוּקִ֗ים נֹתֵ֣ן לֶ֭חֶם לָרְעֵבִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה מַתִּ֥יר אֲסוּרִֽים׃

lines.text: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. Yahweh frees the prisoners.
Doing judgment for the oppressed, Giving bread to the hungry.

146.he: יְהוָ֤ה ׀ פֹּ֘קֵ֤חַ עִוְרִ֗ים יְ֭הוָה זֹקֵ֣ף כְּפוּפִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה אֹהֵ֥ב צַדִּיקִֽים׃

lines.text: Yahweh opens the eyes of the blind. Yahweh raises up those who are bowed down. Yahweh loves the righteous.
Jehovah is loosing the prisoners, Jehovah is opening (the eyes of) the blind, Jehovah is raising the bowed down, Jehovah is loving the righteous,

146.he: יְהוָ֤ה ׀ שֹׁ֘מֵ֤ר אֶת־גֵּרִ֗ים יָת֣וֹם וְאַלְמָנָ֣ה יְעוֹדֵ֑ד וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים יְעַוֵּֽת׃

lines.text: Yahweh preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.
Jehovah is preserving the strangers, The fatherless and widow He causeth to stand, And the way of the wicked He turneth upside down.

146.he: יִמְלֹ֤ךְ יְהוָ֨ה ׀ לְעוֹלָ֗ם אֱלֹהַ֣יִךְ צִ֭יּוֹן לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֗ר הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃

lines.text: Yahweh will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise Yah!
Jehovah doth reign to the age, Thy God, O Zion, to generation and generation, Praise ye Jah!

147.he: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ ׀ כִּי־ט֭וֹב זַמְּרָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ כִּֽי־נָ֝עִים נָאוָ֥ה תְהִלָּֽה׃

lines.text: Praise Yah, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.
Praise ye Jah! For [it is] good to praise our God, For pleasant — comely [is] praise.

147.he: בּוֹנֵ֣ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה נִדְחֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל יְכַנֵּֽס׃

lines.text: Yahweh builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.
Building Jerusalem [is] Jehovah, The driven away of Israel He gathereth.

147.he: הָ֭רֹפֵא לִשְׁב֣וּרֵי לֵ֑ב וּ֝מְחַבֵּ֗שׁ לְעַצְּבוֹתָֽם׃

lines.text: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
Who is giving healing to the broken of heart, And is binding up their griefs.

147.he: מוֹנֶ֣ה מִ֭סְפָּר לַכּוֹכָבִ֑ים לְ֝כֻלָּ֗ם שֵׁמ֥וֹת יִקְרָֽא׃

lines.text: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.
Appointing the number of the stars, To all them He giveth names.

147.he: גָּד֣וֹל אֲדוֹנֵ֣ינוּ וְרַב־כֹּ֑חַ לִ֝תְבוּנָת֗וֹ אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר׃

lines.text: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.
Great [is] our Lord, and abundant in power, Of His understanding there is no narration.

147.he: מְעוֹדֵ֣ד עֲנָוִ֣ים יְהוָ֑ה מַשְׁפִּ֖יל רְשָׁעִ֣ים עֲדֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: Yahweh upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.
Jehovah is causing the meek to stand, Making low the wicked unto the earth.

147.he: עֱנ֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה בְּתוֹדָ֑ה זַמְּר֖וּ לֵאלֹהֵ֣ינוּ בְכִנּֽוֹר׃

lines.text: Sing to Yahweh with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,
Answer ye to Jehovah with thanksgiving, Sing ye to our God with a harp.

147.he: הַֽמְכַסֶּ֬ה שָׁמַ֨יִם ׀ בְּעָבִ֗ים הַמֵּכִ֣ין לָאָ֣רֶץ מָטָ֑ר הַמַּצְמִ֖יחַ הָרִ֣ים חָצִֽיר׃

lines.text: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.
Who is covering the heavens with clouds, Who is preparing for the earth rain, Who is causing grass to spring up [on] mountains,

147.he: נוֹתֵ֣ן לִבְהֵמָ֣ה לַחְמָ֑הּ לִבְנֵ֥י עֹ֝רֵ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִקְרָֽאוּ׃

lines.text: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.
Giving to the beast its food, To the young of the ravens that call.

147.he: לֹ֤א בִגְבוּרַ֣ת הַסּ֣וּס יֶחְפָּ֑ץ לֹֽא־בְשׁוֹקֵ֖י הָאִ֣ישׁ יִרְצֶֽה׃

lines.text: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
Not in the might of the horse doth He delight, Not in the legs of a man is He pleased.

147.he: רוֹצֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אֶת־יְרֵאָ֑יו אֶת־הַֽמְיַחֲלִ֥ים לְחַסְדּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Yahweh takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.
Jehovah is pleased with those fearing Him, With those waiting for His kindness.

147.he: שַׁבְּחִ֣י יְ֭רוּשָׁלִַם אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה הַֽלְלִ֖י אֱלֹהַ֣יִךְ צִיּֽוֹן׃

lines.text: Praise Yahweh, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!
Glorify, O Jerusalem, Jehovah, Praise thy God, O Zion.

147.he: כִּֽי־חִ֭זַּק בְּרִיחֵ֣י שְׁעָרָ֑יִךְ בֵּרַ֖ךְ בָּנַ֣יִךְ בְּקִרְבֵּֽךְ׃

lines.text: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.
For He did strengthen the bars of thy gates, He hath blessed thy sons in thy midst.

147.he: הַשָּׂם־גְּבוּלֵ֥ךְ שָׁל֑וֹם חֵ֥לֶב חִ֝טִּ֗ים יַשְׂבִּיעֵֽךְ׃

lines.text: He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.
Who is making thy border peace, [With] the fat of wheat He satisfieth Thee.

147.he: הַשֹּׁלֵ֣חַ אִמְרָת֣וֹ אָ֑רֶץ עַד־מְ֝הֵרָ֗ה יָר֥וּץ דְּבָרֽוֹ׃

lines.text: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.
Who is sending forth His saying [on] earth, Very speedily doth His word run.

147.he: הַנֹּתֵ֣ן שֶׁ֣לֶג כַּצָּ֑מֶר כְּ֝פ֗וֹר כָּאֵ֥פֶר יְפַזֵּֽר׃

lines.text: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.
Who is giving snow like wool, Hoar-frost as ashes He scattereth.

147.he: מַשְׁלִ֣יךְ קַֽרְח֣וֹ כְפִתִּ֑ים לִפְנֵ֥י קָ֝רָת֗וֹ מִ֣י יַעֲמֹֽד׃

lines.text: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?
Casting forth His ice like morsels, Before His cold who doth stand?

147.he: יִשְׁלַ֣ח דְּבָר֣וֹ וְיַמְסֵ֑ם יַשֵּׁ֥ב ר֝וּח֗וֹ יִזְּלוּ־מָֽיִם׃

lines.text: He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
He sendeth forth His word and melteth them, He causeth His wind to blow — the waters flow.

147.he: מַגִּ֣יד דברו לְיַעֲקֹ֑ב חֻקָּ֥יו וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטָ֗יו לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

lines.text: He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.
Declaring His words to Jacob, His statutes and His judgments to Israel.

147.he: לֹ֘א עָ֤שָׂה כֵ֨ן ׀ לְכָל־גּ֗וֹי וּמִשְׁפָּטִ֥ים בַּל־יְדָע֗וּם הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃

lines.text: He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise Yah!
He hath not done so to any nation, As to judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye Jah!

148.he: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ ׀ הַֽלְל֣וּ אֶת־יְ֭הוָה מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֑יִם הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בַּמְּרוֹמִֽים׃

lines.text: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!
Praise ye Jah! Praise ye Jehovah from the heavens, Praise ye Him in high places.
Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army!
Praise ye Him, all His messengers, Praise ye Him, all His hosts.

148.he: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ שֶׁ֣מֶשׁ וְיָרֵ֑חַ הַ֝לְל֗וּהוּ כָּל־כּ֥וֹכְבֵי אֽוֹר׃

lines.text: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!
Praise ye Him, sun and moon, Praise ye Him, all stars of light.

148.he: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ שְׁמֵ֣י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ֝הַמַּ֗יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר ׀ מֵעַ֬ל הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

lines.text: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, you waters that are above the heavens.
Praise ye Him, heavens of heavens, And ye waters that are above the heavens.

148.he: יְֽ֭הַֽלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י ה֖וּא צִוָּ֣ה וְנִבְרָֽאוּ׃

lines.text: Let them praise Yahweh’s name, for he commanded, and they were created.
They do praise the name of Jehovah, For He commanded, and they were created.

148.he: וַיַּעֲמִידֵ֣ם לָעַ֣ד לְעוֹלָ֑ם חָק־נָ֝תַ֗ן וְלֹ֣א יַעֲבֽוֹר׃

lines.text: He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.
And He establisheth them for ever to the age, A statute He gave, and they pass not over.
Praise Yahweh from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths;
Praise ye Jehovah from the earth, Dragons and all deeps,

148.he: אֵ֣שׁ וּ֭בָרָד שֶׁ֣לֶג וְקִיט֑וֹר ר֥וּחַ סְ֝עָרָ֗ה עֹשָׂ֥ה דְבָרֽוֹ׃

lines.text: lightning and hail, snow and clouds; stormy wind, fulfilling his word;
Fire and hail, snow and vapour, Whirlwind doing His word;
mountains and all hills; fruit trees and all cedars;
The mountains and all heights, Fruit tree, and all cedars,
wild animals and all livestock; small creatures and flying birds;
The wild beast, and all cattle, Creeping thing, and winged bird,
kings of the earth and all peoples; princes and all judges of the earth;
Kings of earth, and all peoples, Chiefs, and all judges of earth,
both young men and maidens; old men and children:
Young men, and also maidens, Aged men, with youths,

148.he: יְהַלְל֤וּ ׀ אֶת־שֵׁ֬ם יְהוָ֗ה כִּֽי־נִשְׂגָּ֣ב שְׁמ֣וֹ לְבַדּ֑וֹ ה֝וֹד֗וֹ עַל־אֶ֥רֶץ וְשָׁמָֽיִם׃

lines.text: let them praise Yahweh’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
They praise the name of Jehovah, For His name alone hath been set on high, His honour [is] above earth and heavens.

148.he: וַיָּ֤רֶם קֶ֨רֶן ׀ לְעַמּ֡וֹ תְּהִלָּ֤ה לְֽכָל־חֲסִידָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֣י יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל עַֽם־קְרֹב֗וֹ הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃

lines.text: He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise Yah!
And He exalteth the horn of His people, The praise of all His saints, Of the sons of Israel, a people near Him. Praise ye Jah!

149.he: הַ֥לְלוּיָ֨הּ ׀ שִׁ֣ירוּ לַֽ֭יהוָה שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ תְּ֝הִלָּת֗וֹ בִּקְהַ֥ל חֲסִידִֽים׃

lines.text: Praise Yahweh! Sing to Yahweh a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.
Praise ye Jah! Sing ye to Jehovah a new song, His praise in an assembly of saints.

149.he: יִשְׂמַ֣ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל בְּעֹשָׂ֑יו בְּנֵֽי־צִ֝יּ֗וֹן יָגִ֥ילוּ בְמַלְכָּֽם׃

lines.text: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
Israel doth rejoice in his Maker, Sons of Zion do joy in their king.

149.he: יְהַֽלְל֣וּ שְׁמ֣וֹ בְמָח֑וֹל בְּתֹ֥ף וְ֝כִנּ֗וֹר יְזַמְּרוּ־לֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!
They praise His name in a dance, With timbrel and harp sing praise to Him.

149.he: כִּֽי־רוֹצֶ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה בְּעַמּ֑וֹ יְפָאֵ֥ר עֲ֝נָוִ֗ים בִּישׁוּעָֽה׃

lines.text: For Yahweh takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.
For Jehovah is pleased with His people, He beautifieth the humble with salvation.
Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.
Exult do saints in honour, They sing aloud on their beds.

149.he: רוֹמְמ֣וֹת אֵ֭ל בִּגְרוֹנָ֑ם וְחֶ֖רֶב פִּֽיפִיּ֣וֹת בְּיָדָֽם׃

lines.text: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,
The exaltation of God [is] in their throat, And a two-edged sword in their hand.
to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;
To do vengeance among nations, Punishments among the peoples.

149.he: לֶאְסֹ֣ר מַלְכֵיהֶ֣ם בְּזִקִּ֑ים וְ֝נִכְבְּדֵיהֶ֗ם בְּכַבְלֵ֥י בַרְזֶֽל׃

lines.text: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
To bind their kings with chains, And their honoured ones with fetters of iron,

149.he: לַעֲשׂ֤וֹת בָּהֶ֨ם ׀ מִשְׁפָּ֬ט כָּת֗וּב הָדָ֣ר ה֭וּא לְכָל־חֲסִידָ֗יו הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃

lines.text: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise Yah!
To do among them the judgment written, An honour it [is] for all his saints. Praise ye Jah!

150.he: הַ֥לְלוּיָ֨הּ ׀ הַֽלְלוּ־אֵ֥ל בְּקָדְשׁ֑וֹ הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בִּרְקִ֥יעַ עֻזּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Praise Yah! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!
Praise ye Jah! Praise ye God in His holy place, Praise Him in the expanse of His strength.
Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!
Praise Him in His mighty acts, Praise Him according to the abundance of His greatness.

150.he: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ בְּתֵ֣קַע שׁוֹפָ֑ר הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בְּנֵ֣בֶל וְכִנּֽוֹר׃

lines.text: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!
Praise Him with blowing of trumpet, Praise Him with psaltery and harp.

150.he: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ בְּתֹ֣ף וּמָח֑וֹל הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בְּמִנִּ֥ים וְעוּגָֽב׃

lines.text: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!
Praise Him with timbrel and dance, Praise Him with stringed instruments and organ.
Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!
Praise Him with cymbals of sounding, Praise Him with cymbals of shouting.
Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!
All that doth breathe doth praise Jah! Praise ye Jah!
